title: Account Management Specialist
company: Talent Corner HR Services Pvt Ltd
description:
**About the Role**

A Pharma company is seeking an experienced and result-oriented Accounts & Finance Manager to independently manage the company's accounting and finance operations, statutory compliance, taxation and audit functions. The ideal candidate will have strong financial management experience, sound knowledge of regulatory requirements and preferably experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Accounts & Financial Management**

* Manage day-to-day accounting and overall financial operations.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger and bank reconciliations.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements.
* Monitor cash flow, working capital, budgeting and financial planning.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records and entries.

**2. Statutory Compliance & Taxation**

* Ensure timely GST, TDS and Income Tax filings and related compliance.
* Handle GST reconciliations, tax assessments and supporting documentation.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with tax consultants, auditors and relevant authorities.
* Track changes in taxation and financial regulations and ensure timely implementation.

**3. Audit & Internal Controls**

* Manage and coordinate internal, statutory and tax audits.
* Coordinate with external auditors and provide required financial records and explanations.
* Establish and maintain effective internal financial controls and accounting procedures.
* Identify financial discrepancies, risks and compliance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure audit readiness and timely closure of audit observations.

**4. Financial Reporting & MIS**

* Prepare monthly MIS reports and financial performance statements.
* Analyse revenue, expenses, profitability and cost-control measures.
* Present clear financial reports and insights to management.
* Support management with financial analysis and strategic decision-making.

**5. Team & Department Management**

* Supervise and guide the accounts and finance team.
* Set processes and ensure timely completion of accounting and reporting activities.
* Improve departmental efficiency, accuracy and accountability.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, medical devices, surgical products or pharma distribution is preferred.
* Knowledge of inventory accounting, stock valuation and batch-wise inventory management will be an added advantage.
* Familiarity with industry-specific statutory and regulatory requirements is desirable.

**Required Skills & Eligibility**

* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Accounts and Finance.
* CA / MBA (Finance) or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, GST, TDS, Income Tax and statutory compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to independently handle audits, taxation and financial reporting.
* Working proficiency in Tally / ERP / SAP and MS Excel.
* Strong analytical, leadership, communication and problem-solving skills.

**Compensation**

Up to ₹10 LPA, based on the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience and overall suitability.

title: IT Finance Analyst
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented finance professional to join our global IT Finance team. You will support capital expenditure tracking, expense and budget reconciliation, and vendor invoice processes, and you will work closely with stakeholders across global offices and external vendors. The role suits someone who enjoys working with data, managing recurring reporting cycles, and improving finance processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage CapEx tracking and reporting: reconcile capital expenditure requests and maintain reporting dashboards. Volumes are higher during annual budgeting cycles.
* Create and maintain CapEx codes and requests in the planning system for global offices.
* Reconcile CapEx spend and invoice data each month, including multi-currency validation (USD and local currencies).
* Extract, clean and map monthly actuals from the ERP system and update expense reporting dashboards.
* Run plan-vs-actual reconciliations, including annualised forecasts, across major IT cost categories.
* Run the monthly vendor invoice approval process and resolve invoice queries with vendors and the accounts payable team.
* Identify opportunities to automate and streamline recurring finance processes.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5–7 years of experience in finance, FP&A, IT finance or financial operations
* Hands-on experience with EPM/ERP systems, ideally Oracle EPM and SAP
* Strong Excel skills: data cleansing, lookups, mapping and reconciliations
* Experience building or maintaining Power BI dashboards
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 tools, including SharePoint
* A clear understanding of CapEx vs. OpEx, budgeting cycles and multi-currency reconciliation
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to meet recurring weekly, monthly and annual deadlines
* Clear communication skills for working with global stakeholders and external vendors

title: Senior Analyst/Manager- Valuation
description:
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.

Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.

We are looking for a Senior Analyst / Manager to join our Valuation team. In this role, you will build, calibrate, and maintain pricing models across complex asset classes — including credit default swaps (CDS), interest rate swaps (IRS), fixed income bonds, and inflation swaps and independently verify the fair value of client portfolios against market and model benchmarks. This is a high-visibility, individual-contributor role with direct exposure to trading desks, risk managers, and fund controllers at our client organizations, and with room to grow into a review/mentoring capacity

**What you'll do:**

* Design, build, and maintain independent pricing models for CDS, IRS, government and corporate bonds, and inflation swaps (zero-coupon and year-on-year), incorporating appropriate curve construction, discounting, and day-count conventions.
* Perform daily, weekly, and month-end Independent Price Verification (IPV) by comparing internal/front-office marks against independent market data sources (e.g., Bloomberg BVAL, IHS Markit, ICE Data Services, Refinitiv) and internally derived model prices.
* Investigate and resolve pricing breaks and tolerance exceptions; document root causes, assumptions, and remediation in line with the firm's valuation policy. Provide explanation of PNL attributable to different components of pricing.
* Calibrate and stress-test yield curves, credit curves (hazard-rate stripping), and inflation curves used across the pricing library; validate model outputs against theoretical and market benchmarks.
* Prepare valuation reserve and fair-value hierarchy (ASC 820 / IFRS 13) analysis and support quarterly valuation committee packs for client funds.
* Partner with trading, risk, product control, and technology teams to enhance and automate the valuation model library, improving accuracy, coverage, and turnaround time.
* Support internal and external audit, regulatory, and client due-diligence requests by providing clear, well-documented explanations of pricing methodology.
* Contribute to process improvement and automation initiatives, including migrating manual valuation workflows to Python/SQL-based tooling.
* Rates & Credit Derivatives: Interest rate swaps, basis swaps, swaptions, credit default swaps (single-name and index), total return swaps.
* Inflation Products: Zero-coupon and year-on-year inflation swaps, inflation-linked bonds.
* Fixed Income: Government and corporate bonds, floating rate notes, convertible bonds, and other cash instruments.

**What you'll need:**

* 3–6 years of experience in valuation, independent price verification, product control, or quantitative risk — at an investment bank, hedge fund, asset manager, fund administrator, or independent valuation vendor.
* Strong working knowledge and application of derivative pricing and fixed income mathematics: discounting/OIS curves, curve bootstrapping, hazard-rate models for credit, and inflation curve construction.
* Hands-on experience building or maintaining pricing models for at least two of: CDS, IRS, bonds, or inflation swaps.
* Proficiency in Excel/VBA; working knowledge of Python and/or SQL for model development and automation.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative finance field.
* Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex valuation concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* CFA, FRM is big plus
* Familiarity with third-party pricing and analytics platforms such as Bloomberg (BVAL), IHS Markit.
* Prior experience with fair value hierarchy classification (ASC 820 / IFRS 13) and valuation governance frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with FinCad is a strong advantage
* Experience working directly with buy-side clients (hedge funds, asset managers) or within a fund administration / valuation control environment.

title: Senior Analyst, FP&A (Technology)
description:
**Department:**
Finance

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Work Hours:**
Hybrid | 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Reports to:**
Senior Manager, Finance Business Partner — Product & Technology

**About Cvent**

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with a suite of solutions that help organizations manage the entire event lifecycle. Our mission is to transform the way meetings and events are planned, executed, and evaluated globally.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a strategic, analytically strong FP&A professional to join our team as a Senior Analyst I or II (level based on experience) – FP&A, supporting the Product & Technology mini-CFO in business partnering with Cvent's Product, Engineering, Cloud/DevOps and IT organizations.

Product & Technology is one of Cvent's largest investment areas. This role sits at the intersection of the product roadmap and the P&L: you will help leaders understand how engineering capacity, cloud hosting, software and tooling spend translate into product cost, margin and return. You will help Product, Technology and Finance leaders answer the core questions: what does each product cost to build and run, what does it return, and where should the next engineering and cloud dollar go.

You will drive core planning processes — annual operating plan, rolling forecasts and monthly spend tracking — and build the financial analysis behind investment decisions, from business cases through post-investment tracking. The ideal candidate can independently structure ambiguous problems across new datasets and stakeholders, and turn them into clear recommendations for senior leaders.

**AI Overview**

AI is an integral part of how this role works. You will use AI tools (e.g. Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to enhance efficiencies by automating reports, prepare dashboards for product leaders, perform spend analysis, improve forecasting accuracy, build business cases for new product development/ feature enhancements, and run scenario and sensitivity analysis, while validating outputs for accuracy.

This role involves frequent interaction with senior leaders across Product, Technology, IT, Accounting and Corporate Finance teams based in the U.S. and India.

**Key Responsibilities**

Product P&L, Planning & Spend Management (primary focus)

* Prepare and maintain the product P&L, including monthly and quarterly refreshes, variance analysis and commentary, to inform investment and scaling decisions for each product.
* Support the mini-CFO in translating product roadmaps and technology plans into the annual operating plan and rolling forecasts, with run-rate visibility and driver-based links between operational metrics and financial results.
* Maintain and improve allocation methodologies for shared R&D, platform, hosting and IT costs so that product-level profitability is reliable and consistent.
* Analyze opex and capex, and closely monitor headcount, contractor spend, software and licenses, and cloud hosting costs.
* Develop and track key Product & Technology efficiency metrics, including:
* R&D and Tech spend as a % of revenue
* Product contribution margin and gross margin by product
* Cloud hosting cost as a % of revenue and unit cost (per customer / event / registrant)
* Fully loaded cost per engineering FTE and contractor mix
* Software capitalization rate
* Total cost of ownership (TCO) and payback on approved investments

Cloud Cost & Optimization

* Work with Cloud/DevOps teams to improve cloud cost transparency, tagging and unit economics.
* Help leadership identify, size and deliver cost optimization opportunities across hosting, software, licenses and vendors.

Investments & Capital Planning

* Build business cases, in partnership with Product and Technology leaders, for new products, feature enhancements, platform modernization and tooling — using NPV/IRR, payback and ROI, including build-vs-buy comparisons, to guide prioritization and trade-offs.
* Track approved investments against their business cases, including benefits realized, total cost of ownership and post-investment performance.
* Support software capitalization and capex tracking, working with Accounting to ensure policy compliance.

Reporting, Automation & Cross-functional Work

* Design and automate KPI packs, product profitability views and investment performance dashboards for leadership, and present insights confidently to non-financial and senior audiences.
* Simplify recurring work to cut manual effort and improve accuracy, including through the use of AI tools.
* Lead or support ad-hoc strategic projects, including integration of acquired products into the product P&L and consolidation of technology and vendor costs.
* Extract and analyze data using tools like Adaptive Planning, Excel, BI platforms, cloud billing data and Jira.

**Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of experience in FP&A, business finance, or financial modelling, ideally at a technology/SaaS company or a multinational. Exceptional candidates outside this range will be considered.
* **Preferred background (either path works):**
  experience in a technology/SaaS organization either (a) in Finance partnering with R&D, Engineering, Cloud or IT, or (b) in Technology/IT finance, FinOps or cost analytics — with real exposure to how product and technology spend drives P&L outcomes.
* CA, MBA (Finance) or CIMA preferred; a commerce, economics or engineering graduate with strong FP&A experience will also be considered.
* Advanced Excel modelling, including P&L and scenario models, sensitivity analysis and clean, auditable model design.
* Understanding of SaaS P&L structure and cost allocation for shared R&D, platform and hosting costs.
* Working knowledge of software capitalization (ASC 350-40) and capex vs. opex treatment.
* Familiarity with cloud billing and cost management (AWS/Azure cost tools, FinOps practices) is a strong plus.
* Working knowledge of planning and BI tools such as Workday Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, Sigma, Tableau or Power BI; SQL is a plus.
* Hands-on proficiency with AI tools (e.g. Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to automate reporting, perform variance and data analysis, build financial models and support research.
* Strong data-driven mindset and the ability to structure and interpret large, imperfect datasets to generate insights.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including explaining financial results to non-finance stakeholders; proven ability to work closely with senior leaders is strongly preferred.
* Strong drive, curiosity, and willingness to learn.

title: Independent Director
description:
**The mandate follows a component through its entire consequence chain**

The Audit and Risk Chair must be able to begin with a customer programme and follow it through design, sourcing, tooling, production, quality, dispatch, cash and field performance. Each stage can change the accounts and the risk profile. The Board is looking for a director who can identify where optimistic commercial assumptions, operational evidence and financial judgement diverge.

**Programme economics**

Material nominations should show expected volume and mix, customer schedules, price-reset clauses, development responsibility, tooling ownership, localisation, working capital, qualification and downside. Engineering change and customer recovery must enter forecasts promptly. The Chair will examine whether revenue, margins and capital are supported by acceptance and cash rather than programme optimism.

**Supply network**

Critical materials, components and processes should be mapped beyond immediate suppliers. Sole-source exposure, financial fragility, geopolitical restrictions, counterfeit prevention, long lead times, obsolescence and alternate qualification belong in Board risk. Inventory buffers will be judged against cash, redesign and shelf-life consequences.

**Quality and field risk**

The committee will receive evidence on process capability, internal and external defects, concessions, rework, line stoppage, warranty, field events and corrective action. A recurring small defect can be strategically material before the provision is large. Traceability should survive plants, systems and subcontractors.

**Financial and control remit**

The Audit agenda includes inventory, capex, revenue, provisions, customer debit notes, foreign exchange, government incentives where applicable, related parties, procurement integrity, fraud and IT access. Post-investment reviews should distinguish equipment installed, capacity qualified, utilisation achieved and cash return realised.

**Cyber-physical and continuity risk**

Plant systems, engineering repositories, remote vendor access and customer data require integrated governance. The Chair will seek evidence of segmentation, access, backup, restoration and safe manual operation. A cyber scenario should consider quality, shipment, customer notification and financial reporting—not only system recovery.

**NRC and CSR connection**

As an NRC member, the director will examine succession for operations, quality, engineering, finance and commercial leadership and whether incentives encourage escalation. CSR oversight will focus on measurable outcomes, responsible sourcing and plant-community integrity.

**Entry assignment and candidate profile**

The Chair's first assignment will trace one material programme from bid case to current cash and field performance, then use the gaps to reset Audit and Risk agendas. Candidates should bring senior automotive, industrial, finance, audit, quality or enterprise-risk leadership. Dual-chair experience is preferred. Independence, DIN, databank compliance and willingness to visit plants are mandatory.

**How the two committees will decide**

Audit will determine whether reported positions and controls are supportable; Risk will determine whether the exposure remains acceptable and what action is required. The same evidence may produce different decisions. The Chair must preserve that distinction, ensure conclusions are reconciled at Board level and prevent a favourable accounting treatment from being presented as proof that the underlying risk is well managed.

title: Associate, Turnaround & Restructuring Services
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
  
  
The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
  
  
Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.
  
  
The Associate, Turnaround Restructuring Services (TRS) role at Portage Point represents a unique opportunity to drive meaningful impact on complex, high-stakes client challenges. As a key contributor within our TRS practice, this Associate will support the full spectrum of restructuring, distressed advisory and operational transformation work – from situational assessment and stabilization initiatives, restructuring strategy development and overall financial and operational value creation plan execution. This Associate, TRS will report to the local TRS Director and will execute discrete workstreams on client engagements, contribute to proposal development and collaborate with cross-functional partners in Office of the CFO, Transaction Execution Services, Investment Banking and Transaction Advisory Services teams. If you thrive in a high-performance culture and want to help build the future of a rapidly growing consultancy, this is the right role for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with senior team members and clients to support complex operational and financial challenges across the business lifecycle including formulating business plan and liquidity assessments and implementing cost reduction, value creation, business transformation and performance improvement plans, and if necessary, contingency planning and Chapter 11 bankruptcy preparation / execution
* Analyze financial statements and key operational data; build models such as three-statement forecasts, thirteen-week cash flows (TWCFs), and value creation scenarios
* Contribute to restructuring workstreams including DIP sizing, Chapter 11 filing prep, vendor analysis, SOAL / SOFAs, MORs, KPI tracking, retention plans, liquidation analyses, headcount forecasts, GL review, footprint rationalization, S&OP, organizational design and go-to-market strategy
* Identify and re-allocate resources to operational, growth, financial and strategic initiatives with highest risk adjusted return
* Develop detailed financial projections and business plans
* Create high-impact deliverables including business plan materials, liquidity projections, analysis of strategic alternatives, KPIs, financial updates and board-ready reporting for executives, investors and creditors
* Contribute to a high-performing, inclusive and values-driven culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* Three plus years of experience at a top-tier advisory firm serving U.S. clients, with hands-on exposure to business operations and Chapter 11 restructuring
* Proven ability to build three-statement models, TWCFs, dynamic KPI dashboards and complex ad hoc analyses
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Analyst, Corporate Accounting
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Unit Overview:**
BlackRock Finance and Strategy (F&S) consist of professionals in disciplines such as Controllers, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Treasury, Tax, Financial Controls, Global Strategic Sourcing, Strategy, and Corporate Development. Within the Controllers’ Group, this role is part of the wider Global Corporate Consolidation & Control team which has a broad and varied remit including reporting monthly Income Statement and Balance Sheet positions, accounting for corporate transactions and repatriations, intercompany settlements, maintenance of global intercompany loans, global ownership of ARCS (a Balance Sheet verification process) and control of the general ledger & consolidation over month-end. In its day-to-day activities, the intercompany team has significant interaction with Finance teams globally, such as Legal Entity Controllers and Treasury, as well as the other Finance teams.
  
  
**Purpose/Background**
This role sits within the Global Corporate Consolidation & Control team and supports the integrity of BlackRock’s intercompany accounting processes across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. The Analyst will partner with Regional Controllers, Treasury, and Tax to ensure accurate, timely, and controlled intercompany & consolidation reporting within Oracle Cloud.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Intercompany Accounting & Close**
Support a high-volume, multi-entity close in a fast-paced environment, directly working with the EMEA-based intercompany team (predominantly based in Edinburgh)
  
  

* Verifying manual settlements for global intercompany positions.
* Submitting manual settlements for payment
* Preparing/posting multi-currency journals for manual settlements in line with the month-end calendar
* Perform balance sheet reconciliations including responsibility for providing suitable documentation and clearing reconciling items on a timely basis
* Proactively investigate and resolve intercompany breaks across the Group

**Corporate Consolidation**

* Support the Corporate Consolidation team (based in Gurgaon) with performing group level consolidations and validations
* Support maintenance and changes within the legal entity hierarchy as required
* Participate in project work for the Corporate Control team to support legal entity acquisitions, restructures, rationalisations and UAT testing within the consolidation system (FCCS).

**Controls & Governance**

* Provide commentary and metrics on balance sheet movements for month-end reporting purposes and senior management
* Ensure compliance with US GAAP and internal accounting policies
* Act as a point of contact and support audit requests and walkthroughs
* Actively identify and remediate control gaps and process inefficiencies

**Process Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to streamline Corporate Control & Intercompany processes across the BlackRock Group
* Support automation initiatives (e.g., reconciliation tooling, template standardisation)
* Utilise AI solutions for process enhancements and enhancing controls by proposing and sharing best practices
* Participate in project work across the Corporate Control team, including UAT testing and supporting strategic projects

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build relationships with other Finance teams to ensure that all stakeholders’ reporting requirements are met in a complete and timely manner
* Liaise with regional controllership and functional teams to resolve intercompany breaks
* undefined
* Other ad hoc tasks as required

**Development Value**
This position offers significant development opportunities within the Global Corporate Consolidation & Control team, which is responsible for a broad range of accounting, reporting, and control activities across multiple regions. The role provides exposure to Global F&S partners, including Entity Controllers, Treasury, Corporate Cash and Corporate Cost teams.
  
  
In addition to strengthening core technical accounting and intercompany expertise, the role provides:
  
  

* Experience with process automation initiatives, including opportunities to work with AI‑enabled tools, workflow automation, and data‑quality improvements.
* The ability to build capability in evaluating, testing, and enhancing new technological solutions used within Finance.
* Development of cross‑functional communication skills through interaction with teams globally.
* Opportunities to lead or support transformation projects, enhancing both analytical skills and project‑delivery experience.
* Broader Corporate Control exposure, enabling progression into roles across reporting, controls management, systems accounting, or process transformation disciplines.

**Experience/Competencies**

* Ability to clearly and confidently communicate in verbal and written form with colleagues of different levels.
* Self-starter, highly numerate, quick learner, team player, with an ability to adjust to change and the desire to take on responsibility is required.
* Experience of working in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment would be an advantage
* Organised and methodical, possessing attention to detail, good analytical skills and the ability to work to tight deadlines.
* Takes ownership of deliverables and proactively escalates risks

**Skills/Qualifications**

* Part qualified accountant or qualification through experience preferred
* 2–3 years of accounting experience (Ideally the successful candidate would have Financial Services or large corporate experience)
* Exposure to intercompany, reconciliations, or financial close preferred
* Strong Excel and data handling capability
* Prior experience of working with ERP systems (such as Oracle) and AI tools is desirable

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Content Manager - Research (Real Estate)
description:
**Position Summary**
*The primary output of this research is the transcript: a written record of each human-moderated interview, published on GLG's Library, our access-controlled research platform, for use by institutional investors.*
The Content Manager serves as the Real Estate subject matter expert within the Real Estate pod and owns its expert research content coverage. The role identifies the companies, themes and investor questions that warrant coverage; defines and validates the Network Member profiles needed; designs differentiated interview agendas; leads human-moderated one-to-one interviews; and develops recurring programs for execution by Associates. The Content Manager reviews content for research quality and relevance and works with Associates and Compliance through publication.
  
  
The role requires an investor mindset and deep knowledge of Real Estate, including its major property types, companies, value chain, financial statements, operating drivers, market cycles and current debates. The Content Manager must also understand relevant credit, private-market and other investor perspectives well enough to assess the category broadly; ask incisive questions; challenge superficial answers; and produce content that leaves investors materially better informed.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Coverage ownership and research agenda**

* Set and maintain the research agenda for Real Estate, including priority companies, themes, catalysts, investor debates and underserved information needs.
* Identify emerging themes, inflection points and content gaps early, connecting macro, sector and sub-sector developments to company-level implications.
* Translate earnings calls, conferences, market events, client demand and usage signals into timely interviews and recurring content programs for Real Estate.
* Use a shared research foundation to develop several distinct conversations on the same company or topic without producing repetitive content.

**Network Member strategy and interview leadership**

* Build and maintain a map of the roles, organizations, value-chain positions and geographies needed to answer priority research questions.
* Define and validate Network Member profiles, screening criteria and briefing context that distinguish direct visibility from nominal seniority.
* Design investor-focused interview agendas and questions that go beyond public commentary and generate original insight.
* Lead human-moderated one-to-one interviews, listening actively, probing inconsistencies and redirecting the conversation toward material investor questions.

**Structured programs, quality and collaboration**

* Define the research objective, respondent criteria, question sets and cadence for channel checks and other recurring structured programs within Real Estate.
* Brief Associates executing those programs, review representative output and determine whether it meets substantive research and quality standards.
* Work with Associates and Compliance to resolve substantive questions and carry approved content through publication.
* Capture company briefs, Network Member knowledge, question frameworks and findings in reusable form to strengthen future coverage of Real Estate.
* Collaborate across the sector pod when sub-sector, asset-class, regional or thematic perspectives would materially improve the research, and contribute to team ideation, knowledge sharing and quality calibration.
* Use AI-enabled research and moderation tools to deepen preparation and improve efficiency, applying judgment to validate outputs.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in equity or credit research, buy-side or sell-side analysis, research services, strategy consulting, corporate strategy, primary research or an expert network.
* Deep expertise across real estate property types and markets, preferably developed through public-equity, commercial real estate or comparable fundamental research, with sufficient familiarity across credit, private-market and other relevant investor perspectives to assess the category broadly.
* Experience producing research or insight for institutional investors or another sophisticated financial audience.
* Strong working knowledge of financial statements, operating drivers and the performance indicators relevant to Real Estate.
* Strong interest in financial markets, company and industry analysis, and business dynamics, with the intellectual curiosity and discipline to maintain deep expertise within Real Estate.
* Demonstrated ability to translate research objectives into incisive, investor-relevant questions designed to generate differentiated insight.
* Excellent verbal communication and live-interviewing skills, including the ability to probe beyond surface-level responses and challenge senior operators in real time.
* Strong written English and research judgment, with the ability to distinguish incremental insight from general commentary.
* Ability to own Real Estate independently, collaborate effectively within the Financials & Real Estate pod, and deliver high-quality work at speed in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Independent ownership of company, industry or thematic research within Real Estate that informed an investment, strategy or operating decision.
* Direct exposure to expert interviews, earnings or market-event analysis, or senior-level research discussions.
* Relevant language skills, local-market knowledge, transaction experience or technical credentials for specialist mandates.
* MBA, CFA, CA or a relevant graduate or technical qualification.

**About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group**
GLG is the world’s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.
  
  
At GLG, you are an extension of our clients' core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry’s most trusted research environment, you’ll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes.
  
  
We are a global team of pragmatic problem-solvers who mirror the intensity of the markets we serve. If you are driven by intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action, join us in reinventing the industry we invented.
  
  
Gerson Lehrman Group, Inc. (“GLG”) is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, race, religion, color, marital status, disability, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Financial Accountant II - Blackline
description:
This role is responsible for the timely and accurate execution of general ledger accounting activities for Canada-based entities (CO\_1000, CO\_1020) within the scope of the India Finance Shared Services Center (FSSC), including payroll-related journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and statutory tax filings support, in accordance with US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles. This role is also responsible for administering user access, workflows, and audit documentation on the BlackLine reconciliation platform
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Prepares and posts the recurring Canada Bi-Weekly Payroll journal entry (CO\_1020) from the auto-load interface, verifying successful posting and manually correcting any rejected entries
* Prepares and posts the Canada Payroll & APC Accrual, APC Charge/Expense, PTO Liability, and RRSP Clearing journal entries based on inputs provided by the payroll team
* Prepares and posts the Canada RSU Reclass journal entry (CO\_1000) to reclass or write off RSU accrual to the appropriate expense account
* Prepares and posts the Canada Cash Clearing and Payroll Reclass journal entries for CO\_1020
* Prepares and posts the GRIR Reclass journal entry (CO\_1000)
* Prepares and posts the Canada DPSP True-Up, DPSP Clearing, Workers’ Compensation True-Up, and Medical Burden True-Up journal entries
* Prepares and posts the CRA and Quebec Tax Assessment entry, reclassifying sales tax receivables to prepaid expense
* Performs quarterly balance sheet reconciliations for 13 payroll-related general ledger accounts under CO\_1020, including Prepaid Payroll, Salaries and Wages, Workers Compensation, Social Security, Profit Sharing, PTO, Payroll Tax Payable (Federal and State), Fringe Benefits, Medical/Dental/Vision Benefits, and 401(k) Payable

**BlackLine System Administration**

* Provisions BlackLine access for new users and deactivates access for terminated users, reviewing headcount reports to confirm timely deactivation
* Assigns and reassigns reconciliation accounts to the appropriate users and configures journal workflows in BlackLine
* Prepares ITGC 5 and ITGC 7A audit documentation and obtains approvals from the designated approvers
* Provides sample documentation to support ITGC 4A, ITGC 4B, and mitigation ticket audits
* Prepares the monthly SAP vs. BlackLine reconciliation to identify and resolve differences between the two systems, and sends reminders to team members for pending reconciliations and outstanding tasks
* Prepares and posts the Canada Employer Health Tax Expense and Employer Health Tax Accrual journal entries in line with annual statutory requirements

**What You Bring**

* Chartered Accountant or CPA or CMA
* 4-6 years of relevant experience in payroll accounting, general ledger accounting, or reconciliations, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Finance Shared Services experience in a large multinational company with a high-volume, performance-driven environment preferred
* Large ERP system experience — SAP preferred
* Experience with BlackLine required
* Prior exposure to Canadian payroll and statutory tax filings is an advantage
* Determines the appropriate resolution of routine journal entry and reconciliation discrepancies within established policies and procedures
* Escalates significant reconciliation, control, or audit-related matters to the Immediate Supervisor for review and decision
* Recommends process improvements to journal entry, reconciliation, and BlackLine administration workflows
* Strong working knowledge of the BlackLine reconciliation platform, including system administration, user access provisioning, and workflow configuration
* Solid understanding of US GAAP and general ledger accounting, including payroll accruals, reconciliations, and month-end close processes
* Working exposure to Canadian payroll, tax, and statutory reporting requirements, including CRA, Quebec sales tax, and Employer Health Tax
* Strong working knowledge of SAP or an equivalent ERP system for journal entry preparation and posting
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines across monthly, quarterly, and annual cycles
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills for interacting with team members, auditors, and business partners
* Strong analytical and problem-solving background
* Fluent (both orally and in writing) in English

**Who We Are:**
For 70 years, Bio-Rad has focused on advancing the discovery process and transforming the fields of science and healthcare. As one of the top five life science companies, we are a global leader in developing, manufacturing, and marketing a broad range of high-quality research and clinical diagnostic products. We help people everywhere live longer, healthier lives. Recently voted a Best Place to Work, Bio-Rad offers a unique employee experience with collaborative teams that span the globe. Here, you are supported by leadership to build your career and are empowered to drive change that makes an impact you can see.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Bio-Rad's biggest asset is its people, and the reason why our Total Rewards deliver programs that provide value, quality, and inclusivity while satisfying the diverse needs of our evolving workforce. Our robust offerings serve to enrich the overall health, wealth, and wellbeing of our employees through the various stages of an employee’s work and life cycle. We’re proud to offer a variety of options, including competitive insurance plans for you and your immediate family, Annual Health checkup , Marriage Leave, Paternity Leave ,Employee Assistance Programme , extensive learning and development opportunities, and more.
  
  
**EEO Statement:**
Bio-Rad is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer, and we welcome candidates of all backgrounds. Veterans, people with disabilities, and people of all races, ethnicities, genders, ages, and orientations are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**Agency Non-Solicitation:**

title: Senior Specialist, Product Management
description:

Senior Specialist, Product Management
  
  
**Overview**
This Senior Specialist role in Product Management will support the commercialisation and sales expansion of Operational Reports across one of the five global regions. The role will focus on driving product adoption, identifying customer pain points, supporting sales enablement, and contributing to the development of commercialization strategies. The individual will work closely with regional ACS teams and the Global Product Management team to ensure alignment between product capabilities and market needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Collaborate with ACS teams to support product commercialisation efforts and drive customer engagement
  
  
Assist in identifying short-term and long-term whitespace opportunities and new use cases based on customer feedback and market trends
  
  
Support internal and external partnership initiatives to accelerate go-to-market efforts
  
  
Contribute to pricing strategy discussions and help quantify product value for customers
  
  
Monitor product adoption and usage metrics, and support initiatives to improve customer engagement
  
  
Assist in developing KPIs and tools to track commercialization success
  
  
Contribute to the creation of region-specific commercial constructs and go-to-market strategies
  
  
Develop customer value narratives and case studies to support sales conversations
  
  
Partner with regional teams to create and deliver sales training materials
  
  
Build strong working relationships across cross-functional teams to support commercialization goals
  
  
**All About You**
2+ years of product management experience with a focus on go-to-market, pricing, and commercialisation in technology or data-driven solutions; experience in payments or financial services is preferred. Experience in Python and SQL is preferred.
  
  
Strong customer orientation and commercial acumen
  
  
Exposure to API and AI-based product commercialization is a plus
  
  
Ability to support strategic product initiatives and contribute to business transformation
  
  
Analytical mindset with a focus on solving customer problems and supporting sales efforts
  
  
Understanding of competitive landscape and industry trends
  
  
Experience working in cross-functional teams and managing multiple priorities
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in business or related field; MBA or equivalent experience is a plus
  
  
Prior experience in strategy consulting or product commercialization is beneficial
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders

title: Manager_Financial Reporting_Taxation_Audits
description:
***This position is only for Chartered Accountants, Non CA or CA INTER candidates, kindly do not apply. This position is based in New Delhi NCR. Outstation candidates shall not be considered.***

**About Octagona India**

Octagona India Private Limited (www.octagona.co) is a leading management consultancy firm providing end-to-end business solutions to companies establishing and expanding operations in India. Our services span market entry strategy, business development, legal and tax advisory, and human resources management. We are committed to delivering excellence and creating lasting value for our clients. Our Head Office is located in Jasola, South Delhi, with branch offices in Pune and Bangalore, and an international presence in Italy and the USA. We're part of the Bonfiglioli Consulting Group of Italy.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Chartered Accountant to lead the finance, accounting, taxation and compliance function of Octagona India from our New Delhi head office. The ideal candidate will own the company's financial reporting, ensure timely and accurate tax and statutory compliance, and manage all audit processes, while acting as a trusted finance partner to the Director and senior management. The role also supports Octagona's international clients in navigating Indian financial, tax and regulatory requirements. This position calls for a detail-oriented professional with strong technical depth, sound commercial judgement and the confidence to interface with auditors, regulators, group entities in Italy and clients from across Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Financial Accounting & Reporting***

•    Oversee day-to-day accounting operations of the Company, including general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, and project/client-wise revenue and cost tracking.

•    Prepare and finalise monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) / applicable Indian GAAP and the Companies Act, 2013.

•    Prepare management MIS, variance analyses, profitability reports (by service line, client and office) and dashboards for the Director and senior leadership.

•    Support the preparation of consolidated and group reporting packages as required by Bonfiglioli Consulting Group, Italy, including timely responses to Group queries and deadlines.

•    Ensure proper revenue recognition, provisioning, accruals, fixed asset accounting and period-end closing procedures.

•    Maintain robust documentation and audit trails for all financial transactions.

***Taxation & Statutory Compliance***

•    Ensure timely and accurate compliance under the Income Tax Act, including advance tax computation, TDS/TCS deductions, deposits, quarterly returns and annual income tax return filing.

•    Manage end-to-end GST compliance: monthly/quarterly returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B), input tax credit reconciliation (GSTR-2B), annual return and reconciliation statement, and multi-state registrations (Delhi, Maharashtra, Karnataka).

•    Handle tax assessments, notices, scrutiny proceedings and appeals, coordinating with external tax counsel where required.

•    Manage transfer pricing compliance for transactions with group and related entities, including benchmarking support, documentation and Form 3CEB.

•    Ensure compliance under FEMA and RBI regulations for cross-border transactions, foreign inward remittances, intercompany invoicing and related reporting (FIRC/FIRA, Form 15CA/15CB, etc.).

•    Track regulatory and tax law changes, assess their impact on the company, and advise management proactively.

***Audit & Assurance***

•    Coordinate and manage statutory audit, tax audit and any group or limited-review audits, serving as the primary point of contact for auditors.

•    Prepare audit schedules, supporting documents and responses to audit queries within agreed timelines; ensure timely closure of audit observations.

•    Design, implement and periodically review internal financial controls (IFC) and SOPs to safeguard company assets and minimise risk.

•    Coordinate internal audits, track recommendations and ensure corrective actions are implemented.

•    Support due diligence exercises, valuations and audits connected with group restructuring, new office set-ups or investments.

***Budgeting, Planning & Treasury***

•    Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process in consultation with business heads; monitor actual performance against budget and recommend corrective measures.

•    Manage cash flow planning, working capital, collections and vendor payments to maintain healthy liquidity.

•    Oversee banking relationships, foreign currency receipts, hedging considerations and treasury operations.

•    Evaluate pricing, project costing and profitability of proposals and engagements in coordination with business development teams.

•    Provide financial inputs for strategic decisions such as service line expansion, new office openings and investments.

***Client Finance & Advisory Support***

•    Support Octagona's client companies (particularly European and Italian entities) with finance, tax and compliance guidance during and after their India market entry.

•    Assist clients with company incorporation-related financial requirements, capital infusion, FDI/FEMA reporting, accounting set-up and statutory registrations (PAN, TAN, GST, etc.).

•    Contribute to financial due diligence, financial modelling, tax structuring and cost analysis for client engagements and proposals.

•    Review outsourced accounting and compliance deliverables, where applicable, to ensure accuracy, quality and timeliness.

•    Act as a finance point of contact for international clients and group colleagues, ensuring clear communication and local regulatory support.

***Team Leadership & Process Improvement***

•    Lead, mentor and develop the accounts and finance team, including interns and article assistants, and ensure clear allocation of duties and deadlines.

•    Manage relationships with external professionals, including auditors, tax consultants, company secretaries and legal advisers.

•    Drive automation and digitisation of finance processes, including accounting software optimisation, reconciliation tools and reporting templates.

•    Establish and maintain a compliance calendar and ensure zero-default filings across all offices.

•    Implement policies for expense management, travel reimbursements, vendor onboarding and approval workflows.

***Auxiliary Responsibilities***

•    Coordinate with other colleagues on payroll processing, salary structuring, full-and-final settlements and employee tax declarations.

•    Support management with contract reviews from a financial and tax perspective (client agreements, vendor contracts, leases, intercompany agreements).

•    Oversee insurance, asset registers, procurement and vendor payment processes.

•    Assist in preparing financial sections of investor, bank, group and board presentations.

•    Maintain confidentiality of financial and client data and ensure data security in finance operations.

•    Undertake any other finance, compliance or administrative responsibilities assigned by management from time to time.

**Qualifications & Skills**

•    Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA); additional qualifications such as CS, CMA, DISA, IFRS/ACCA certification or an MBA in Finance are a plus though not mandatory.

•    6 – 9 years of post-qualification experience in accounting, taxation, audit and compliance, including at least 2 -3 years in a senior or managerial role.

•    Prior experience in a reputed consulting firm, CA firm, Big 4, multinational subsidiary or professional services organisation is strongly preferred.

•    Strong knowledge of Indian accounting standards (Ind AS), the Companies Act, 2013, Income Tax Act, GST laws, FEMA, and transfer pricing regulations.

•    Proven experience handling statutory and tax audits, tax assessments and regulatory filings end to end.

•    Exposure to international or group reporting and cross-border transactions (experience with European / Italian entities is an advantage).

•    Hands-on experience with accounting/ERP software (such as Tally Prime, Zoho Books, SAP or equivalent) and advanced proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office Suite.

•    Strong analytical, financial modelling and MIS-reporting skills with the ability to convert data into actionable business insights.

•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

•    Strong leadership, integrity and ethical judgement, with the ability to take ownership and make sound decisions under pressure.

•    High attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines and balance internal finance priorities with client deliverables in a fast-paced consulting environment.

•    Collaborative and approachable, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels, from interns to the Director and international stakeholders.

•    Adaptability, a problem-solving mindset and a willingness to learn and grow with a growing, multi-office organisation.

**What We Offer**

•    Competitive salary and medical insurance package (post probation).

•    Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership and a diverse, talented team in India and Italy

•    Exposure to international clients, cross-border transactions and group-level reporting.

•    Career growth and development opportunities.

•    A collaborative and inclusive work environment.

•    Opportunity to travel to Italy for business purposes as and when deemed necessary.

**Joining Period:**
Within December 2026

title: Accountant
description:
**Type:**
Full-time (with at least 5-6 hours of overlap in CST)
  
  
**Location:**
Remote, India
  
  
**Company:**
Sanctuary
  
  
**Compensation:**
up to $2000 USD per month
  
  
**About Us**
Sanctuary builds nature - led, wellness - centered communities that feel alive. Our first 135-acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:
  
  
🌱 Non-toxic materials
  
  
💧 Clean water and filtration systems
  
  
⚡ EMF-conscious design
  
  
🌿 135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning
  
  
🏗️ Masonry construction
  
  
We are a global team (spread across 8 countries) of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it’s not just where people live - it’s how they live.
  
  
Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.
  
  
****The role****
Sanctuary is a US-based construction and development company operating across 7 to 8 US entities with different payment structures, plus an India entity based in Delhi. We are looking for a precise, ownership-driven Accountant to own the books for both our US and India entities.
  
  
Your first major task will be reconciling Sanctuary’s financial records in QuickBooks across the past 3 years. That means reviewing historical records, identifying discrepancies, and getting everything fully reconciled and up to date. From there, you will assist our finance team and own day-to-day accounting, payables, cash flow, and compliance across both countries.
  
  
This role is for someone who can walk into a fast-moving environment, figure out what needs to be done, and do it. If you need step-by-step direction or a ready-made SOP on day one, this role is not for you.
  
  
This is not a clock-in, clock-out role.
  
  
It is not basic bookkeeping.
  
  
It is not consolidating numbers someone else has already organized.
  
  
****What you’ll own****

* Full ownership of the books across all US entities in QuickBooks Online and the India entity in Tally: entries, categorization, and accuracy
* Reconciling the past 3 years of records: backtracking all invoices paid to date, identifying outstanding amounts, and flagging what is still owed, to whom, and by when
* Tracking and managing all incoming and outgoing invoices across entities, including construction-side payments previously managed by the team
* Accounts payable end to end: knowing exactly which payments are due, to whom, and when
* Intercompany transactions and reconciliation between the US and India entities
* Consolidation of books of accounts between holding companies and subsidiaries
* Supporting the team in maintaining a forward-looking cash flow tracker so the team always knows what payments are coming and can communicate proactively with consultants and vendors if timelines shift
* Reconciling bank transactions, payment confirmations, and internal records regularly and accurately, with no missed entries and no approximations
* India payroll bookkeeping and coordination on statutory compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, PT, MCA filings) end to end, including coordination with any vendors on ground.
* Supporting documentation for construction draw applications and other external financial processes
* Flagging gaps, inconsistencies, and risks before they become problems

****What we’re looking for****

* 4 to 8 years of full-cycle accounting experience across both India and US books. That means not just bookkeeping and not just compliance, but both.
* Deep proficiency in QuickBooks Online (non-negotiable)
* Strong working knowledge of Tally
* Hands-on experience handling India statutory payroll compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, PT) yourself, not just overseeing a CA or vendor who does it
* Experience in managing accounts and consolidation for multiple entities simultaneously
* Obsessive attention to detail: you don’t miss large entries, and you don’t miss small ones either
* Strong written and verbal English. You will coordinate regularly with US-based founders and consultants.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and high comfort using AI tools to automate and streamline workflows
* Experience with US real estate or construction accounting, including draw applications

****What success looks like****
*At 30 days:*

* You have gone through QuickBooks across all active US entities and the India entity’s books, and you know exactly what is in there and what is not
* You have a clear, accurate picture of every outstanding invoice: who is owed, how much, and since when
* You know the India entity’s compliance calendar and its current status
* You have flagged anything broken, missing, or at risk
* You have started building a cash flow tracker the team can actually use to plan and communicate future payments
* The team now relies on your support in obtaining and updating the numbers in the cash flow tracker.

*At 90 days:*

* The 3-year reconciliation is complete, or on a clear path to completion with known gaps documented
* Books across both countries are current, and month-end is running on your own rhythm
* The team no longer has to chase you. You are the one coming to them.

****Who this role is for****

* You find a messy set of books and feel the urge to fix it, not avoid it.
* You are highly proactive, communicate smartly and very proactively, own your mistakes, and don’t let things fall through the cracks.
* You catch things others miss.
* You look at a situation and figure out what to do next
* You don't just flag a problem and pass it on. You think through possible solutions, come with a proposed approach, and check if you're heading in the right direction rather than relying on the team to figure it out for you.
* You understand that in a company like this, being late is sometimes unavoidable, but being silent about it is not acceptable.

**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**South Asia Region Context**
The South Asia Region, comprising Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, is at a pivotal stage of development. Rapid economic growth, driven by urbanization and demographic trends, has reduced poverty, but significant disparities persist. The region also faces growing climate risks, environmental pollution, informality, and low female labor force participation.
  
  
Sustained, private sector-led growth, anchored in investments in infrastructure, logistics, energy, and connectivity, is critical to creating jobs for South Asia’s sizeable youth population. At the same time, continued investment in human capital is needed to equip people for the jobs of the future.
  
  
The South Asia Infrastructure program supports countries in building sustainable, resilient, and inclusive infrastructure systems through an integrated, cross-sectoral approach to growth, job creation, connectivity, resilience, and service delivery. Infrastructure engagements increasingly combine public and private sector solutions, including collaboration across the World Bank Group, to maximize development impact.
  
  
India, the largest economy in South Asia, is undergoing a profound urban and economic transformation. Meeting the country’s growing demand for sustainable mobility, efficient logistics systems, and climate-resilient infrastructure will be important for improving access to jobs and services, enhancing competitiveness, supporting decarbonization, and attracting private investment. The World Bank Group’s engagement in India increasingly calls for integrated solutions that combine public and private financing, policy reform, institutional strengthening, and collaboration with IFC and MIGA.
  
  
**Transport And Logistics Practice**
The Transport and Logistics Practice supports efficient, safe, resilient, and low-carbon connectivity across road, rail, urban transport, maritime transport, inland waterways, and aviation. Working with public and private sector partners, it combines investment and policy support to improve access, trade, economic integration, and the performance of transport services and supply chains.
  
  
In India, the Practice’s urban transport program promotes compact, connected, inclusive, and low-carbon development through better public transport, multimodal integration, transit-oriented development, electric mobility, safer streets, stronger institutions, and sustainable financing. The program brings together lending, analytics, technical assistance, policy dialogue, and partnerships with national, state, and city governments.
  
  
**About The Position**
ISAT1 seeks to recruit an Urban Transport Specialist (GF), based in New Delhi, to support the preparation and implementation of urban mobility operations and analytical and advisory work in India and, as needed, elsewhere in South Asia. The position requires a strong combination of urban transport expertise, operational capability, client engagement, analytical judgment, and the ability to work effectively across disciplines and institutions.
  
  
The selected candidate will be expected to contribute materially to the design and delivery of complex programs, including public transport and institutional reform, urban rail and bus systems, integrated mobility, electric mobility, accessibility and inclusion, climate resilience, road safety, digitalization, infrastructure financing, and private sector participation. The Specialist will work closely with government counterparts, World Bank Group teams, development partners, consultants, and other stakeholders, and will report to the Practice Manager for Transport and Logistics in South Asia.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
The Urban Transport Specialist will perform a full range of technical, operational, analytical, and coordination functions, including but not limited to the following:
  
  

* Urban Transport Operations
* Support and, as appropriate, lead or co-lead the identification, preparation, appraisal, and implementation of lending and non-lending activities in urban transport.
* Contribute to project design, results frameworks, implementation arrangements, cost and economic analysis, risk assessment, procurement planning, and implementation support.
* Help resolve implementation bottlenecks and provide practical, timely advice to clients on institutional, technical, contractual, and operational issues.
* Work with environmental, social, procurement, financial management, legal, and other specialists to ensure integrated and high-quality project delivery.
* Monitor progress, results, risks, disbursements, and agreed actions, and prepare concise, decision-useful reporting for task teams and management.
* Technical and Policy Support
* Provide technical advice on urban mobility planning, public transport networks and operations, urban rail and bus systems, multimodal integration, first- and last-mile connectivity, walking and cycling, transit-oriented development, and demand management.
* Support reforms related to public transport institutions, governance, service contracting, fare policy, funding and financing, data systems, performance management, and service quality.
* Contribute to electric mobility programs, including public transport electrification, enabling infrastructure, institutional arrangements, and coordination with energy and private sector stakeholders.
* Integrate climate mitigation and resilience, road safety, gender, universal accessibility, social inclusion, and environmental considerations into transport strategies and investments.
* Assess opportunities for private capital mobilization and innovative financing, including PPPs, blended finance, guarantees, land value capture, and collaboration with IFC and MIGA, where appropriate.
* Analytics, Knowledge, and Innovation
* Lead or contribute to analytical and advisory work, policy notes, investment frameworks, sector diagnostics, and city-level mobility studies.
* Collect, assess, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data; use evidence to diagnose mobility constraints, compare options, and formulate implementable recommendations.
* Promote the use of digital tools, geospatial analysis, transport modeling, open data, and other technologies where they improve planning, operations, monitoring, or user outcomes.
* Prepare clear technical reports, briefing notes, presentations, talking points, and other knowledge products for varied technical and senior audiences.
* Share lessons across projects, cities, countries, and Global Practice networks, and contribute to knowledge events and professional communities.
* Client Engagement and Partnerships
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with national ministries, state governments, urban local bodies, transport authorities, operators, development partners, private sector participants, academia, and civil society.
* Participate in policy dialogue and technical discussions, providing evidence-based and practical advice that is responsive to client priorities and implementation capacity.
* Plan and support missions, workshops, consultations, training activities, and high-level visits, including timely documentation and follow-up.
* Coordinate effectively across World Bank Group practices and institutions to develop integrated solutions relevant to India’s urban transformation.
* Team Contribution
* Work collaboratively in diverse, multidisciplinary, and geographically dispersed teams, contributing constructively to shared outcomes.
* Guide consultants and junior colleagues, review technical outputs, and contribute to quality assurance and capacity development.
* Support country and regional strategy work and other Transport and Logistics Practice priorities, including assignments outside the immediate urban transport portfolio when required.
* Undertake other related responsibilities assigned by the Practice Manager.

Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master’s degree or higher in transport planning, transport or civil engineering, urban planning, economics, public policy, finance, or a closely related field.
* At least 5 years of progressively responsible professional experience in urban transport, with demonstrated experience in project preparation, implementation, and/or advisory work.
* Substantial experience in at least three of the following areas: public transport planning and reform; urban rail or bus systems; integrated and multimodal mobility; electric mobility; active mobility and road safety; transport institutions and policy; infrastructure financing or private sector participation.
* Experience working with national, state, or city governments on complex transport programs. Experience in India or comparable federal and rapidly urbanizing settings is highly desirable.

**Technical And Operational Capabilities**

* Strong understanding of urban mobility systems, including the interactions among land use, accessibility, public transport, non-motorized transport, road networks, technology, institutions, financing, and user needs.
* Demonstrated ability to translate technical analysis into practical project design, policy advice, and implementable actions.
* Experience managing or supporting complex infrastructure or service-delivery projects, including coordination across technical, fiduciary, environmental, social, and institutional dimensions.
* Familiarity with economic and financial analysis, procurement and contract management, results monitoring, and risk management in infrastructure projects.
* Experience with World Bank or other MDB operations is desirable. Familiarity with IPF, PforR, or other development finance instruments would be an advantage.

**Client, Communication, And Team Skills**

* Excellent client orientation and the ability to build trust, work through differing perspectives, and provide candid, evidence-based advice in complex institutional settings.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, including the ability to present complex issues clearly and concisely to technical and senior audiences.
* Proven ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.
* Strong judgment, initiative, attention to detail, resourcefulness, and results orientation.
* Ability to mentor colleagues, manage consultants, and contribute to an inclusive and collaborative working environment.

**Critical Success Factors**

* Sound understanding of India’s urban transport challenges, institutions, and political economy, with the ability to identify feasible pathways for reform and investment.
* Capacity to connect technical quality with implementation realities, financing constraints, institutional incentives, and user outcomes.
* Ability to move comfortably between detailed operational work and higher-level strategic and policy dialogue.
* Credibility with clients and colleagues, combined with humility, collaboration, and a strong focus on results.
* Commitment to sustainable, safe, resilient, inclusive, and low-carbon urban mobility.

**WBG and Transport GP Competencies**
The position requires strong alignment with World Bank Group Core Competencies, including Deliver Results for Clients, Collaborate Within Teams and Across Boundaries, Lead and Innovate, Create, Apply and Share Knowledge, and Make Smart Decisions. Relevant Transport GP competencies include transport policy and institutions, general transport planning, transport systems and technologies, operational project management, project design for impact and sustainability, client orientation, and knowledge and communication.
  
  
As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:
  
  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes**

* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies
  
  
The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.
