title: Financing & Risk Solutions Analyst
description:
Join us as a Financing & Risk Solutions Analyst
  
  

* In this crucial role, you'll support the Specialty Finance desk in delivering high-quality monitoring, analysis and risk oversight across securitisation transactions, including consumer loans, credit cards, auto loans and other structured finance products
* You'll play a key role in overseeing AUP processes, reviewing IPD waterfall reports and assessing ongoing transaction performance to support effective risk management and decision-making
* This is a fantastic opportunity to build specialist expertise in structured finance, supported by training, self-development opportunities and exposure to a broad range of transactions and stakeholders
* We’re offering this role at senior analyst level

What you’ll do
  
  
As a Financing & Risk Solutions Analyst, you'll support the effective management of securitisation transactions, ensuring activities remain aligned to the bank's conduct, operational, credit and regulatory risk frameworks. You'll help monitor transaction performance, analyse key risks and support the ongoing oversight of complex structured finance portfolios.
  
  
We'll also look to you to prepare analysis, presentations, reviews and supporting documentation that contribute to origination and portfolio management activities. You'll work closely with client coverage teams and a wide range of internal stakeholders, helping deliver insight that supports informed decision-making and strong customer outcomes.
  
  
**Your Day-to-day Activities Will Include**

* Preparing investor presentations, market analysis and other marketing materials, while monitoring market developments and identifying emerging trends and opportunities
* Supporting the preparation of corporate finance advisory materials and financial models across the US technology sector
* Monitoring US and European debt markets, producing market updates across investment grade, high yield and leveraged loan markets
* Writing market commentary for clients and maintaining internal databases covering issuance activity, investor demand, pricing analysis and transaction performance
* Analysing financial performance and preparing peer comparison analysis, including spread, yield and relative value assessments to support transaction and investment discussions

The skills you'll need
  
  
To succeed in this role, you'll hold an MBA in Finance or a professional qualification such as CA, CFA or FRM. You'll also bring a strong understanding of financial markets, structured finance products and financial statement analysis, together with experience using industry-standard platforms such as Bloomberg, Intex, Reuters, FactSet and Dealogic.
  
  
We're looking for someone with strong experience in securitisation, structured credit or portfolio monitoring, ideally gained within an investment banking, capital markets or analytical risk environment.
  
  
**You’ll Also Demonstrate**

* Experience working within cash management, fixed income, investment banking or credit research functions supporting debt-related products and transactions
* A good understanding of investment banking products, credit markets and structured finance solutions
* Strong analytical capabilities, including ratio analysis, sector assessment, pitch book preparation and financial modelling
* Excellent numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex information and deliver clear, insightful analysis

* Assist in the development of methodologies, templates and best practices that build the OCFO and TAS practices
* Support internal trainings and best practice sharing
* Support talent acquisition and firm-building initiatives
* Contribute to a high-performing, inclusive and values-driven culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field; advanced degree or professional certification (CPA or CA) preferred
* Experience working with private equity clients or on U.S. / global transactions is preferred
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* Four plus years of experience in financial consulting, advisory services or audit, preferably with exposure to transaction-driven or capital markets environments
* Strong understanding of GAAP accounting principles and financial reporting requirements, including practical experience with complex areas such as revenue, business combinations or financial instruments
* Experience in financial modeling and financial statements analysis as well as accounting treatments
* Experience with financial technologies and tools such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Blackline and FloQast
* Experience leveraging technology and automation solutions (Power BI / Tableau, Power Automate, UI Path, Automation Anywhere) and interest in leveraging emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, to transform finance functions
* Exposure to ASC 606, ASC 805 and ASC 842
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

title: Account Manager
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Accounts Manager (CA Inter)

**Company:**
Genefied Brand Protection Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Wazirpur, New Delhi (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
4–7 years

**Industry:**
Software / SaaS (Brand Protection, Traceability & Channel Loyalty)

**About Genefied**

Genefied is a technology company that helps brands protect, track and grow their products across the distribution chain. Our platform covers QR-based product traceability, anti-counterfeiting, and channel loyalty programs for retailers, mechanics, dealers and influencers. HybridOcean, our AI layer, turns that data into sales and distribution intelligence. We serve leading brands across India, the GCC and Africa, and we’re scaling fast.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a hands-on Accounts Manager who is CA Inter qualified to own our day-to-day finance operations. You’ll keep our books accurate and current, make sure invoices go out on time and payments come in on time, manage vendor and bank relationships, and give leadership a clear and reliable view of where the money stands. This role suits someone who enjoys ownership, likes structure and follow-through, and wants to grow with a scaling SaaS business.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Day-to-Day Accounting*

* Maintain complete and accurate books of accounts in Tally / Zoho Books, including journal entries, ledgers and voucher management
* Record all sales, purchase, expense and payroll-related entries daily
* Support month-end and year-end closing, provisions, accruals and ledger scrutiny
* Prepare MIS reports and cash-flow statements for management

*Accounts Receivable*

* Raise one-time setup invoices and recurring monthly or annual subscription invoices accurately and on schedule
* Work closely with Customer Success and Sales so every billable milestone, renewal and change in scope is invoiced without delay
* Track outstanding receivables, run ageing reports and follow up with clients for timely collection
* Reconcile client accounts, resolve billing disputes and flag overdue accounts to management early
* Manage foreign currency receipts from international clients, including FIRC/BRC documentation

*Accounts Payable*

* Process vendor invoices after verification against POs and agreements
* Schedule vendor payments according to agreed terms and the company’s cash position
* Maintain vendor ledgers and reconcile them regularly

*Bank & Treasury*

* Prepare daily and monthly bank reconciliations across all accounts
* Monitor bank statements, fund positions and daily cash balances
* Coordinate with banks on payments, remittances, documentation, KYC and any banking requests

*Compliance & Statutory*

* Ensure timely compliance with GST (returns, reconciliation, e-invoicing, LUT for export of services), TDS (deduction, deposit, returns, certificates) and other statutory requirements
* Coordinate with external CAs, auditors and consultants for audits, ROC and tax filings
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails

*Vendor & External Liaison*

* Act as the single point of contact for vendors, banks, auditors and tax consultants
* Build strong working relationships with external partners and resolve queries quickly

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Books updated daily, with zero backlog at any time
* 100% of invoices raised within 2 working days of the billing trigger (setup completion, renewal or monthly cycle)
* Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) reduced and maintained within target, with a weekly ageing report shared with management
* Collection efficiency: share of receivables collected within the due date
* Bank reconciliation completed for all accounts by the 5th of every month
* Vendor payments processed on time per agreed terms, with no penalty or late fee
* Zero delays or penalties on GST, TDS and other statutory filings
* Monthly MIS delivered to management by the 7th of every month
* Clean audit with minimal observations

**Requirements**

* CA Inter (cleared both groups or one group) or semi-qualified CA; B.Com / M.Com mandatory
* 4 to 7 years of hands-on accounting experience, ideally in a SaaS, IT services or B2B company
* Strong working knowledge of Tally Prime and/or Zoho Books, plus advanced Excel
* Sound understanding of GST, TDS and Indian accounting standards
* Experience handling receivables, payables and bank reconciliations end to end
* Exposure to export invoicing and foreign currency receipts is a strong plus
* Highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable with deadlines
* Clear communicator who can follow up firmly but professionally with clients and vendors

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of the accounts function in a fast-growing SaaS company
* Direct exposure to leadership and to business decision-making
* Exposure to international operations across the GCC and Africa
* A growth path toward Finance Manager as the company scales
* Competitive compensation based on experience

title: Finance Officer
description:
**Finance Officer**

Navitas is seeking a financially astute, diligent and highly organized Finance Officer to support the delivery of finance operations in India and across our international business.

Based in India, this role will provide finance support to regional operations, working closely with finance teams, business stakeholders and external service providers. The role provides a broad range of finance support, including accounts payable and receivable, payment processing, banking, payroll support, financial reporting, tax compliance and offshore accounting activities.

The Finance Officer will play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring timely and compliant financial transactions, and supporting consistent finance processes across multiple entities and locations.

The ideal candidate will be proactive, commercially aware and detail-oriented, with strong technical accounting knowledge and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, international environment.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Scrutinize expense invoices and claims, ensuring accurate processing in line with company policies, accounting standards, and statutory requirements.
* Manage end-to-end payment processing, accounts payable/receivable, and banking operations, including SA region transactions.
* Maintain accurate financial records, fixed asset registers, and ensure all expenditures are correctly recorded and aligned with forecasts and internal controls.
* Ensure full compliance with tax regulations, including TDS (deduction, deposit, certificates, returns) and GST, in coordination with external advisors.
* Liaise with banks, auditors, and external stakeholders to resolve queries and ensure smooth financial operations and audit processes.
* Support preparation of monthly financial reports, management presentations, and assist in budgeting and financial forecasting activities.
* Handle updates of authorized bank signatories and assist with payroll processing and other finance-related administrative tasks.
* Contribute to strategic finance initiatives and provide support across cross-functional and operational requirements as assigned by management.

**Qualifications and Selection Criteria**

**Essential**

* Professional qualification such as CA / CA Intermediate or equivalent, with 3–4 years of relevant experience in finance or accounting roles.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel with excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on accuracy, compliance, and quality of work.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders.
* Strong self-management, prioritization, and ownership skills with proven ability to perform in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**Desirable**

* Relevant educational industry experience, particularly with the tertiary sector or with entities providing services to international students

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**

* Strong communication skills with excellent command of spoken and written English and Hindi, along with the ability to effectively engage with internal and external stakeholders.
* Solid knowledge of TDS, GST, and other applicable tax regulations with practical understanding of compliance requirements.
* Proficient in accounting software and advanced Microsoft Office tools (especially Excel), with strong data handling and reporting skills.
* Confident presentation and interpersonal skills with a professional, friendly, and collaborative approach.
* High integrity with strong attention to detail, patience, discretion in handling sensitive information, and a commitment to accuracy and accountability.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Accurate and timely maintenance of employee records and office financial documentation.
* Consistent adherence to timelines across all financial processes and reporting cycles.
* Strong compliance with internal policies, accounting standards, and statutory requirements.
* Efficient and smooth day-to-day financial operations across regional offices.
* High levels of stakeholder satisfaction, including staff and UP hosting partners.

**About Navitas**

Navitas is a leading global education provider supporting more than 60,000 students each year through innovative, life-changing learning opportunities around the world. You’ll be part of a purpose-driven organization where your work directly contributes to helping learners achieve their goals.

**How to Apply**

Power the numbers that drive decisions. Join Navitas as a Finance Officer and bring precision, compliance, and control to our global finance operations.

Apply online via www.navitas.com/careers.

**Applications will close on 23 November 2026.**
Early applications are encouraged, as we may appoint before the closing date.

Applicants must have full working rights in New Delhi, India, and be available to start immediately or on short notice.
*By applying, you agree to Navitas’ Privacy Policy.*

* High School Diploma (Bachelors preferred)
* Five to eight years of project accounting (billing) experience (professional services experience preferred)
* Ability to work 2nd shift

* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with both internal and external customers, across all levels and functions

title: Company Secretary cum Finance Executive
description:
The Company Secretary cum Finance Executive supports both company secretarial and financial operations in India. The role is responsible for statutory compliance, corporate governance and board administration, while also contributing to budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, audit coordination, cash-flow monitoring, account reconciliations, and tax compliance.

**Company Secretarial & Statutory Compliance**

* Organize and manage Board meetings, Annual General Meetings, and committee meetings.
* Maintain statutory registers and corporate records, including records relating to members and directors.
* Ensure timely filing of Registrar of Companies forms and other required regulatory documents.
* Provide support and advice on corporate governance and legal compliance matters.
* Liaise with relevant regulators, including the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and the Securities and Exchange Board of India, as applicable, as well as external advisors.

**Finance Planning & Reporting**

* Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Support the preparation of financial statements and management information system reports.
* Coordinate with internal and statutory auditors during audit activities.
* Monitor cash flow, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and account reconciliations.
* Support accurate and timely finance reporting and follow-up on identified matters.

**Taxation & Financial Compliance**

* Support compliance with applicable tax requirements, including Goods and Services Tax, Tax Deducted at Source, and income tax.
* Maintain appropriate financial records and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external advisors on finance and compliance requirements.
* Monitor deadlines and support timely completion of statutory and financial submissions.

**Governance & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Work closely with the Finance Director, India, and relevant internal stakeholders on governance and finance matters.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain accurate meeting, statutory, audit, and finance documentation.
* Manage multiple priorities and deadlines across company secretarial and finance responsibilities.
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with a high level of integrity and discretion.

**Systems & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Use Microsoft Office applications, company secretarial software, and finance systems to support role responsibilities.
* Collaborate with Finance, Legal, Tax, business teams, auditors, regulators, and external advisors as required.
* Identify and escalate compliance, governance, or financial matters requiring management attention.
* Support continuous improvement of documentation, reporting, and compliance processes.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Company Secretary (CS) Executive or Professional certification is mandatory, with 3–5 years of relevant company secretarial experience, preferably within a multinational medical device, healthcare, or related organization. A Commerce background and strong knowledge of the Companies Act, FEMA, and financial reporting standards are preferred.
* Strong communication, organization, documentation, integrity, and discretion, with fluency in English and the relevant local language.

title: Associate Manager II - City CEO (Strategy & Business Operations)
description:
Location : Delhi

**About the Team**

Currently, Navi is into Lending, Health Insurance, Mutual Funds, Gold & UPI. This position is for the function SBO (Strategy & Business Operations), which spans across all of these businesses. SBO is front end for all non-automated interactions with Navi customers and has two broad focus areas:

1. Be the representative of the customers in Navi and the representative of Navi to the Customers
2. Build Industry first and best ever customer-facing innovations across products - Look for big problem statements which can create long-term step-jump results (e.g. how to make cashless health claims to 90% - Industry is at 50% or how to solve fraud in debt management and claims)

SBO currently has four operating verticals with a prime focus on achieving business objectives:

1. Debt Management – Focus on making our lending portfolio profitable by ensuring we get the most of money back, we have lent using data science and human behavior principles.
2. Customer Experience – Understanding users' pain points and working with product and tech to better our offerings.
3. Claims – Give the best ever customer experience to genuine customers and catch all fraudulent cases upfront
4. Operations – Non-customer-facing operations focused on making the customer experience better while managing operations risk

SBO also has central functions to ensure constant innovation & support for operating verticals:

* Process Excellence – Create, audit, and improve people and various processes:

broadly involves auditing and doing RCAs on people and processes, and using

that to drive actions which improve the business metrics for short and long term.

* Control tower – Real-time monitoring of all critical business metrics, along with pre-empting and intervening in any issues at an early stage

**About the Role**

City CEO is a general management role that involves leading a team of debt management executives/managers, owning business targets, and contributing to key strategic initiatives in the debt management charter.

**What We Expect From You**

**Performance Management:**

* Responsible for hitting the topline and bottom-line targets
* Build processes and metrics that are consistent and scalable
* Own the debt management P&L of Navi in his/her region

**People Management**

* Build and manage a team of debt management executives and managers
* Work closely with central teams like Finance, HR, Quality, Vigilance et
  **:**

**Strategic Initiatives:**

* Come up with Operations design strategies for step jump improvements
* Conduct experiments to validate insights and scale successful experiments through cross-team collaboration
  **:**

**Must Haves**

* Consistent high achievement in academics & work (top 0.1%) with experience up-to 1 to 3 years of experience.
* Impact-driven mindset coupled with a strong bias to action
* Willingness to take on a high-impact execution oriented role as part of a fast-paced environment

**About Navi**

We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI.

Founded by
**Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal**
in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started!

To know more about us, our work, people, culture, values etc., check out
navi.com/careers
.

**Our Culture**

At Navi, we’re a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether you’re shaping the future of fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a difference.

**We’re guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at
navi.com/careers/values-at-navi
to see what drives us every day.**

If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

title: SVP - Investor Relations
description:
**Job Role :**
SVP Investor Relations and M&A

**Location:**
Delhi

**Reporting To:**
Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

BLS International Services Ltd. is a globally trusted, AI & tech-enabled service provider to governments and citizens, with a legacy since 2005. It is world’s largest publicly listed Visa & Counselor services company, traded on India's major stock exchanges (BSE: 540073; NSE: BLS). BLS International offers a comprehensive range of service solutions encompassing outsourced visa processing, document verification, biometrics, attestation, passport services, e-visa solutions, end-to-end solutions in e-governance, digital and retail services. BLS International partners with over 46 client governments and operates across 100+ countries through 50,000+ centres, 9 global training hubs, and 8 global contact centres. Guided by a continued focus on innovation, transparency, and service excellence, BLS International combines cutting-edge technology with robust operational processes to deliver the highest standards of data security and efficiency. Recognized for its proven track record and adherence to global standards, BLS International has been featured among Business Today's India's Most Valuable Companies, Forbes Asia's Best Under a Billion, Fortune India's ‘The Emerging 100’. To explore more about BLS International’s global presence and comprehensive service offerings, visit www.blsinternational.com.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an accomplished finance professional with 18+ years of experience in Investor Relations and Mergers & Acquisitions to lead the organization's capital market communication, strategic transactions, and shareholder engagement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**Investor Relations**

* Develop and execute the company's Investor Relations strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with institutional investors, analysts, shareholders, and the investment community.
* Lead quarterly earnings calls, investor presentations, annual reports, and shareholder communications.
* Prepare investor decks, earnings releases, management discussion & analysis (MD&A), and financial communication materials.
* Monitor analyst coverage, investor sentiment, and market trends to provide strategic insights to leadership.
* Coordinate investor meetings, roadshows, conferences, and analyst interactions.
* Ensure compliance with stock exchange regulations, SEBI requirements, and disclosure obligations.
* Partner with finance, legal, and corporate communications teams to ensure timely and accurate disclosures.

**Mergers & Acquisitions**

* Identify, evaluate, and execute acquisition, merger, divestment, and strategic investment opportunities.
* Lead end-to-end M&A transactions including valuation, financial modelling, due diligence, negotiation, documentation, and deal closure.
* Coordinate with investment bankers, legal advisors, tax consultants, auditors, and external stakeholders.
* Conduct strategic market assessments and target identification.
* Prepare business cases, investment proposals, and Board presentations.
* Lead post-merger integration planning and synergy realization.
* Evaluate joint ventures, strategic alliances, and partnerships.

**Corporate Strategy & Finance**

* Support long-term strategic planning and capital allocation decisions.
* Evaluate fundraising opportunities including equity, debt, and structured financing.
* Develop valuation models, scenario analysis, and investment appraisals.
* Provide strategic recommendations to the Board and executive leadership.
* Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and macroeconomic developments.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to SEBI regulations, Companies Act, Listing Obligations, and corporate governance standards.
* Coordinate Board, Audit Committee, and Investor Committee presentations.
* Maintain confidentiality of strategic transactions and sensitive information.

**Required Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant (CA), MBA (Finance), CFA, or equivalent qualification.
* 18+ years of experience in Investor Relations, M&A, or Investment Banking.
* Experience working with listed companies is highly preferred.
* Proven track record of leading large-scale M&A transactions.
* Strong understanding of capital markets, valuation methodologies, and corporate finance.
* Experience interacting with institutional investors, analysts, investment bankers, and regulatory authorities.
* Excellent financial modelling and valuation skills.
* Strong knowledge of SEBI regulations, Companies Act, and corporate governance frameworks.
* Experience preparing Board-level presentations and investment proposals.

title: Strategy Associate- Himalayan Systems Change
description:
**Company Description:**
Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.
  
  
As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.
  
  
**Strategy Associate | Himalayan Systems Change**
**Location:**
India, with regular travel, including to the Himalayan region
  
  
**Level:**
Associate
  
  
**The opportunity**
Systemiq is looking for a Strategy Associate to support our growing portfolio of work in the Himalayan region, building on our recently launched report,
*Prosperous and Resilient Himalayas*
.
  
  
The report sets out an agenda for sustainable economic growth and resilience, protecting natural systems while creating new opportunities for mountain communities. Our work aims to translate this vision into practical programmes, partnerships and financing solutions.
  
  
You will contribute to projects spanning water security, climate and disaster resilience, sustainable tourism, mountain products, enterprise development and policy. Working with colleagues across Systemiq's global network, you will help develop solutions that address the connections between environmental, economic and social challenges.
  
  
We are looking for someone with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, sound economic and financial understanding, and an interest in translating strategy into practical action. You will take ownership of defined workstreams, support engagement with a diverse range of stakeholders and contribute to an evolving portfolio of high-impact work across India and the wider Himalayan region.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**

* **Deliver research and strategic analysis.**
  Conduct research, interviews and quantitative analysis to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities and develop clear, evidence-based recommendations.
* **Support programme development.**
  Help design projects, pilots and implementation approaches, including concept notes, workplans, delivery models and assessments of costs, risks and scalability.
* **Apply economic and financial analysis.**
  Build and adapt financial models, assess project economics and business cases, and identify potential financing approaches.
* **Support enterprise and investment opportunities.**
  Assess businesses, innovations and projects for commercial viability, market potential and impact, contributing to strategies for growth and investment.
* **Engage stakeholders and partners.**
  Support relationships with government, businesses, research institutions, funders and local communities, including meetings, workshops and field visits.
* **Contribute to project delivery.**
  Produce high-quality presentations, reports and proposals, coordinate project activities and help monitor progress, budgets and risks.
* **Collaborate across disciplines.**
  Draw on expertise across Systemiq's global teams to develop solutions that connect policy, business, finance, environmental resilience and local economic development.

**The experience and capabilities we are looking for**
**Strategy and analytical capabilities**

* Typically 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in management consulting, strategy advisory, economic or financial analysis, public policy, international development or related fields.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex questions and translate evidence into practical recommendations.
* Confidence working with Excel, including financial modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise written materials and engage effectively with different audiences.
* Experience managing workstreams, coordinating activities and delivering high-quality outputs against deadlines.

**Relevant sector and regional experience**

* An understanding of sustainable development challenges in India, ideally including climate resilience, natural resources, rural livelihoods, enterprise development or sustainable finance.
* Experience working with government, businesses, investors, development organisations or local institutions in India or comparable emerging markets.
* Exposure to the Himalayan region, mountain economies or related sectors such as water, sustainable tourism and agricultural value chains would be an advantage.
* Familiarity with project finance, grants, investment assessment or blended finance would be beneficial.
* A strong academic background in economics, finance, business, public policy, engineering, environmental science or a related discipline.

**Leadership and personal attributes**

* Curious and intellectually rigorous, with an interest in understanding how economic, environmental and social systems interact.
* Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of tasks while working collaboratively with colleagues and external partners.
* Adaptable and pragmatic, with the ability to work across different topics and navigate an evolving project portfolio.
* Motivated to translate research and strategic thinking into practical solutions that create lasting economic and environmental impact.
* Committed to Systemiq's mission and to supporting sustainable, inclusive development in the Himalayan region.

**Languages and travel**

* Fluent English is essential. Hindi and/or another relevant Indian or Himalayan language would be an advantage.
* Willingness to travel regularly, including field visits across the Himalayan region, is essential.

**What we offer**

* **Meaningful impact:**
  Contribute to work that supports economic prosperity, environmental resilience and sustainable livelihoods across the Himalayan region.
* **Diverse project experience:**
  Work across strategy, finance, policy, enterprise development and implementation.
* **Global collaboration:**
  Work with international colleagues and draw on expertise across Systemiq's global network.
* **Learning and development:**
  Build your analytical, consulting and stakeholder engagement capabilities through challenging projects and experienced colleagues.
* **A purpose-driven culture:**
  Join a collaborative team guided by our values of creativity, challenge, collaboration, change and care.

**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.

company: ABC - Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited
description:
**Job Purpose**
Job Purpose Description
  
  
**Job Context & Major Challenges**
As the debt arm of Aditya Birla Financial Services Group (ABFSG), Aditya Birla Finance Limited (ABFL) offers specialized lending and financing solutions in the areas of Capital Markets, Corporate/ Trade Finance, Commercial Real Estate and BIL/PL. Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, we have made significant progress and our balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several midsized Banks and NBFCs.
  
  
A well established brand and top 3 player in the Capital Markets space, today our product suite comprises of a welldiversified look, with equal weightage and focus given to the 3 lines of business. Having seen a y.o.y cumulative growth of 50% in both topline and bottom line, sustainable profitability continues to be the key management agenda.
  
  
The company has a welldefined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending spacespread across both retail HNI and corporate clientele. We have made significant investments in our process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all our business processes. Spread across 18 cities, we plan on further diversifying our risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing our customers a onewindow shop for all their financing needs.
  
  
The Risk and Compliance function is engaged in evaluating the creditworthiness of the loan applications for CMG, CFG, SME and BIL/PL lending divisions considering the quantitative & qualitative factors like ownership, size & market presence of the client business, capital adequacy, collateral quality, earnings quality, liquidity, management quality & client credibility & adherence to statutory requirements.
  
  
The Risk & Compliance function carries out monitoring of client wise exposure and portfolio exposure to identify early warning signals of stress and to minimize NPAs. Currently monitoring is done in association with Business Teams as RMG does not have presence at Branch level. It carries out over due loan recovery from defaulting clients in coordination with Business Teams.
  
  
The Credit Analyst is an integral part of the Risk & complianceand is responsible for analyzing the proposal with the required due diligence and to ensure that all information required to take a credit decision is captured in the proposal.
  
  
The major challenges to this profile include
  
  
Availability of data and information for exhaustive credit appraisals as each of the proposals has their respective structuring complexities as per the customer, product & regulatory requirements.
  
  
Ensuring faster TATs in a highly competitive & dynamic market conditions and scale of operations due to voluminous retail transactions as well as structured high value deals.
  
  
Liasing with external agencies (legal, Technical, verification) to ensure that crdit risk, customer risk & property risk are all mitigated.
  
  
Cross functional coordination to enable timely approval of credit proposals.
  
  
Pro active monitoring and regularization of sticky accounts as well as pending documents.
  
  
Self updation on economic / sectoral changes in the economy
  
  
Seamless coordination with multiple internal and external entities

The role also calls for team management and manmanagement skills as the Sr. Credit Analyst needs to coordinate with various people to achieve his job objectives.

title: Marketplace Manager - Amazon
description:

The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, improving product visibility, managing marketplace operations, optimizing advertising campaigns, and ensuring a seamless customer experience. This role requires a strong analytical mindset, hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, and a deep understanding of marketplace growth strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketplace Management**

* Own end-to-end management of the Amazon Seller Central account.
* Drive revenue, profitability, and overall marketplace growth.
* Manage catalog creation, product listings, variations, A+ Content, Brand Store, and storefront optimization.
* Ensure catalog accuracy and maintain listing hygiene.
* Monitor account health and resolve policy, compliance, and suppression issues.

**Listing Optimization**

* Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, and images.
* Improve organic search rankings through keyword research and Amazon SEO.
* Coordinate with design and content teams for creatives, A+ Content, videos, and enhanced brand content.

**Advertising & Growth**

* Monitor and improve KPIs such as ROAS, ACoS, TACoS, CTR, Conversion Rate, and Sales.
* Launch promotional campaigns, Lightning Deals, Coupons, and seasonal offers.
* Identify new opportunities to improve visibility and increase conversions.

**Inventory & Operations**

* Forecast demand and coordinate inventory planning with the supply chain team.
* Ensure healthy inventory levels and minimize stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Monitor FBA inventory, replenishment cycles, and fulfillment performance.
* Coordinate with logistics and operations teams for timely order fulfillment.

**Pricing & Competition**

* Track competitor pricing and market trends.
* Recommend pricing strategies to maximize profitability while remaining competitive.
* Manage Buy Box performance and pricing optimization.

**Data & Reporting**

* Analyze marketplace performance using Seller Central reports and business analytics.
* Prepare weekly and monthly business reports with actionable insights.
* Track sales, traffic, conversion rates, advertising performance, inventory, and profitability.
* Recommend strategies to improve marketplace performance.
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Brand, Marketing, Performance Marketing, Creative, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Support teams.
* Support new product launches and GTM strategies on Amazon.
* Coordinate with external agencies and Amazon account managers whenever required.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central.
* Expertise in Amazon SEO and listing optimization.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon Advertising (PPC).
* Experience with A+ Content, Brand Registry, and Brand Store.
* Excellent analytical skills with advanced Excel proficiency.
* Understanding of inventory planning and demand forecasting.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Data-driven approach with strong problem-solving abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, E-commerce, or a related field.

3–6 years of experience managing Amazon marketplaces for a D2C or consumer brand.

Experience in Beauty, Personal Care, FMCG, Wellness, Fashion, or Lifestyle brands is preferred.

Familiarity with marketplace analytics tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataHawk, or similar platforms is an added advantage.

title: Senior Analyst/Manager - Pricing (Financial Operations)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for resourceful candidates to join our Financial Operations (FinOp) group based in Hyderabad, India. The Pricing Team is a unit of DESCO’s finance and operations department and is responsible for the valuation of private investments and oversight of valuation of non-private investments performed by Arcesium LLC, an affiliate of the firm. The role also involves working closely with the various Front Office teams.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will be expected to value the private equity and credit investments which entails understanding of investments, industry research and analysis of the portfolio company’s fundamentals, and performing in-depth competitor analysis. You will be responsible to build, update, and maintain the valuation models that incorporate the terms of the investment while adhering to the accounting/audit guidelines, preparing detailed documentation of the valuation methodology, monitoring deal inputs and assumptions for their relevance on a periodic basis. In addition, you will facilitate valuation reviews by third parties (like CITCO and Houlihan Lokey) and auditors (like EY); creating summary highlighting significant changes/events and industry analyses, to be presented to the valuations committees for their review. Additionally, you will also be involved in developing and reviewing controls to oversee the pricing of various Equity/Fixed Income and derivatives (OTC and Exchange Traded) products.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* Candidate should have a master’s degree in finance or equivalent, with 3-6 years of business valuations experience in complex securities/private equity/debt or investment banking space
* The candidate should have an understanding of various Equity/Fixed Income and derivatives (OTC and Exchange Traded) products.
* The ideal candidate should have exceptional valuation, research and financial modeling skills including excellent analytical and quantitative skills as well as the ability to perform in-depth, innovative, critical analysis.
* Candidate should be able to develop a sound knowledge of the economic/characteristics, conditions and trends of a broad range of geographies, industries, and their investment characteristics.
* The candidate should have excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills (both oral and written), with proven ability to articulate sophisticated ideas, issues and recommendations effectively.

Interested candidates can apply through our website:
  
  
https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/SrAnaMgrFinOpMar26

You will monitor and report on a growing book of client exposures, build and maintain cash flow models, prepare pitch documents and credit papers, as well as review materials for public securitisations. In addition, you will perform client-driven and internal securitisation data analysis and tasks along with ad hoc special project work for a variety of business growth opportunities.

* 3-5 years' experience, including at least 2 years in banking or financial services, with strong financial modelling skills and the ability to analyse financial statements and cashflow performance.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience developing financial models and preparing transaction or approval presentations.

title: Analyst, Corporate Development
description:
**About Cvent**
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6000+
  
  
employees and ~34,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999,
  
  
Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event
  
  
professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help
  
  
them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people
  
  
together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry
  
  
through innovative technology that powers human connection.
  
  
Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone
  
  
for $4.6B in 2023.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like
  
  
entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and
  
  
celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human
  
  
connection.
  
  
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At
  
  
Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our
  
  
DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to
  
  
experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll
  
  
thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering
  
  
exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn,
  
  
iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AIpowered
  
  
collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**About The Role**
Cvent’s Corporate Development team serves a critical function by driving inorganic growth to support
  
  
the company’s long-term strategic goals. Sitting at the intersection of strategy and M&A execution, the
  
  
team partners closely with senior leadership across every department at Cvent in the full acquisition
  
  
lifecycle including sourcing and identification, business case formulation, financial analysis, valuation
  
  
negotiation, due diligence, and closing. While we rely on structured workflows curated through a strong
  
  
track record of successful acquisitions, we maintain the flexibility to adapt to complex situations through
  
  
creative problem solving. In a rapidly evolving Event Management technology landscape, it takes a
  
  
team of superstars to sustain Cvent’s competitive advantage through M&A.
  
  
We are looking to hire a full-time Corporate Development Analyst based in Cvent’s Gurgaon office who
  
  
will report to the Senior Manager of Corporate Development, to support the full M&A lifecycle from
  
  
sourcing to closing. You will serve as the junior member of a lean high-performing team and will quickly
  
  
gain exposure to Cvent's global senior management.
  
  
▪ Assist in the identification and preliminary analysis of potential acquisition candidates.
  
  
▪ Perform detailed analysis on potential acquisitions, including a review of historical 3-statement
  
  
trends, detailed P&L and cash flow forecasting, customer retention, and bottoms-up cost builds
  
  
▪ Liaise with department leads as the central project manager of due diligence workstreams,
  
  
including data-room coordination, milestone tracking, and checklist management.
  
  
▪ Own the Corporate Development team’s market landscape database and monitor key
  
  
developments.
  
  
▪ Ad-hoc special projects. Examples include data analysis requested by Cvent executives, market
  
  
research, board presentations, and financing initiatives.
  
  
▪ An interest in sales compensation and a desire to work in a high energy, fast paced environment
  
  
▪ Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Computer
  
  
Science, Engineering, or other relevant fields
  
  
▪ 2-5 years of work experience in corporate development/ M&A, investment banking, management
  
  
consulting, private equity, venture capital or other relevant fields
  
  
▪ Proficiency in 3-statement modeling, M&A valuation analysis techniques (DCF, multiples, etc.),
  
  
and rigorous analysis of large complex datasets
  
  
▪ Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint and AI tools
  
  
▪ Fluent in written and spoken English, with excellent communication and presentation skills
  
  
▪ Additionally, the following Pluses will make your application stand out:
  
  
▪ Prior experience in SaaS, and/or strong familiarity with SaaS retention metrics and Revenue
  
  
recognition
  
  
▪ Prior hands-on M&A live deal experience, particularly due diligence and financial analysis
  
  
▪ Experience working with, and/or presenting to, senior executives (internally or client-side)
  
  
**Recruitment Scam Notice:**
Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting
  
  
communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email address. Cvent
  
  
will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or
  
  
social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from
  
  
communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.
  
  
If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond
  
  
and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.
  
  
For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/noticerecruitment-
  
  
fraud.

title: Project Finance Specialist
description:
**About Juniper Green Energy**

Juniper Green Energy is an independent renewable energy power producer in India, focused on the development, construction and operations of utility-scale solar, wind, and hybrid renewable energy projects. It is headquartered in Delhi NCR since October 2018; the company has grown its operational capacity to approximately 1.66 GWp (as of Jan 14th, 2026). With expertise spanning the entire project lifecycle – from initial concept to construction and development across India – Juniper Green Energy provides energy solutions and undertakes large-scale projects, thus playing a role in India's shift towards clean energy.

Juniper Green Energy is a part of the AT Capital Group, a globally diversified investment group based in Singapore. AT Capital Group focuses on sectors including Renewable Energy, Residential and Commercial Real Estate, with a presence in India, the GCC, and Europe. Within India, the Group also operates Experion Developers, a leading real estate company focused on luxury and sustainable developments across key locations in the country.

**About the position:**

In this role, you will leverage your expertise in project and corporate finance to secure funding for our renewable energy projects, ensuring their successful implementation and contributing to our company's growth and success. Your attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and ability to build and maintain relationships will be crucial in driving our finance initiatives forward and achieving our strategic objectives.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Work on Project & Corporate Finance (Term Loan, ECBs & Bonds and LC/BG)
* Preparation of Financial Model, Detailed Project Information Memorandum
* Maintain & Build relationships with Banks, FIs & NBFCs
* Submit funding proposal to prospective lenders including filling of application, submission of required data
* Manage the entire project appraisal process in close coordination with Lenders, internal stakeholders, external consultants etc
* Manage Due diligence exercise (including technical, legal, title search etc) conducted by various consultants on behalf respective Lenders
* Negotiations & Finalisation of Term Sheets
* Review, finalisation and execution of Facility & Security Documents
* Comply with various disbursement and commitment conditions
* Submit periodic data on time as per requirement of lenders, rating agencies & banks.
* Ensuring Compliances with required guidelines, policies & procedures as well as agreed covenants & reporting requirements to achieve financing effectiveness.
* Work on availing Non-Fund Based facility (LC/BG) from various banks
* Management of Escrow Accounts, Construction & Operation Budget
* Manage coordination between internal and external stake holders
* Support Secretarial & Accounts team for timely closure of books
* Supporting internal processes interfacing with projects Team, legal teams as well as management & the Board.

**Our Ideal Candidate:**

* MBA in finance from a reputable institute or Chartered Accountant.
* Experience in project and corporate finance, preferably in the Infrastructure/ Renewable energy sector.
* Strong understanding of financial modelling, project appraisal, and lending processes.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and complex projects simultaneously.

We strongly encourage applications from female candidates as part of our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive workplace.

**About us\***
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Group is responsible for the overall financial management of our company. This includes accounting, financial and regulatory reporting, balance sheet management, financial planning and analysis, treasury, investor relations, corporate investments and tax
  
  
Global Corporate & Investment Banking (GCIB) , Global Markets (GM), International Finance & Corporate Treasury strives to be a valued business partner to the company's trading, corporate, institutional & banking businesses and is responsible for funding the balance sheet, maintaining strong capital and liquidity positions, managing interest rate risk and overseeing company’s relationship with external stakeholders.
  
  
Our priority is to operate a series of key control processes to ensure the integrity of the group's financial results. Then we build on these activities to offer performance insight to business leaders.
  
  
Enterprise Capital management (ECM) implements the Board’s capital management strategy including issuance, redemption or repurchase of common stock and other capital instruments. ECM works closely with lines of business and guides them to efficiently and proactively manage the enterprise's capital including design and implementation of capital allocation methodologies. In addition, ECM produces and monitors regulatory and internal economic capital metrics including capital adequacy ratios, leverage exposure and risk-weighted assets and oversees the end-to-end capital measurement process across the enterprise including Basel calculations and adherence, partnering with other control functions, ECM manages external disclosures related to capital management including 10Q, 10K, Pillar 3 disclosures and other regulatory filings. ECM interfaces with banking regulators globally on all capital-related matters.
  
  
**Job Description\***
The role is part of the Enterprise Capital Management (ECM) team and assists in driving banking portfolio calculations and reporting of capital for Global banking transactions, including consideration of any new regulations, timely and accurate preparation of the company’s regulatory capital results; research causes of unanticipated capital changes; end-to-end review, analysis, and ad-hoc analytical reporting to senior management and regulatory agencies. Success requires understanding of regulatory capital rules and the ability to formulate means by which answers may be derived from large sets of data.
  
  
As part of the responsibilities of the role, the teammate will develop business partner relationships within ECM, e.g. various workstreams, ECM Technology, Quality Assurance, Capital Risk and Internal/External audit. Throughout the tenure of the role, the teammate will gain exposure and understanding in Basel 3 Capital Calculations for the Corporation and develop/improve the following skills: communication and project coordination, time management.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Produce and monitor Market Risk and Credit risk risk-weighted assets (RWA) metrics and reports
* Prepare COREP templates related to Market Risk, Credit Risk, Leverage & Large Exposure
* Be responsible for investigating and explaining period over period capital movements
* Build relationships with partners and ensure appropriate level of capital knowledge
* Foster relationships with partners in capital management, business and finance to resolve questions, provide data as necessary with great attention to detail
* Demonstrate clear understanding of drivers on capital calculations and the ability to communicate results
* Analysis of underlying drivers for periodic changes and variances
* Assist with execution of routines to support daily, month-end and quarter end close cycles
* Supporting firmwide initiatives and ECM projects to test complex logic and heavy data sets for regulatory reforms or strategic fixes.
* Partner with tech team to identify continuous improvement on existing routines, leveraging new tools or emerging technology

**Education**
Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA/ B. Tech from Tier I/II institute with at least 8 yrs. Possess strong technical background with in-depth understanding of Global Markets business, balance sheet, liquidity, capital, regulatory landscape and processes.
  
  
**Experience Range**
7 to 8 years with at least 5 years’ experience in Treasury function managing capital, marker risk and credit risk calculations.
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Strong understanding of Basel capital requirements and financials, preferably in a UK / EMEA bank setting
* Experience and exposure to RWA and capital calculations is must
* Prior experience working in accounting or financial services
* Knowledge of Banking products and risk management
* Intellectual curiosity, regularly asking questions to enable rapid learning of a complex topic.

* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels

title: Anaplan Model Builder
description:
**Role purpose:-**

The Anaplan Model Builder will design, build, test, deploy and support scalable Anaplan solutions across Finance and the wider business. Reporting to the Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan), the role will translate business requirements into robust models, workflows, dashboards and data structures, while supporting effective platform operation and continuous improvement.

The role will support Anaplan use cases spanning corporate planning, budgeting and forecasting, client and product profitability, cash flow and liquidity forecasting, funding forecasts, management reporting and scenario analysis.

**Key responsibilities:-**

* **Model design and build:**
  Develop modules, lists, hierarchies, calculations, dashboards and user experiences using scalable, maintainable design principles.
* **Requirements and solution design:**
  Work with Finance and business stakeholders to translate planning and reporting needs into functional requirements, model designs, business rules and acceptance criteria.
* **Data and integration:**
  Build and maintain imports, exports, actions and processes; define source-data requirements; validate and reconcile data; investigate load failures with Technology and data teams.
* **Testing and quality:**
  Complete unit testing and support system, integration, regression and user acceptance testing. Reconcile outputs, resolve defects and retain appropriate evidence.
* **Release and change management:**
  Prepare model changes, impact assessments, release documentation and deployment instructions within the agreed environment and governance framework.
* **Platform support:**
  Provide hands-on support for live models, recurring planning cycles, incidents, data issues and performance problems. Maintain and optimise models and identify technical debt.
* **Controls and governance:**
  Maintain roles, selective access, validation controls, documentation, data dictionaries and calculation definitions. Follow access, segregation-of-duties and audit requirements.
* **Adoption and knowledge transfer:**
  Create intuitive user experiences, guides and training materials; support demonstrations and adoption; capture knowledge from delivery partners and build internal capability.

**Key working relationships:-**

Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan); Finance process owners and users; Finance Systems and Technology teams; data and integration teams; external implementation and managed-service partners.

**Key deliverables:-**

* Robust and scalable Anaplan models aligned with approved requirements and architecture.
* Accurate calculations, planning logic, dashboards, workflows and management outputs.
* Reliable data integrations, imports, exports, validations and reconciliations.
* Complete functional, technical, testing, release and operational documentation.
* Stable support for live models and key planning cycles, with timely defect resolution.
* Effective knowledge transfer and reduced reliance on external delivery resources.

**Skills and experience:-**

**Essential**

* Practical experience designing and building Anaplan models in a business environment.
* Strong knowledge of lists, modules, hierarchies, line items, actions, processes and dashboards.
* Experience translating Finance or business requirements into model designs.
* Understanding of multidimensional modelling, data structures and model performance.
* Experience with data imports, exports, transformation, validation and reconciliation.
* Ability to diagnose calculation, data, model and performance issues.
* Experience supporting testing, deployment and live operational models.
* Understanding of planning, budgeting, forecasting or management reporting.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred**

* Anaplan Model Builder certification or equivalent demonstrable experience.
* Experience with FP&A, profitability, unit economics, cash flow or liquidity models.
* Experience integrating Anaplan with ERP, data warehouse or reporting platforms.
* Knowledge of Application Lifecycle Management and controlled deployment.
* Experience in Financial Services or another controlled or regulated environment.
* Understanding of Agile delivery, data governance, access controls and audit requirements.
* Experience working with external implementation or managed-service partners.

**Personal attributes**

* Hands-on, structured and delivery-focused, with strong attention to detail.
* Able to simplify complex calculations and challenge unnecessary complexity.
* Collaborative across Finance and Technology, with clear stakeholder communication.
* Proactive in identifying risks, control gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Pragmatic, dependable and committed to sustainable internal capability.

**Success measures**

* Delivery of assigned developments to agreed scope, quality and priorities.
* Accuracy, reliability, usability and performance of models and outputs.
* Adherence to design, documentation, security and governance standards.
* Successful business testing, adoption and support through planning cycles.
* Reduction in manual activity, defects and dependency on external resources.

**Role boundary**

Finance Systems Manager (Anaplan) owns platform strategy, roadmap, delivery governance, stakeholder alignment, supplier management and overall platform outcomes.
**The Anaplan Model Builder**
owns the detailed design, build, testing, documentation, deployment support and maintenance of assigned solutions. Business process owners approve requirements, assumptions, processes and outputs.

title: Finance Manager
description:
****Who we are****
Imagine a world where your birthplace doesn’t limit your dreams. That’s what Passage is here to create. We aren’t just a bridge of financial support; we connect families all around the world to life-changing opportunities. We believe in a future where deserving students can pursue their dreams and ambitions – even if their parents don’t have money.
  
  
Our mission is bold but simple: by 2030, we aim to dismantle the barriers preventing brilliant minds from accessing the opportunities they deserve. Starting with financial barriers, we’re offering loans to international students and refugees, helping them pursue better education in Canada and unlock a world of possibilities – not just for themselves, but for their families and future generations, too.
  
  
****Who you are****
We’re looking for an exceptional finance professional with a CA (ICAI) or CPA designation and 3–5 years of progressive post-qualification experience in accounting and finance. You’ll work directly with the finance lead at our Canadian head office and take meaningful ownership of accounting, reporting, compliance and filings.
  
  
You will own the global books, which span multiple subsidiaries and require consolidation. We need someone we can trust to run the accounting, close the month, get the numbers right, and keep the company compliant across every jurisdiction we operate in. As the business grows, you’ll be the person the finance lead relies on to make sure the financial foundation is sound.
  
  
We are a small team, so you will work without much structure and build a lot of it yourself. We’re looking for someone who is careful, dependable and takes pride in accurate, timely reporting – and who wants to grow their scope as the company scales.
  
  
Because you’ll be collaborating closely with the Canadian head office across a 9.5–10.5 hour time difference, extended or shifted hours are likely. Strong written communication and comfort working asynchronously are essential.
  
  
****What you will do****
You’ll take full ownership of core accounting, reporting, compliance and filings, with exposure across audit, internal controls, and cross-functional initiatives that support our product and growth.
  
  
**Accounting & Financial reporting**

* Lead day-to-day accounting operations and month-end close
* Prepare monthly financial statements under IFRS and support external audit
* Maintain and document accounting policies, memos, and reconciliations
* Build and scale internal controls, systems, and reporting infrastructure

**Compliance & Filings**

* Work with the Canadian head office on statutory, tax and regulatory filings, with the expectation of leading these over time
* Maintain the compliance calendar and ensure deadlines are met across jurisdictions

**Finance Operations**

* Design and manage finance-related processes integrated with our product
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to automate manual workflows
* Run day-to-day financial operations, including payroll, vendor payments and banking across entities

**Strategic Reporting & Analysis**

* Partner with the finance lead on investor and board reporting
* Support strategic decision-making while preparing and maintaining critical source-of-truth datasets across accounting, operations, and lending
* Build tools and frameworks to track KPIs, unit economics, and cash flow

You’ll also be a key contributor to long-term projects like audit readiness, financial model development, and future financing events – with increasing ownership based on performance.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* CA (ICAI) or CPA designation with 3–5 years of post-qualification experience, ideally starting in Big 4 audit
* Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting under IFRS or equivalent
* Comfort working independently in Excel and building reporting from scratch
* Strong written English and the ability to work effectively across time zones

****Nice to Haves****

* Experience in financial services, lending, NBFC or fintech, or structured credit
* Experience with expected credit loss (IFRS 9 or equivalent) modelling and reporting
* Exposure to Indian/Canadian tax and regulatory filings (e.g. HST, SR&ED, CRA correspondence)
* Experience reporting to a foreign parent or head office
* Exposure to FP&A, financial modelling, or investor reporting
* Experience building and/or testing internal controls
* Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker Studio)

****Ready to join us?****
We’re on a mission to make the world a fairer place, one student at a time. If you’re excited to work hard, innovate fearlessly, and collaborate with a high-energy team striving for global impact, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
Note: This role is based in Gurgaon, India, and requires a five-day-a-week in-office commitment. You will work directly with the finance lead at our Canadian head office, and extended or shifted hours are likely given the time difference. Applicants must be willing to relocate to the Delhi NCR area if they’re not already there.
  
  
Let’s help shape a future where every dream can thrive – no matter where it begins.

title: Sr Payments Analyst - Fixed Assets
description:

**How You’ll Make An Impact**

Our Corporate and Global Functions are essential in driving the company's strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across various departments, business areas, and regions. These roles support our vision to become the most valued energy technology company in the world. As part of our team, you contribute to our vision by shaping the global energy transition, partnering with our internal and external stakeholders, and conducting business responsibly and in compliance with legal requirements and regulations.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. description:
