title: Senior Analyst, Lending Models
description:
**About Allica Bank**
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
  
  
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
  
  
**Department Description**
The Modelling team sits within the Credit Portfolio Management (CPM) function and is at the heart of building the measurement and decisioning models behind Allica’s lending products. The team builds and owns the bank’s IFRS9 model estate (including PD, LGD, SICR and economic response models), the statistical and machine learning models and credit policy rules used for automated underwriting, and the credit-linked GenAI solutions used to automate processes.
  
  
**Role Description**
This role will be part of the team building, implementing, monitoring and optimising two sets of models: the IFRS9 impairment models that measure our credit risk and support accurate reporting to auditors and investors, and the decisioning models and policy rules behind automated lending, which are critical to delivering fast, consistent and well-controlled credit decisions and a better customer journey as the bank grows.
  
  
The role requires the technical ability and practical mindset to take models and decisioning changes from initial problem definition through data identification, cleansing and analysis to model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between structured model development and fast-paced ad-hoc analysis, working closely with Finance, Credit Risk, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data, Engineering, Capital Markets and Model Risk colleagues. They will communicate complex concepts clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise and work with third-party suppliers where required. We are looking for a hands-on modeller who can turn data into reliable, scalable solutions, and help make data a key strength for the bank.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**

* Take a hands-on role in the design, build, implementation and continuous refinement of the bank’s credit risk models, spanning the full suite of IFRS9 impairment models (PD, LGD, SICR and economic response) and the statistical and machine learning models that support automated lending decisions.
* Develop and deploy models in Python across the full model lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model fitting, validation, implementation and ongoing performance assessment.
* Perform ad-hoc analysis to optimise credit policy rules and decisioning flows, using rule-firing, decision and outcome data to identify redundant, overlapping or mis-calibrated rules.
* Produce regular monitoring, covering population stability, discriminatory power, calibration, and segment and vintage performance, as well as decision rates and alignment with underwriting outcomes for decisioning models.
* Recalibrate or redevelop models as portfolio experience matures, comparing predicted and actual outcomes and adjusting model scaling, score cut-offs or policy thresholds where evidence of drift or mis-calibration exists.
* Lead root-cause investigations into model, rule or decisioning-flow underperformance by tracing issues through decision logs, data lineage, feature calculations, production pipelines and implementation logic.
* Build well-controlled, reproducible modelling processes and drive improvements to the data, tooling and infrastructure required for future model development and deployment.
* Document models, rules, assumptions, limitations and changes to a high standard, supporting governance, independent review and validation, and stakeholder review.
* Work closely with Credit Risk, Finance, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data and Engineering teams to track model requirements and translate business needs into practical solutions, while complying with all mandatory policies and maintaining a strong internal control environment.

**Personal Attributes & Experience**

* You have at least 5 years’ hands-on risk modelling experience, applying statistical modelling techniques such as logistic and linear regression, as well as machine learning models, to solve practical business problems.
* You are comfortable with large data sets, and data extraction and manipulation using Excel, SQL, Python & BI tools.
* You have a proven track record with Python coding, and are comfortable using GenAI tools to increase coding productivity.
* You have a good understanding of IFRS9, credit and lending concepts, preferably in commercial lending.
* You are driven, self-motivated and passionate about building great solutions for the bank.
* You can work independently and are flexible to adapt quickly to changing priorities within a very dynamic environment.
* You work well with stakeholders across the business, and collaboratively within the team.
* You have strong skills in writing technical documents as well as business-focused documents to get buy-in from various stakeholders.
* Experience of implementation of models into software applications is highly desirable.

Prior experience in this area matters for this role. If you believe you are a strong fit for the role, but don’t quite meet one of the requirements above – if you think you can suitably overcome that, then please apply anyway.
  
  
**Working at Allica Bank**
At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
  
  
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:
  
  

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
* Options for flexible working
* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

**Don’t tick every box?**
Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!
  
  
**Flexible working**
We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.
  
  
**Diversity**
We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Job Description – Manager Finance

Venture Capital Fund / Alternative Investment Fund (AIF)

Position: Manager – Finance

Reporting To: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Location: New Delhi

Experience

Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 4–5 years of relevant experience, preferably in Venture Capital, Private Equity, AIFs, Financial Services, Startups, or Consulting firms.

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented finance professional to join our Venture Capital Fund team. The role will primarily focus on fund finance operations, regulatory and compliance management, MIS reporting, portfolio monitoring, financial analysis, and supporting strategic finance initiatives. The candidate will work closely with the CFO to ensure smooth financial and operational management of the Fund and portfolio companies.

Key Responsibilities:

Compliance & Regulatory Management

· Manage compliance requirements applicable to SEBI-registered AIFs and related entities.

· Coordinate with auditors, consultants, custodians, bankers, and legal advisors.

· Support periodic regulatory filings, investor reporting, and statutory compliances.

· Monitor compliance with fund documents, investment limits, drawdowns, and reporting obligations.

· Maintain compliance trackers, records, and documentation to ensure timely closure of action items and regulatory submissions.

· Coordinate with the Chief Compliance Officer for escalation of key compliance matters, regulatory observations, and risk areas requiring management attention.

· All compliance activities, filings, and reports are subject to final review and oversight by the Chief Compliance Officer prior to submission or closure.

Audit, Taxation & Legal Coordination

· Work closely with the CFO in managing statutory, tax, and fund audits for the Fund, AMC, and related entities.

· Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and advisors for timely completion of audits, tax filings, and regulatory compliances.

· Maintain audit, tax, and compliance records/documentation in an organized manner.

· Support the legal team in managing agreements, legal documentation, due diligence requirements, and coordination with external counsels.

Financial Reporting & MIS

· Assist in periodic MIS reports, fund performance reports, cash flow statements, and portfolio summaries.

· Assist in preparation and review of financial statements, NAV workings, and investor reports.

Portfolio Monitoring & Analysis

· Work closely with the CFO in monitoring and analyzing the financial and operational performance of portfolio companies.

· Support collation, review, and analysis of financial data, MIS, valuation-related information, and operational metrics of portfolio companies.

· Assist the CFO in preparation of portfolio review reports, investor updates, performance dashboards, and internal analytical presentations.

· Maintain and manage a centralized data repository for portfolio company information, financial records, compliance documents, investment data, and reporting trackers.

· Coordinate with portfolio companies for timely collection of financial statements, operational updates, budgets, and other information required for monitoring and reporting purposes.

· Support tracking of portfolio-level KPIs, investment performance, follow-on requirements, and key developments for management review

Desired Skills & Competencies

· Strong understanding of accounting, financial analysis, and fund operations.

· Working knowledge of SEBI AIF regulations and compliance framework.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Proficiency in Excel, financial modeling, and MIS reporting.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.

· Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

· High attention to detail and execution capability.

Preferred Background

· Experience in Venture Capital / PE Funds / AIFs / Investment Banking / Financial Advisory preferred.

· Exposure to portfolio monitoring, fund accounting, or transaction support would be an added advantage.

Qualification

· Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory

· 4–5 years of post-qualification experience

title: Senior Manager, AR Finance
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Senior Manager, AR Finance Americas provides Tenneco ownership of Accounts Receivable governance, controls, compliance, and performance across Powertrain (PT) and Clean Air (CA) in the Americas. The role combines PT North America operational oversight, CA control responsibilities, and hands-on governance of 3POs delivery and improvement projects. It serves as Tenneco's primary AR point of contact for the region, ensuring strong controls, clear accountability, standard processes, and effective execution.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

• Act as Tenneco’s primary point of contact for Accounts Receivable across the Americas.

• Lead AR process governance for CA and PT and ensure alignment with Tenneco Global Process Standards.

• Partner with plants and 3POs to implement, sustain, and improve standardized AR processes across the region.

• Monitor past-due receivables and drive recovery actions to maintain performance within targets established by Tenneco leadership.

• Review and approve AR account reconciliations for CA and PT, including PT North America, and ensure timely resolution of reconciling items and risks.

• Review and validate bad debt reserves and write-off proposals for CA and PT in line with Tenneco policies and financial reporting requirements.

• Review forecasted customer receipts and month-end past-due performance, identifying risks, opportunities, and required actions.

• Explain variances in collections, customer receipts, past due, DSO, bad debt, and working capital performance.

• Partner with the Americas FP&A team during month-end reviews, cash forecasting, variance analysis, and performance discussions.

• Review and approve role assignments and access creation requests managed with 3P ensuring compliance with internal controls and segregation of duties.

• Govern customer portal access, including approvals, periodic access reviews, and compliance monitoring.

• Provide business approvals for Customer Master Data workflow creation and process changes within delegated authority.

• Participate in Serrala pilot activities, business testing, process adaptation, deployment readiness, and change implementation.

• Act as the escalation point for complex or recurring issues involving collections, disputes, cash application, reconciliations, Customer Master Data, portal access, and bad debt.

• Monitor 3POs service delivery through KPIs, SLAs, process compliance, and corrective action plans.

• Lead root-cause analysis and remediation of upstream and downstream process gaps affecting AR performance.

• Drive process standardization, controls, system enhancements, automation, and continuous improvement across the Americas.

• Prepare and communicate AR performance, risk, compliance, and project updates to Tenneco leadership and key stakeholders.

• Lead projects assigned by Tenneco leadership, ensuring clear ownership, stakeholder alignment, timely execution, and measurable outcomes.

• Provide direct operational oversight for PT North America AR activities while retaining Tenneco accountability for decisions, approvals, controls, and audit support.

• Review and approve AR reconciliations and ensure timely resolution of aged reconciling items for PT and CA.

• Approve user access, role assignments, and segregation-of-duties controls, including periodic user-access reviews.

• Provide business approvals for Customer Master Data creation and maintenance workflows within delegated authority.

• Review and approve AR and PT Corporate adjustments, write-offs, re-aging requests, and bad debt proposals in line with Tenneco policies.

• Review and approve North America AR SOPs and ensure procedures remain aligned with global standards and control requirements.

• Prepare and review the Customer Receipts Forecast using expected customer payment behavior, open receivables, and known collection risks.

• Own the Tenneco response and remediation plan for AR audit findings, control gaps, and compliance actions.

• Provide hands-on governance of 3POs performance, including close follow-up, clear communication, escalation, corrective actions, and delivery of assigned efficiency projects.

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. A master’s degree or professional certification is preferred.

**Experience:**
At least 7 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, finance operations, shared services, service-provider management, or related financial processes.

**Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of AR, collections, cash application, reconciliations, bad debt, Customer Master Data, internal controls, and working capital management.
* Experience with ERP systems and AR solutions, supported by strong analytical, reporting, and performance-management capabilities.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, decision-making, change leadership, organization, and ability to work effectively across cultures and priorities.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**PURPOSE**

The Revenue Manager is responsible for driving total hotel revenue and profitability through strategic pricing, inventory management, demand forecasting, and market intelligence. The role focuses on maximising revenue across Rooms, Suites, Food & Beverage outlets, Banqueting and Events, and other ancillary revenue streams while preserving unit's luxury positioning and guest experience standards.

The incumbent will lead the hotel’s revenue management strategy by analysing market demand, competitor performance, booking trends, and distribution channels to optimise occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), Revenue per Available Room (RevPAR). Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, Finance, and Operations, the Revenue Manager will support data-driven commercial decisions that enhance market share, profitability, and long-term business growth.

**KEY ORGANISATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

**Reports To:**
Director of Sales & Marketing

**Direct Reports:**
Revenue Executive(s), Reservations Associate

**Interacts With:**

**External**

* Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)
* Corporate Travel Partners
* Revenue Management Consultants
* Market Benchmarking and Distribution Partners (STR, RateGain, etc.)

**Internal**

* General Manager
* Director of Sales & Marketing
* Reservations Team
* Front Office
* Finance
* Food & Beverage
* Banquets & Events
* Marketing
* IT
* Hotel Operations Teams

**Revenue Strategy & Optimisation**

* Develop and execute revenue management strategies to maximise ADR, RevPAR, occupancy and profitability.
* Monitor booking pace, pickup trends, market demand and competitor pricing to implement dynamic pricing strategies.
* Manage room inventory, room category availability, restrictions, controls, and overbooking strategies where appropriate.
* Optimise revenue opportunities across transient, corporate, wholesale, group and MICE segments.
* Collaborate with Sales and Events teams to evaluate group business opportunities and displacement analyses.
* Oversee banquet and event space inventory utilisation to maximise revenue contribution from Meetings, Conferences, Weddings and Social Events.
* Ensure optimal rate positioning across all direct and indirect distribution channels.

**Forecasting, Analytics & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly and annual revenue forecasts for Rooms and total hotel revenue.
* Produce rolling forecasts by segment, channel to support strategic planning and budgeting.
* Monitor and analyse key performance indicators including ADR, RevPAR, Market Penetration Index (MPI), Revenue Generation Index (RGI) and occupancy performance.
* Provide actionable revenue insights through market trend analysis and business intelligence reporting.
* Support annual budgeting, strategic planning and long-range forecasting processes.
* Utilise STR, RateGain and internal reporting tools to identify opportunities and market risks.

**Distribution & Channel Management**

* Maintain rate parity and inventory accuracy across all distribution channels.
* Monitor OTA performance, direct booking trends, channel costs and contribution margins.
* Manage rate loading, promotions, packages and strategic offers through PMS, CRS and channel management platforms.
* Evaluate distribution partnerships and recommend initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.

**Commercial Collaboration**

* Lead weekly Revenue Strategy Meetings to review pace, forecast accuracy, market demand and business mix.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing teams to align promotional activities with demand forecasts.
* Support commercial decision-making through pricing recommendations and revenue impact assessments.
* Work closely with Operations to ensure revenue strategies are aligned with guest expectations and service standards.

**Leadership & People Development**

* Drive a revenue-focused culture throughout the hotel by promoting commercial awareness across departments.
* Coach and mentor revenue and reservations team members.
* Facilitate training on revenue management principles, forecasting methodologies, Best Available Rate (BAR) strategies, and distribution management.
* Establish performance objectives and development plans for team members.

**Work Experience**

* Minimum 5-7 years of experience in Revenue Management within luxury hotels.
* Prior experience with luxury city hotels, luxury lifestyle hotels, or leading hospitality brands preferred.
* Proven track record in driving ADR, RevPAR and total revenue growth.

title: Senior Consultant, India-Europe Projects
description:
Jain-Richter Group connects Indian and European companies with the right partner on the other side. You find those partners, run the projects that bring them together, and sit at the table with the Managing Partner.

**The practical terms first**

* ₹45,000 to ₹60,000 a month depending on experience, on a consultancy agreement
* Plus performance-based pay
* Remote from Delhi NCR, Monday to Saturday, starting by 07:30 IST
* In person with clients in Delhi NCR 10 to 15 days a quarter

**What is on the desk now**

You work across all four services, because the work arrives that way. Every project is confidential, so these are described without names.

**Technology transfer & joint ventures**

* A European biogas technology owner wants Indian EPC contractors to take its licence.
* A German engineering firm builds biogas plants for Indian clients.
* A joint venture is moving from term sheet to company.

**Investment & acquisitions**

* Indian investors are looking at German companies, hotels and real estate.
* A European pharmaceutical site needs a buyer.
* Investors want Indian greentech opportunities.

**Market entry & access**

* German Mittelstand companies are preparing to enter India.
* Indian technology companies want a way into German industry.

**Trade & sourcing**

* Trading houses want agricultural commodities and edible oils.
* New enquiries need qualifying before anyone spends time on them.

**The work**

**Find and qualify the right companies (about 35%)**

* Build the target list for each project: manufacturers, EPC contractors, investors, Mittelstand companies, suppliers and buyers.
* Check what each company claims against sources a client can verify: filings, certification registers, trade fair exhibitor lists, trade data.
* Deliver a ranked shortlist with a short case for each name, and a separate list of what you could not verify.

**Run the projects (about 30%)**

* Own the tracker for four to six live projects, so every thread carries an owner and a dated next step.
* Prepare a one-page brief for every meeting, route NDAs and keep the documents in order.
* Send minutes and follow-ups the same day, and chase every open thread to a yes, a no or a date.

**Work with clients and partners (about 25%)**

* Join client and partner calls and the meetings in Delhi NCR, and present your own research.
* Be the day-to-day contact for information requests.
* Represent the firm at trade fairs and come back with qualified contacts and written notes.

**Improve how the firm works (about 10%)**

* Fix what slows the work down: the project tracker, the CRM, research and handover templates, and the AI research workflows.
* Write down each process you improve, so the next person can run it without asking.
* Propose one improvement a month, agree it with the Managing Partner, and put it in use. Client deadlines always come first.

**How we work together**

**We work across two time zones: the Managing Partner in Singapore, you in India. A few simple habits keep us in step and make sure your work keeps moving without waiting on anyone.**

1. **Progress over perfection.**
   We work on an 80/20 basis. A clear first answer early is worth more than a perfect one late, so share what you have as soon as it is enough to decide the next step.
2. **Raise it early.**
   If something is not working after about two hours, let us know and suggest a way forward. Getting stuck is normal; staying stuck alone is what we want to avoid.
3. **Align before you dive in.**
   For anything that will take longer than a day, send a short note first: how you understand the task, how you plan to approach it, and when you expect to finish.
4. **A short daily update.**
   At the end of your day, by 17:00 IST, a few lines on what you completed, anything that is blocked, and your priorities for tomorrow.
5. **Stay connected in the mornings.**
   A short call each morning, and replies within a couple of hours between 07:30 and 13:00 IST.

"I could not verify this" is always a good answer. We value honesty over a confident guess.

**What this role is not**

* Not an executive assistant role. No calendar management, inbox triage, travel booking or errands.
* Not a sales role. You find and qualify companies. The Managing Partner pitches, prices, negotiates and signs. That boundary is legal, not a judgement about you.
* Not web development or design.

**You**

* Mid to senior level: at least five years in consulting, market research, transaction support, investment promotion, a chamber of commerce or an embassy's commercial section.
* You can name a project you ran from start to finish and what it changed.
* You write English that goes to a German managing director or an Indian promoter family with light edits or none. You speak Hindi well enough to call a company and ask a short set of questions.
* Excel or Sheets to a working standard. You use AI research tools and check every fact against its original source.
* You live in Delhi NCR, meet in person on a few days' notice, and work on your own laptop.
* German is a real advantage, and is paid as one.
* The role is open to anyone, whatever their gender, community or marital status.

**Your first 90 days**

* Day 30: the tracker is live for every open project, nothing sits without a dated next step, and the daily handover runs unasked. One ranked target list delivered.
* Day 60: you run the weekly rhythm of one project on your own, and own the follow-ups from at least two client meetings.
* Day 90: at least one project has moved a full stage, with you as the working contact on our side. One improved process is written down and in use.

**Pay**

The monthly fee is fixed and paid against your invoice. Performance-based pay is at the firm's discretion and scored on four things you control:

* Delivery: milestones met on the agreed date, or moved in writing before they were missed.
* Research quality: sources a client can check, a ranking with reasons, an honest unverified list.
* Project control: every thread with an owner and a next step, and a handover on every working day.
* Client and partner feedback: how the people on the other side describe working with you.

Performance-based pay is never linked to a deal, a commission or a transaction value. That is a legal requirement, and it keeps the incentive on the quality of the work.

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn. Then email your answers to the two questions below, in no more than 150 words each, to join@jain-richtergroup.com with the subject line "Senior Consultant, your name".

1. Describe one project you ran from start to finish. What was the outcome, and what did you personally do?
2. Tell us about a time you stopped working on something because it was not going anywhere. How long did it take you to notice, and who did you tell?

Applications without the two answers are not read.

Shortlisted candidates have one interview of 45 minutes with the Managing Partner, a two-hour case study, and a paid trial week on real work before any agreement is signed. We reply to everyone within seven days, and if we say no, we say why in a line.

title: Research Analyst
description:
**Location:**

2–3 years

**About the Tax Vertical at ICPP**

The Convergence Foundation (TCF) is expanding its work on
**tax policy as a critical lever for India's long-term economic growth**
. To advance this agenda, TCF has incubated a
**Tax Policy Vertical at the ICPP, Ashoka University**
, bringing together Ashoka's academic and interdisciplinary strengths with a strong focus on real-world policy questions.

The Vertical aims to build an independent, long-term research and policy platform focused on
**how India can strengthen tax administration, compliance and institutional design while supporting investment, productivity, formalisation and growth**
. Its work will combine rigorous research, evidence generation, international benchmarking and implementable policy design, with engagement across the policy cycle.

The Vertical will initially focus on
**tax administration and compliance across all taxes**
, while building distinctive datasets, research capacity and institutional partnerships over time. It will serve as a
**research institution, policy sounding board and convening platform**
, with independence and freedom from commercial or success-based advisory work at its core.

**About the Role**

The Tax Policy Vertical at the Indian Council for Public Policy (ICPP), Ashoka University, is establishing India's leading independent centre for research on taxation, tax administration and public finance. The centre aims to generate rigorous evidence, inform policy reforms, strengthen state capacity, and contribute to India's long-term economic growth agenda under
*Viksit Bharat 2047*
.

We are looking for a highly motivated Research Associate with 2–3 years of experience in economics, public policy, public finance, or related fields to support research, policy analysis and stakeholder engagement across direct taxes, indirect taxes, tax administration and institutional reforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Research & Policy Analysis**

* Conduct quantitative and qualitative research on taxation, public finance and economic policy.
* Analyse datasets relating to taxation, investment, compliance costs, litigation and economic growth.
* Analyse tax laws, administrative processes and institutional reforms in India and internationally.
* Undertake literature reviews, comparative policy studies and international benchmarking.
* Support development of policy papers, issue briefs, working papers and discussion notes.

**Policy Development**

* Support formulation of evidence-based policy recommendations.
* Assist in developing long-term reform frameworks on tax policy and administration.
* Contribute to research on tax competitiveness, investment climate and ease of doing business.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support consultations with government officials, academia, industry, multilateral organisations and civil society.
* Prepare background notes, meeting briefs and consultation summaries.
* Assist in organising policy roundtables, workshops and conferences.

**Knowledge & Communication**

* Prepare presentations, policy decks and research summaries for senior policymakers.
* Monitor domestic and global developments in taxation and public finance.
* Contribute to blogs, newsletters and knowledge products.

**Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy or related discipline.
* 2–3 years of experience in:
* Public policy research organisations/Think tanks
* Economic/Strategy/public sector consulting
* Excellent analytical and research skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of India's federal tax system, fiscal policy and public finance.
* Experience working with government datasets and policy reports.
* Quantitative skills (Excel required; familiarity with Stata, R or Python preferred).
* Excellent writing and presentation skills.
* Ability to synthesise complex evidence into clear policy recommendations.
* Strong project management and stakeholder coordination abilities.

title: Assistant Manager - Accounts Payable
description:

The role involves ensuring timely and accurate invoice processing, vendor reconciliations, MIS reporting, and effective monitoring of the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) cycle. The ideal candidate should have
**hands-on experience in SAP/SAP HANA**
, particularly PR/PO, MIGO, and MIRO transactions, along with a strong understanding of Accounts Payable processes, financial controls, and capital expenditure (Capex) accounting.

1. **Key Responsibilities**

**Accounts Payable Management**

* Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable activities, including invoice processing, verification, accounting, and payment-related activities.
* Ensure timely and accurate booking of vendor invoices in SAP/SAP HANA through MIRO and journal vouchers (JV).
* Monitor pending Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs) and coordinate with relevant departments for timely MIGO and MIRO completion.
* Verify invoices against applicable POs, goods receipts/service entry sheets, and supporting documents.
* Identify and resolve invoice discrepancies, blocked invoices, and pending GR/IR items.
* Ensure appropriate accounting and classification of expenses in accordance with company policies.
* Handle Capex MIRO transactions and write-offs in SAP.

**Vendor Reconciliation and Ageing**

* Perform regular vendor ledger reconciliations and resolve outstanding differences.
* Prepare and review vendor ageing reports and monitor overdue and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with procurement, business teams, and vendors to resolve open items.
* Monitor vendor advances and ensure timely adjustment and settlement.

**MIS and Management Reporting**

* Prepare periodic Accounts Payable MIS reports for management review.
* Prepare and analyze Budget vs. Actual expenses and highlight significant variances.
* Analyze key AP metrics, outstanding liabilities, vendor ageing, and pending invoices.
* Provide financial data, analysis, and ad-hoc reports to support management decision-making.

**MSME Compliance**

* Identify and monitor MSME-registered vendors.
* Track outstanding MSME dues and ensure compliance with applicable statutory payment timelines.
* Maintain records and provide information required for MSME-related reporting and compliance.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve MSME-related issues.

**Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Process Monitoring**

* Monitor the complete PR–PO–MIGO–MIRO–Payment cycle.
* Track pending PR, PO, MIGO, and MIRO transactions and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure timely closure of open items and minimize ageing of pending transactions.
* Work closely with Procurement, Stores, Supply Chain Management (SCM), and business teams to improve P2P processes.

**Internal Controls and Audit**

* Ensure compliance with internal accounting policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and financial controls.
* Support internal, statutory, and tax audits by providing required schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen Accounts Payable controls and operational efficiency.

**2. Educational Qualifications**

* CA Inter from a recognized institution.
* Any graduate or Post Graduate

**3. Experience and Technical Competencies**

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable or Finance & Accounts.
* Hands-on experience in SAP/SAP HANA is required, particularly in MIRO and related transactions.
* Experience in manufacturing, agriculture, Agri-inputs, seeds, or related industries will be an added advantage.
* Experience managing a high-volume vendor base and complex Procure-to-Pay transactions will be preferred.

**4. Key Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Accounts Payable and Procure-to-Pay processes.
* Good knowledge of vendor ageing, vendor reconciliation, and Accounts Payable MIS.
* Understanding of Budget vs. Actual expense analysis.
* Knowledge of MSME vendor compliance and payment requirements.
* Strong MS Excel skills, including data analysis and MIS preparation.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Procurement, Stores, SCM, and other business functions.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.

**5. Role Expectations**

The successful candidate will ensure efficient Accounts Payable operations, accurate financial records, timely vendor reconciliations, adherence to statutory payment requirements, and effective monitoring of the Procure-to-Pay cycle while supporting financial controls and reporting requirements.

title: Senior Analyst - Credit and Collections
description:
**Job Description**
As the Senior Analyst – Credit and Collections, you will be responsible for managing the accounts receivable for a portfolio of customers, including collecting payments, maintaining records, and evaluating credit information to minimize credit risk. You will be responsible for contacting customers to confirm outstanding payments, obtain payment commitments and recommending solutions to remove impediments for future customer payments within the agreed payment terms. You will also mentor others with lower-level positions in Financial Services.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Reviews past due invoices and makes a high-volume of collection contacts via phone, e-mail, or customer portals.
* Works with the customer to determine root cause of dispute for unpaid or short-paid invoices. Identifies and documents detailed reason and recommends corrective action to resolve current and future disputes.
* Performs customer account reconciliations, including research of unapplied cash, and credits and unearned discounts. Recommends actions for resolution and avoidance of future reconciling issues.
* Evaluates collectability of unearned cash discounts, finance charges, small dollar invoices, etc. and performs write-offs of uncollectable amounts within their level of authority. Reviews and approves write-offs escalated from Analysts and further escalates with recommendations to next level of approval authority based on materiality.
* Obtains appropriate credit information to rate credit worthiness of new and existing accounts within assigned portfolio. Reviews and approves credit limits escalated from Analysts and further escalates with recommendations to next level of approval authority based on materiality.
* Works cross-functionally with sales, operations, finance, contract administration, and customer master administration teams to gather and review documents, including purchase orders, credit applications, and loads into contract tracking tool with recommendation of approval decision by financial services management and partners.
* Reviews orders on credit hold by assessing credit worthiness of customers, including financial ratings, open invoices, in-process payments, and backlog. Releases orders or escalates to supervisor with recommendation for continued credit hold actions.

* Associates’ Degree (U.S.)/College Diploma (Canada) - Accounting, finance, supply chain or business required; Bachelors’ Degree preferred

* Ability to prioritize tasks and demonstrate a willingness to accept new challenges.
* Ability to work with all levels of management to accomplish goals and objectives.
* Willingness to travel on a limited basis (1-3 trips per year)

title: Financial Controller
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Energeia is an Industrial Energy Savings Company. We find energy waste in factories and commercial buildings, fix it, and get paid from the savings we verify. Since 2018 we have completed 1,200+ site appraisals and 250+ energy audits, and saved customers ₹256 Crore in energy costs. We are a BEE-accredited ESCO with offices in 5 cities, our own manufacturing and training facility in Haryana, and technology partnerships with ABB, L&T and GFS Corp (USA).

In August 2026 we launched August Energeia with Singapore-based August Energy: a $100M platform that finances, installs and operates energy infrastructure for Indian industry, so customers pay from savings instead of upfront capex. The capital comes from global institutional investors including Proparco and responsAbility.

**WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW**

Every project now sits inside an institutional-grade structure. Clean books, clean contracts and clean compliance are what let capital move.

We run five revenue streams: ESCO and project fees, product sales, AMC and SaaS subscriptions, GCC retainers and cash flows from live ESCO projects. Investors want each one booked, filed and reported monthly. This is a new finance leadership seat: you will own the numbers, lead the Accounts team, and grow into Head of Finance as we scale.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

* Books and close: month-end and year-end close in Zoho Books, with reconciliations, accruals and revenue recognition across all five streams
* Statutory compliance: the full calendar for GST, TDS, advance tax, income tax, PF, ESI and ROC, with zero late filings
* CA and audit: manage our external CA firm and lead statutory and tax audits from schedules to sign-off
* MIS: monthly P&L by business line, cash flow, receivables, payables and people cost
* Investor reporting: monthly and quarterly investor packs and project-level P&L for ESCO and Cooling-as-a-Service assets
* Cash and collections: a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast, and receivables discipline with Sales
* Controls: payment approval, vendor onboarding and expense policies that scale across 5 cities
* Budgets: build the annual budget with function heads and track variance monthly
* Team: lead and develop the Accounts team, and replace manual work with Zoho automation and AI tools

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: compliance calendar live and owned; first MIS published on a fixed date; close process documented with the Accounts team
* 6 months: close in 7 working days; MIS out by the 10th of every month; first quarterly investor pack delivered on time
* 12 months: zero late filings or penalties; statutory audit closed on time with no material qualifications; cash forecast and next year's budget running

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant, 5 to 8 years post-qualification, at least 2 inside a company (not only in practice)
* Personal ownership of month-end close for a business with multiple revenue streams
* Hands-on GST, TDS, income tax and PF/ESI compliance, run without penalties
* Has managed an external CA firm and a statutory audit through to sign-off
* Has built an MIS from a raw ledger in Excel: P&L, cash flow and receivables
* Has led or coached an accounts team of 2 to 5 people
* Zoho Books or Tally, and advanced Excel

**STRONG PLUS**

* Project or infrastructure accounting, with asset-level cash flows
* Reporting to institutional investors, PE funds or DFIs
* Ind AS, FEMA and ODI exposure for international entities
* ESOP accounting and valuation coordination
* Zoho One beyond Books: CRM, Expense, People
* Daily use of AI tools for analysis and automation

**HOW WE WORK**

* Trust: radical openness and transparency in everything we do
* Growth mindset: experiment, fail forward, invest in your own learning
* Ownership: results-driven people who solve more than their own problems
* Community: collaborative, inclusive teams that enjoy working together
* Fairness and decency: do what is right, not what is easier
* Resilience: welcome the challenges that push us, and come back stronger

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive compensation, based on experience
* A direct line to the CEO and a defined path to Head of Finance
* A seat at the table for investor conversations with August Energy and its partners
* Exposure to global partners: ABB, GFS Corp and August Energy

**THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF**

* You want a pure compliance role. Half of this job is MIS, cash and investor reporting.
* You need a finished process and a large team. You will build both, with a lean team.
* You prefer to advise from outside. Here you own the numbers and sign for them.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. Our team will get back to you on next steps.

Energeia is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skill and ownership, and welcome applicants of every background.

title: Credit Underwriter and Risk Management
description:
**Company Description**
Z1N Capital is an asset management firm focused on investment opportunities in India, with a particular emphasis on credit and fixed-income strategies. The firm applies a disciplined, research-driven approach to capital allocation, aiming to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for its investors. Z1N Capital values rigorous analysis, prudent risk management, and long-term partnerships in the Indian financial markets. Team members collaborate closely to assess credit opportunities and manage portfolios in a dynamic economic and regulatory environment.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram for a Credit Underwriter and Risk Management professional. The role involves evaluating credit proposals, performing detailed financial and business analysis, and underwriting loans in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements. The professional will assess borrower creditworthiness, structure loan terms, and prepare clear credit memos and recommendations for approval committees. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring existing exposures, tracking portfolio performance, and identifying emerging risks across sectors. The individual will collaborate with investment, operations, and compliance teams, maintain accurate documentation, and communicate underwriting decisions and risk assessments to internal stakeholders.

* **Key Responsibilities**

• Credit Assessment & Underwriting

• Evaluate loan applications by analysing financial statements, income documents, bank statements, GST returns, and other supporting information depending on customer profile (salaried / self-employed / MSME).

• Review credit bureau reports (CIBIL/Experian/CRIF/Equifax) for score, repayment track, existing obligations, write -offs, and settlements.

• Assess repayment capacity using FOIR, DSCR, and other key ratios, and understand business vintage, stability, and cash -flow patterns.

• For secured products, evaluate collateral comfort through LTV, valuation and legal reports, and overall security coverage.

• Decisioning & Deal Structuring

• Prepare concise credit notes / CAMs summarising risk assessment, strengths, weaknesses, and recommendations (approve/modify / decline) within defined authority limits.

• Structure deals appropriately (tenor, amount, co -applicants/guarantors, security, covenants) to balance risk and business potential.

• Ensure all underwriting decisions are in line with internal credit policies, RBI norms, and product program guidelines.

• Coordination & TAT Management

• Work closely with sales, operations, KYC, legal, technical, and collections teams to resolve queries and move cases smoothly from login to disbursement while meeting TAT benchmarks.

• Provide clear feedback to sourcing teams on declined/reworked cases to improve file quality. • Portfolio Quality & Risk Monitoring

• Identify early warning signals such as adverse bureau behaviour, high FOIR, frequent banking bounces, or negative market feedback at the underwriting stage and highlight to seniors.

• Participate in periodic portfolio reviews to understand delinquency trends, modify underwriting filters, and suggest policy/process improvements.

• Support audits, compliance reviews, and internal control checks by maintaining complete and accurate documentation of all underwriting decisions.

• Process & Policy Support • Provide inputs for refinement of scorecards, underwriting checklists, and product programs based on on -ground experience.

• Contribute to the training of new RMs/DSAs on documentation quality and basic credit hygiene, when required.

**Qualifications & Skills**

• Graduate/Postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, Business, Accounting, or related field; CA / MBA (Finance) preferred but not mandatory.

• 2-6 years of hands -on experience in credit underwriting for retail or MSME loans in NBFC/bank/fintech.

• Strong skills in financial statement analysis, cash -flow assessment, bank -statement analysis, and credit-bureau interpretation.

• Good understanding of RBI/NBFC regulatory framework and internal credit/risk policies.

• High attention to detail, sound judgement, and ability to take timely, well -documented credit decisions under volume and TAT pressure.

title: Manager / Sr. Manager Strategy and Investor Relations
description:
**Client - One of the largest players in the CoWorking space**

This role is the engine room of the company's capital markets function. It prepares everything investors see, keeps track of who owns the stock and who we meet, supports management in every investor interaction, and gives leadership timely analysis on acquisitions and promoter shareholding matters.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Quarterly earnings cycle

* Build the quarterly earnings presentation: financial and operating KPIs, portfolio updates, guidance and narrative, in line with the house style.
* Draft the earnings call script for the founders and CFO, and prepare an anticipated Q&A pack with data-backed answers.
* Draft the quarterly shareholder letter in the founders' voice.
* Coordinate the timeline with Finance, the auditors and the Company Secretary so results, deck and filings go out on schedule.

2. Roadshows and investor conferences

* Plan and run deal and non-deal roadshows (domestic and international): target lists, broker coordination, meeting schedules, logistics and briefing notes.
* Manage participation in broker-hosted investor conferences, including 1x1 and group meeting requests.
* Attend investor meetings, take notes, track the questions raised and close out follow-ups.
* Feed recurring investor questions back into the deck, script and Q&A pack.

3. Investor presentation and materials

* Keep the corporate investor presentation current after every quarter and every material event.
* Prepare tailored versions for specific investors, conferences and strategic discussions.

4. Investor database and engagement tracking

* Maintain a database of current and prospective investors: institution, fund, contacts, holdings, investment style and meeting history.
* Use it to target new investors, prioritise meetings and report engagement to management.

5. Weekly BENPOS analysis

* Analyse the weekly beneficiary position (BENPOS) data from the RTA.
* Track changes in institutional, retail and promoter holdings; identify new entrants, exits and build-ups.
* Circulate a weekly shareholding movement note to management and link it to investor targeting.

6. M&A opportunity evaluation

* Screen and evaluate acquisition, merger and partnership opportunities in flexible workspace and adjacent sectors.
* Build financial models and valuations (DCF, comparables, precedent transactions) and run synergy analysis.
* Support due diligence with external advisors and prepare board and Audit Committee material, including related-party transaction requirements where relevant.

7. Review of external communications

* Review press releases, stock exchange intimations, media statements, website content and investor-facing material for accuracy, consistency and SEBI LODR compliance.
* Make sure numbers and messaging match published financials and earlier disclosures.

title: Financial Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* Minimum of 3 to 4 years of relevant experience in the securitization field with hands-on exposure to Structured Finance asset classes such as Collateralized Loan Obligations, Residential Mortgage Backed Securities, Commercial Mortgage Backed Securities, or Asset Backed Securities required; background in Collateralized Loan Obligation asset class preferred
* Strong quantitative and analytical problem-solving abilities with the capability to interpret and model complex deal structures and cash flow waterfalls accurately
* Experience with data tools and scripting or programming languages such as SQL, Python, VBA, C#, JavaScript, and JSON highly desirable; candidates may be assessed on problem-solving skills and ability to write code
* Attention to detail with the ability to deliver outputs accurately within stipulated timeframes while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced global environment
* Excellent team player with the ability to collaborate effectively with financial engineers, data teams, and developers across multiple global locations
* Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage directly with trustees and cross-functional teams across client support and asset class desks & private credit exposure is a plus
* Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use

**Education**

* Master's degree in Finance, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field required

**Responsibilities**

* The Financial Engineer is responsible for waterfall cash flow modelling of structured finance deals to expand coverage and deliver high-quality analytics for global clients & develop complex cash flow projection models, including deal structure setup, for US and European securitization transactions using proprietary modelling software
* Lead and participate in quality and productivity enhancement projects to improve the accuracy and efficiency of cash flow modelling workflows
* Lead and participate in modelling and updating tool development and enhancement initiatives in collaboration with technology and developer teams
* Work closely with asset class desks and client support teams to address client challenges, support new feature developments, and analyze emerging securitization products in the market
* Collaborate with financial engineers, data teams, and developers across multiple global locations to improve the coverage and quality of content offerings and business processes. Also, engage directly with trustees of structured finance transactions to resolve issues and ensure accurate representation of deal terms in models
* Contribute to cross-training within the team by sharing expertise in securitization structure and cash flow features across various asset classes

**About The Team**
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today's risks into tomorrow's opportunities. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment with 14,000+ employees across 90 cities, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and innovative workplace. The India Cash Flow Modelling team, part of the Asset Management group, is primarily responsible for deal setup and waterfall cash flow modelling of Collateralized Loan Obligation deals using in-house proprietary modelling tools, alongside data updating and analytics activities. By joining this team, you will play a key role in expanding global structured finance deal coverage, driving process innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams around the world to deliver impactful analytical solutions.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Assistant Manager : Finance Controllership
description:
**About The Company**
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
  
  
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
  
  
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
  
  
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Aspire, the Finance team plays a strategic and pivotal role in Aspire's continued expansion. Our comprehensive Finance function encompasses six key verticals: Financial Controlling, Treasury, Finance Analytics, Strategic Finance & Planning, Credit Risk, and Finance Strategy & Operations. From conducting in-depth strategic data analysis to spearheading Finance transformation initiatives with our Aspire software, you'll directly contribute to critical business decisions in a dynamic market. This is an exciting chance to be part of a team that values strategic thinking, innovation, and robust controls in a hyper-growth environment.
  
  
**About The Role**
Reporting to the Entity Controller, you’ll own core controllership work across Aspire’s regulated and non-regulated entities, and support the wider finance agenda across the Group.
  
  

* Own the month-end close for assigned entities, including GL and trial balance reconciliations, to deliver accurate financial results within tight deadlines
* Own financial statement preparation, including supporting schedules and balance sheet reconciliations, for monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting
* Own the statutory audit cycle end-to-end: be the primary point of contact for Big 4 auditors, prepare workpapers and technical memos, and drive annual report preparation and filing
* Support regulatory reporting for EMI/regulated entities, including capital adequacy and KRI monitoring, regulatory returns, and wind-down and recovery plan financial models
* Support safeguarding and client-money reconciliations, ensuring safeguarded funds are accurately reflected and compliant with regulatory requirements
* Support intercompany accounting across Group entities, including recharges, settlements, balance reconciliations, and related FX impacts
* Build a strong understanding of product and transaction flows end-to-end, including the underlying fund flows and associated risks, and use it to plan finance reporting requirements and give a Financial Controller’s perspective on new and existing products
* Support group expense tracking, monthly opex reporting, and cost analysis
* Support accounting policy memos and finance process design for new product launches, working closely with Product, Payments, and Operations teams
* Support the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of SOPs, internal controls, and AP and accrual processes, to ensure financial reporting is accurate and assets are safeguarded
* Work with the Tax team to review local tax filings and returns (withholding tax, VAT/GST, corporate income tax)
* Ensure all entity accounts and ledgers comply with IFRS / local GAAP, Group accounting policies, and regulatory requirements

**Minimum Qualifications**

* CA with 3–4 years of post-qualification experience, or MBA (Finance) with 10+ years of relevant experience
* Strong technical expertise in IFRS / local GAAP and all aspects of corporate accounting
* Proven experience handling Big 4 auditors through statutory audits
* Exposure to regulatory reporting for EMIs, payment institutions, banks, or other regulated financial entities
* Hands-on use of AI tools to automate close, reconciliation, and reporting workflows

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Fintech background, ideally with payments and settlement experience
* Self-motivated, results-oriented, and hands-on; able to work independently while managing multiple priorities
* Proven team player with strong cross-functional collaboration skills

title: Senior Manager – Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
*At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.*
*We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.*
*Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.*
*We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.*
*If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.*
**About Lilly’s India Affiliate**
*Few careers offer the opportunity to work directly for the people your work is ultimately meant to serve.*
*Lilly’s India affiliate is one of them.*
*Whether you are building brand strategies, developing sales capabilities, creating market access, or enabling the teams that do — the work you do here ensures that Lilly’s medicines reach the people who need them.*
**Purpose of the Job**
The Senior Manager – Financial Planning & Analysis is a highly analytical and meticulous finance professional responsible for driving robust financial planning, analysis, and business partnering across Lilly India’s commercial, marketing, and corporate functions. The role works closely with Director – FP&A to strategize and support the development of business cases, regular reporting, and potential business partnerships, providing critical financial insights that support data-driven decisions in pricing strategy, business development, and business planning. Provide financial governance and analytical rigor across annual planning, forecasting, and management reporting cycles and support global finance alignment on key performance drivers, planning assumptions, and timelines.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
**Financial Planning & Analysis**

* Lead creation of Annual Business Plans through active coordination with Sales / Marketing functions to develop robust yet achievable sales forecasts.
* Develop expense budgets in coordination with functional heads (Sales, Marketing, Medical, Corporate Affairs, HR, etc.), ensuring opex growth remains modest while maximizing ROI.
* Develop income statements reflecting Area-level expectations on growth (Sales / Opex).
* Support long-range planning based on industry analysis, product pipeline, and business strategy, including Alliance strategy and planning.

**Business Case Development & Evaluation**

* Develop and evaluate business cases assessing the financial viability of strategic initiatives, including new commercials, tenders, new product launches, and existing products.

**Pricing Strategy and Profitability**

* Develop pricing scenarios that ensure competitiveness in the marketplace and maximize realizations.
* Devise transfer pricing strategies for existing and new products.
* Drive profitability through monthly opex control and analysis of promotion and marketing spends, and Price / Volume / Mix analysis for revenue.

**Management Reporting**

* Create monthly Management Reporting, including preparation, analysis, and presentation of the Balanced Scorecard to Top Management.
* Prepare quarterly forecasts for Sales and Opex, at Affiliate, Brand, and BU level.
* Deliver monthly / quarterly / periodic reporting to the Regional Team on Sales, Opex, BUC, and related metrics.

**FP&A Transformation**

* Identify opportunities to apply AI/automation and Power BI-driven analytics to streamline planning cycles, strengthen forecast accuracy, and deliver self-service reporting capabilities to business stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications And Additional Preferences**

* University degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field; CA / CPA / CMA / MBA.
* 5+ years of work experience in FP&A, Financial Modelling, Corporate Finance / Strategy preferably in pharmaceutical industry.
* Strong grounding in financial modelling, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
* Strong analytical and interpersonal skills; assertive business partner with good financial acumen and ability to challenge / investigate.
* SAP and Microsoft Office proficiency; experience with automation tools such as Power BI and AI-based tools to automate routine tasks.
* Good operational finance and process improvement skills.
* Deals easily with ambiguity and can effectively cope with change; high learning agility.
* Ability to work effectively across a virtual network.

**Additional Information**

* Must be legally allowed to work in India.
* Office-based role; requires four (4) days a week in office.

*At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients.*
*It is how we work.*
*We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work.*
*This is not just a policy.*
*It is who we are.*

title: Finance - Private Markets Fund Controllership - Associate
description:
**Company Overview**
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
  
  
KKR's Gurugram office provides best-in-class business operations services and solutions to our internal stakeholders and clients, drives organization-wide process efficiency and transformation, and reflects KKR's global culture and values of teamwork and innovation. The office contains multifunctional business capabilities and is integral in furthering the growth and transformation of KKR. The office was established with an initial concentration of finance, operations, and technology personnel, followed by the expansion of additional functions and capabilities. KKR’s creation of a Gurugram office builds upon the firm's momentum in India and bolsters its existing presence in Mumbai.
  
  
**Team Overview**
Finance supports the strategic direction of the Firm by ensuring efficient and effective financial planning, analysis, budgeting, reporting, compliance, accounting, and stewardship of financial risks and controls. By doing so, we produce accurate financial information for decision making, ensure compliance with financial regulations and policies, and provide leadership for operational improvements, cost savings and strategic investments that align with the Firm’s culture and long-term goals.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The role is responsible for the preparation, analysis, and dissemination of financial and operational information for the private equity fund.
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**
**Operational Excellence**

* Collect and analyze financial data from various sources and prepare periodic reports for investors and stakeholders.
* Present the fund's performance and financial position.
* Ensure the reports are accurate, complete and in compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Generate reports from Investran, match opening balances with previous quarter closing balances, current activities, perform accuracy checks on all the reports.
* Conduct monthly partner transfers by identifying all partner transfers during the month from the transfer sheet, generating reports to identify any transfers that need to be adjusted, making partner transfer adjustment entries in Investran and regenerate reports to check adjustments flowing correctly in the reports.
* Prepare quarterly deal by generating reports (Balance and GAAP Financial statements), match opening balances with previous quarter closing balances, current activities, formatting as per guidelines, checking accuracy of all the reports.
* Prepare pdf package for the generated and checked reports.
* Generate quarterly fund expenses report by passing the JE as per fund receivable handoff received, match opening & closing balances, perform checks for the figures.
* Generate quarterly FX contracts report by passing the JE as per foreign currency exchange contracts handoffs, match opening & closing balances, and perform checks for the figures.
* Generate quarterly management fees report by passing the JE as per management fee handoff received, match opening & closing balances, perform checks for the figures.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with team members of the private equity team, such as portfolio managers and investment professionals, to gather and review relevant data for reporting purposes.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that reports accurately reflect the fund's activities and performance.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Run MPI reports and reconcile it with Grants and Forfeit support
* Reconcile balances/activities with prior year, Q4 rolls and support

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce or equivalent work
* Chartered Accountant / CFA
* 6-9 years of experience in fund reporting, accounting or finance
* Experience in preparing regular financial reports for private equity funds, including NAV, performance reports, and presentations
* Knowledge of fund accounting principles and the ability to maintain accurate and up-to-date capital account records
* Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations governing private equity funds and the ability to ensure compliance with all relevant requirements
* Ability to perform complex financial analysis and modelling
* Ability to communicate regularly with investors and provide updates on fund performance
* Proficiency in financial reporting software and systems, such as Bloomberg, etc.
* Ability to manage large amounts of data accurately and efficiently
* Systems/ Tools/ Applications knowledge:
* Highly proficient in MS Excel
* Investran
* Displays high intellectual curiosity and innovative mindset
* Demonstrates highest levels of integrity
* Focus on delivery excellence and accountability
* Build strong relationships with local and global colleagues
* Displays behaviors of self-reliance
* Demonstrates a relationship-driven mindset

title: Invoicing Specialist, Operations Support
description:
Concentrix is a technology-enabled global business services company specializing in customer engagement and improving business performance. We partner with ambitious, progressive executives around the world to future-proof their business and stay ahead of the competition and customer expectations.
  
  
**Role And Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare and process invoices, accruals, and run-rate revenue calculations, while owning revenue assurance and variance management to ensure that revenue leakage, billing gaps, and operational exceptions are identified, investigated, and resolved in a timely manner.
* Interpret client contracts and commercial terms, with the ability to translate binding contractual requirements and operational performance metrics into accurate revenue calculations, billing requirements, and invoice preparation.
* Establish and maintain financial and operational controls to improve the accuracy and completeness of invoicing, billing, accruals, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Partner with site-level WFM, BI, and Operations POCs to ensure that exceptional and abnormal hours are accurately captured in client dashboards and reflected correctly in the month-end locked-hours dashboard. Validate and incorporate approved exceptional and abnormal hours into final invoices to facilitate timely client approval.
* Maintain clear documentation of processes, assumptions, contractual requirements, and revenue calculation methodologies to ensure consistency, facilitate timely client approvals, and support audit readiness.
* Collect, validate, and reconcile data from multiple tools and sources to perform invoice revenue validation, accruals, reconciliations, variance analysis, and financial reporting.
* Develop and maintain standardized reports and dashboards for senior leadership, highlighting key financial and operational trends, risks, opportunities, and business drivers.
* Identify potential financial risks, revenue leakage, billing gaps, and operational exceptions, and proactively communicate them to relevant stakeholders along with recommended corrective actions.
* Support client and internal business reviews by preparing financial insights, performance trends, variance analysis, and actionable recommendations.

**Key Skills & Knowledge**
Strong focus on data accuracy, integrity, validation, and reconciliation, with a high level of attention to detail.
  
  

* Working Knowledge of revenue recognition principles, accruals, billing, forecasting, run-rate revenue, and financial variance analysis.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/INDEX MATCH, SUMIFS, Power Query, Power Pivot, data analysis, and data visualization.
* Strong understanding of WFM and operational deliverables and metrics, including data validation, reconciliation, exception management, and audit requirements.
* Ability to understand and interpret client contracts, commercial terms, service-level requirements, and performance metrics, and translate them into accurate revenue, billing, and invoicing calculations.
* Ability to drive automation and process improvements using advanced Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot, Power BI, and other reporting or analytical tools to reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, and enhance reporting efficiency.
* Communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly articulate financial insights, explain variances, and present and support data-driven conclusions.

**Desired Skills**

* Ability to build and maintain strong working relationships with global stakeholders across locations and functions.
* Strong ability to prioritize multiple deliverables, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented, with a strong work ethic and the ability to independently identify issues, risks, and opportunities and develop insightful solutions.
* Strong project and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed timelines.
* Excellent team player with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse, multicultural teams and contribute to a positive working environment.
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and continuously changing business environment while maintaining a high level of ownership and accountability.
* Confidence to provide, communicate, and constructively defend a point of view using data, analysis, and sound business rationale.

**Educational Qualification**
Bachelor's Degree

Offer letters and other recruiting correspondence from Concentrix are printed on Concentrix letter head with authentic signatures of appropriate Concentrix authorities'
