title: Cloud FinOps Team Lead
description:
**Cloud FinOps Team Leader**
Gurugram, Haryana, India
  
  
AXA XL Global Technology (GT) division has been going through significant transformation including simplification of applications landscape across geographies and business units, Cloud transformation and migration to strategic platforms, as well as operating model transformation to support upcoming technological and business process changes. These include setting modernized standards, new technologies, increased level of automation and new ways of working. Now, as part of Cloud BAU, Cloud FinOps main goal is to ensure that AXA XL’s Cloud spend is well understood, governed and managed. Head of Cloud FinOps is a crucial role in the organization, with primary responsibility to manage Cloud cost optimization, rightsizing strategies, and resource allocation, aiming for efficient and cost-effective business processes. They play a vital role in financial planning and analysis, monitoring and communicating key performance indicators for management to make data-driven decisions, oversee and guide the FinOps team, ensuring seamless collaboration with other teams such as application development, architecture, financial accounting, and management.
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  

* Continue to develop and implement FinOps best practice frameworks, including policies, processes, and best practices, to ensure effective cloud financial management aligned with organizational goals. Collaborate with architects, application delivery, cloud engineers, DevOps, finance, and procurement teams to enhance integration of FinOps principles and promoting responsible cloud usage, through education and best practice processes.
* Create financial dashboards, provide insights and forecasts to senior stakeholders, and foster a culture of cloud financial responsibility through training. Manage Azure cloud service budgets, participate in CSP negotiations via Procurement, and conduct regular FinOps maturity assessments to drive continuous improvement.
* Report on accuracy, policy compliance and leading initiatives to enhance cloud financial management in line with industry best practices and assigned budget. Build and implement data-driven reporting allowing to identify cost-saving opportunities, optimizing resources, and tracking utilization for efficiency. Provide regular, timely, transparent and accurate cloud consumption costing information to management team and recommendations for optimization.
* Outline, communicate and foster chapter ownership and governance across teams (application development, architecture, finance, management, business) to optimize synergies and encourage joint goals. Assist building of the FinOps community within application teams to increase maturity and ensure they have the Fin Ops knowledge they need to be responsible for their own costs.
* Maintain AXA XL Cloud run costs that forecasts are maintained for the Global IT estate over the financial period and that we can achieve run rate savings, this includes:
* Periodic production of cloud costs to consumption owners to ensure trends are understood and anomalies addressed
* Maintaining average cost profiles of applications migrating to cloud and then updating cloud cost forecasts in line with migrations
* Assist with yearly budget process to ensure budget requests are in line with the business case forecasts
* Active membership of AXA Group’s FinOps community to gain from and share learnings with the community. Also produce quarterly reporting required by Group.
* Maintain a good understanding of the cloud provider pricing models so that can work with Application Teams to give recommendations on potential cost savings. Work with technical teams to drive technical optimizations such as right sizing.

title: Accountant (CMA)
description:
****The Role**
: Digital Accounting**
  
  
  

You will not just do the books, which is also a task to be done by you. You will maintain a digital financial accounting system that scales. We are a startup, needing real-time visibility into our cash flow, burn rate and unit economics. Your mission is to ensure that every rupee spent is tracked, compliant, and audit-ready
*before*
the external auditors even ask.

You will be the administrator of our financial tech stack (Zoho Books, Zoho Payroll, Zoho Expense). You need to know the set up of the automation rules wherein most of the linked bookkeeping/expense/payroll entries happen automatically. Your purpose is to integrate Finance, HR, and Procurement into a seamless, data-driven engine using the available system of cloud tools.

You act as the "Controller" of funds - ensuring vendors get paid on time, but only after proper Purchase Order (PO) validation following an approval process. You are the translator who turns complex engineering spend (including imports) into accounting ledgers that our investors and CA can understand.
  
  
Note:There will be a probation period for this role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  
  

**1. Financial Operations (The Daily Work)**

* **Bookkeeping:**
  Daily recording of transactions in
  **Zoho Books**
  . Perform Bank reconciliation, credit card reconciliation, and petty cash management.
* **Procurement Cycle:**
  Manage the Purchase Order (PO) process for engineering parts. Ensure invoices match the POs (Three-Way Match) before releasing payment.
* **Payroll Processing:**
  Process monthly payroll, including breakdown of allowances, reimbursements, and deductions, ensuring employees are paid on time every month.

**2. Compliance & Taxation**

* **TDS & GST:**
  Calculate monthly
  **TDS**
  (Tax Deducted at Source) and
  **GST**
  liabilities accurately. Prepare the data, ensure proper reconciliation of GST data for our CA to file the returns.
* **Vendor Compliance:**
  Ensure capture of vendor details (PAN/GST) before we pay a single rupee.
* **Documentation:**
  Maintain a digital archive of all agreements, invoices, and challans. No physical paper chases.

**3. Reporting & Analysis**

* **MIS Reporting:**
  Produce the monthly
  **"Founder’s Finance Pack"**
  : Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, and 'Runway' analysis.
* **Budget vs. Actual:**
  Track project expenses against the budget.
* **Project Expenses:**
  Maintain separate accounts and details as per requirements for project costing and accounting.

Requirements
  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **Education/Qualification:**
  CMA qualified.
* **Experience:**
  1–2 years of hands-on accounting experience.
* **Tech Stack:**
  **Mandatory proficiency in Zoho Books.**
  If you have used only desktop Tally, this role is not for you. We require cloud-first account keeping.
* **Excel Skills:**
  You must be a master of VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and basic financial modelling.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Inter-CA (will be considered based on experience).
* Experience in a
  **Manufacturing or Hardware Startup**
  (dealing with inventory/stock valuation).
* Knowledge of
  **Import/Export documentation**
  (Bill of Entry, Customs Duty).
* Experience with
  **Project Accounting**
  and integration of Accounting software with Project Management software.

**Skills & Abilities**

* **Process Oriented:**
  You love checklists. You don't rely on memory; you rely on systems.
* **Integrity:**
  You are handling the company's accounts. Unquestionable ethics are required.
* **Communication:**
  Ability to explain to an engineer the need for a GST bill for buying a motor without slowing them down.

**Application Requirements:**
Explain your suitability for this Role in a clear and concise Cover Letter, and your experience in tech stack proficiency, as also for the key responsibilities. Do not forget to attach your CV.
  
  
  
  
Benefits
  
  
  
**The Rewards:**
  
  
  

* As we grow, you will be a natural choice to grow in the Finance department.
* Modern Work Environment: Best-in-class systems and software tools. No dusty files or slow computers.
* Unlike a CA firm where you work nights during audit season, here we value consistency and automation.
* **Pioneers:**
  This is a unique Firster's Team opportunity to join 0-1 builders and help in building the company's DNA.

The Compensation, Health, Wellness & Professional Development
  
  
  

* Competitive Market Salary + Performance-Based Incentive.
* Comprehensive Allowances: Structured House Rent Allowance (HRA) and standard Conveyance Allowance.
* Digital & Workplace Enablement: Dedicated allowances covering Mobile & Internet connectivity, and monthly fixed value food coupons.
* Health & Wellness: Fixed Medical Allowance integrated into monthly compensation to support ongoing medical and wellness needs.
* Continuous Growth: Direct reimbursement for Professional Development and technical certifications, as specified/applicable to the role.
* Dynamic Work Culture in NCR: A collaborative, 'builder-first' environment in NCR (Gurgaon), which values institutional discipline alongside rapid startup innovation.
* Field & Travel Support: On deployment for travel on project work (if applicable).

title: Analyst
description:
Role Overview

The role will provide senior-level research, analytical, and due diligence support to a US wealth management business. The primary focus is investment research and product due diligence, complemented by advisor management support and suitability oversight. The individual will independently review investment product information, assess relevant risks and disclosures, identify exceptions or information gaps, and prepare clear, evidence-based findings for review by authorized stakeholders. The role requires strong wealth management domain knowledge, sound analytical judgment, high attention to detail, and effective collaboration with onshore teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Investment Research and Product Due Diligence (Core Responsibility)

* Conduct initial and periodic due diligence reviews of investment products using approved documentation and information sources.
* Research product structures, investment objectives, underlying assets, risk factors, fees, liquidity, disclosures, and available performance information.
* Compare products and assess relevant features, risks, costs, and other decision-useful attributes.
* Identify information gaps, inconsistencies, material changes, and potential risk indicators; document evidence and findings for stakeholder review.
* Prepare structured product assessment summaries, research reports, and supporting materials that enable informed review and decision-making.
* Support ongoing product monitoring and maintain complete, traceable due diligence records.

2. Suitability Oversight Support

* Support reviews of investment recommendations and transactions against documented suitability requirements and review frameworks.
* Assess relevant client investment objectives, risk profiles, product characteristics, and disclosures where these are available and within the assigned review scope.
* Identify potential mismatches, exceptions, or deviations from established criteria and escalate them through the agreed governance process.
* Document review rationale, evidence, findings, and follow-up actions to maintain a clear audit trail.

3. Advisor Management Support

* Provide analytical and documentation support for advisor management activities related to investment products and review requirements.
* Review advisor-related records and supporting documentation for completeness, consistency, and adherence to defined procedures.
* Track open items, resolve information gaps with relevant stakeholders, and maintain accurate status reports and supporting records.
* Support consistent application of established policies, procedures, and review standards.

4. Risk, Controls, and Governance

* Perform assigned activities in line with documented procedures, confidentiality requirements, internal controls, and applicable compliance guidelines.
* Recognize and escalate potential risks, control gaps, exceptions, or incomplete evidence through established channels.
* Maintain review documentation and records to support quality checks, audit readiness, and governance reviews.
* Track findings and remediation actions through closure, coordinating with relevant stakeholders as required.
* Contribute to process standardization, documentation improvements, and quality and efficiency initiatives.

5. Stakeholder Engagement and SME Contribution

* Partner with onshore stakeholders to clarify requirements, discuss complex findings, and respond to research and due diligence requests.
* Communicate analysis and findings clearly, objectively, and within agreed turnaround times.
* Provide subject-matter expertise, support knowledge transfer, and contribute to process documentation or training where required.
* Manage assigned deliverables independently while meeting agreed service levels and quality expectations.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Banking, or a related discipline.
* 10–12 years of relevant experience in wealth management, investment research, investment product due diligence, suitability oversight, or related financial-services risk and control functions.
* Strong hands-on experience in investment research and due diligence; exposure to advisor support and suitability reviews is also required.
* Working knowledge of wealth management products such as equities, mutual funds, fixed-income securities, and other relevant investment products.
* Ability to interpret product documentation, disclosures, risk information, fees, and performance data and translate findings into clear written assessments.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to identify gaps and escalate concerns.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint for analysis, reporting, and presentation of findings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly for working with onshore stakeholders.
* High attention to detail, strong documentation discipline, and ability to handle confidential information.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate, high-quality outputs within agreed SLAs.

Preferred Skills

* Experience supporting a US-based wealth management firm, private bank, trust company, or investment advisory business.
* Familiarity with investment product disclosures, suitability frameworks, product governance, and periodic due diligence practices.
* Experience preparing management reports, research summaries, and stakeholder-ready presentations.
* Advanced Excel capability; experience with VBA or reporting automation is an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators

* Accuracy, completeness, and quality of investment research and due diligence assessments.
* Timely completion of assigned reviews and requests within agreed SLAs.
* Quality and clarity of written analysis, evidence, and supporting documentation.
* Timely identification, documentation, and escalation of exceptions and potential risks.
* Adherence to client procedures, confidentiality requirements, and internal controls.
* Stakeholder feedback and contribution to process quality and continuous improvement.

Role Expectations and Decision Rights

The individual is expected to operate as an experienced offshore subject-matter expert, independently conducting assigned research and review activities and presenting well-supported findings. The role supports oversight and decision-making; it does not independently confer authority to approve investment products, make investment recommendations to end clients, or provide final suitability decisions unless specifically authorized under the client’s governance framework. Final approvals, investment decisions, and formal escalations remain with the designated authorized stakeholders.

title: Head of Finance and FP&A, India
description:
****Role Description****
The Head of Reporting will lead the Group management reporting agenda within the FP&A Finance team, ensuring senior leaders have a clear, accurate and timely view of financial performance. The role is responsible for delivering Group management reporting and flash results, supporting consistent regional reporting, leading flash review meetings with functions and regional teams, and overseeing Group pro forma calculations for actuals and forecasts. The role will partner closely with Group Financial Control, regional finance teams, functional finance leaders and Finance Systems to strengthen reporting quality, data integrity and insight.
  
  
This is a senior finance leadership role suited to a qualified finance professional with more than 10 years’ experience, including significant exposure to FP&A, management reporting, financial control, performance analysis and team leadership in a complex, international organisation.
  
  
The role will require to work closely with Group Financial Control, Finance Systems, Finance Business Partners, functional Finance leaders and regional finance teams across the organisation. The role will directly manage a team of three based in India.
  
  
****Specific Role Responsibilities****
Group Management Reporting and Flash Results
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of Group management reporting, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely, consistent and focused on the key drivers of performance.
* Own the preparation and delivery of flash results, providing an early and reliable view of monthly financial performance.
* Develop clear analysis of actual performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, highlighting material variances, risks, opportunities and emerging trends.
* Work closely with the Planning team to ensure budget and forecast bases are aligned with actuals reporting requirements.
* Maintain a robust reporting timetable, governance framework and quality-assurance process across the monthly reporting cycle.

Regional Reporting and Performance Insight
  
  

* Support regional finance teams in delivering high-quality management reporting that is aligned with Group definitions, timelines and performance measures.
* Drive consistency in reporting across regions and functions while recognising relevant local business drivers and requirements.
* Work with HR to ensure consistency in headcount reporting.
* Work with Commercial teams to capture new business and pipeline activity in management reporting.
* Translate complex financial results into concise, decision-useful commentary and insights for senior management, Executive and Board-level audiences.
* Continuously improve the relevance, clarity and efficiency of management information, focusing reporting on the measures that best explain business performance.

Flash Meetings and Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Plan, coordinate and lead monthly flash meetings with functional and regional teams, ensuring clear understanding of performance and the actions required.
* Provide constructive challenge on reported results, supporting commentary, forecast movements and the underlying operational drivers.
* Build strong relationships with regional Finance, functional Finance, Finance Business Partners and senior leadership to improve accountability and reporting quality.
* Present Group performance clearly and confidently, adapting the level of detail to the needs of different senior stakeholders.

Pro Forma Reporting, Controls, Systems and Team Leadership
  
  

* Own and run Group pro forma calculations for actuals and forecasts, maintaining clear methodologies, assumptions, controls and audit trails.
* Provide inputs into quarterly lender reporting, including P&Ls, exceptional costs and pro forma EBITDA.
* Work closely with Group Financial Control throughout month-end to align reported results, resolve issues and ensure management reporting is reconciled to the underlying financial records.
* Partner with Finance Systems and data teams to strengthen data integrity, resolve recurring data issues and improve the reliability and automation of reporting processes.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of three based in India, setting clear priorities, maintaining effective controls and building strong reporting and analytical capability.

****Required Qualifications And Experience****

* Qualified accountant or finance professional, ideally ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent. Financial Services or Technology experience is preferable.
* 10+ years’ experience in Finance, including substantial experience in FP&A, management reporting, financial control or performance analysis.
* Proven experience delivering Group management reporting and flash results in a complex, multi-entity or international organisation.
* Strong understanding of month-end close, management reporting controls, reconciliations and the relationship between statutory and management reporting.
* Experience producing pro forma or adjusted financial information for actuals and forecasts, supported by clear methodologies and controls.

title: Independent Consultant, Market Shaping - Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health. We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead (Pb) exposure is a silent yet devastating global health crisis, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Research from UNICEF and other partners estimates that 1 in 2 children in LMICs have elevated blood lead levels, contributing neurological damage, reduced cognitive development, and a variety of health impacts.
  
  
Lead exposure in India arises from multiple sources, with leaded decorative paints and used lead-acid batteries (ULABs) representing the two most significant. Despite a regulatory limit of 90 ppm for lead in decorative paints, widespread non-compliance among SME manufacturers means lead chromate pigments continue to enter the paint supply chain. ULABs are the single largest source of secondary lead in India, with approximately 1.1 million metric tonnes generated annually across the automotive, telecom, inverter, and UPS sectors; informal recycling of spent batteries releases lead into surrounding communities, disproportionately affecting children.
  
  
WJCF has launched a new Lead Exposure Program, building on its proven market shaping capabilities and experience partnering with governments to address large-scale and cross-sectoral health challenges. Program priorities include
  
  

* Devising and implementing strategies to support paint SME manufacturers in transitioning from lead inputs to safer and sustainable alternatives (organic pigments)
* Scoping gaps and intervention areas for market-shaping opportunities across the lead exposure program, spanning diagnostics (pXRF), treatment (chelating agents), and source-side mitigation (plastics, other sources)

The incumbent will support across multiple market shaping workstreams as detailed below.
  
  
Position Details
  
  
We are seeking an analytically rigorous and entrepreneurial individual to support the design, implementation, and monitoring of WJCF’s market shaping interventions. The role involves market assessment, value chain analysis, stakeholder interviews, policy analysis, and financial modelling. It spans government, private sector, and civil society actors, and sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, environmental health, and government engagement.
  
  

* Location New Delhi, with domestic travel to pilot states.
* Duration Up to 6 months, extendable based on performance
* Market Strategies to Transition Paint SMEs to Safer Alternatives

**Transition to Lead-Free Paints**

* Support the scoping and implementation of targeted pilot interventions to enable industry transition to lead-free paints, including addressing SME barriers to transition, supply chain solutions, and related market-shaping measures.

**Pilot Planning & Design**

* Develop detailed pilot blueprints for selected interventions implementation plans, resource requirements, partnerships, budgets, timelines, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies.
* The intervention hypotheses under consideration are

+ Aggregate raw material demand Test the feasibility of aggregating demand from medium-sized paint manufacturers to secure lower-cost lead-free inputs and incentivize greater reformulation of paints to lead-free alternatives.
+ Leverage institutional procurement Identify high-volume institutional paint buyers and work with them to adopt lead-free procurement commitments, creating demand-side pressure for manufacturers to reformulate their products.

* Prepare implementation toolkits and support materials for roll-out as needed.

**Exploring Lead-Free Pigment Transitions in Non-Paint Sources**

* Mapping lead and lead-free pigment supply chains, assess switching barriers, and evaluate the feasibility of lead-free alternatives in other sources (plastics, turmeric)
* Identify opportunities and support concept to proposal writing, including defining and prioritizing intervention areas.
* Market Shaping for Portable XRF (pXRF)

**Accelerate access to affordable pXRF for research and routine government environmental testing**

* Conduct a supplier and distribution landscape of pXRF devices
* Assess device availability and pricing across suppliers
* Map demand with stakeholders, including current pXRF use and unmet needs
* Understand procurement pathways and regulatory frameworks
* Assess end-user needs to evaluate product-market fit
* Market shaping for Chelating Agents

**Enable access to affordable oral chelation therapy**

* Expanding access to chelation drugs through improved sourcing and procurement to reduce costs and enable addition in essential drug lists
* Assessing alternative formulations or delivery approaches that could improve affordability and feasibility in low-resource settings
* Cross-cutting

**Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting**

* Support proposal development, including concept notes, funding proposals, and progress reports.
* Support stakeholder management across donor, government, private sector, and civil society partners.
* Maintain programme tracking tools and contribute to milestone monitoring.
* Scope can potentially evolve basis developing understanding of the above lead exposure program areas
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, economics, public policy, or a related field; a postgraduate degree is preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience with a strong analytical focus, such as market assessment, supply chain analysis, commercial strategy, or policy analysis. Strategy consulting experience is preferred.
* Experience in primary research, such as stakeholder interviews, value chain mapping, or market assessments in complex, multi-stakeholder settings.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, and comfort building unit economics or financial models.
* Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to identify and pursue high-impact opportunities in complex, uncertain, and changing environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce high-quality reports, briefs, and presentations for government, donors, and technical audiences.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to work independently, lead workstreams end-to-end, and to propose and carry out new initiatives.

title: Procurement & Costing Manager - Interiors & Turnkey Execution
description:
**Location:**

Delhi NCR

**Company:**

Hub and Oak Interiors

**About Hub and Oak Interiors**

Hub and Oak Interiors is an established commercial interior design and turnkey fit-out company based in Delhi NCR. We specialise in designing and delivering offices and commercial workspaces for startups, corporates and established businesses across Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida and Faridabad. 

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Procurement & Costing Manager to take end-to-end ownership of BOQs, project estimates and cost planning for office interiors and turnkey projects. The role involves working closely with the Interior Design Head, Business Development Manager and Project Manager to ensure proposals are accurately costed, commercially viable and submitted on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **BOQ Preparation and Quantity Take-Offs:**

   Prepare detailed BOQs by reviewing layouts, working drawings, specifications and site measurements. Identify missing information, scope gaps and discrepancies before finalising estimates.
2. **Project Estimation and Costing:**

   Prepare item-wise estimates covering materials, labour, installation, transport, wastage, site overheads and contingency allowances. Cover all relevant trades, including civil works, partitions, ceilings, flooring, furniture, joinery, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire safety and IT infrastructure.
3. **Vendor Quotations and Rate Analysis:**

   Obtain quotations from vendors and contractors, prepare comparison statements, assess scope completeness and negotiate rates to establish reliable project costs.
4. **Commercial Proposals and Tender Support:**

   Prepare priced BOQs, quotation inputs, inclusions, exclusions and assumptions. Coordinate with business development to ensure client proposals reflect the approved scope, costs and margins.
5. **Budget Planning and Value Engineering:**

   Develop execution budgets and recommend alternative materials, specifications or construction methods to meet client budgets while maintaining design intent, functionality and quality.
6. **Design and Execution Coordination:**

   Work with the design and project teams to validate quantities, specifications, site conditions and execution requirements. Hand over approved costing sheets and budgets to the Project Manager before execution.
7. **Variation Costing and Cost Monitoring:**

   Estimate additional work and scope changes, maintain variation records and support approval before execution. Compare actual and committed costs against budgets with the project and accounts teams, highlighting overruns and margin risks.
8. **Cost Database and Documentation:**

   Maintain updated material and labour rates, vendor quotations, standard BOQs and historical project costs. Ensure estimates are version-controlled, traceable and supported by clear calculations and approvals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Preferably 5–8 years of relevant experience in estimation, costing or quantity surveying, with hands-on experience in commercial office interiors and turnkey fit-outs.
* Degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management or a related discipline. Candidates with equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Ability to read architectural, interior and services drawings and independently prepare quantity take-offs and detailed BOQs.
* Strong understanding of interior materials, construction methods, labour productivity and vendor pricing.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and AutoCAD for drawing review and measurement; familiarity with estimation software is an advantage.
* Strong commercial judgement, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple estimates within deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with designers, project managers, vendors and the business development team.

**Success in This Role**

Accurate and timely estimates, complete BOQs with minimal scope omissions, reliable execution budgets, prompt costing of variations and clear visibility of expected project margins.

The incumbent will serve as the Fiscal head of the Foundation under the supervision of the Executive Director (ED). This position provides strategic financial leadership by overseeing all accounting and detailed analysis to support effective financial planning and decision-making.

This is a full-time position (40 hours per week) based in New Delhi.

**Major Duties and Responsibilities:**

1. **Financial Leadership**

1.    Provide strategic financial advice to the Executive Director on organizational performance, sustainability, and risk

2.    Prepare financial forecasts and annual budget proposals for USIEF activities.

3.    Monitor risk exposure and mitigation measures and regularly report key risks to the Executive Director.

4.    Lead digital transformation initiatives through automation and process optimization and maintain a digital bookkeeping system as per accounting norms and USIEF policies.

**B.   Financial Systems and Controls**

1.    Accountable for the operation and continuous improvement of key finance processes to generate quality, timely, and accurate performance reports, analysis, and recommendations to facilitate effective decision-making.

2.    Lead on the maintenance and strengthening of the internal control environment to mitigate risks by ensuring compliance with key finance processes, identifying control weaknesses, and making associated recommendations for improvement.

3.    Supervise and manage all routine financial and accounts activities, including payment processing and voucher verification.

4.    Supervise timely disbursement of payments to grantees and other service providers.

5.    Analyze, monitor, and recommend action regarding funds management, including funds on hand, time deposits, and investments.

**C.   Audit, Compliance and Statutory Reporting**

1.    Supervise and facilitate all audit works - internal/statutory/PF Trust Funds /Utilization Certificates/tax reimbursement certificates.

2.    Supervise and ensure timely submission of various periodic tax returns, including Income tax, Tax Deduction at Source (TDS), and Goods and Services Tax (GST).

3.    Prepare financial reports required for finance committees and board meetings.

4.    Supervise and ensure timely submission of periodic financial/grant reports to the Department of State/ US Embassy/ Government of India/Other Stakeholders.

**D. General Management**

1. Coordinate with Regional Offices for budgets, payments, bank receipts, and other financial matters.
2. Propose improvements in USIEF fiscal policies as and when necessary.
3. Lead, mentor, and develop the fiscal team, fostering high standards of professionalism and accountability.
4. Any other activity as assigned by the Executive Director or Deputy Director in the absence of the ED.

**Minimum Requirements**

**Essential:**

(1) Master’s Degree with a specialization in Finance or a professional degree (MBA/CS/CA/ICWA) from a reputed educational institution.

(2) 15 years of Professional and Supervisory experience, of which a minimum of five years of supervisory experience.

**Desired:**

Experience in a multicultural environment in an educational institution or      NGO/Not for Profit Organization.

**Skills Required**

**Essential:**

·      Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

·      Ability to lead and manage the finance and accounts team effectively.

·      An in-depth understanding of the Government of India rules and policies on financial matters.

·      Expert knowledge of accounting & auditing standards and Indian tax laws.

·      Ability to synthesize data and develop visual and graphical representations for reports.

·      Excellent computer skills in working with Tally and MS Office applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**Desired:**

* Familiarity with U.S. Government policies on financial matters.
* Familiarity with CSR guidelines.

**Employment Type and Compensation:**

Full-time

Rs. 24.39 Lakhs per annum, including annual benefits of approx. Rs. 8.05 Lakhs

title: Specialist Analyst (Technology market, market sizing, revenue analysis)
description:
**Job Title: Specialist Analyst, Emerging Market Dynamics**
**Location: Remote- India**
As a
**Specialist Analyst, Emerging Market Dynamics,**
you will collaborate with global teams in the development of thought-provoking, data-driven research that reinforces Gartner as the world authority for technology market and business economics. This role launches your long-term career at Gartner, offering unlimited potential for growth and advancement as a premier thought-leading analyst.
  
  
You will serve as a key contributor in support of Gartner’s Market Share development and delivery. With a focus on cross-technology market share tracking and analysis, you will develop expertise in market sizing, assess market hierarchies, and evaluate competitive dynamics to identify market winners and losers.
  
  
You will be a foundational contributor to the quantitative research that empowers Gartner clients. Leveraging your strong analytical skills and focus on market share analysis, you will support the delivery of actionable intelligence on competitive environments, vendor performance, and market trends. Through your research, data analysis and client interactions, you will serve as a trusted advisor and strategic resource to Gartner c-level clients and product / service leaders navigating the rapidly evolving technology market landscape.
  
  
**What You Will Do:**

* Develop and Publish Market-leading Insights: Author research-driven insights by developing key positions that address the present and future trajectory of markets and key winners and losers within critical AI and broader technology races.
* Lead Market Research and Data Analysis: Proactively assess market hierarchies and support the identification and evaluation of key technology vendors, including market leaders and disruptors based on market intelligence and quantitative analysis.
* Market Research Insights: Compile foundational insights and contribute directly to key analysis-focused research deliverables including Market Share and Forecast Analysis publications.
* Client & Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a central point of contact for client interactions related to market share, segmentation, and sizing methodologies, articulating competitive dynamics and applying them to annual and strategic planning initiatives.
* Data Stewardship and Quality: Collect, document, and maintain comprehensive vendor and market data, ensuring accuracy and up-to-date alignment between vendors and the products / services they deliver to market.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* BE/B.Tech + MBA (or a post-graduate degree with a background in IT, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, or Economics) with 0 to 2 years of relevant experience.
* Demonstrated foundational experience in research and data analysis, with a strong interest in global IT markets and economic trends.
* Highly numerate with exceptional critical thinking skills; capable of quickly grasping market fundamentals and drivers of growth.
* Proficiency in core analytical and data visualization tools (e.g., MS Excel, Power BI) and a working knowledge of business databases (e.g., Factiva, Capital IQ, Crunchbase).
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to assist in translating complex data into clear, fact-based narratives.
* Strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and a ‘get-it-done’ attitude; able to work collaboratively within a multicultural global team.
* Intellectual curiosity and a proactive mindset, with an eagerness to learn, participate in foundational training, and engage in thought leadership discussions.
* Demonstrated ability to explain market context and complex quantitative insights to a senior executive audience in both written and verbal form.

**What You Will Get:**
Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay, offering a competitive base salary alongside an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential. Employees will participate in an annual bonus plan. We also offer market-leading benefit programs including a generous paid time off policy, comprehensive group medical insurance, parental leave, and a high emphasis on continuous learning and professional development.
  
  
The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Executive Assistant to the Managing Director
description:

* Computer literacy in Microsoft Office, database management and other tools, with advanced skills in MS Excel, for analytics and reporting.

* Strong research and analytical skills; o Strong oral and written communications skills;

title: Audit & Assurance | Consultant, Business Process Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Consultant, Business Process Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance**
**About**
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte’s clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
  
  
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
You will have the opportunity to work on multiple projects across industries that help organizations manage and mitigate risk, improve operational performance, and maximize enterprise value. In this role, you will build on your foundation to design, implement, assess and support risk management; provide advisory services; and assist in restructuring programs, reengineering processes, and frameworks to address the growing challenges and risks our clients face. You would have an opportunity to gain experience in:
  
  

* Providing extensive range of accounting and reporting services in addition to enhancing the overall value on financial reporting, technical and operational excellence related services delivered to the client.
* Assisting companies to understand, assess impact, and operationalize complex accounting and reporting changes resulting from shifting regulations, new accounting standards, corporate actions and capital market transactions.
* Driving operational efficiencies in the financial close and reporting process through providing efficient, sustainable, and technology-enabled solutions aligned with accounting and financial reporting requirements.
* Support risk assessment for clients to identify prioritized list of risk/audit and helping plan the audit approach and scope, preparing the audit program, determining auditing procedures, seeing the audit process through completion, and applying internal audit standards
* Create internal control documentation for the engagement including narratives, process and data flows, and other supporting work papers
* Conduct/lead client interviews, communication and follow-ups
* Support various internal audit activities, including scoping, planning procedures, issuing requests, coordinating collection and examination of documentation, review and discussion of draft conclusions, management action plan and issuance of report to the client
* Mergers & Acquisitions related analysis of income statement trends to identify any one-time, non-cash or non-recurring items that may impact normalized earnings; analysis of normalized working capital, seasonality, cash and financial debt positions and potential adjustments for deal purposes and impact on free cash flow as well as evaluating the liabilities including any off-balance sheet items or contingent liabilities.
* Providing financial consulting services relating to business valuation for various classes of liabilities

and assets, including intangible asset; real and personal property; and various complex securities, including fixed-income securities, equities, derivatives, etc., using different valuation techniques models in accordance with US GAAP. Also, creating financial models, conducting industry research, and writing reports
  
  

* Apply a general knowledge of the technologies used to build complex IT environments and facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to review, design, and implement products and services
* Demonstrate understanding of business processes, internal control risk management, IT controls, and related regulatory and compliance standards
* Exercise professional skepticism, judgment and adhere to the code of ethics while on engagements

**Required Skills**

* Experience — 0 to 1 year
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), positive attitude, and willingness to go the extra mile
* Strong analytical, critical thinking/problem-solving skills and executive presence
* Experience with working in an ambiguous environment. Business mindset to understand the rationale behind the transactions, process workflow and ability and willingness to dive deeper into industry issues and bring greater insights for our clients
* Knowledge of accounting standards, financial management and technical concepts, strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels
* Willingness to expand skillset and work on other related areas

**Preferred Skills**

* Big 4 Articleship experience

**Qualification**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) - Rank Holder in CA Final will be preferred

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Sr. Financial Analyst- US Payroll
description:
**About Us**

TrueBlue (NYSE: TBI) is a leading staffing, recruiting and workforce management company. The company fills individual positions on demand, staffs entire facilities, and manages outsourced recruiting processes and staffing vendor programs for a wide variety of clients. The company's specialized workforce solutions meet clients' needs for a reliable, efficient workforce in a wide variety of industries including - construction, manufacturing, financial services, pharmaceuticals, transportation, aviation, and energy. The Senior Financial Analyst - Payroll oversees payroll operations, compliance, reporting, and analytics while serving as a subject matter expert for payroll-related matters. This role partners with Payroll, HR, Finance, and Tax teams to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing and drive continuous process improvements.

• Deep Knowledge of end-to-end US payroll processing and review complex payroll transactions

• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local payroll regulations and tax requirements

• Oversee payroll accuracy through detailed audits and controls

• Perform payroll reconciliations, variance analysis, accrual reviews

• Drive payroll process improvements and automation initiatives

• Resolve escalated payroll issues and partner with cross-functional stakeholders

• Maintain confidentiality of organizational information

• Ensuring process SLA’s & TAT are met

• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines under pressure

▪ Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce or a related field

▪ Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience supporting US Payroll operations, including payroll processing, payroll taxation, compliance, and employee payroll inquiries

▪ Strong written and verbal communication skills

▪ Strong knowledge of US payroll regulations, taxation, and compliance requirements

▪ Expert-level Excel skills with experience in data analysis, reporting and advanced formula

▪ Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Global Finance Associate - Travel & Expense - Japanese
description:

By rethinking structures and standardizing processes across geographies and business entities, we will make it simpler and more efficient to work together and flex to meet the needs of BCG.
  
  
As part of the Global Finance Operations Centre (GFOC), you will be responsible for pre-payment audit and processing of employees’ expense claims in accordance with BCG’s Travel and Expense (T&E) policy
  
  
for its offices across multiple locations. This role will specifically support BCG's Japan office, requiring effective communication with Japanese-speaking stakeholders and application of local T&E policy nuances. Also will be responsible for managing employee queries and their timely resolution, and related daily/monthly closing and reporting activities.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Review Employee expense claim reports for accuracy and appropriate documentation:

+ Submitted expenses are in compliance with the respective BCG office’s Travel and Expense policy
+ Submitted expenses match with the receipts provided
+ Proper approval has been obtained for expenses incurred outside of the policy

* Resolve expense claims related queries via effective collaboration with various stakeholders to ensure the highest user satisfaction
* Prepare and distribute the routine report/reminder to local finance offices
* Provide regular updates to local finance for any expense trends, abnormal behaviour, improvement action plan, and audit procedure changes
* Partner and maintain relationships with local finance teams to address travel expense policy and audit questions as they arise
* Maintaining the highest quality standards and ensure no duplicates claims or remibursements are initiated
* Maintain employee and approver data in the system. Prepare periodic reconciliations to ensure data is accurate and up to date
* Follow set processes and highlight when there is a need for change or update
* Adhere to the internal compliance policy and guideline established by the management on their daily operational activities
* Maintain exception logs for the process-related exception as and when they occur for knowledge retention
* Complete ad hoc requests and perform other duties as needed with minimal oversight
* Active participation in the organization-wide projects and initiatives
* Liaise directly with employees, approvers, and local finance teams in Japan in Japanese (spoken and written) for query resolution and audits
* Translate/localize routine reports, reminders, and policy communications between English and Japanese for the Japan office
* Interpret and apply Japan-specific T&E policy nuances (e.g., local tax treatment of allowances, statutory receipt/documentation norms) alongside global BCG policy
* Act as the primary point of contact for Japan-side escalations requiring language and cultural fluency
* Support onboarding and training of new hires or approvers in Japan on T&E tools and policy, in Japanese where needed

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Experience & Qualifications**

* Minimum qualification B.Com with prior experience of working in a global finance operations team
* 2-4 years of relevant experience in travel and expense processing, reporting, query management
* MS Excel, Word proficiency and adaptable to several software applications
* Preferably exposure to ERP systems and T&E Workflow solutions like Concur, Chrome River etc.
* Business-level proficiency in Japanese (reading, writing, and speaking) is mandatory – JLPT N2 or above preferred; ability to draft professional business communication in Japanese
* Working proficiency in English to collaborate with global stakeholders and internal teams

Who You'll Work With
  
  
We pride ourselves on a collaborative working environment and utilize digital tools to foster that collaborative environment across a global company. The Global Finance Operations Centre aims at providing best in-class operational excellence and execution through partnership, building trust and credibility. It provides a foundation to ensuring smooth finance operations, coordinating change and ensuring performance of individual processes with high service levels.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Ability to prioritize and manage workload
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills – strong attention to details
* Strong initiative and willingness to take on projects in a proactive manner
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment; excellent time management skills and ability to meet tight deadlines
* Excellent oral and written communication skills & effective listening skills
* Relationship building, partnering and collaboration
* Committing to improvement through feedback and self-reflection,learning new topics & skills
* Strong customer orientation and flexible to business needs
* Utilizes sound judgment in dealing with work flow and uncertain situations
* Handles situations with confidence, understanding and tact
* Ability to respect all BCG information as personal and confidential
* Strong cross-cultural communication skills and sensitivity to Japanese business etiquette; ability to translate/interpret between English and Japanese accurately in a professional context

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

* Manage system interfaces for data replication (IDOC, ALE, DRF) and ensure seamless data transfer.
* Design workflows, handle ABAP development, and manage data migration processes.
* Optimize system performance and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Collaborate with functional teams to ensure alignment of technical solutions with business needs.

* Minimum of

* Strong skills in ABAP, workflows, data migration, and SAP table structures (especially in S/4 HANA).

  implementation

At Fusion, we aspire to be one of the world's leading life sciences consulting firms, setting industry benchmarks with innovative and pioneering solutions.

At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients.

We value employees who push boundaries through innovation, navigating diverse client needs in ever-evolving environments, with a commitment to continuous learning both for themselves and their colleagues.

Go beyond, grow beyond, and maximize impact. Each employee shapes their own journey, and our mission is to ignite the spark of greatness while pushing the boundaries of what you are capable of. We cultivate an environment where every individual can thrive and flourish through meaningful connections, extended learning, motivation, and support to experiment with new and innovative approaches, including taking risks.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Roles and Responsibilities

* Utilize SAP B1 software to manage and maintain financial transactions, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger entries, and payroll processing.
* Perform month-end and year-end closing activities, including reconciling accounts, preparing financial statements, and analyzing financial data.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records in compliance with company policies, international accounting standards, and local regulations.
* Assist in the preparation and analysis of annual budgets, forecasts, and financial projections.
* Collaborate with the procurement and inventory teams to ensure accurate inventory valuation and cost accounting.
* Monitor cash flow and perform cash management activities, including bank reconciliations, cash forecasting, and optimizing working capital.
* Conduct regular internal audits to identify and rectify financial discrepancies or irregularities.
* Provide financial analysis and reports to management, highlighting key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial metrics.
* Support the preparation of financial reports for statutory audits, tax filings, and regulatory compliance.
* Stay updated with changes in financial regulations, accounting standards, and SAP B1 functionalities, and provide training to relevant stakeholders as needed.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, production, and procurement, to optimize processes and improve efficiency within the organization.
* Maintain strong internal controls and ensure compliance with internal policies and procedures.

* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field.

* Proficiency in using SAP Business One (SAP B1) software is mandatory.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and tax regulations.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and make informed decisions.

* Good understanding of cost accounting, inventory valuation, and production processes.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other accounting software.
* Knowledge of Angolan accounting regulations and practices is a plus.
