**About Angel One:**

For nearly three decades, Angel One has been making investing and wealth creation more accessible and engaging for Indians. Today, 3.7+ crore customers trust Angel One across investing, trading, wealth creation, and credit.

We are one of the best fintech platforms, building simple, intelligent and seamless financial experiences for millions of users across the country. From investing and trading to wealth creation and credit, everything we build is focused on making financial journeys easier, faster, more accessible and engaging.

We believe strong fundamentals matter—in investing, in technology and in the way we build our teams. Trust, simplicity, speed and long-term thinking shape how we work and what we build.

Here, people work on real problems at real scale. Millions of users interact with our platform every day, and every team plays a role in shaping that experience.

We move fast, take ownership and keep learning along the way. No matter the role, people here are encouraged to share ideas, challenge the usual and build things that create real impact.

If you're excited to solve meaningful problems, build at scale, and shape the future of financial services, you'll fit right in.

Be part of our team that’s scaling sustainably, thinking big, and building for the billion!

**Job Title: Manager/ Senior Manager – Market Share & Intelligence**

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a high-ownership, analytical professional to drive business strategy, market-share growth, competitive intelligence, and strategic initiatives for Angel One’s Assisted Business. The role will focus on tracking market performance, benchmarking competitive positioning, identifying growth opportunities across trading segments, and translating data-driven insights into actionable business interventions.

The individual will work closely with Business, Product, Sales, Technology, Marketing, and Operations teams to drive strategic initiatives, improve business performance, strengthen competitive positioning, and deliver measurable growth outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Market Share & Business Performance Analysis:**
  Track and analyse market share, exchange-level turnover, trading volumes, active clients, segment mix, and other relevant business indicators across equity delivery, intraday, futures & options (F&O), and commodity segments.
* **Competitive Intelligence & Benchmarking:**
  Monitor competitor strategies, brokerage and pricing structures, product propositions, trading experience, customer engagement initiatives, and distribution models to assess Angel One’s competitive positioning.
* **Growth Opportunity Identification:**
  Identify market-share gaps, emerging trends, underpenetrated customer and partner segments, and opportunities to improve client activity, turnover, product adoption, and business growth.
* **Business Insights & Strategic Recommendations:**
  Analyse performance trends, anomalies, and underlying drivers of market-share gains or losses. Translate findings into actionable recommendations and business cases for improving segment-level performance.
* **Strategic Initiative Execution:**
  Drive cross-functional growth initiatives from problem identification and opportunity assessment through implementation, tracking, and evaluation of measurable outcomes.
* **Performance Monitoring & Reviews:**
  Establish structured performance-review frameworks, dashboards, and scorecards to monitor business metrics, evaluate the effectiveness of interventions, and recommend course corrections.
* **Competitor and Market Deep Dives:**
  Conduct focused analyses of competitor initiatives, market movements, pricing changes, and product developments, assessing their potential impact on Angel One’s business.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Partner with Product, Sales, Technology, Marketing, and Business Operations teams to translate insights into business actions and ensure effective execution.
* **Management Reporting:**
  Prepare business reviews, leadership presentations, periodic performance updates, and strategic recommendations to support business planning and decision-making

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 3–7 years of experience in market share, market research, business strategy, growth analytics, competitive intelligence, business analytics, management consulting, broking research, or financial services.
* Strong understanding of equity markets, derivatives, commodities, the Indian stockbroking ecosystem, and broking business models.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse market and business performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong commercial acumen, structured problem-solving skills, and the ability to connect market movements with business outcomes.
* Advanced Excel skills and strong PowerPoint proficiency. Experience with SQL and BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau will be an advantage.
* Experience working with large datasets, building dashboards and performance scorecards, and presenting insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives from analysis to execution.

**At Angel One, our thriving culture is rooted in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).**

*As an Equal opportunity employer, we wholeheartedly welcome people from all backgrounds irrespective of caste, religion, gender, marital status, sexuality, disability, class or age to be part of our team.*

*We believe that everyone's unique experiences and viewpoints make us stronger together.*

*Come and be a part of #OneSpace\*, where your individuality is celebrated and embraced.*

title: Program Leader - Finance
description:
R1 is the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems and medical groups. We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration.
  
  
With over 30,000 employees globally and a robust presence in India, comprising over 17,000 employees across Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Chennai, we foster an inclusive culture where every team member feels valued and empowered. Our mission is to transform the healthcare industry by driving efficiency for healthcare systems, hospitals, and physicians.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Lead the India SSC FP&A delivery model for the Physician IDP portfolio, with end-to-end accountability across close, reporting, planning and decision support. The role will operate as a senior finance partner to US-based finance leadership and business stakeholders, translating operational and client drivers into clear financial outcomes while building a scalable, well-controlled FP&A capability in India.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the month-end close rhythm for the Physician IDP portfolio, including pre-close readiness, in-close financial tracking, issue escalation, accrual and adjustment coordination, and final performance review.
* Lead post-close reporting, client-level P&L reviews, variance analysis and executive commentary across revenue, headcount, cost and margin.
* Drive forecasting cycles, annual budgeting and long-range planning, ensuring assumptions are integrated, challenged, documented and aligned with business priorities.
* Partner with US finance and business leaders during contract and solution-development stages to create financial drafts and business cases, including expected headcount based on volumes, productivity assumptions, onshore/offshore mix and client-level margin.
* Provide finance leadership on commercial trade-offs, scenario modeling, pricing economics, capacity choices and margin improvement opportunities.
* Establish governance for physician-client data masters, including client hierarchy, contract attributes, volume drivers, staffing assumptions, cost allocations and ownership of changes.
* Lead ad hoc analysis and decision support on growth, profitability, productivity, workforce, cost actions and client performance.
* Own service delivery governance with clear calendars, review checkpoints, quality standards, issue logs and stakeholder communication.
* Identify and deliver standardization, automation and dashboard opportunities that improve control, cycle time, transparency and analytical capacity.
* Build, coach and manage the India FP&A team; define responsibilities, develop capabilities, provide feedback and create succession depth.
* Act as the senior India point of contact for US leadership, maintaining a predictable operating cadence and proactively escalating risks and decisions.

Core Deliverables
  
  

* Close tracker and issue/risk view
* Monthly client-level performance pack and executive commentary
* Forecast, annual budget and LRP models
* Commercial solution drafts and scenario models
* Headcount, volume, location-mix and margin bridge
* Governed physician-client data master
* Ad hoc decision-support analyses
* Process documentation, controls and improvement roadmap

**Qualifications And Experience**

* MBA/PGDM in Finance, Chartered Accountant, CMA or equivalent finance qualification.
* Typically 12+ years of relevant experience, with substantial experience in FP&A and finance business partnering.
* Demonstrated leadership of month-end performance management, forecasting, budgeting and long-range planning in a complex, multi-client or multi-business environment.
* Strong financial modeling, client-level P&L, workforce planning and scenario-analysis capability.
* Experience working with senior US-based stakeholders and within a Global Capability Center or Shared Services model.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint capability; working knowledge of planning, ERP and BI/reporting tools.
* US healthcare, physician services or revenue-cycle exposure is preferred.

Leadership and Behavioral Capabilities
  
  

* Enterprise ownership and sound judgment
* Executive communication and influence
* Commercial and client profitability mindset
* Structured problem solving and analytical depth
* Team leadership and capability building
* Control orientation, data discipline and attention to detail
* Ability to lead across time zones and through ambiguity

Success Measures
  
  

* Timely and accurate completion of close, reporting and planning cycles.
* Quality and usability of financial insights provided to US leadership and business stakeholders.
* Forecast reliability, data integrity and strength of client-level profitability visibility.
* Effectiveness of business partnering, issue resolution and decision support.
* Progress in standardization, automation, controls and team capability.

Working in an evolving healthcare setting, we use our shared expertise to deliver innovative solutions. Our fast-growing team has opportunities to learn and grow through rewarding interactions, collaboration and the freedom to explore professional interests.
  
  
Our associates are given valuable opportunities to contribute, to innovate and create meaningful work that makes an impact in the communities we serve around the world. We also offer a culture of excellence that drives customer success and improves patient care. We believe in giving back to the community and offer a competitive benefits package. To learn more, visit: r1rcm.com
  
  
Visit us on Facebook

title: Associate  - Mergers & Acquisitions CoE
description:
**About Us**

Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, cross-industry capabilities, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

 

**About M&A CoE**

* M&A Center of Excellence (CoE) at BCN is a new CoE being established to support Bain’s capabilities for
  **M&A And Divestitures practice**
* **Bain’s M&A CoE offerings will include offerings across Growth and M&A Strategy, Deal Sourcing and Screening, Corporate Due Diligence (Integration thesis and Synergies modules) , Merger Integration, Divestiture and Separation. The CoE will play a crucial role in improving and further differentiating Bain’s approach across these offerings.**
* The M&A CoE will actively support Bain Partners/ Global Case teams across and Client Cases/ Client development efforts

* CoE scope and scale is expected to evolve over time to more deeper domain expertise, broader scope and end-to-end offerings. Plan is to also expand the CoE to BCN Mexico in future.

**About You**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with strong academic background
* 2-4 years of prior domain experience/ relevant expertise e,g. Synergy analysis (and/or cost diagnostics), Due Diligence (M&A or Private Equity), Merger Integration, Divestiture strategy, etc
* Strong analytical skills with proven ability of leveraging/ embracing automation / AI to drive efficiency across products/ offerings.
* High-level competence in core analytical tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Hands-on skills in research and analytics are required, along with significant exposure to key secondary data sources. A robust consulting and problem-solving skill set tied with a background in marketing analytics is also necessary
* Fundamental skills include excellent work planning, communication, and team leading abilities. Relevant experience with data analytics, project and team management, coaching, and mentoring is also required

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Works under the guidance of the Project Leader / Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s overall answer, final materials, client communication, work planning. Brainstorming with the supervisor on various aspects for IP development, CD, case work as needed
* Ensure timely, high quality, error-free research, analysis and output. Drive insights through data analysis – Story-lining the deliverable to prove/disprove hypotheses
* Works with project/case teams across geographies and industries; however, they focus almost exclusively M&A related projects/ cases
* Have structured communication skills and a willingness to learn the consulting toolkit to be able to translate analytical insights into business impacts
* Brings to the table various cutting-edge technologies and best practices in a productized delivery model; adoption of AI/ agentic tools for driving efficiency
* Communicate effectively and clearly explain insights and implications for the client
* Openness to transfer to Mexico / help set-up M&A in Mexico will be an added advantage

 

**What makes us a great place to work**

We are proud to be
consistently recognized
as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for
diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents
.

title: Assistant Manager - Franchise Revenue
description:
**Purpose of the Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled Finance professional to manage revenue recognition, deferred income accounting, and development agreement (DA) tracking. The ideal candidate will ensure compliance with accounting standards, maintain accurate financial records, and support business decision-making through detailed financial analysis.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Revenue Recognition Accounting:
  
  
  

* Ensure accurate and timely revenue recognition in compliance with US GAAP / IFRS (IFRS 15 and ASC 606) and company policies.
* Analyse contracts to determine proper revenue recognition treatment.
* Work cross-functionally with finance and operations teams to validate revenue transactions.

**Deferred Income Accounting**

* Maintain and update deferred income schedules ensuring proper accounting treatment.
* Record, track, and reconcile deferred revenue balances as per accounting guidelines.
* Ensure accurate recognition of deferred income over the appropriate periods.

**Development Agreement (DA) Tracking**

* Track and monitor Development Agreements (DAs) to ensure compliance with financial terms.
* Work with relevant teams to update DA status and align financial reporting with contractual obligations.
* Maintain accurate records of active and expired agreements.

**DA Incentive End-to-End Accounting**

* Ensure proper accounting and reporting of DA-related incentives, including calculation, recognition, and settlement.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to validate DA incentive payments and adjustments.
* Provide financial analysis and reporting on DA incentives for management review.

**Support Sox/Internal Audit**

* Ensure adherence to SOX and internal audit requirements.
* Provide accurate and timely information to support audit.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree+ master’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field (CA qualified preferred).
* 4+ years of experience in revenue accounting, financial analysis, or related fields.
* Strong knowledge of revenue recognition standards (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and deferred income accounting.
* Experience with financial reporting tools and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Hyperion, or similar).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced formulas, financial modeling, and data analysis).
* Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.

title: Deputy Manager- Banking
description:
Deputy Manager - Banking Operations

**Experience:**
5-9 Years

* Manage day-to-day investment activities including Fixed Deposits, Mutual Funds, and bank reconciliations.
* Monitor daily cash flows, liquidity position, and investable surplus funds across business units.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**About the Opportunity**

**Role:**
Revenue Management

**Level:**
Assistant/ Deputy Manager

**Reporting To:**
Associate Director - Revenue Management

**Location:**
Gurgaon

**About the Function**

Being the largest online travel aggregator in India, MMT witnesses a sizeable number of users visiting the app and transacting every day.

The Ground Transport(GT) business offers an unmatched booking experience to this vast user base, with the widest range of Bus, Rail, and Cab booking options—also playing a crucial role in acquiring new users, especially from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across India.

This is further complemented by a world-class post-booking experience—whether it's through the app's numerous self-help features or our hand-picked executives who strive to deliver customer delight at every step. The Ground Transport SBU embraces a strong innovation mindset and has consistently launched industry-first features that make the booking experience truly seamless and delightful.

At MMT, the Ground Transport unit takes immense pride in its team members who work tirelessly to champion the best possible experience for our users. An orchestra of product managers, tech developers, designers, researchers, and revenue managers comes together to ensure we continue to lead and differentiate ourselves in the industry.

**About the role:**

As part of the GT Online Revenue function, you will join a whip-smart team responsible for managing revenue, driving growth, and increasing profitability. You will embody our values of consumer focus, commitment to results, and continuous improvement by developing innovative solutions that raise challenging questions and demand both creative and practical answers.

The ideal candidate is an independent, self-starting, quick-witted, entrepreneurial, and intellectually curious individual. This person must excel at cross-functional collaboration, blend creativity with strong organizational skills, manage deliverables under tight deadlines, and consistently produce high-quality work under pressure.

**What will you be doing**

**P&L and Revenue Management**

* Own and manage the business P&L, working with internal stakeholders to devise strategies aimed at achieving revenue goals.
* Closely monitor performance parameters, ensuring tight control over key business KPIs such as conversions, transactions, and margins.
* Conduct deep dives into competitor pricing data and use insights to inform category pricing strategies.
* Adjust pricing strategies based on demand signals and market conditions to maintain competitiveness and maximize revenue.

**Growth Strategy Development**

* Define annual and quarterly plans based on short- and long-term growth strategies, influencing key cross-functional teams to align on common objectives.
* Develop and implement initiatives focused on customer acquisition.
* Analyze demand signals and traffic data to understand business and marketing trends.
* Use these insights to shape business and marketing strategies, driving greater engagement and higher conversion rates.

**Customer Engagement & Marketing Collaboration**

* Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute customer engagement strategies and campaigns that maximize customer lifetime value.
* Lead tactical initiatives around active revenue drivers such as pricing, seasonal trends, and topical promotions using relevant marketing channels.
* Collaborate with various marketing functions to maximize order volumes while maintaining a healthy ROAS.

**Collaboration with Product & Operations Stakeholders**

* Partner with product teams to develop first-class, customer-centric experiences.
* Work with operations teams to streamline processes that drive strong NPS and CSAT scores.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Create and maintain rich, interactive visualizations through effective data interpretation and analysis.
* Integrate reporting components from multiple data sources to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Apply statistical methods to analyze data and answer key business questions, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.

**Qualification & Experience**

* MBA from a reputed institute with 2–5 years of experience in a revenue or category management role within a consumer-facing, technology-enabled business—preferably in the e-commerce industry.
* Proven track record of working in high-growth, data-driven environments with a strong understanding of business levers and consumer behavior.
* Advanced proficiency inMS Excel and MS PowerPointfor data analysis and business storytelling.
* Sound understanding of SQL and Python is mandatory to independently work on data extraction, modeling, and analysis.

**Key Success Factors for the Role:**

* A mindset that consistently focuses on return on investment, business outcomes, and revenue growth.
* High energy, team-oriented, and brings a positive, can-do attitude.
* Strong understanding of data analysis, with hands-on experience in data-driven decision-making.
* Proven track record of driving business growth through both tactical and strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication skills and strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Manager-Senior Manager Cross Sell - Digital Lending
description:
**Job Purpose:**

Building X Sell capabilities for the entire portfolio, including partner base X-sell and direct to customer X-sell.

Optimize risk and approvals to achieve organizational business objectives.

Devise and drive different cross-sell programs leveraging the existing digital assets which helps in credit-healthy business

growth.

**Key Accountabilities:**

**Segmentation**

* Perform Qualitative and Quantitative analysis to slice heterogeneous portfolio into homogeneous segments
* Determine Product-Market fitment for designing policy of X sell for Personal Loan, Consumption Loans and Business
* Loans.

**Base Identification**

* Help identify the right base from risk and conversion perspective.
* Work closely with Data Science team for implementing the X Sell model for PL, CL and Business Loan.
* Blend different source of intelligence and propose framework of differential strategies which includes determining right rate of interest, right offer, right product, right channel, right time, etc. to different segments.

* Conduct controlled experiments and A/B tests on Cross Sell program.

* Set KPIs, introduce analytical framework and best cross-selling practices used in BFSI industry.

* Work closely with Product, technology and Data science teams
* Automate various algorithms and steps in the cross-sell journey to achieve desired scale and efficiency.

**Educational Qualifications**

***Qualifications***

* Minimum Qualification required: Graduate in Engineering or Postgraduate in Finance/Statistics/Management/Quant subjects from A institutes.
* Qualifications preferred: BTech with MBA.

* Minimum 4 years with 2 years in credit risk or similar fields.
* Should have a fair understanding of various risk metrics and credit ecosystem.
* Stake holder management skills- Work closely and align with each of the internal functions which includes Business development, Credit and Policy, Data science, Legal, Technology, Operations, Collections, Customer Success team and external stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience to work on large structured and unstructured datasets using different data processing is must, using SQL, Python etc.
* Good communication skills, Data driven, Analytical approach, Team Player.
* Experience in data science, model building, any highly analytical field is preferred.

title: Finance & Accounting Officer
description:
General Ledger Management: Manage daily GL postings, review journal entries, ensure accurate transaction classification, and reconcile general ledger balances with subsidiary ledgers. Finalize daily accounting entries through the ERP system.
  
  
Financial Reporting & Analysis: Prepare and finalize balance sheets, profit and loss statements, inventory valuations, and other financial reports in line with accounting standards and company policies. Analyze financial data to identify trends, variances, and improvement opportunities.
  
  
Month-End & Year-End Closing: Coordinate timely month-end and year-end closing activities, including required adjustments, trial balance preparation, monthly MIS, and management reporting.
  
  
Audit & Compliance: Support internal and external audits by preparing statutory financial statements, annexures, and notes to accounts. Ensure compliance with accounting standards, GST, TDS, and other statutory requirements while staying current with regulatory changes.

title: Senior Leader - M&A, Corporate Development & Investor Relations
description: Designation: Senior Leader – M&A, Corporate Development & Investor RelationsExperience: 10+ yearsFunction: Corporate Strategy, M&A & Investor RelationsRole Overview We are seeking an experienced, commercially astute and hands-on professional to lead and support the organisation’s Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), corporate development and Investor Relations (IR) initiatives. The role will work closely with senior leadership on identifying and evaluating strategic opportunities, structuring transactions, conducting investment analysis, coordinating due diligence and managing relationships with promoters, investors, analysts and other key stakeholders. The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of corporate M&A, financial analysis, accounting and transaction execution, complemented by the relationship-building skills required to engage with diverse stakeholders. Familiarity with the business services industry would be an advantage. We are looking for someone who combines the energy and agility to drive transactions with the maturity, credibility and commercial judgement to engage confidently with senior business leaders and investors. The candidate must be willing to travel extensively, where required, and be comfortable operating in a dynamic, multi-stakeholder environment. Key Responsibilities 1. M&A Strategy, Deal Origination & Execution Identify, evaluate and pursue strategic acquisition, merger, investment and business expansion opportunities aligned with the organisation’s growth objectives. Engage with promoters, business owners, investment bankers, advisors and potential partners to explore and develop transaction opportunities. Undertake preliminary screening and detailed evaluation of target companies, assessing strategic fit, business fundamentals, financial performance, growth potential and key risks. Structure transactions and support negotiations on deal terms, valuation, commercial arrangements and transaction frameworks. Drive transaction workstreams from initial opportunity assessment through due diligence, internal approvals and deal closure. Build and maintain a pipeline of potential acquisition targets and strategic investment opportunities. 2. Investment Analysis & Investment Committee (IC) Presentations Prepare initial opportunity assessments and detailed investment analyses for consideration by senior management and the Investment Committee. Develop and review financial models, valuation analyses, business projections, scenario assessments and investment return calculations. Prepare comprehensive IC notes, transaction memoranda, management presentations and investment recommendations. Evaluate the financial and strategic rationale for proposed transactions, including synergies, risks, integration considerations and value-creation opportunities. Present findings and recommendations clearly, objectively and confidently to senior leadership, incorporating feedback into investment decisions. 3. Financial Analysis, Accounting & Due Diligence Demonstrate a strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, P&L analysis, balance sheets and cash flow statements. Assess the financial health, earnings quality, working capital, cash flows, liabilities and underlying business performance of target companies. Actively support and coordinate financial, commercial, tax, legal and operational due diligence with internal teams and external advisors. Identify financial, operational and commercial risks, accounting discrepancies and potential deal-breakers during the diligence process. Challenge assumptions, validate information and translate due diligence findings into actionable inputs for valuation, negotiations and deal structuring. Ensure robust tracking of diligence findings, transaction milestones, dependencies and closure requirements. 4. Investor Relations & Stakeholder Management Support the development and execution of the organisation’s Investor Relations strategy and investor communication initiatives. Build and nurture relationships with investors, analysts, promoters, business owners, financial institutions and other relevant stakeholders. Develop investor presentations, business performance updates, financial narratives and other stakeholder-facing materials in collaboration with senior management. Communicate the organisation’s strategy, business performance, growth plans and investment rationale with clarity and credibility. Support investor meetings, analyst interactions, business discussions and other strategic engagements. Ensure consistency, accuracy and quality of information shared with relevant stakeholders, in coordination with the appropriate internal teams. 5. Business Research & Strategic Advisory Track industry developments, market trends, valuation benchmarks, transaction activity and competitor movements. Develop an understanding of the business services sector, including its operating models, revenue drivers, profitability metrics, customer dynamics and consolidation opportunities. Identify emerging sectors, adjacent business opportunities and potential platforms for inorganic growth. Provide data-backed insights and strategic recommendations to support management decisions on acquisitions, investments and business expansion. 6. Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with senior leadership and multiple internal functions to drive strategic initiatives and transaction execution. Coordinate with finance, legal, operations, business teams and external advisors to ensure timely delivery of transaction requirements. Manage multiple priorities and complex workstreams while maintaining high standards of analysis, confidentiality and execution. Demonstrate ownership, sound judgement, cultural adaptability and the ability to work effectively across different organisational styles and stakeholder groups. Travel as required to meet promoters, investors, target companies, advisors and other business stakeholders. Desired Candidate Profile 10+ years of relevant experience in corporate M&A, corporate development, investment banking, transaction advisory, private equity or a closely related function. Demonstrated experience in evaluating and executing M&A transactions, including financial analysis, valuation, deal structuring and due diligence. Strong understanding of accounting, financial statements, P&L analysis, cash flows and business economics. Proven ability to prepare investment assessments and detailed IC notes, and to present recommendations to senior decision-makers. Experience in Investor Relations, investor engagement, analyst interactions or senior stakeholder communication is essential. Exposure to the business services industry, particularly asset-light or people-intensive service businesses, would be advantageous. Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with the confidence to engage with promoters, investors, analysts and senior executives. Willingness to travel frequently and participate in face-to-face business and transaction discussions. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and detailed analytical work. High levels of integrity, discretion, cultural sensitivity and professional maturity. Educational Qualifications CA, MBA (Finance), CFA or an equivalent qualification in Finance, Business or a related discipline. Strong transaction experience and demonstrable financial and commercial acumen will be key selection criteria. Key Success Factors Ability to independently drive M&A opportunities from evaluation to execution. Quality and rigour of investment analysis and IC recommendations. Effectiveness in structuring deals and managing due diligence. Strength of relationships with promoters, investors and other external stakeholders. Ability to collaborate with senior leadership and multiple internal functions. Sound judgement, cultural compatibility and a high degree of ownership.

title: Assistant Business Manager
description:
**Role**

We are looking for an
**Assistant Business Manager**
to support the Business Manager in driving sales performance across stores. The role will focus on

.

The ideal candidate will be commercially driven, highly analytical and comfortable working closely with store teams to understand performance, identify opportunities and ensure execution against business priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Sales Performance & Target Achievement

* Support the Business Manager in driving achievement of
  **store and individual sales targets**
  .
* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance against targets, budgets and previous-period performance.
* Identify gaps in achievement and work with store teams to define corrective actions.
* Monitor performance by store, category, brand, product, salesperson and other relevant business parameters.
* Support the implementation of sales action plans to improve target achievement.

**2. Data Analysis & Business Insights**

* Analyse store-level sales and operational data to identify
  **trends, gaps, opportunities and performance drivers**
  .

* Sales vs. target
* Sales growth
* Average transaction value
* Conversion rate
* Footfall and customer engagement
* Product/category contribution
* Individual salesperson performance
* Inventory availability and sell-through
* New vs. repeat customer contribution
* Translate data into clear insights and recommendations for the Business Manager and store teams.

**3. Identifying Business Gaps**

* Proactively identify reasons for underperformance at store, category, brand or individual level.
* Conduct root-cause analysis for sales shortfalls.
* Identify gaps related to
  **customer conversion, product availability, sales productivity, inventory, customer follow-up and team performance**
  .
* Track agreed corrective actions and ensure timely closure.
* Highlight emerging risks to the Business Manager before they impact target achievement.

**4. Store & Team Performance**

* Work closely with Store Managers and sales teams to understand business performance.
* Support managers in interpreting performance data and converting insights into actionable plans.
* Track individual sales performance and highlight coaching or performance-development opportunities.
* Support sales contests, campaigns and other initiatives aimed at improving store performance.
* Participate in store visits and business reviews to understand on-ground challenges.

**5. Business Planning & Reviews**

* Support preparation of weekly and monthly business reviews.
* Assist in developing sales forecasts based on historical trends, current performance and business inputs.
* Track progress against business plans and highlight deviations.
* Support the Business Manager in preparing performance presentations and management reports.
* Maintain a structured repository of key performance insights and action items.

**6. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinate with functions such as
  **Merchandising, Inventory, Marketing, CRM, Finance and Operations**
  to resolve business gaps.
* Follow up on stock availability, product movement and other factors affecting sales.
* Support execution of promotional and commercial initiatives at stores.
* Ensure relevant business information is communicated effectively to store teams.

**Key Deliverables**

The Assistant Business Manager will be expected to:

* Improve visibility of
  **store-level sales performance and target gaps**
  .
* Provide timely and accurate business MIS.
* Identify key reasons for sales underperformance.
* Recommend actionable interventions to improve sales.
* Track execution and impact of corrective actions.
* Support achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Improve data-driven decision-making across stores.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration
  **, Commerce, Economics, Retail Management or a related discipline**
  .
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in
  **retail, luxury retail, sales operations, commercial operations or performance management**
  .
* Experience in luxury retail, premium retail or consumer-facing businesses would be an advantage.

**Skills & Competencies**

* **Commercial acumen**
  – understands sales drivers and business levers.
* **Analytical thinking**
  – able to interpret data and identify meaningful patterns.
* **Problem solving**
  – can move from identifying a gap to determining its root cause and action.
* **Execution orientation**
  – follows through on action plans and outcomes.
* **Stakeholder management**
  – comfortable working with store managers and cross-functional teams.
* **Communication skills**
  – able to present data and insights clearly to different stakeholders.
* **Attention to detail**
  – maintains accuracy in reporting and analysis.
* **Ownership mindset**
  – proactively identifies issues rather than waiting for instructions.

Job Description: Accounts & Finance Executive – Operations

Company: Raptor Supplies Private Limited

Department: Accounts & Finance Operations

Location: Lower Ground Floor, A & M Supplies India Private Limited, A-41, Block B, Mohan Cooperative Industrial Estate, Saidabad, New Delhi – 110044

Experience: 1–2Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Raptor Supplies

Raptor Supplies is a global B2B e-commerce company specializing in Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO) products and industrial supplies. The company serves customers across the UK, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia, working with a wide network of global brands and suppliers.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Accounts & Finance Executive to join our Operations team. The candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting activities, processing invoices, reconciling accounts, maintaining financial records, and supporting financial reporting and operational activities. The role requires close coordination with internal departments and vendors to ensure accurate documentation, timely payments, and smooth financial operations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Accounting & Financial Operations**

Maintain accurate records of daily financial transactions.

Process sales invoices, purchase invoices, and non-COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) invoices.

Maintain and update accounts payable and accounts receivable records.

Perform debtor and creditor reconciliations and follow up on outstanding balances.

Review ledger entries and ensure accurate accounting records.

Assist in preparing financial statements, balance sheets, and monthly reports.

**2. Invoice & Payment Management**

Verify invoices against purchase orders, supporting documents, and approvals.

Track vendor payments, customer receipts, and outstanding invoices.

Coordinate with Procurement and Operations teams to resolve invoice discrepancies.

Maintain records of payment transactions and supporting documentation.

Assist in monitoring payment schedules and ensuring timely processing.

**3. Reconciliation & Reporting**

Perform bank reconciliations and verify financial transactions.

Prepare accounts receivable and accounts payable ageing reports.

Assist in monthly closing activities and financial reporting.

Identify discrepancies and support their timely resolution.

Maintain proper documentation for internal reviews and audits.

**4. Operations Coordination**

Coordinate with Procurement, Order Processing, Logistics, and other internal teams regarding invoices and financial documentation.

Verify supplier bills and operational expenses before processing.

Maintain accurate records of purchase-related and operational transactions.

Support the finance team in improving accounting workflows and documentation processes.

Ensure timely communication and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.

**5. Compliance & Documentation**

Maintain organized financial records, invoices, vouchers, and supporting documents.

Assist in GST-related documentation, TDS records, and other statutory compliance activities, as applicable.

Support internal and external audits by providing the required financial information.

Ensure adherence to company policies, approval procedures, and accounting practices.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field (B.Com preferred).

1–3 years of experience in accounting, finance, or accounts operations.

Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial documentation.

Proficiency in MS Excel, including formulas, Pivot Tables, and data reconciliation.

Experience with accounting software or ERP systems; knowledge of Xero, Sage, or similar platforms is an advantage.

Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Good communication and coordination skills.

High attention to detail, accuracy, and time management.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Comfortable working in a fast-paced operational environment.

Able to manage multiple accounting tasks and meet deadlines.

Capable of coordinating with multiple internal teams and external vendors.

Proactive in identifying discrepancies and resolving financial issues.

Committed to maintaining confidentiality and accuracy in financial records.

**Why Join Raptor Supplies?**

Opportunity to work with a global B2B e-commerce and industrial supplies business.

Exposure to finance operations, vendor management, and cross-functional business processes.

Collaborative work environment with opportunities for professional growth.

title: Relationship Manager - Wholesale Banking Group
description:
**Essential Services: Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service.**
The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the role**

ICICI Bank provides comprehensive banking solutions to corporate customers. As a Relationship Manager of Wholesale Banking, you will be responsible for credit appraisal, financial analysis, client servicing, writing of credit notes, end-to-end executive of banking transactions, documentation, and covenant management. In this role, you work under the guidance of a Senior Relationship Manager/ Regional Head. While serving customers, you will be responsible for 360-degree banking and looking for banking opportunities across the customer ecosystem. This will involve offering banking products and services across the customer segments of the Bank. In your responsibility, you also hold the principle of being “Fair to Customer, Fair to Bank. You will be responsible for generating new business leads as well as deepening relationships with existing customers.

**Bankable individuals not just Bankers: We hire from across industries!**

We at ICICI Bank are in continuous pursuit of creating consistent customer delight and superior experience. Our Relationship Managers are empowered individuals who champion the cause of customer experience and have penchant for building and nurturing business relationships. If you are an individual, whose heart echoes with our aspiration, look no more. We do not just choose diverse minds but celebrate their success. If you are a bankable individual without banking experience, you are very much welcome, irrespective of your present core responsibilities or the industry associated. Our training programs equip you to get ready for the role of a Relationship Manager. Professionals from across industries are welcome to apply for the role of Relationship Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **360° Credit Assessment:**
  Understand in detail the client’s business and financials and prepare a quality appraisal note in collaboration with the Risk Management team.
* **Business Development:**
  Market scoping, segmenting and targeting to acquire new clients as per the risk appetite of the bank and drive ecosystem revenue o The RM for the purpose of business origination, will engage with banks, brokers, corporates, law firms, trade associations, chamber of commerce as well as attend events, participate in seminars, and trade fairs.
* **Collaboration:**
  Work in synergy with different internal teams of the Bank in order to deliver the right solutions to the customer. Collaborative working is key in this role.
* **Portfolio Management:**
  Manage a high-quality portfolio of corporate clients. Work towards generating new business leads as well as deepening relationships with existing customers.
* **Customer Service:**
  Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offer suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**

* **Educational Qualification:**
  MBA/chartered accountants/ Graduates. Graduates with 3-6 years of work experience or MBA/CAs with 1-5 years of work experience in the area of relationship management across industries
* **Communication skills:**
  Ability to tailor conversations (both verbal & written) arounds the need of customer with utmost focus on service delivery.
* **Financial Understanding:**
  Understanding of the intricacies of financial analysis, the balance sheet, profit & loss accounts and cash flow statements. Knowledge of basic banking products.

**About the Business group**

The Wholesale Banking Group of ICICI Bank manages a wide range of clients, which includes large private sector business houses and companies, financial institutions and banks, public sector undertakings, and Central and State government entities. The group also has a strong franchise among Multi-National Corporations (MNCs), real estate companies, IT & ITES, and new-age services companies, along with a strong franchise in the financial sponsor's space with a special focus on private equity funds and their investee companies. Additionally, it also caters to the requirements of the capital market and custody participants through unique digital solutions, improving their operational efficiency.

title: Marketplace Manager
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Marketplace Manager to own and grow our presence across India's leading online marketplaces — primarily Amazon and Flipkart, and others such as Myntra, Nykaa, Meesho, and JioMart as relevant to our categories. You'll be responsible for the full commercial and operational health of these channels: driving sales, protecting margins, keeping listings and inventory in top shape, and turning major sale events into our biggest revenue days of the year.

This is a hands-on, data-driven role for someone who knows Seller Central and Seller Hub inside out and can move comfortably between the spreadsheet and the strategy.

Key Responsibilities

* Own end-to-end management of the brand's storefronts on Amazon, Flipkart, and other marketplaces, including revenue targets and channel P&L.
* Create and optimize product listings — titles, images, bullet points, descriptions, and A+ / enhanced brand content — to maximize search ranking and conversion.
* Manage pricing strategy and win/defend the Buy Box while protecting margins against competitor activity.
* Plan and execute marketplace advertising (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display) against clear ACOS / ROAS targets.
* Forecast demand and coordinate inventory and fulfillment across FBA, Flipkart Assured / FBF, and self-ship models to avoid stock-outs and overstock.
* Lead planning and execution for major sale events — Great Indian Festival, Big Billion Days, Prime Day, and brand-day activations.
* Monitor and protect account health: seller ratings, return rates, policy compliance, and listing suppressions.
* Build and manage relationships with platform category / account managers to unlock visibility, deals, and co-marketing opportunities.
* Track, analyze, and report channel performance — sales, traffic, conversion, ad efficiency — and translate the data into actions.
* Stay ahead of marketplace policy changes, new features, and category trends.

Requirements

* 3–6 years managing brands or accounts on Amazon and/or Flipkart (in-house, or at a seller / aggregator / agency).
* Hands-on expertise with Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Strong command of marketplace advertising and the metrics that govern it (ACOS, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate).
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills and comfort working with large datasets.
* Solid understanding of marketplace SEO, listing optimization, and Buy Box mechanics.
* Commercial acumen — able to balance growth, margin, and inventory.
* Strong negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

Nice to Have

* Experience with tools like Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar.
* Exposure to additional platforms (Myntra, Nykaa, Meesho, Ajio, and quick-commerce such as Blinkit / Instamart).
* Experience managing external agencies or a small team.
* Category experience relevant to [our products].

What Success Looks Like

* **First 3 months:**
   listings audited and cleaned up, clear targets set per channel, and a firm handle on account health.
* **First 6–12 months:**
   measurable growth in marketplace revenue and improved ad efficiency, with well-executed festive sale events.

The role will involve working closely with senior leadership on investment opportunities, strategic transactions, financial analysis and investor-related deliverables.

* Assist in valuation exercises using methodologies such as DCF, comparable company analysis and precedent transactions.
* Prepare investment teasers, opportunity assessments and preliminary investment evaluation reports.

**2. Financial Modelling and Investment Committee (IC) Notes**

* Develop, maintain and update financial models, valuation models, business forecasts and scenario analyses.

* Assist in preparing transaction documentation, management presentations and other deal-related materials.
* Track action items, timelines and deliverables to ensure the smooth execution of transaction workstreams.

**4. Investor Relations (IR) and Management Support**

* Support the preparation of investor presentations, performance updates, financial summaries and other investor-facing materials.

* Conduct market, peer and competitor benchmarking to support investor communication and strategic decision-making.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency and timely collation of financial and business information used in investor-related deliverables.
* Provide analytical and execution support to senior leadership on ad hoc strategic, financial and business initiatives.

**5. Research, Analytics and AI-Enabled Productivity**

* Leverage traditional research platforms, financial databases and analytical tools to support investment evaluation and decision-making.
* Use AI-powered tools to accelerate research, information synthesis, financial analysis, document review and presentation development.
* Explore and implement efficient workflows using AI tools while ensuring data confidentiality, source validation and analytical accuracy.
* Stay updated on industry developments, transaction trends, valuation benchmarks and emerging investment themes.

Desired Candidate Profile
  
  
  

* 3–4 years of relevant experience in M&A, investment banking, corporate finance, transaction advisory, private equity, investment analysis or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on experience in financial modelling, valuation, investment analysis and preparation of IC notes or investment memos.

Key Competencies

* AI-enabled research and productivity
* Ownership, agility and attention to detail

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) is a division of Global Banking & Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. In this regard, BF&C will ensure, inter alia, that accounting policies are correctly and consistently applied, and that trading portfolios are appropriately valued.
  
  
The team prepares and reports P&L and balance sheet to the business and ensures the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger. We are responsible for daily service delivery and ensuring effective controls, transparent management information and becoming a center of excellence delivering process simplification and efficiencies. We work closely with front office, middle office, traders and valuation control teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) seeks to provide a support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the P&L production area covering the Global Credit Trading desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P&L to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Middle Office, and Finance and Trade Capture teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Primary products covered will include: Bonds, CDS, TRS, ETFs and Loans
* Production and reporting of daily P&L to Front Office & Senior Management
* Reconcile actual P&L with trader estimates and provide flash/actual variance analysis
* Working closely with the trading desks on position, P&L or other issues on an ad-hoc basis
* Front-to-Back analysis & reconciliations of front office PnL and balance sheet to firm sub-ledgers
* Assist with execution of month-end controls ensuring management vs financial P&L variances are within thresholds
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves
* Would be typical own set of books / cost center and Business Units
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries
* Development & continuous improvement of existing processes & workflow
* Testing / UAT for systems work ranging from minor system releases to major system implementations
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk

**Education\***
Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute
  
  
Certifications If Any
  
  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus
* Ability to use Excel Power Query or Alteryx would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly

**Experience Range\***
2-5 years of experience in Global Markets
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Prior BFC experience for >2 years is mandatory
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite; expert knowledge of Excel, Word, PowerPoint. Knowledge of Visual Basic, Access databases and macros will be an added advantage.

**Mission and objectives**

UNEP’s mission is to provide leadership and encourage partnership in caring for the environment by inspiring, informing, and enabling nations and peoples to improve their quality of life without compromising that of future generations. For five decades, the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) has been a leading advocate for the environment, a steadfast partner and a trusted adviser with a mission to inform, enable and inspire nations and peoples to improve their quality of life without compromising that of future generations. UNEP monitors the state and health of the planet, ensures that science remains at the centre of decision-making processes, and that environmental rule of law continues to underpin global environmental governance.

Together with its partners, UNEP has made significant progress, yet there is no denying that today, environmental challenges have reached unprecedented levels. Unsustainable patterns of consumption and production have led to the triple planetary crisis of climate change, nature and biodiversity loss, and pollution and waste. The science is clear: human health, prosperity, equity and peace are all under threat. We must urgently transform our economies and societies and our relationship with nature. UNEP is here to lead this transformation with its 193 Member States, and in partnership with other UN agencies and stakeholders. With its experience, expertise, dynamic programmes and forward-thinking strategy, and with its dedicated staff, UNEP is uniquely positioned in addressing and reversing the triple planetary crisis.

**Context**

The UN Volunteer assignment is part of the India component of the European Commission-funded Sustainable Watershed Management Project in Brazil and India. The UN Volunteer will be working under the direct supervision of the relevant Programme Management Officer in UNEP India Office and the overall project supervision of the Project Lead within the Freshwater and Wetlands Ecosystems Unit, Marine and Freshwater Branch at UNEP HQ, and in close collaboration with relevant UNEP teams, implementing partners, national counterparts and technical experts.

**Task description**

• Conduct targeted research and analysis on existing financing approaches and enabling conditions at the national, state, and local/project levels.

• Analyze best practices and challenges in existing financing approaches in India based on review of the literature and stakeholder consultations.

• Support the analysis and documentation of findings and insights of the financing dimension of the India pilot.

• Develop a draft sustainable finance framework and accompanying recommendations for integrated watershed management in India, including the identification and assessment of relevant investment opportunities.

• Support stakeholder consultations and coordination with relevant government agencies, financial institutions, implementing partners, and technical experts contributing to the India pilot case.

• Draft technical outputs related to the India sustainable finance framework, including reports, presentations, and supporting knowledge products.

• Support the development of a global guidance document on sustainable finance for watershed management based on the analysis and synthesis of lessons learned and practical experiences from the India and Brazil case studies, contributing to a replicable and scalable approach for integrated, sustainable watershed management across regions and countries.

• Coordinate with UNEP teams, project partners, and technical experts to support the integration of technical inputs and feedback into project deliverables.

• Support knowledge-sharing and communication activities related to sustainable finance, watershed management, and freshwater ecosystem resilience, as relevant to the project.

• Report regularly to the supervising officer and project lead within the Freshwater and Wetlands Ecosystems Unit on progress related to the assignment and delivery of outputs.

• Any other tasks that may be required in support of the assignment and project objectives.

**Relevant experience**

4 years

**Languages**

English, Level: Fluent, Required

Hindi, Level: Fluent, Desirable

**Required education level**

Master's degree in Sustainable finance, environmental finance, natural resource economics

An advantage will be given to candidates with prior experience in freshwater ecosystems, watershed management, or related natural resource management fields.

**Skills and experience**

• Minimum of 4 years of progressively responsible professional experience at national and/or international level in sustainable finance, environmental finance, climate finance, investment analysis, natural resource economics, or related fields.

• Demonstrated experience in developing technical reports, policy papers, financing frameworks, guidance documents, or knowledge products related to sustainable or environmental finance.

• Strong experience in research and analysis of financing mechanisms, including blended finance, investment structuring, and enabling policy/financial environments for sustainable development.

• Proven ability to produce high-quality written outputs, including drafting, editing, and synthesizing complex technical information for diverse audiences.

Desirable Experience

• Experience engaging with or coordinating among government institutions, development partners, financial institutions, private sector actors, and technical experts.

• Familiarity with watershed management, freshwater ecosystems, nature-based solutions, or climate adaptation financing.

• Experience working in international, multi-stakeholder environments, including development or UN system contexts.

• Previous experience with the United Nations system or other international organizations is an asset

Skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong drafting, formulation, and reporting abilities.

• High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and professionalism in document production and editing.

• Strong interpersonal and intercultural skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with diverse stakeholders, including government counterparts, technical experts, and community-level actors.

• Ability to work effectively in complex and multicultural environments, demonstrating adaptability and sound judgment under tight deadlines.

• Strong computer literacy, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and standard digital communication tools; familiarity with databases or project management tools is an advantage.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision while delivering high-quality outputs under time constraints.

title: Business Operations | CEO’s Office
description:
**We’re looking for someone who wants to get into everything.**

Aidentifi is building an AI-native way of running an executive search business, and we’re looking for an unusually organised, commercially curious operator to work closely with the CEO.

This is not a traditional finance or administrative role.

You’ll work across commercial operations, resource utilisation, contracts, workflows, research, presentations and CEO priorities. Importantly, you’ll also become a
**driver and navigator of our internal operating system**
, helping us run the business through it and continuously make it better.

**What you’ll do**

* Run & improve the operating system
* Become a power user and day-to-day operator of Aidentifi’s AI driven internal operating system
* Make sure mandates, priorities, information and follow-ups move through the system properly
* Spot where processes break, information gets lost or people work around the system
* Work with our business and technology teams to improve workflows, automation and AI assistance
* Test new ways of working in the real world and help turn what works into repeatable processes
* Help us answer a simple question:
  **how should an AI-native company actually operate?**

**Business & commercial operations**

* Analyse resource utilisation, client economics and business performance
* Support proposals, contracts, commercial decisions, invoicing and collections
* Build useful dashboards, analyses and management information
* Coordinate across clients, teams and external partners
* Find operational gaps and take ownership of fixing them

**CEO’s Office**

* Help translate priorities into execution
* Keep important decisions, commitments and follow-ups moving
* Prepare presentations, analyses and briefing materials
* Research companies, industries, business ideas and investments
* Get rapidly up to speed on unfamiliar topics and turn messy information into a structured point of view
* Help prioritise what actually deserves attention

And plenty that isn't listed here.

**The breadth is intentional.**

Who we’re looking for

We want someone who is:

* Exceptionally organised and detail-oriented
* Commercially curious and comfortable with numbers
* Good at creating structure from ambiguity
* Strong with Excel and PowerPoint
* Interested in AI, technology and automation
* A clear writer and communicator
* Able to move comfortably between analysis and execution
* Fast at learning unfamiliar subjects
* High-agency and comfortable figuring things out
* The kind of person who notices when something doesn't work and wants to fix it

A
**CA/accounting, finance, consulting or similarly rigorous background**
could be particularly relevant, but this is
**not an accounting position**
. Our accounting and compliance work is handled by external professionals.

We're interested in the discipline those backgrounds can develop: numerical fluency, reliability, structured thinking and attention to detail.

Why this role is different

You'll have an unusual vantage point across the company.

You'll see the commercial side of the business, its numbers, customers, people, systems and decisions. At the same time, you'll help us figure out how
**AI, automation and good operating discipline can change the way a company actually works**
.

You won't just use the operating system.

**You'll help us learn how it should work.**

For someone early in their career who ultimately wants to become a
**BizOps leader, Chief of Staff, general manager, COO or entrepreneur**
, that's a pretty interesting place to sit.

If your reaction to something unfamiliar is:

**“Let me understand it, structure it and figure it out.”**

We'd like to hear from you.

title: Project Leader- ENR
description:
**ABOUT US:**

  

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change-makers define the future. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. Expert Client Delivery (ECD) is an integral unit of BCN. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, and Bain intellectual property.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**

This is an opportunity to be a part of Bain’s Energy and Natural Resources (ENR CoE) team, based out of Gurugram office, and specifically support BAIN ENR practice on live cases, client development and proposal support. The ENR CoE consists of 45+ team members, organized into ~10 teams, working across various sectors such as oil and gas, power and utilities, chemicals, mining, fertilizers and agri-business

As the ENR sector personnel, you will get exposed to case delivery and client development activities for our clients in Oil and gas, Power & Utilities, Renewables, Wastewater Recycling, etc. The primarily objective of the sector professionals is to collaborate with practice/ case teams on the development and deployment of industry specific analytical products and topic expertise to answer strategic questions of Bain’s ENR clients.

In addition, Associates help mentor and coach Analysts by providing regular guidance / feedback. The expectation is to eventually provide significant direction and support to resolve complex issues and effectively manage client and team meetings.

 

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

 

* Candidate should be currently working in strategy consulting/research-oriented set-up and possess acumen to  solve open-ended problems
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different ENR sub-sectors (Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities, Renewables, Petrochemicals, etc.)
* Proficient in research and analysis, as well as able to provide solid business judgment to derive answers in situations where  data is not easily available or explicitly published
* Able to interface with primary client contact (Bain case teams from ME offices)
* May have first-level team management responsibility, which involves allocating and reviewing work to a small team of  analysts and conducting performance / feedback discussions
* Provide content thought leadership & may manage simple cases independently

 

**ABOUT YOU:**

* Candidate should be an MBA from top-tier College with strong academic records with 3-6 years of experience in consulting for ENR clients.
* Candidates should possess excellent analytical, communication, problem solving and team player skills; ability to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.
* Should possess strong Excel Modeling and PowerPoint skills.
* Good understanding of any of the ENR subsectors is an added advantage

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. description:

Full-Time, On-Site

Fire Remedy Systems (FRS) is an established organization specializing in fire safety, fire detection, fire alarm, and fire-fighting solutions and Electrical/ELV & Civil works. We are looking for a responsible, organized, and computer-proficient professional to manage day-to-day office activities and provide administrative, Billing, procurement, and project documentation support.

The Business Office Coordinator will be responsible for managing routine office operations, maintaining company records, coordinating procurement activities, supporting accounts and billing, and ensuring the timely preparation and submission of business documents. The role requires hands-on experience with office software, accounting applications, spreadsheets, email communication, and digital documentation.

* Scan, print, merge, convert, and organize PDF documents for official submissions.

**B. Computer and Software Proficiency**

* **MS Excel:**
  Prepare and maintain data sheets, purchase registers, expense statements, payment trackers, stock registers, reconciliation sheets, and MIS reports using formulas, sorting, filtering, and lookup functions.

* **MS Outlook / Gmail:**
  Handle official emails, attachments, follow-ups, meeting schedules, and correspondence records.
* **PDF Software:**
  Manage document merging, splitting, conversion, compression, page arrangement, and basic editing.
* **Google Workspace / Microsoft 365:**
  Maintain shared files, spreadsheets, calendars, and digital records.
* Adapt quickly to the company's existing billing, procurement, inventory, and project handling.

**C. Billing and Payment Follow-Up**

* Prepare department billings, maintain payment schedules and follow up with clients, vendors, and internal teams regarding pending bills and payments.

**D. Procurement and Vendor Coordination**

* Obtain and compare quotations from suppliers and prepare comparative statements.
* Prepare purchase orders, work orders, material requirement sheets, and procurement trackers.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding prices, delivery schedules, payment terms, and pending supplies. Maintain vendor databases, purchase records, delivery challans, and material receipt details.
* Track material requirements and coordinate with project teams to ensure timely procurement.

**E. Project and Business Support**

* Maintain project-wise folders containing work orders, purchase orders, invoices, measurement and billing documents, and correspondence.
* Track the status of running bills, payment certificates, approvals, and outstanding amounts.
* Coordinate with clients, contractors, suppliers, and site staff for documentation and information requirements.

**4. Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Graduate or diploma holder in Commerce, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.
* Minimum 2–4 years of relevant experience in office administration, accounts support, procurement coordination, or business operations.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, email applications, and PDF management tools.
* Practical knowledge of accounting software/ERP is preferred.
* Good command of written and spoken English and Hindi.
* Ability to draft professional emails and official letters independently.
* Strong numerical accuracy, data-entry skills, document management, and follow-up abilities.
* Experience in a contracting, engineering, construction, or project-based organization will be an added advantage.

**5. Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented, and computer-savvy professional who can independently manage routine office work, maintain accurate records, coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, and ensure that assigned tasks are completed on time with minimal supervision.
