* Maintain robust process documentation, SOPs, desktop procedures, control evidence and knowledge repositories.
* Identify financial and operational risks early, implement preventive and corrective actions, and support internal, statutory and external audits.
* Promote a strong controls and compliance culture while balancing governance with efficient business outcomes. Transformation & Operational Excellence
* Drive simplification, standardization, automation and productivity improvement across the assigned portfolio.
* Use data and process insights to identify recurring issues, remove non-value-added activities and improve customer experience.
* Partner with technology, process owners and business teams on system implementations, migrations, transitions and continuous-improvement programs.
* Embed scalable ways of working and share leading practices across teams and locations. Stakeholder & Change Management
* Build trusted relationships with business finance, operations, procurement, sales, tax, legal, technology, banks, vendors, customers and auditors, as relevant to the portfolio.
* Facilitate governance reviews, resolve escalations, communicate trade-offs clearly and ensure ownership of agreed actions.
* Act as a change leader during organizational, process and technology transformation. People Leadership
* Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team with clear accountability, role clarity and performance expectations.
* Plan staffing, hiring, onboarding, succession and capability development in line with current and future business needs.
* Create an inclusive, collaborative and learning-oriented environment that supports engagement, retention and internal mobility.

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* Master of Business Administration

**Experience**

* 12-15 years

**What We Look For**
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
  
  
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

* Experience working with financial data in Excel or other reporting tools.

This role maintains relationships with a range of business partners – including Commercial (and wider multi-functional selling) teams, Marketing, FP&A, Internal audit, Supply and our various DBS Shared Services teams across the world.
  
  
You will lead the performance agenda for your customers and support in promoting Diageo’s best interests in all regions and channels. This includes contributing to monthly cluster meetings, understanding the key dynamics of all functions within the business and holding business partners to account for strong performance in their areas of responsibility.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Business Partner to GTs Account Controllers and their respective commercial teams:
  
  

* Performance Management: Embeds a strong performance culture within the team, tracking performance against the financial plan (NSV, Operating Profit, Cash) and other critical metrics (including market share and supply chain effectiveness) and proactively managing associated risks and opportunities. This entails:
* Managing the BPM cycle with commercial business partners
* Proactively driving commercial partners to understand external influences and trends and their impact on current/future performance
* Driving possibility thinking in commercial discussions, and managing the development of new customer and brand opportunities
* Quantifying risks and opportunities to the Annual Operating Plan (“AOP”), and communicating these clearly to key stakeholders
* Act as a key business partner to the Account Controllers (Commercial Team) to:
* Drive the commercial performance agenda including planning and customer negotiation strategy that will secure continued value-creating growth
* Drive an effective measurement and evaluation process for investment in the customer alongside the CP&A team
* Support the productivity agenda, including RGM and A&P effectiveness

* Ensure all globally mandated CARE requirements are adhered to
* Ensure full visibility of risks and mitigation

**Key Functional Capabilities**

* Ability to drive value through commercial knowledge/insight and understanding of the impact of decisions on the business

**Strategic Analysis and Financial Modelling**

* Ability to develop, review and present financial analysis/models to address ongoing investment opportunities

* Ability to transition effectively between both operational detail and strategic goals in reviewing ongoing performance

title: Sr Associate/Assistant Manager- Cost Accountant
description:
Join the dynamic team at Wholsum Foods and be part of an extraordinary movement! Our mission is simple: to change the way the world eats. With brands like Slurrp Farm and Mille, we offer healthy and delicious alternatives to the junk food epidemic. It's time to rediscover the nutritious traditions of our ancestors and embrace the power of millets like Ragi, Jowar, Bajra, and Foxtail Millet.

Led by founders Shauravi Malik and Meghana Narayan, we are food enthusiasts, entrepreneurs, and mothers committed to making a difference. We're expanding globally and seeking talented individuals who thrive in a collaborative, innovative, and high-growth environment. Join us and embark on a rewarding journey where you can grow professionally while having a blast!

At Wholsum Foods, we celebrate diversity and unity, all driven by a shared mission to revolutionize the way we eat. Our team is our greatest asset, and our core values - Relationship First, Dependable, Passionate, and Growth Mindset - bring out the best in each team member. We take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace, embracing individuals regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Together, we will redefine the future of food!

We are also Great Place to Work Certified.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a
**CMA / Cost Accountant**
to strengthen our cost accounting, inventory controls and financial closure processes. The role will focus on
**COGS, product costing, inventory valuation, yield & wastage analysis, cost control and month-end closure**
.

The role will work closely with Finance, Operations and Procurement teams to
**identify cost variances, improve inventory accuracy, strengthen controls and provide actionable insights on product margins and cost efficiency**
. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, hands-on experience with costing and inventory, and a good understanding of ERP/accounting systems.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Product Costing & COGS:**

* Review and validate monthly COGS and product-level costing.
* Analyse standard BOM vs. actual consumption and identify material consumption variances.
* Review changes in raw material, packaging and other input costs and assess their impact on product margins.
* Support standard costing and periodic revision of product costs.
* Analyse product/customer/channel-level gross margins and identify significant cost deviations.

**2. Inventory & Stock Reconciliation**

* Perform monthly closing stock reconciliation between Tally, EasyEcom and operational records.
* Reconcile inventory sub-ledger with the General Ledger and investigate variances.
* Review inventory movements including purchases, production, sales, returns, transfers, adjustments and write-offs.
* Ensure appropriate inventory valuation and accounting treatment.
* Identify and track slow-moving, obsolete, damaged and expired inventory.

**3. Yield & Wastage Analysis**

* Monitor production yield and wastage against standard norms.
* Analyse actual wastage versus standard/approved wastage levels.
* Identify reasons for abnormal wastage and coordinate with operations/procurement teams for corrective actions.
* Track material consumption efficiency and highlight recurring variances.

**4. Expense & Cost Control**

* Review major operating and production-related expenses against budget/previous periods.
* Analyse significant expense variances and provide explanations.
* Ensure appropriate expense provisioning at month-end for goods/services received but invoices not yet received.
* Review provision workings, reversals and utilisation.
* Support identification of cost-saving opportunities and improve overall cost controls.

**5. Month-End Closure**

* Support the finance team in month-end closing activities.
* Prepare/review COGS, inventory, provision and related accounting workings.
* Ensure timely booking of inventory adjustments, provisions and other cost-related entries.
* Perform month-end reconciliations and ensure open reconciling items are tracked and resolved.
* Support preparation of MIS and management reporting related to costs, margins and inventory.

**6. MIS & Variance Analysis**

* Prepare periodic cost and variance analysis for management.
* Analyse actual cost vs. standard/budget/prior period.
* Track gross margin movements and identify key cost drivers.
* Prepare dashboards/reports covering COGS, inventory, wastage, yield and cost variances.

**7. Audit & Compliance Support**

* Provide inventory, costing, COGS and provision schedules for statutory/internal audits.
* Support physical stock verification and reconciliation.
* Ensure proper documentation and audit trail for costing and inventory-related entries.
* Assist in implementing and strengthening internal controls around inventory and cost accounting.

**WHAT WILL YOU BRING?**

* CMA / Cost Accountant – qualified or with relevant experience in cost accounting.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in cost accounting, inventory accounting, costing or controllership.
* Strong understanding of BOM, standard costing, COGS, inventory valuation, yield/wastage and variance analysis.
* Good Excel and analytical skills, with experience in ERP/accounting systems.
* FMCG / manufacturing/e-commerce experience would be preferred.

**WHAT WILL YOU GET?**

* Opportunity to work with a fast-growing, purpose-driven food brand.
* A collaborative and supportive team culture.
* Growth opportunities and skill-building in a dynamic, high-energy environment.

**Starting Date: Immediately**

**Location: Gurgaon**

To drive cost governance, budgeting, forecasting, and financial control across Wind EPC projects. The role will be responsible for developing project cost estimates, monitoring budget adherence, performing variance analysis, maintaining EAC (Estimate at Completion), and providing management insights to enable timely commercial decisions and improve project profitability. This role acts as the financial custodian of Wind EPC projects from project award through commissioning.

Project Costing & Budgeting
  
  

* Prepare detailed project cost estimates and EPC cost models during project planning and award stages.

* Track commodity price trends and evaluate business impact.
* Support management approvals, NFAs, and budget allocation processes.
* Evaluate change orders, variation claims, and scope deviation impacts.
* Establish governance mechanisms for budget control and commercial discipline.

MIS & Management Reporting

* Prepare budget reviews, Board/ExCom inputs, and project performance dashboards.
* Provide actionable insights on project profitability and cost efficiency.
* Maintain project-level and portfolio-level financial KPIs.

* Timeliness of monthly reporting

* Accuracy of cash flow forecasts

title: Senior Investment Associate - NORTH
description:
**About the Company**

Vantrock is an Operator led real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain — first mile, last mile, city-centre, dark-store and self-storage formats, and logistics-anchored mixed-use developments with distribution below and office above. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back-office space — vertical industries, where our expertise transfers; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

**Responsibilities**

* Own the models. Land acquisition, development cost, leasing, financing, operating cash flows and exit; project and equity IRR, MOIC, yield on cost, development margin; the sensitivities that matter — built, documented and auditable on the platform's dashboards.
* Own the Investment Committee paper. Screening notes, investment proposals and IC memoranda to the team's standard, with a view you can defend: merits, risks, mitigants, value creation.
* Run diligence end to end. Commercial, financial, legal, technical, environmental and tax workstreams — commanding the platform's partners, integrating findings into structure and price, tracking conditions precedent to closing.
* Take smaller transactions end to end. Negotiation support on the large ones; ownership of the small ones, under the Principal's oversight.
* Own the team's inputs to the monthly Asset Review. Actuals against underwriting, construction cost against spend, leasing, drawdowns and returns, produced with the Financial Controller & Head of Asset Management; the investment content of periodic investor reports for the CFO's sign-off.
* Sponsor the assets you close and contribute to the annual asset business plan.
* Direct and train the Analyst on models, memoranda and diligence, and review their work to the team's standard.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including at least four years of hands-on work on live transactions — modelling, valuation, diligence, structuring, IC materials, documentation and closing.
* A Deal Sheet of closed transactions you co-led or supported end to end, at least one of them in warehousing or industrial.
* Strong financial-modelling, valuation and analytical capability; a sound understanding of real-estate cash flows, development economics, capital structures and return metrics.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; fluent with AI tools and comfortable building on dashboards.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to run several workstreams to tight timelines.
* Not a modelling-only seat. The Associate forms and defends a view.

**Required Skills**

* Strong financial-modelling, valuation and analytical capability.
* Sound understanding of real-estate cash flows, development economics, capital structures and return metrics.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint.
* Fluency with AI tools and comfort building on dashboards.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to run several workstreams to tight timelines.

**Preferred Skills**

CULTURAL FIT

We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.

AI proficiency and partner command are standing requirements in every Vantrock seat: you work fluently with AI tools and build on the platform's dashboards, and you command the institutional partners who execute the transactional work.

title: Market Risk Specialist
description:

Louis Dreyfus Company is a leading merchant and processor of agricultural goods. Our activities span the entire value chain from farm to fork, across a broad range of business lines, we leverage our global reach and extensive asset network to serve our customers and consumers around the world. Structured as a matrix organization of six geographical regions and ten platforms, Louis Dreyfus Company is active in over 100 countries and employs approximately 20,000 people globally.

The Market risk team at LDC is responsible for producing quantitative market risk metrics along with qualitative assessment of potential risks to the company portfolio due to changes in market conditions. You will work closely with traders, risk managers, and other stakeholders to provide analysis, report risk metrics, and develop insights into market movements.

* Independently run and validate daily Market Risk calculations, including VaR and key risk metrics, ensuring data integrity, model stability, and timely delivery.
* Perform first-level analysis of VaR movements, identifying key drivers (price, positions, volatility) and escalating material changes with clear explanations to Management or Platform Risk Managers.
* Conduct deep-dive analysis on market exposures, linking risk movements to market fundamentals (e.g., price trends, supply/demand changes, basis movements).
* Generate and distribute daily risk reports to senior management, summarizing risk exposures, key metrics (e.g., Value at Risk (VaR), Margin Call Exposure), and historical trend analyses.
* Act as a key point of contact for various stakeholders, providing timely insights, challenging assumptions where appropriate, and supporting risk-informed decision-making.
* Continuously enhance and streamline risk reporting, improving transparency, consistency, and relevance to business decisions.
* Support and drive enhancements to risk tools, dashboards, and reporting frameworks, improving usability, efficiency, and data visibility across platforms.
* Contribute to enhancements in risk models and methologies (e.g. VaR assumptions, stress testing approaches)
* Explore and apply AI and data analytics tools to improve risk monitoring, anomaly detection, and reporting efficiency.

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics and Finance or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience; strong programming skills are highly valued.
* English (Fluent)
* Prior experience in financial analysis or related roles is preferred, with exposure to physical and/or derivatives markets considered an advantage. Familiarity with commodities trading and market risk is a plus.
* Familiarity with market risk concepts and metrics, such as Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, and exposure analysis, with the ability to interpret and explain risk movements.
* Exposure to risk systems, data analysis tools, or reporting platforms (e.g.,Python, Power BI, or similar) to support risk monitoring and reporting processes.
* Experienced in designing data modelling/analytics.
* Exposure to process improvement, automation, or data-driven initiatives (including use of analytics tools or AI-assisted workflows) to enhance risk reporting and monitoring efficiency.

Additional Information
  

* Strong understanding of statistical and financial risk models, including practical application in risk measurement (e.g.VaR, stress testing, scenario analysis) and interpretation of outputs in a business context.
* Strong Programming skills in data analysis and automation tools such as Python, SAS, Java, HTML or similar, with the ability to analyze large datasets, improve workflows, and support automation initiatives.
* Experience in data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI), with the ability to build interactive dashboards and translate complex risk metrics into clear insights.
* Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to detect discrepancies in data and systems, ensuring the reliability of risk assessments.
* Exposure to advanced analytics or AI-assisted tools to enhance risk monitoring, anomaly detection, or reporting workflows.

title: Investment Officer
description:
**Join Our Mission to Foster Prosperity in Asia**
Are you ready to make a difference in the future of Asia and be a catalyst for positive change? At ADB, our mission is simple yet powerful: to alleviate poverty and promote sustainable development in the Asia-Pacific region.
  
  
**Organizational Setting and Reporting Relationship**
The position of Investment Officer is assigned to the Private Sector Financial Institutions Division (PSFI) in the Office of the Director General (OPSD) within the Private Sector Operations Department (PSOD) . You will be based at our Resident Mission Office in New Delhi, India (INRM).
  
  
You will report to the Country Director of INRM and the designated PSFI International Staff.
  
  
**Your Role**
As an Investment Officer, you will participate in the processing of ADB's private sector financing of financial institutions projects and technical assistance in India and South Asia. You will also be responsible for establishing new client relationships and maintaining existing ones within the context of project development and assist in managing relationships with the governments in the region.
  
  
**You Will**
**You will need:**
**Benefits**

* Project Processing
* Lead and/or participate in the processing of projects, undertaking the needed due diligence, risk analysis and mitigation work towards the structuring of loans, equity investments, guarantees or other forms of assistance.
* Lead credit and financial due diligence by developing financial models and in general assessing the risk and credit profile of proposed financial institutions projects and reviewing project documents.
* Analyze financial statements and financial projections/models.
* Perform sensitivity analysis and stress testing and make necessary recommendations.
* Participate in due diligence missions and providing technical support and recommendations to team leaders.
* Represent ADB in specific transactions with external technical advisors, consultants and lawyers.
* Lead relevant sector and country research, as needed, as part of transaction risk assessment and make recommendations to the project team leader.
* Collaborate with the Office of Risk Management and the Safeguards Specialists to address credit-related and safeguard issues.
* Work with the Treasury Department to facilitate local currency lending.
* Prepare project documentation and presentation materials and discussing issues in various meetings, including Investment Committee and Board meetings.
* Business Development
* Lead and/or facilitate discussions with potential private sector and state-owned financial institutions for project development and processing.
* Identify and screen projects for developmental aspects and commercial viability to contribute to the development of a pipeline for PSFI in India and other countries in the South Asia.
* Others
* Lead and/or contribute to the development of policy and strategies for ADB's developmental goals for the private sector in consultation with relevant stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Finance Sector Group and other relevant sovereign teams on various initiatives.
* Liaise with governments to advocate and promote PSFI projects.
* Perform other tasks as assigned and reflected in the incumbent's workplan.
* Bachelor's degree in management or finance or in related fields; preferably with advanced training and/or qualification as Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA).
* At least 8 years of work experience preferably in the financial sector; and at least 4 years of relevant experience in the financial sector, preferably in investment management, investment banking, consulting, credit analysis, or research with a focus on financial institutions.
* Deal origination experience in debt and/or equity transactions in India and other countries in the region.
* Proven ability to undertake research and analysis on difficult but well-defined tasks, collect and organize required data and information, apply appropriate computer skills in organizing and analyzing the data; and prepare notes, papers and sections of reports.
* Good analytical thinking with ability to comprehend causal links, make pros and cons analysis, and analyze factors to reach a decision.
* Able to guide Junior team members to facilitate work planning, delivery and quality review.
* Able to work collaboratively with teams as a constructive team member.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Please refer to the link for ADB Competency Framework for Technical Local Staff grade TL5.

ADB offers a rewarding salary and a comprehensive benefits package . The salary will be based on ADB's standards and comparator markets, taking into account your qualifications and experience.
  
  

* Retirement plan

**Additional Information**
This appointment is open to internal and external applicants.
  
  
This opening is a local staff position. It is open only to nationals and permanent residents of India.
  
  
This is a fixed term appointment with option to renew, initially for a period of up to 3 years, or up to the Normal Retirement Date (NRD), whichever comes earlier, for the purpose(s) and conditions determined by ADB, in accordance with Administrative Order No. 2.01 (Recruitment and Appointment). After the initial fixed-term period, ADB may choose to renew the appointment for up to an additional 3 years or not renewed. This decision will be made in the overall interest of ADB, based on factors including but not limited to the requirement of Staff's particular blend of skills and experience for the medium-term work program of the organizational unit, sufficient funding to cover the renewed period, and Staff's performance and suitability for employment. There is no limit to the number of renewals up to NRD. However, this appointment is not convertible to a regular appointment.

title: Manager Impact, India and Southeast Asia
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
  
  
**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
Direct Reports:
  
  
**Matrix/Dual Reports**
Chief Impact Officer
  
  
None
  
  
VP, India; MD, Grids of the Future
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet’s goals are bold and audacious. We recognize that the path to a just energy transition worldwide will be complex, non-linear, and filled with successes and opportunities, alongside failures and challenges. The Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will support our effort to measure our contribution to impact through evaluations, monitoring and learning. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is embedded within our operating model, to ensure that we have an ear to the ground so we remain responsive and opportunistic, while generating insights that support continuous improvement.
  
  
Stepping into a start-up environment, the Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will lead monitoring, evaluation and learning for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio, guided by the organization’s Impact framework. They will also lead impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions, and provide monitoring and analytics support across the global portfolio. They will be responsible for independently establishing the routine and long-term work component of these workstreams, ensuring that they are efficiently managed and executed.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
  
  

+ Monitoring: Providing backend impact data quality assurance for all India and Southeast Asia transactions. Provide technical advice on target setting, indicators, theory of change mechanisms, causality links for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio. Onboard and train program teams on results monitoring sheets – ensuring compliance. They will also support the monitoring function across the global portfolio, including data compilation, quality checks and analytics for quarterly impact reporting, working alongside the Alliance’s external monitoring and learning partner.
+ Grids of the Future impact: Leading impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions. Developing and maintaining expected-impact estimates for utility partnerships, grid digitalization, battery energy storage and distributed energy resource programs, working with program teams and external modelling partners. Tracking realized impact against expected impact as programs move through the pipeline, and designing evaluations of utility-level outcomes such as reliability, losses and effects on consumers.
+ Evaluation: Sourcing and managing independent evaluation partners working closely with the Director of Evaluation. Establishing the pulse on what needs evaluation and when by closely working with the India and Southeast Asia and Grids of the Future teams in sourcing evaluation questions. Selecting fit for purpose evaluation approaches and tools and sense checking their design and functionality.
+ Learning: Support the team in designing and managing ongoing reflection, sense-making, and learning from the work to inform potential shifts in strategy when necessary, using data and evidence to rationalize change.
+ Capacity building: Onboarding, training and operationalizing Impact functions in country teams, solution teams and hiring monitoring evaluation and learning consultants. Ensuring that all requirements per the Impact framework are met in the investment cycle for all India and Southeast Asia programs.
+ Systems integration: Ensuring the internal Global Energy Alliance systems tracking progress on program implementation, financial execution and impact measuring are integrating, working in close collaboration with the IT systems manager, the management teams for country programs and scalable solutions and the Investment team.
+ Advisory function: Advising global Impact colleagues and external technical providers by ground truthing India and Southeast Asia portfolio realities.

**BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES**
**Preferred Attributes**

* Working in Partnership: Learning with, learning from, and learning for our partners, particularly those who are closest to the work on the ground. Balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and working in partnership wherever possible.
* Directs Work: Being strategic with efforts and generating information that informs decision making and improves impact. Providing direction and removing obstacles to get work done.
* Manages Complexity: Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Values Differences: Recognizes the value of different perspectives and commits to inclusion, equity, and diversity in every aspect of work.
* Intellectual Humility: We know that we don’t have all the answer. We strive to be equally comfortable talking about what is not working as we are celebrating our successes. We listen to the voices of those we serve.
* Innovation and Entrepreneurial Spirit: A self-starter who takes initiative to identify areas of improvement and uses an energetic, pragmatic, and creative approach to optimize practice; embodying ‘Start-Up Philosophy.’

**Required Experience**

* 10-15 years of experience in monitoring, evaluation, and learning.
* Advanced degree in relevant subjects such as economics, public policy, or similar areas with strong training in evaluation, monitoring and learning.
* Experience in developing best-in-class monitoring, evaluation and learning approaches including designing and establishing these systems from scratch. Ideal experience gained in a complex organizational environment.
* Substantial experience of monitoring, evaluation and learning in the context of climate and energy programs, and/or programs driving systems change. Experience with contribution analysis will be a plus.
* Experience measuring the impact of grid infrastructure, utility performance or battery energy storage programs, including modelling expected impacts and validating them against realized results.
* Experience working in India and Southeast Asia, with familiarity with the region’s energy sector, utilities and government programs.
* Experience working independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience working with contractors, consultants to ensure value for money and quality actionable outcomes.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong writing skills.
* Expertise in STATA, R or similar software packages, and MS Excel.
* Experience with Power BI or other dashboard tools, data engineering and applied use of AI tools for analysis will be a plus.

Please submit your application on or before

Gallagher & Mohan works exclusively within the real estate industry. Our mission is to provide financial analysis, marketing, and accounting support to our clients. **About The Role**
A hands-on role owning the resident revenue cycle from move-in through move-out for an assigned group of US properties. You will set up new leases in Yardi, apply daily cash, keep tenant ledgers accurate, manage delinquency and deposit accounting, and complete the monthly GPR, accrual and AR reconciliation work that supports the financial statements — partnering daily with US site teams and property management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* 1. Move-Ins & New Resident Setup — Audit every new move-in in Yardi against the executed lease. Post prorated rent, deposits, admin, pet, parking and utility charges, and set up concessions and recurring charge schedules correctly the first time.
* 2. Cash Application & Tenant Ledgers — Apply lockbox, ACH, portal, check and money order receipts daily. Clear unapplied and suspense items, and correct misapplied payments, duplicate charges and open credits with documented adjustments.
* 3. Delinquency & Collections — Review aging by property, assess late fees per lease and local ordinance, track payment plans and rental assistance, support notices and legal referrals, and recommend approved write-offs.

title: Impact Manager (Full-time / Remote)
description:
**About Generation:**

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have an 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

**JOB OBJECTIVES:**

The Impact Manager will strengthen Generation’s ability to measure, evaluate, and communicate durable impact across the global network. Reporting to the Lead, Impact Evaluation & Data Advocacy, this role will lead durability measurement and evaluation workstreams, deliver instruction and content for the Durability Academy, and serve as global D&I’s day-to-day counterpart on APAC and SAMEA.

This role combines research rigor, structured problem-solving, and the ability to teach and coach. The Impact Manager will independently own defined evaluation, research, and insight workstreams, manage vendor and research partner relationships, coach Durability Academy partner organizations, and produce high-quality materials for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders.

This is a remote position, based in the SAMEA region (India preferred).

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Durability & Impact Evaluation**

* Lead defined cross-country durability analyses (employment, earnings, job quality, financial health, and related metrics), from framing through final outputs
* Shape evaluation framing, research design, and methodological comparability across countries and program models
* Manage evaluations and research partnerships end to end, including scoping, vendor procurement, contracting support, data-sharing processes, and quality of deliverables
* Own evaluation briefs, synthesis memos, and funder-ready materials
* Ensure durability insights are grounded in consistent and reliable underlying data

**Durability Academy Instruction & Content**

* Co-facilitate cohort-wide Durability Academy sessions, taking ownership of selected modules over time
* Serve as a 1:1 coach for a portfolio of cohort partner organizations, guiding them through their theory of change, durability logframe, and measurement plans
* Maintain and improve Academy content between cohorts, including module materials, milestone documents, logframe templates, and facilitation guides
* Turn cohort work into reusable examples, case material, and practical guidance for future cohorts and the wider Durability Collective

**APAC & India Impact Priorities**

* Act as global D&I's day-to-day counterpart to Generation India and other APAC teams on evaluation, data, and impact priorities
* Coordinate regional evaluations and research partnerships, ensuring alignment with global methodology and standards
* Support regional teams on outcomes data, cost-per-learner and ROI inputs, and funder reporting
* Support onboarding and alignment of regional impact leads with global D&I tools and ways of working
* Surface regional insights and needs to D&I leadership to inform priorities and planning

**Structured Analysis & Insight Communication**

* Translate ambiguous leadership and funder questions into structured analytical approaches, and lead the resulting analyses
* Develop high-quality slide decks, workshop materials, and written summaries for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders
* Shape coherent impact narratives across decks, reports, and external-facing materials
* Contribute evidence, data, and methodology inputs to grant proposals and funder engagement

**Cross-Functional Delivery & Team Support**

* Manage timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across D&I workstreams, proactively flagging risks and reporting progress
* Partner with Impact Operations and Analytics colleagues to improve the clarity and consistency of core metrics (e.g., placement, durability indicators, income, living wage, ROI)
* Provide guidance and quality review for analyst-level work as needed
* Support D&I team operations such as recruitment and onboarding

**ATTRIBUTES (e.g. qualifications, knowledge, skills, and experience):**

***Required experience and skills:***

* 5+ years of experience in impact evaluation, monitoring & evaluation, research, analytics, consulting, policy, or related fields
* Track record of independently owning evaluation, research, or analytical workstreams from framing to delivery
* Experience managing external vendors, research partners, or academic collaborators
* Experience facilitating workshops, training, or coaching for professional audiences
* Strong structured thinking and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights
* Strong written communication and slide development skills, including materials for senior leadership or funders
* Comfort working with data (Excel required; SQL preferred)
* Ability to operate independently with significant ambiguity and manage multiple workstreams

***Preferred experience and skills:***

* Experience in workforce development, economic mobility, education, or related social sector work
* Experience working with teams in India or the wider SAMEA/APAC region
* Hands-on experience with survey design, research design, and impact evaluation methodologies, including quasi-experimental approaches
* Familiarity with adult learning principles or curriculum development
* Experience working with dashboards (e.g., Power BI) and interpreting metrics
* Fluency in additional languages beyond English

***Mindset:***

* Structured thinker who breaks down ambiguous questions into clear components and approaches, and helps others do the same
* Intellectually curious and motivated to understand the “why” behind outcomes, not just produce analysis
* Rigorous and practical, holding a high bar on evidence while keeping measurement useful for partners and programs
* Takes ownership, proactively flagging risks and proposing solutions
* Collaborative and low-ego, able to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders, cultures, and time zones
* Self-reflective and open to giving and receiving frequent feedback

A key part of the role will be understanding our cost of serving customers, building reliable unit economics and helping us make better decisions on pricing, margins and growth. You'll also get hands-on exposure to fundraising, investor relations and strategic corporate transactions as the business evolves.

**2. Unit Economics & Commercial Strategy**

* Build a deep understanding of the economics of our AI voice agents, from telecom and dialer costs to LLM infrastructure and cost-to-serve.

**3. Fundraising, Investor Relations & Capital Strategy**

* Ensure the company's financial and corporate governance stays ahead of its growth, with the right reporting, controls and compliance processes in place.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Strong fundamentals in financial modeling, cash flow management, financial reporting and Excel/Google Sheets.

**Why This Role?**

You'll work directly with the founders, take ownership of a core business function and have a real say in how financial decisions are made. The role offers a mix of hands-on execution and strategic exposure, with room to build the function as Fundamento grows.

Permanent Role Description | India
  
  
**Role purpose:**
Build permanent in-house D365 functional ownership within Finance Systems, reducing dependency on external delivery partners while strengthening platform control, continuous improvement and future deployment capability.
  
  

* Role Overview

**Role Title**
Finance Systems Functional Lead- Finance & Operations
  
  
**Employment Type**
Permanent, full-time employee of FNZ Technology (India) Private Limited
  
  
**Reports To**
Head of Finance Systems
  
  
**Team / Pillar**
FNZ Finance Systems - D365 Finance & Operations
  
  
**Location**
India - Gurugram
  
  
**Working Pattern**
India-based role with regular UK/EU hours overlap for global collaboration
  
  
**Start Date**
At the earliest opportunity, subject to notice period and pre-employment checks
  
  
**Travel**
Occasional domestic or international travel may be required
  
  
**Priority**
High - required to strengthen post-go-live ownership, stabilisation and future D365 delivery
  
  

* Purpose and Context

**FNZ has deployed Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations as a core global finance platform.**
Following global go-live, the priority is to stabilise the platform, embed robust operational ownership, support close and control activities, deliver agreed enhancements, and prepare for future modules and deployments.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on permanent role within the Finance Systems team. The role holder will act as FNZ Finance's internal D365 functional authority, owning functional design and configuration across core finance processes, leading issue resolution and continuous improvement, and ensuring that changes are controlled, documented, supportable and aligned to Finance requirements.
  
  
The position is not a general business analyst role. It requires a practitioner who can work directly in D365, translate finance requirements into sustainable solutions, challenge implementation-partner proposals, and take enduring accountability for platform health and business outcomes.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

D365 Functional Ownership
  
  

* Own the functional integrity of D365 Finance & Operations across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, Expense Management, Project Accounting and Financial Reporting.
* Provide end-to-end functional leadership from requirement and design through configuration, testing, deployment, support and adoption.
* Act as the senior FNZ-side functional reference point for Finance Controllers, process owners, technology teams and delivery partners.
* Maintain solution design, configuration and process documentation so that knowledge remains within FNZ.

Platform Stabilisation and Support
  
  

* Lead functional triage and root-cause analysis for production issues, coordinating resolution through the agreed incident, problem and change processes.
* Support month-end and year-end close, reconciliations and resolution of finance-system issues without compromising financial control or data integrity.
* Own the functional backlog, prioritising defects, control gaps, user pain points and enhancements based on risk, value, urgency and capacity.
* Provide guidance, coaching and knowledge transfer to Finance Systems colleagues and business users.

Change, Release and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Translate finance and regulatory requirements into clear solution options, functional specifications, acceptance criteria and test scenarios.
* Assess proposed changes for cross-module, integration, reporting, data and control impacts before approval.
* Partner with technical teams and vendors on configuration, integrations and extensions, ensuring solutions follow D365 standard capability wherever practical.
* Support release planning, regression testing, deployment readiness, post-release validation and benefits realisation.

Data, Integrations and Reporting
  
  

* Protect the integrity of finance master data, dimensions, opening balances, sub-ledger data and intercompany processing.
* Support D365 integrations including banking, payments, expense, tax, consolidation and downstream reporting platforms.
* Partner with Data and Reporting teams on D365 financial reporting, Power BI and Workiva outputs, ensuring consistent definitions and reconciliation to the ledger.

Controls, Audit and Governance
  
  

* Embed segregation of duties, access controls, change evidence, configuration governance and audit-ready documentation into day-to-day platform ownership.
* Support ITGC and financial-controls evidence, remediation activity and audit requests relating to D365.
* Operate within the Finance Systems governance framework, including demand intake, design authority, environment management, release control and capacity planning.

Future Roadmap and Team Leadership
  
  

* Provide functional leadership for future D365 capabilities such as Consolidation, advanced Treasury and Cash Management, Project Accounting and other agreed modules.
* Support future entity onboarding, acquisitions and migrations from legacy finance platforms into D365.
* Help shape the D365 roadmap and operating model, reducing avoidable external dependency and building a sustainable internal capability.
* Lead the D365 pillar through influence and subject-matter authority; line-management responsibilities may be added as the team develops.
* Required Skills and Experience

**Essential**

* 10+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Dynamics AX functional experience, including significant responsibility for finance modules.
* Demonstrable experience delivering and supporting complex, multi-entity and multi-currency D365 implementations.
* Deep understanding of Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes, with strong knowledge of financial controls and close activities.
* Hands-on functional configuration capability across core D365 finance modules, including dimensions, posting profiles, workflows, intercompany and financial reporting.
* Experience of data migration and validation covering master data, general-ledger balances and sub-ledger open items.
* Experience of integrations, testing, cutover, hypercare, release management and production support.
* Ability to diagnose complex functional issues, evaluate trade-offs and drive decisions through to resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the credibility to work with senior Finance stakeholders, regional teams, auditors and external partners.
* Ability to work independently in a global environment while maintaining disciplined documentation, governance and knowledge sharing.

**Preferred**

* Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant, MBA Finance or equivalent finance qualification.
* Experience in financial services, fintech, asset servicing or another regulated, multi-jurisdiction environment.
* Knowledge of IFRS, statutory reporting and audit / ITGC control requirements.
* Experience with D365 Consolidation, Project Accounting, Treasury and Cash Management, Subscription Billing or Revenue Recognition.
* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Workiva, Azure DevOps and finance-data integrations.
* Previous experience as a solution architect, functional lead, platform owner or capability lead.
* Success Measures
* Stable and controlled D365 operations through month-end, year-end and business-critical processing.
* Clear ownership and timely resolution of functional incidents, problems and enhancement requests.
* High-quality functional designs, test evidence, release documentation and audit artefacts.
* Reduced reliance on external partners for routine functional decisions and platform knowledge.
* A prioritised improvement roadmap aligned to Finance outcomes, risk and available capacity.
* Effective partnership with Finance stakeholders and measurable improvement in user confidence and platform adoption.
* Employment Terms and Ways of Working
* Permanent, full-time appointment into FNZ Technology (India) Private Limited [legal employing entity to be confirmed by HR].
* Direct reporting line to the Head of Finance Systems and full integration into the global Finance Systems team.
* Standard FNZ India employment terms, benefits, leave, probation and notice provisions apply, subject to HR confirmation.
* Appointment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, right-to-work verification and any role-specific screening.
* UK/EU hours overlap is expected for regular collaboration, with flexibility around critical close, release and incident periods.
* All work must comply with FNZ information-security, data-protection, acceptable-use, change-control and records-management requirements.

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.
  
  
Cinch is Southeast Asia’s leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle. We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends — sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access — creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption. At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we’re creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers — and where the work has real, lasting impact.
  
  
**The Role**
As our FP&A Analyst you will own Cinch’s budget and forecast. You will build the plan by market, track performance against it every month, and work with stakeholders across the region to keep us on plan. A subscription device business has a lot moving at once: device cost, financing, collections, churn and residual value. Your job is to know which levers matter, show where we are ahead or behind, and drive the actions that close the gap.
  
  
You will work directly with the Corporate Finance Director, the founders, and country and functional leads across our markets. Investors and lenders will see your work.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Budget ownership. Build and own the annual budget by market and function. Hold budget holders to it, challenge spend against it, and lead re-forecasts when the plan changes.
* Forecasting and planning. Run a rolling, driver-based forecast by market across revenue, margin, opex and cash. Keep it accurate enough that leadership uses it to make decisions.
* Variance tracking. Track actuals against budget and forecast every month, by market. Explain the drivers in plain English and recommend the actions needed to get back on plan.
* Key levers. Identify and track the operating levers that drive results in each market, such as new subscriptions, yield, churn, collections, device cost and residual value. Build a KPI view that shows leaders early when a lever is off track.
* Regional business partnering. Work with country leads, Growth, Operations and Asset Operations across markets to agree targets, own the numbers together and drive outcomes against the budget.
* Monthly reporting. Produce the monthly management pack with variance analysis against budget and prior periods, and explain the drivers in plain English.
* Unit economics. Track and model contribution margin per device, per subscriber and per channel, including cost of funds, acquisition cost, collections losses and residual value.
* Cash and funding. Maintain the cash flow forecast and support the borrowing base and covenant reporting that lenders require.
* Investor and board reporting. Prepare the financial sections of investor updates and board packs, with the Controller.
* Scenario and business-case modelling. Model new markets, products and partnership deals so decisions are made with numbers on the table.
* Data quality. Work with the Data team and RevOps to make sure the numbers you report tie back to source systems.

**What You Bring**
**Must-have**

* 2 to 4 years in FP&A, finance business partnering, or investment banking / consulting with a finance focus.
* Hands-on experience running a budget and forecast cycle, including variance analysis and re-forecasting.
* Strong stakeholder management. You can hold budget holders to account, push back with data and build trust with teams in different countries.
* Strong financial modelling skills in Excel or Google Sheets: three-statement thinking, driver-based forecasts and sensitivity analysis.
* Solid grasp of accounting fundamentals and how they flow into a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow.
* Clear communicator, able to turn a model into a one-page answer for a non-finance audience.
* Degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience in subscription, leasing, lending, fintech or hardware businesses.
* SQL or BI tool experience (for example Looker, Metabase or Power BI).
* Exposure to lender or investor reporting, covenant tracking or borrowing base models.
* Experience in a startup or scale-up where the finance function was being built.
* Experience in a multi-country or regional finance role, ideally across Southeast Asia.
* CFA, ACCA, CPA or progress towards one.

title: Pricing Analyst
description:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.
  
  
Cinch is Southeast Asia’s leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle. We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends — sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access — creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption. At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we’re creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers — and where the work has real, lasting impact.
  
  
**The Role**
Pricing decides whether a subscription device makes money. As our Pricing Analyst you will be the protector of yield and margin: you will measure what our fleet actually earns by market, segment and product type, price new launches, drive our residual value analysis, and make sure every special deal and promotion still makes money.
  
  
You will work closely with Commercial, Growth, Marketing and Asset Operations, and with the Corporate Finance Director, who owns pricing strategy.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Yield analysis. Track gross yield across the portfolio by market, product type, tenure and customer segment, comparing old versus new pricing and first versus subsequent lease cycles. Explain what moved yield and recommend what to do about it.
* New launch pricing. Price new devices and product launches by market, reset the price ladder for prior generations, and track post-launch performance against the original pricing case.
* Residual value analysis. Drive residual value analysis by market, device and age. Compare realised resale and re-let values against our assumptions and feed the results back into pricing.
* Residual value counterparties. Work with Asset Operations on discussions with buy-back, trade-in and resale counterparties, bringing the residual value benchmarks and economics behind each negotiation.
* Special deal and promotion pricing. Partner with Growth and Marketing on campaigns, partner offers and special deals. Find the structure that hits the commercial goal while protecting margin, and set clear guardrails on what can be discounted and by how much.
* Pricing models. Build and maintain the models that set subscription rates by device, tenure, market and channel. Inputs include device cost, financing cost, expected residual value, refurbishment, logistics, credit loss and servicing cost.
* Deal pricing support. Turn around pricing and margin analysis for B2B, partner and enterprise deals quickly, with a clear recommendation and the trade-offs.
* Margin tracking. Monitor realised yield and margin against plan by product, channel and cohort. Flag leakage from discounts, promos, early returns and write-offs.
* Market and competitor benchmarking. Track competitor and market pricing in each country we operate in, including local currency and tax effects.
* Experiments. Design and read price tests and promotion results, and recommend what to keep.
* Pricing governance. Keep one price book, a clear discount approval matrix and a log of every price change and why it was made.

**What You Bring**
**Must-have**

* 2 to 4 years in pricing, FP&A, commercial finance, strategy or consulting, with real financial modelling experience.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and working SQL or willingness to learn it quickly.
* Comfortable with margin maths: contribution margin, cost of funds, breakeven and sensitivity analysis.
* Curious and analytical. You enjoy digging into data to find out why a number moved, and you keep going until you have the answer.
* Commercial instinct with discipline. You can work with Growth and Marketing to get a deal done, and say no, with numbers, when it gives away margin.
* Degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering or a related field.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience in subscription, leasing, rental, lending, BNPL or consumer electronics.
* Exposure to residual value, used-device or secondary-market pricing.
* Experience with price testing, elasticity analysis or demand modelling.
* Familiarity with BI tools and basic Python or R.
* Exposure to more than one Southeast Asian market, or to the Middle East.

title: Associate (Procurement) - Performance Improvement CoE
description:
**About Us**

Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Performance Improvement Centre of Expertise (PI CoE). The PI CoE plays a crucial role in assisting case teams in India and abroad with various cost reduction/optimization activities by offering a range of solutions, including Procurement (e.g., Spend cube, analytics, maturity assessment, vendor strategy), Zero-based budgeting (e.g., Cost visibility, Budgeting, Initiative tracking, client training), Supply Chain (e.g., Inventory Diagnostics, Inventory Optimization, Network Optimization, Manufacturing Diagnostics, Integrated Business Planning), as well as cost diagnostics (e.g., Value Calculator, Net Working Capital), savings, and PMI Analysis. Investment Analysis & Commercial Evaluation

Full-time Graduate from a recognized institution. MBA / PGDM in Business Administration, Finance, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related discipline preferred.

*rocksport is a dynamic and fast-growing EdTech startup on a mission to revolutionize sports education through technology-driven learning experiences. We empower schools, coaches, and students with scalable, engaging, and data-informed tools that foster physical literacy, skill development, and lifelong wellness habits.*
*Founded with a vision to bridge the gap between traditional sports training and modern digital learning, rocksport operates across multiple cities and partners with leading educational institutions, sports federations, and government bodies. Our culture thrives on innovation, accountability, collaboration, and impact — and we’re looking for passionate professionals who want to grow with us as we scale nationally and beyond.*
**About The Opportunity**

* This role is responsible for end-to-end management of accounts payable operations, ensuring accurate vendor invoice processing, timely payments, statutory compliance, and month-end closing in a multi-location or multi-branch organization.
* The position requires strong expertise in GST, TDS, vendor reconciliations, and ERP systems (Tally ERP/Tally Prime), with a focus on internal controls, audit support, and process improvement.

****Role & Responsibilities****

* Manage end-to-end accounts payable operations including receipt, verification, booking, and processing of vendor invoices.
* Verify invoices against purchase orders, work orders, goods receipt notes (GRNs), and supporting documents.
* Ensure correct accounting entries, expense classification, cost centre allocation, and GST treatment.
* Identify duplicate invoices, incorrect billing, missing documents, and discrepancies before processing payments.
* Maintain accurate vendor ledgers and ensure timely accounting of expenses and liabilities.
* Prepare vendor payment proposals based on agreed credit terms, due dates, and available cash flow.
* Ensure timely processing of vendor payments after obtaining required approvals.
* Perform regular vendor ledger reconciliations and resolve outstanding differences.
* Track advances, security deposits, debit notes, credit notes, and outstanding vendor balances.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to resolve payment-related queries.
* Ensure correct GST input tax credit (ITC) eligibility and reconciliation of purchase invoices with GSTR-2B.
* Follow up with vendors for missing invoices, incorrect GSTINs, tax discrepancies, and other GST-related issues.
* Ensure correct deduction of TDS under applicable sections of the Income Tax Act and timely deposit of TDS.
* Assist in preparation and reconciliation of TDS returns, including quarterly returns and Form 26AS/AIS-related vendor queries.
* Maintain proper documentation for GST, TDS, statutory audits, and tax assessments.
* Ensure timely closure of accounts payable at month-end.
* Review outstanding expenses, unbilled liabilities, vendor advances, and other payable balances.
* Prepare ageing reports, overdue payment reports, vendor outstanding statements, and payment forecasts.
* Reconcile accounts payable balances with the general ledger and assist in balance sheet reviews.
* Support monthly financial reporting and audit schedules.
* Coordinate with procurement, operations, HR, warehouse, and other departments for invoice approvals and supporting documents.
* Ensure compliance with the company's financial policies, approval matrix, and internal controls.
* Identify opportunities to improve invoice processing, payment tracking, and reconciliation processes.
* Guide and review the work of the accounts payable team, wherever applicable.
* Support internal, statutory, GST, and tax audits by providing the required records and explanations.

**Skills & Qualifications**
****Must-Have****

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification.
* 4–7 years of relevant experience in accounts payable, vendor accounting, team handling, and statutory compliance.
* Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, vendor reconciliations, and month-end closing.
* Hands-on experience with Tally ERP/Tally Prime and advanced Excel.
* Strong accounting and reconciliation skills.
* Good understanding of GST and TDS provisions.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors and payment deadlines.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage a team and work independently.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a multi-location or multi-branch organisation.
* Knowledge of ERP systems and invoice processing workflows.

****Benefits & Perks****
[Add information regarding benefits and perks here]

title: Project Lead (Consultant) – RMEAL
description:
**About The Job Project Lead (Consultant) - RMEAL**
**Project Lead (Consultant Position) – Research, Monitoring, Evaluation, Assessments & Learning (RMEAL)**
**Location**
Delhi
  
  
**About Central Square Foundation**
Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working to ensure quality school education for all children in India. We believe strong foundational learning outcomes are critical for lifelong learning and equity. CSF focuses on four core areas: Foundational Literacy & Numeracy (FLN), EdTech, Early Childhood Education (ECE), and School Governance.
  
  
**About RMEAL At CSF**
The Research, Monitoring, Evaluation, Assessment & Learning (RMEAL) function at CSF serves as the organization's central evidence and learning spine. RMEAL partners closely with program verticals—including EdTech—to design, execute, quality-assure, and translate rigorous evidence into actionable insights for decision-making at scale.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As Project Lead (Consultant) – RMEAL, you will drive the design, quality assurance, and learning agenda for evidence generation across CSF's EdTech and AI-enabled initiatives. You will work in close partnership with the EdTech vertical to ensure evaluations are methodologically robust, decision-relevant, and embedded into program and ecosystem strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Evidence Design & Methodological Execution:
  
  

* Design and review rigorous evaluation approaches (RCTs, quasi-experimental, mixed-methods).
* Review SAPs, tools, and analytical outputs.

**Evaluation Quality Assurance & Process Stewardship**

* Guide end-to-end evaluation processes.
* Use structured QA tools and templates.

**Learning, Insights & Translation**

* Translate findings into actionable insights and learning products.

**Stakeholder & Partner Engagement**

* Support funder, government, and partner engagements.

**Team Support & Capability Building**

* Mentor junior team members and support onboarding.

**Planning, Delivery & Portfolio Management**

* Manage timelines, budgets, and reporting.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Master's degree in Economics, Public Policy, Education, Statistics, or related field.
* 7–10 years of experience in research, evaluation, or evidence-informed program design.
* Experience with quantitative and mixed-methods evaluations.
* Ability to translate research into decision-oriented insights.

**Technical Skills Required**

* Strong command of statistical analysis using tools such as Stata, R, or Python.
* Ability to develop and review study plans and Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs) for experimental and quasi-experimental study designs.
* Ability to work with complex survey data, sampling designs, and weighting.
* Experience working with dashboards or data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Data Studio) is desirable.
* Familiarity with qualitative analysis tools and mixed-methods research workflows is an added bonus.
* Strong documentation skills (methods notes, technical briefs, learning memos).

**Desired Qualities**

* Commitment to rigorous, ethical evidence.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills.
* Comfort working across ambiguity and multiple workstreams.
* High learning agility.

**Compensation**
Compensation will be competitive with Indian philanthropy and social-impact sector benchmarks.

title: Treasury Dealer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Treasury Dealer (Front Office) to manage the Bank’s foreign exchange, money market, and government securities transactions within approved limits. The role will handle customer-related spot FX dealing, liquidity management, G-Sec/T-Bill transactions, ALM support, counterparty management, reporting, and treasury controls.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Execute interbank spot FX transactions arising from customer deals and cover positions within approved limits.
* Set daily card rates using FBIL rates and approved margins and price large transactions at live market rates.
* Record customer, base, and cover rates accurately on deal tickets.
* Execute call, notice, term money, interbank deposits, and TREPS transactions within approved limits.
* Purchase G-Secs and T-Bills for the HTM portfolio, including SLR holdings, through NDS-OM and RBI auctions.
* Project daily funds position and ensure CRR and SLR requirements are maintained.
* Prepare liquidity positions, cash-flow projections, and inputs for ALM statements.
* Prepare ALCO papers covering liquidity gaps, rate sensitivity, limits, and market outlook.
* Manage and develop approved banking counterparties, including onboarding, annual reviews, and SSIs.
* Prepare daily treasury position, profit reports, and market commentary.
* Submit required Head Office and regulatory reports accurately and within deadlines.
* Support drafting and revision of treasury policies and procedures in line with RBI and Head Office requirements.
* Ensure all transactions are conducted only through approved lines and platforms; report breaches and errors immediately.
* Prepare Legal Compliance Certificates where required and maintain strict separation between front-office dealing and settlement activities.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* Master's/MBA in Finance, FRM/CFA, and Refinitiv/Bloomberg experience preferred.
* 3+ years of experience in a Bank Treasury Front Office in India.
* Hands-on experience in Interbank Spot FX and G-Sec/T-Bill (HTM) dealing.
* Strong knowledge of FEMA, FEDAI rules, RBI inter-bank dealing directions, CRR, SLR, and RBI ALM requirements.
* Working knowledge of CCIL platforms, including FX-CLEAR, NDS-OM, NDS-Call, and TREPS.
* Ability to work accurately under pressure with strong written and spoken English.
* Experience with foreign bank branches, ALM/ALCO, or treasury policy drafting preferred.
