title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Job Opportunity: Senior Financial Analyst**
**Company Overview**
**Gallagher & Mohan**
is a distinguished firm specializing in delivering world-class financial analysis, marketing expertise, and accounting support tailored to the real estate sector. We serve an exclusive clientele of private equity investors, developers, fund managers, brokers, and other industry leaders. Renowned for our commitment to excellence, clear communication, and strong work ethic, we seamlessly integrate with our clients’ teams to create long-term value. Our portfolio spans diverse real estate transactions—from multifamily apartment communities to large-scale office towers across the United States and European markets, with deal sizes typically ranging from $25 million to over $500 million USD.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Financial Analyst at Gallagher & Mohan, you will play a pivotal role in driving insightful financial analysis and modeling. Utilizing your expertise in Microsoft Excel and adept modeling capabilities, you will craft comprehensive models from scratch and enhance existing client frameworks. Your responsibilities will extend to meticulous tracking and analysis of commercial real estate markets, preparing detailed reports on market trends and economic indicators, and serving as a trusted advisor with a profound understanding of macro and micro factors influencing the industry.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Argus Enterprise Mastery: Utilize Argus Enterprise extensively to develop, maintain, and enhance comprehensive financial models for real estate assets. Ensure accuracy and efficiency in cash-flow projections and asset valuations.
* DCF Modeling: Construct and refine Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) models to evaluate investment opportunities, asset performance, and future cash flows. Provide in-depth analysis and interpretation of model outputs.
* Model Optimization: Optimize and update Argus models to reflect changing market conditions, investment strategies, and financial structures. Ensure models are aligned with current financial practices and industry standards.
* Market Analysis: Conduct detailed market research and analysis to support Argus , Multi family assets and DCF modeling, including assessing property comparables and evaluating market trends.
* Reporting & Insights: Prepare and present detailed financial reports and insights based on Argus and DCF analyses. Communicate findings and strategic recommendations to senior management and clients.
* Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams during acquisitions, dispositions, and development projects, providing specialized Argus and DCF analysis to support strategic decision-making.
* Performance Evaluation: Assess and report on the performance of investments using key performance indicators (KPIs) such as IRR and Cash-on-Cash returns, integrating these metrics into Argus and DCF models.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Requirements – Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:**

* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
* Argus Expertise: Extensive experience with Argus Enterprise software, including developing and managing detailed financial models for real estate assets.
* DCF Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) modeling, with the ability to create and analyze complex financial models and scenarios.
* Experience: 4-7 years of experience in financial modeling with a focus on Argus and DCF methodologies and Multi family assets . Background in equity research, investment banking, or real estate finance is advantageous.
* Analytical Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on deriving actionable insights from Argus and DCF analyses.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial concepts and findings effectively to diverse stakeholders.
* Organization: Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Team Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and contribute to a collaborative team environment.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Software Proficiency: Advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel, for financial modeling and analysis.
* Advanced Degree: Master’s degree in finance, Business, Real Estate, or Economics is preferred.
* Certifications: Candidates who have completed or are working towards CFA, CA, or FRM certifications will be considered favorably.
* Additional Software Knowledge: Familiarity with other real estate software/programs, such as Yardi Voyager and Google Earth, will be a plus.

**Job Details**

* Title: Senior Financial Analyst
* Department: Financial Analysis
* Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
* Location: Remote
* Shift Timings: EST/PST (US Time Zone)

**Note: Immediate availability is required (within a week).**
Join Gallagher & Mohan, where your leadership abilities and financial expertise will play a crucial role in shaping the success of our team and driving impactful insights in the real estate industry. Apply now to embark on a rewarding career journey with a leading industry player.

title: Principal Analyst (Physical AI Semiconductors, IOT, Market Intelligence, Forecast/ Market Sizing models)
description:
**About this Role :**
Analysts create must-have insights for our clients through published research and client interaction. You will meet with clients every day: on the phone, in a videoconference, from the stage at a Gartner event, or face-to-face during a sales support visit. In every interaction, you will help clients overcome their challenges and perform better.
  
  
As part of Gartner’s Emerging Market Dynamics Group, you will equip leaders across the semiconductor and Physical AI ecosystems with indispensable insights, advice, and tools to achieve their mission-critical priorities and build the successful organizations of tomorrow. You will own the authoritative quantitative view of the MCUs, sensors and edge AI SoCs enabling Physical AI and convert system adoption, semiconductor content and architecture shifts into decision-useful forecasts, market shares and competitive intelligence.
  
  
**What You’ll do:**

* Develop and maintain global forecasts for MCUs, AI-enabled MCUs, edge AI SoCs, embedded AI accelerators and selected sensor semiconductor markets, including units, revenue, ASPs and vendor market share.
* Quantify semiconductor demand across industrial automation, robotics, automotive, drones, machine vision, smart cameras, intelligent edge systems and other major Physical AI applications.
* Build bottom-up semiconductor-content models linking Physical AI system shipments to MCU, edge processor, sensor, memory, connectivity and power-semiconductor content.
* Develop adoption and penetration models distinguishing total device shipments, AI-capable devices, devices actively running AI workloads and Physical AI deployments.
* Track MCU and embedded processor transitions including 32-bit MCUs, MCU + NPU architectures, real-time processors and heterogeneous CPU/GPU/NPU SoCs.
* Track perception and sensing semiconductor markets including CMOS image sensors, MEMS/IMUs, time-of-flight/depth sensing, radar semiconductor content, intelligent sensors and sensor-fusion processors.
* Analyze architecture transitions, design wins, ASP/content growth, competitive positioning and vendor market-share shifts driven by edge AI and Physical AI adoption.
* Maintain quarterly market trackers, forecast models, source databases, vendor-share analysis and scenario models.
* Provide evidence-based written responses and support VP/market-intelligence-level client conversations.
* Partner with analysts covering robotics, automotive, AI accelerators, foundry, advanced packaging, memory, networking and power semiconductors to quantify cross-market dependencies.
* Identify early indicators that could invalidate the current forecast and proactively revise assumptions and outlooks.
* Actively participate in appropriate Gartner global research communities for formal and in-formal knowledge sharing sessions.

**Core Quantitative Coverage :**
You are capable of modeling and forecasting:
  
  

* MCUs / Edge AI SoCs: units, revenue, ASPs, vendor market share, architecture mix, end-market mix, AI-enabled penetration, TOPS/device, power envelope and adoption of MCU + NPU and heterogeneous CPU/GPU/NPU architectures.
* Sensors / Physical AI Content: units, revenue, ASPs, vendor share and application penetration for relevant perception sensors, plus semiconductor content per robot, drone, autonomous machine, smart camera and other Physical AI system.
* Research Boundaries: This role owns the quantitative semiconductor-market truth layer for Physical AI, focused on MCUs, sensors and edge AI processors. It does not own robotics or automotive system strategy, AI software/platform strategy, data-center accelerators, foundry, advanced packaging, memory, networking systems or power-semiconductor markets. However, the analyst must quantify how developments in these adjacent markets affect Physical AI semiconductor demand, content and competitive dynamics.

**Job Requirements :**
**What You Will Need**

* Educational Qualification:
* BE/BTech from Grade A engineering colleges with specialization in Electronics, or Semiconductors, or software engineering.
* Graduate + MBA (Marketing or Ops) from leading A & B-schools is desirable.
* Work experience:
* 5-7+ years minimum experience in semiconductor market intelligence, MCU/embedded processors, sensors, edge AI, product planning, business planning, forecasting or industry research.
* Domain knowledge/Business Acumen:
* Strong expertise in one or more of MCUs, embedded processors, sensors or edge AI SoCs, with the ability to develop credible quantitative coverage across the broader Physical AI semiconductor stack.
* Strong understanding of embedded and edge AI architectures, end-market demand, semiconductor content, technology transitions and competitive dynamics.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain quantitative market models, market-share analysis and forecasts.
* Experience with semiconductor vendors, market-research firms, industrial/robotics ecosystems, automotive suppliers or relevant electronics supply-chain organizations preferred.
* Awareness of the major issues across the IT, technology, semiconductor and electronics industry affecting embedded AI and Physical AI markets, and an eagerness to learn more.
* MS Office Tools:
* Ability to design, develop and maintain large Excel models for market share analysis and forecasting, and strong working knowledge of other MS Office tools such as Word and Power Point for writing and presenting analysis.
* Project management skills:
* Ability to manage time, keep projects on schedule and resolve issues and deliver all client deliverables in a timely manner.
* Communication skills:
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex market data into clear implications.
* Written: A strong writing ability is mandatory. Writing efforts will require stating/staking positions, justifying those positions with facts and providing actionable analysis and recommendations.
* Oral: Skills to converse on telephone, face to face, and on-stage, with the ability to explain complex concepts concisely.
* Problem Solving:
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to think creatively, independently, and efficiently to diagnose and contextualize issues, exhibit critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities, including working on estimation problems and provide insightful and original analysis.
* Interpersonal skills:
* Ability to communicate, engage, and develop cordial professional relationships with analysts, key initiative leaders, team managers, and clients with a compelling and enthusiastic attitude that drives clients to action and guides them to success.
* Strong client presence and ability to relate to a variety of company and personality types is a must - ability to represent Gartner research, methodology and strategies at multiple levels (Board, C-Level, Business Unit and Operational) and multiple client organization types (End User Client, Investors, Technology and Service Providers, Resellers, Channel Partners).
* Ability to organize effectively, drive for results, collaborate productively, coach and develop colleagues where required – provide constructive feedback to peers as well as be receptive to feedback from peers.
* Complete ownership mindset, professional maturity and intellectual curiosity, ability to embrace change and act with integrity, and follow internal processes and policies, including, HR, IT and Finance.

**Who You Are**
To thrive in this role, it helps if you are obsessed with your topic! Gartner analysts are correctly viewed as
**THE**
experts. This means that:
  
  

* You know your technologies, markets, vendors, trends, management practices, etc., well and be able to see the forest and the trees.
* You are an excellent collaborator with the ability to quickly build rapport and gain client trust.
* You are a confident presenter with a high level of executive presence (prior experience with speaking engagements is a plus).
* You are an analytical thinker with the ability to process information quickly and make actionable recommendations.
* You are willing to challenge conventional norms and views.

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

title: Senior Finance Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse large volumes of financial and operational data to provide actionable insights.
* Translate non-financial data and key performance indicators (KPIs) into financial metrics and assess their impact on financial models.
* Produce high-quality financial reports tailored to internal stakeholders, with a particular focus on departmental performance.
* Conduct cost analysis and optimization, identifying opportunities to enhance profitability and efficiency.
* Support forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and financial planning processes.
* Track key financial and operational KPIs, monitoring cost trends and assessing their financial impact.
* Partner with various business units to provide financial insights and recommendations that drive strategic decision-making.
* Collaborate closely with the Group Services CFO, assisting in financial reporting and analysis for global executive leadership.
* Work in a fast-paced, agile environment, adapting to evolving business needs and priorities.

**Key Requirements**
Experience: 4-8 years of relevant experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Finance Analytics, Management Reporting, or a similar finance analyst role with strong exposure to data-driven decision-making
  
  

* Proven experience as a Finance Analyst/Senior Finance Analyst, or in a similar role with a strong focus on data analysis and reporting.
* Expertise in handling and analysing large financial datasets, drawing meaningful insights.
* Strong ability to convert non-financial data and KPIs into financial metrics and assess their business impact.
* Experience producing departmental financial reports for internal stakeholders, ensuring accuracy and clarity.
* Advanced proficiency in financial modelling, forecasting, and planning.
* Solid understanding of cost analysis, cost optimization, and profitability improvement.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to partner effectively with operational teams and senior stakeholders.
* Proficiency in financial software, Excel (advanced), and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present financial data clearly to both financial and non-financial audiences.

If you are an experienced financial analyst with a passion for data-driven decision-making, cost optimization, and financial reporting, we would love to hear from you!
  
  
**About FNZ**
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: BCG X Finance Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
We are seeking a strong candidate with experience and passion to join a Finance Analyst position in BCG X to support our fast-growing global business model.
  
  
In this role you work as part of the BCG X Finance team supporting the leadership of Project Helix – a key initiative integrating AI into BCG offerings, automating case-team tasks and enabling smarter, scalable client solutions. You will have an opportunity to shape our processes, procedures, and system tools as we continue to grow. You will operate in a detail-oriented, tactical way while understanding how your work supports broader Finance priorities, gathering financial data with accuracy and meeting critical deadlines, including regular financial reporting deliverables.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities For This Role Include**

* Working as a team member in our BCG X Finance team in India, serving as a day-to-day finance contact Project Helix stakeholders, providing analysis and information to support stakeholder decision making.
* Financial analysis and performance reporting of Project Helix, having an up-to-date view on all financial details related to Helix asset portfolio (e.g. investments, value creation, operating expenses)
* Other finance ops activities related to managing project Helix in close collaboration with other cross-functional teams (e.g. project code openings, time sheet reconciliation)
* Contribution to the annual financial planning process as part of the BCG X Finance team

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or Math
* 2-4 years of relevant work experience in a fast-paced business
* Proficiency in using core financial tools (e.g. advanced Excel, SAP Business Objects, Alteryx, Tableau) and PowerPoint
* Experience in professional services environment is a plus

Additional info
  
  
BCG X is the tech build & design unit of BCG. Turbocharging BCG’s deep industry and functional expertise, BCG X brings together advanced tech knowledge and ambitious entrepreneurship to help organizations enable innovation at scale. With nearly 3,000 technologists, scientists, programmers, engineers, and human-centered designers located across 80+ cities, BCG X builds and designs platforms and software to address the world’s most important challenges and opportunities. Teaming across our practices, and in close collaboration with our clients, our end-to-end global team unlocks new possibilities. Together we’re creating the bold and disruptive products, services, and businesses of tomorrow.
  
  
At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:

**What You’ll Do**

* Financial Reporting & Variance Analysis: Ensure accurate and timely reporting of monthly and quarterly financial performance, key business metrics, and variance analysis to support executive decision-making.
* Process Improvement & Operations: Identify opportunities to automate data extraction, streamline internal financial workflows, and implement robust data operation processes to increase team efficiency.
* Data & Statistical Modeling: Collate and interpret complex financial and operational data, leveraging statistical modeling techniques to solve business challenges and identify underlying trends.
* Problem Solving & Root Cause Diagnostics: Independently detect discrepancies or logic gaps in methods and analytical frameworks, proposing and implementing scalable solutions.
* Reporting Infrastructure & Automation: Design, build, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and financial reports to streamline monthly reporting cycles and reduce manual workloads.
* Business Partnership & Communication: Partner cross-functionally with leaders across Finance, Service Delivery, HR, and Recruiting to support workforce planning, expense management, and strategic initiatives. Translate complex data into clear, actionable business insights using effective visual storytelling (charts, tables, presentations).

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related field with 4–5 years of relevant industry experience (or a master’s degree with 3+ years of experience).

* Data Synthesis: Proven ability to extrapolate large volumes of data, distilling complex metrics into executive-level insights.

title: Financial Control Accountant
description:
**Job Description**
We’re looking for a Financial Control Accountant, FP&A Lead to join our FP&A team within the
**North America**
business. The primary purpose of this role is to lead forecasting, budgeting and variance analysis activity, with ownership of the annual budget, quarterly forecasts, forecast models, management reporting and the communication of financial conclusions to senior stakeholders.
  
  
You’ll report into the FP&A Manager and work closely with the
**Head of Finance - North America Markets**
and senior stakeholders across the business. Responsible for coordinating planning inputs, setting timetables, reviewing outputs, challenging assumptions and providing clear conclusions on performance, risks and opportunities. The role also supports relevant month-end activity and works closely with Finance Control, while retaining FP&A leadership as its principal focus.
  
  
**The responsibilities will include:**

* Lead the annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting processes, setting timetables, coordinating inputs across the business and taking ownership of delivery to agreed deadlines.
* Own and maintain Excel forecast models, ensuring assumptions, methodologies and data inputs from multiple sources are robust, consistent and appropriately documented.
* Review budget and forecast submissions, challenge assumptions and outputs, and resolve gaps or inconsistencies with relevant stakeholders.
* Analyse monthly ledger data and performance against budget and forecast to identify underlying drivers, trends, variances, risks and opportunities.
* Produce clear, accurate and timely management reporting, translating financial analysis into conclusions and recommended actions for senior stakeholders.
* Coordinate North America regional inputs for ExCo and stakeholder presentations, ensuring outputs are complete, consistent and supported by appropriate analysis.
* Act as the primary FP&A point of contact for budget, forecast and performance queries from the wider business.
* Partner with senior stakeholders across the Markets business, providing constructive challenge and communicating the financial implications of business decisions.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports and analysis to support decision-making and respond to emerging business priorities.
* Support relevant month-end tasks, investigate variances and work with the Finance Control Team to ensure actuals are understood and reflected appropriately in planning and reporting.

**What are we ideally looking for in a successful candidate:**

* CA/CFA qualified or equivalent (preferred), with established experience in financial planning and analysis, management reporting or a closely related finance discipline.
* Demonstrated experience leading annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting cycles, including setting timetables, coordinating contributors, reviewing submissions and delivering consolidated outputs.
* Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, SUMIFS, charts and pivot tables, with proven experience building, maintaining and reviewing forecast models.
* Strong analytical capability, with a track record of interpreting ledger and operational data, explaining variances and identifying material risks and opportunities.
* Experience producing management reporting and presenting clear financial conclusions, implications and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively and build effective relationships across all levels.
* Experience working in a fast-paced, growth-orientated environment and managing competing priorities to agreed deadlines.
* Commercial mindset, sound judgement and a proactive approach to resolving issues and improving planning and reporting processes.
* Background in public practice or corporate.
* Ability to work effectively with stakeholders across multiple regions, including North America and global teams.
* Ability to operate autonomously, coordinate cross-functional inputs and make logical, evidence-based decisions.

**What is in it for you?**

description:

**Responsibilities**
**Job Description:**

* Analyze and interpret entity, portfolio, and property-level financial data, including historical performance and forecasts, to support valuation and advisory engagements.
* Develop and review Argus Enterprise models and Excel-based valuation models for commercial real estate assets including office, industrial, retail, multifamily, hospitality, self-storage, medical office, senior housing, and data center properties.
* Conduct economic, market, industry, and property-level research to assess factors impacting real estate values and investment decisions. Utilize market research databases including CoStar, Green Street, RCA Analytics, REIS, and other industry resources to support valuation conclusions and market analyses.
* Develop, customize, and maintain valuation models using methodologies such as discounted cash flow, direct capitalization, sales comparison, and cost approaches.
* Perform purchase price allocation analyses under ASC 805 including valuation of tangibles and intangible components. Perform fair value analyses under ASC 820, including assessment of market participant assumptions, highest and best use considerations, and application of income, market, and cost approaches.
* Prepare and review valuation analyses, supporting workpapers, and client deliverables to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with professional standards.
* Perform detailed reviews of third-party appraisals and valuation reports, evaluating assumptions, methodologies, discount rates, capitalization rates, terminal capitalization rates, market data, and compliance with applicable valuation standards and accounting guidance. Provide technical observations, recommendations, and audit support documentation to engagement teams.
* Review work performed by Associates, provide technical guidance and coaching, assist with onboarding and training initiatives, support quality control processes, and contribute to the professional development of junior team members.
* Stay current on valuation methodologies, accounting guidance, and real estate market trends through continuing education, professional development, and independent research.
* Prepare and review audit review memoranda, valuation reports, technical summaries, and client deliverables ensuring consistency between valuation models, supporting documentation, and final conclusions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in real estate valuation, appraisal, audit support reviews, financial reporting valuations, transaction advisory services, real estate consulting, or related valuation disciplines.
* Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, organizational, interpersonal, project management, and communication skills required
* Ability to provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of duties
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills are required, along with preferred strong writing abilities and availability to travel for client-related work.
* Experience performing real estate valuations, appraisal reviews, audit support engagements, purchase price allocations, ASC 820 fair value analyses, or real estate advisory engagements preferred.
* Experience with Argus Enterprise, CoStar, and other commercial real estate research and valuation platforms preferred. Ability to develop, review, and analyze property-level cash flow models is highly desirable.

The
**Director, Finance - Franchise Operations (SWA)**
will lead finance partnership for the South-West Asia franchise system, covering Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Maldives and Bhutan. title: Sr. Executive  Finance & Accounts
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

The Executive / Sr. Executive — Finance & Accounts will be responsible for managing end-to-end Accounts Payable operations, Tax / cost accounting, inventory reconciliation, inter-division purchase allocations, and statutory compliance (VAT/GST/Sales Tax filings) across domestic and international entities. The role demands strong hands-on experience in tax compliance, reconciliation, GL accounting, ERP operations and an eye for detail in multi-entity environments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Inventory Allocation: Inventory allocation from one entity to multiple entities; maintain opening, movement and closing inventory (accounting for transit time gaps).

COGS: Prepare and allocate COGS as per purchase / inventory movement / closing inventory.

VAT / Sales Tax Return Filing: File all applicable VAT / GST / Sales Tax returns as per the statutory due date calendar for US, EU, UAE, Brazil, Mexico, Australia, Canada, Cyprus and New Zealand; maintain filing / compliance tracker.

Input / Output Credit: Track and maintain records of all input and output credit taken.

Reconciliation: Reconcile all input / output credit factors against financial numbers (revenue/sales, expenses, customs duty/BOE based input credit).

Accounts Payable: Support international divisions with booking of expenses and bank / Amex transactions.

ELIGIBILITY & REQUIREMENTS

Education: B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent; semi-qualified CA / CMA preferred.

Experience: Executive — 2 to 4 years in international tax / accounts payable / cost accounting / GL. Sr. Executive — 4 to 7 years with hands-on multi-entity or international accounting exposure.

Technical Skills: ERP experience with Perfect Fit / Odoo preferred; proficiency in MS Excel including advanced reconciliation and pivot tables; working knowledge of VAT / GST / Sales Tax compliance across US states, Canada, UAE, EU, Brazil, Mexico, Australia and New Zealand; experience in inventory accounting and inter-company / inter-division transactions.

Soft Skills: High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data; ability to handle multiple deadlines and monthly closing pressures; strong written and verbal communication for inter-team coordination; self-driven with the ability to work independently and escalate issues proactively.

title: Auditor
description:
The role is responsible for conducting
**independent, risk-based audits of the Bank’s Retail Assets portfolio**
to assess the effectiveness of credit underwriting, approval, documentation, monitoring and portfolio management processes.
  
  
The role provides independent assurance on the
**quality of retail credit decisions, adherence to the Bank’s credit policies and regulatory requirements, effectiveness of internal controls, and identification of emerging credit risks**
across retail lending products. It also recommends corrective actions to strengthen the overall credit risk and control environment.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Credit Audit & Assurance
* Conduct periodic and risk-based audits of the Bank’s Retail Assets portfolio.
* Independently evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of credit underwriting, sanctioning, documentation and monitoring processes.
* Assess adherence to approved credit policies, product programmes, delegation of authority and internal risk frameworks.
* Review credit files and customer accounts using appropriate sampling methodologies.
* Identify material deviations, control weaknesses and potential areas of credit risk.
* Evaluate whether identified risks are appropriately recognised, classified, monitored and mitigated.
* Retail Asset Portfolio Review

**Audit Credit Processes Across Applicable Retail Lending Portfolios, Including**

* Home Loans / Mortgages
* Loan Against Property
* Personal Loans
* Auto / Vehicle Loans
* Education Loans
* Credit Cards
* Consumer Finance
* Other secured and unsecured retail lending products

Assess portfolio-level indicators to identify
**concentration risk, underwriting trends, delinquency patterns, early warning signals and deterioration in portfolio quality**
.
  
  

* Underwriting & Credit Decision Review
* Assess the quality and consistency of underwriting decisions.
* Review borrower eligibility, income assessment, repayment capacity and creditworthiness.
* Evaluate adherence to product-specific underwriting parameters and approval conditions.
* Review bureau reports, banking behaviour, collateral and other applicable credit assessment inputs.
* Examine policy deviations and exceptions to determine whether these have been appropriately justified and approved.
* Identify patterns that could indicate weaknesses in sourcing, underwriting or credit decision-making.
* Credit Controls & Risk Management
* Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls across the retail credit lifecycle.
* Review maker-checker controls and delegated lending authorities.
* Assess controls relating to customer onboarding, credit assessment, documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement monitoring.
* Identify process gaps that may expose the Bank to credit, operational, fraud, compliance or reputational risks.
* Assess the effectiveness of Early Warning Signals and other credit monitoring mechanisms.
* Regulatory & Policy Compliance
* Assess compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines and internal policies governing retail credit.
* Evaluate adherence to KYC/AML requirements where relevant to the credit audit scope.
* Highlight regulatory or policy breaches and assess their risk implications.
* Keep abreast of changes in the regulatory environment, credit policies and industry practices relevant to retail lending.
* Audit Reporting & Issue Closure
* Prepare clear, evidence-based audit observations and reports covering findings, root causes, risk implications and recommendations.
* Assign appropriate risk significance to audit observations based on impact and control weakness.
* Discuss findings with Credit, Business, Operations and Risk stakeholders.
* Agree appropriate management actions and timelines for closure.
* Track outstanding audit observations and independently validate remediation and closure.
* Escalate significant, recurring or overdue issues to appropriate senior stakeholders.
* Data Analytics & Thematic Reviews
* Use portfolio data and analytics to identify unusual trends, outliers and high-risk segments.
* Conduct thematic reviews across products, locations, channels or segments.
* Identify systemic issues beyond individual credit files and recommend portfolio-level interventions.
* Support increasing use of data-led and technology-enabled auditing within Credit Audit.
* Stakeholder Management

**Partner Effectively, While Maintaining Audit Independence, With**

* Retail Credit
* Retail Assets Business
* Credit Risk
* Operations
* Collections
* Fraud Risk
* Compliance
* Internal Audit
* Senior Management

Communicate complex credit risks and audit findings in a clear and commercially relevant manner.
  
  

* Key Deliverables
* Completion of assigned credit audits as per the approved audit plan.
* High-quality and timely credit audit reports.
* Identification of material and emerging credit risks.
* Effective tracking and validation of remediation actions.
* Identification of systemic and recurring control weaknesses.
* Actionable recommendations that strengthen the Retail Assets credit control environment.
* Timely escalation of significant credit and control concerns.
* Key Skills & Competencies

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong understanding of retail credit underwriting and credit risk management.
* Knowledge of secured and unsecured retail lending products.
* Understanding of the end-to-end retail credit lifecycle.
* Credit appraisal and financial assessment capabilities.
* Understanding of credit policies, product programmes and approval authorities.
* Knowledge of portfolio monitoring, delinquency and asset-quality indicators.
* Understanding of internal controls and risk-based auditing.
* Ability to interpret portfolio MIS and undertake data-driven credit reviews.
* Sound understanding of applicable banking and credit regulations.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong analytical and critical-thinking ability.
* Independent judgement and professional scepticism.
* High attention to detail.
* Ability to identify root causes rather than only transactional exceptions.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively.
* Integrity and objectivity.
* Effective stakeholder management.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple audit assignments.

**Education**
CA / MBA Finance / CFA / FRM / CIA or other relevant professional qualification would be advantageous.
  
  
**Experience**

* Relevant 2-8 experience in Retail Credit, Credit Risk, Credit Audit, Internal Audit or Retail Assets underwriting within a bank or financial institution.
* Experience across multiple retail lending products would be preferred.
* Prior exposure to credit portfolio analytics, risk assessment or regulatory reviews would be advantageous.
* Role Success Measures

**Success In The Role Would Be Measured Through**

* Quality and timeliness of audit execution.
* Effectiveness in identifying significant credit and control risks.
* Quality and practical relevance of audit recommendations.
* Timely closure and validation of audit observations.
* Reduction in repeat observations.
* Effectiveness of thematic and portfolio-level risk identification.
* Quality of engagement with Credit, Risk, Business and senior stakeholders.

title: Manager, Revenue Accounting
description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.
  
  
Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”
  
  
Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.
  
  
The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.
  
  
**About The Role**
Commure's finance team is rebuilding revenue accounting from the ground up, and this role is the architect of that rebuild. We're creating a brand-new Manager, Revenue Accounting & Deal Operations position to do two things at once: stand up our deal desk function from scratch, and modernize the technical infrastructure that supports revenue recognition across a fast-growing, multi-product healthcare technology business.
  
  
This isn't a maintain-the-status-quo role. Building the process, the playbooks, and the cross-functional muscle memory with Sales, Legal, and Revenue Operations that doesn't yet exist at scale. In parallel, you'll partner with our broader revenue accounting team on close, reconciliations, and audit support, and you'll have real influence over which tools and automation we adopt to get there. Our finance team invests aggressively in emerging finance technology, and you'll have the opportunity to engage in the debate and build out around how AI and automation should change the way revenue accounting and deal desk work gets done.
  
  
If you want to build something from a blank page rather than inherit a finished process, and you want a direct hand in shaping how a scaling, IPO-track company runs deal desk and revenue accounting, this is that seat.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Revenue Accounting Transformation & Technical Accounting-**
**Modernize revenue accounting processes**
: Transform the revenue accounting lifecycle, from contract review through revenue recognition, with a focus on scalability, automation, and IPO-ready internal controls.
  
  
**Lead technical accounting assessments:**
Research complex accounting matters and prepare technical accounting memos under ASC 606, covering multi-element arrangements, complex contracts, and non-standard deal structures.
  
  
**Develop and maintain accounting policies:**
Establish, maintain, and enhance revenue recognition policies to ensure consistent application across an expanding and diversifying product portfolio.
  
  
**Technology & Automation-**
**Drive technology adoption**
: Evaluate and implement revenue automation solutions and AI-enabled finance tools to reduce manual effort, and revenue accounting workflows, and improve accuracy and efficiency.
  
  
**Operational Revenue Accounting**
**Support monthly and quarterly close:**
Collaborate on revenue close activities, including account reconciliations, journal entries, deferred revenue analysis, and account-level reviews, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting.
  
  
**Strengthen financial controls**
: Support external audits and develop scalable, SOX-compliant processes that promote accuracy, consistency, and audit readiness.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Partnership**
**Partner with FP&A**
: Support revenue forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis by providing accurate, well-documented accounting inputs and clear explanations of revenue trends.
  
  
**Compliance & Audit-**
**Support external financial audits:**
Prepare schedules and supporting documentation requested by auditors (PBC schedules), respond to revenue-related inquiries, and ensure audit requirements are met accurately and on time.
  
  
**Drive IPO readiness**
: Strengthen revenue recognition policies, process documentation, and internal controls to align with public-company reporting and compliance expectations.
  
  
**What You Have-**

* 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience specifically in Revenue Recognition, Revenue Accounting, or Technical Accounting within a high-growth or complex business environment.
* Strong expertise in US GAAP and ASC 606, with the ability to independently interpret and apply revenue recognition guidance to complex accounting scenarios.
* Proven experience reviewing and assessing complex customer contracts, including multi-element arrangements, non-standard commercial terms, contract modifications, variable consideration, and performance obligations to determine appropriate revenue recognition treatment.
* Hands-on experience managing revenue accounting activities, including contract assessments, revenue recognition analysis, deferred revenue, journal entries, account reconciliations, and month-end or quarter-end close.
* Experience preparing technical accounting memos, documenting accounting judgments, and establishing consistent revenue recognition policies and procedures.
* Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or CA preferred.
* Hands-on experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, and revenue automation tools, with an interest in AI-enabled finance technology.
* Experience supporting external financial audits and developing or maintaining SOX-compliant processes and internal controls.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex accounting matters to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, take ownership of ambiguous situations, and drive process improvements in a fast-paced, scaling private-company environment.
* Experience working with US-based businesses, customers, or Finance teams and applying US GAAP in a US-market business environment is highly desirable.

title: Financial Planning and Analysis Manager
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Manager**
to manage the company's day-to-day finance and accounting operations. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate financial reporting, timely compliance, effective cash-flow management, strong financial controls, and providing meaningful financial insights to support business decisions.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of accounting principles, taxation, statutory compliance, financial reporting, and preferably experience in managing finance operations in a growing organisation.

**1. Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger and reconciliations.
* Ensure accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing.
* Prepare and review Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow statements and other financial reports.
* Ensure accounting records are accurate, complete, and maintained in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
* Review and reconcile bank, vendor, customer and other balance sheet accounts.

**2. Financial Planning & Analysis**

* Prepare budgets, forecasts and periodic financial projections.
* Track actual performance against budgets and provide variance analysis.
* Prepare management reports and dashboards highlighting key financial trends and business performance.
* Provide financial insights to management to support business and operational decisions.
* Identify areas for cost optimisation and improved financial efficiency.

**3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management**

* Monitor daily/weekly cash flow and ensure adequate liquidity.
* Manage receivables and payables to optimise working capital.
* Track outstanding customer receivables and coordinate with relevant teams for timely collections.
* Review payment schedules and ensure timely vendor payments.
* Support management in cash-flow planning and forecasting.

**4. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely compliance with applicable GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with external consultants, auditors and tax advisors wherever required.
* Review statutory filings and ensure accuracy of supporting documentation.
* Stay updated on relevant changes in accounting, taxation and regulatory requirements.

**5. Audit & Internal Controls**

* Coordinate internal and statutory audits and ensure timely closure of audit requirements.
* Prepare schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents required for audits.
* Establish and maintain appropriate financial controls and approval processes.
* Identify financial and operational risks and recommend corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to company finance policies and procedures.

**6. Business Finance Support**

* Work closely with HR, Sales, Operations and other business teams on finance-related matters.
* Review commercial proposals, contracts and business transactions from a financial perspective.
* Support management in evaluating costs, profitability and financial implications of business decisions.
* Provide timely financial information and analysis to senior management.

**7. Team Management**

* Manage and mentor the finance and accounts team.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely completion of finance activities.
* Review the team's work for accuracy and compliance.
* Build efficient processes and improve finance operations through automation and standardisation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting or a related field.
* CA / CMA / MBA Finance qualification will be an added advantage.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
* Good understanding of GST, TDS, income tax and statutory compliance.
* Experience with accounting/ERP systems such as Tally, SAP, Oracle, Zoho, Keka or similar platforms.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow management and MIS reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with deadlines.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.

AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Role Purpose**

Plan the right workforce, at the right place and time, at the right cost. The role owns end-to-end resource planning and analytics for operational workforce, turning data into clear, decision-ready insights for leadership. As an individual contributor, the role combines deep planning expertise with hands-on use of Python, SQL and Power BI to build models, automate reporting and solve business problems.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Advanced Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI.
* Forecasting, statistics and scenario modelling.
* Strong analytical thinking and practical problem solving.
* Create SOPs for planning processes and BRDs for automation and system requirements
* Independent ownership, stakeholder management and clear communication.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Graduate in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Operations Research or Data Science; post-graduation/MBA preferred.
* 3-8 years of experience, including 1-2 years in resource planning, workforce management(preferred) or capacity planning.
* Airline, aviation, logistics or other 24x7 operations experience preferred.

Key Responsibilities

1. Resource Planning, Forecasting & Analytics

* Own and validate planning assumptions, including productivity, attrition, leave, training, and fleet plan.
* Deliver short-, medium- and long-term workforce requirements aligned to the fleet and network plan.
* Monitor capacity and highlight gaps early and recommend workforce actions.
* Review plan versus actuals, explain variances and refine assumptions.
* Build analytical and simulation models to evaluate operational scenarios, cost-benefit trade-offs and improvement opportunities.
* Define and validate data requirements, analyse operational trends and recommend the best operational and financial outcome.
* Document assumptions, methodology and changes to maintain transparency and governance.

2. Technology & Automation

* Use Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI to analyse data, build dashboards and automate recurring processes.
* Improve data quality, planning accuracy and reporting turnaround time.

3. Stakeholder & Decision Support

* Partners with Operations, HR, Finance and other teams to align assumptions and planning requirements.
* Present complex analysis as simple, leadership-ready recommendations and support implementation.

title: Analyst/Senior Analyst - P&L Reporting
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
The D. E. Shaw group uses a combination of quantitative and qualitative tools to uncover self-governing, hard-to-find sources of return across global public and private markets. We are seeking an analyst/Senior Analyst to join our P&L Reporting team at the firm’s office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram, India which is responsible for producing firm-wide reports that provide insights and analyses into key performance indicators— including profit and loss (P&L), expenses, capital, returns, and fees— for the offices of the Chief Operating Officer (COO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO), business unit (BU) heads, and portfolio managers. The group handles ad hoc requests related to P&L and capital from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders, facilitating effective decision making through clear reporting, analyses, and recommendations. Another key responsibility is driving technology initiatives—leveraging a combination of proprietary and third-party tools to prepare and present reports, streamline workflows, improve process controls, and enhance user experience.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will take end-to-end ownership of the team’s recurring P&L reporting suite — across daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and year-end cycles — ensuring every report on P&L, expenses, capital, returns & fees is accurate, timely and complete. You will also coordinate with various teams including Front Office, Risk, Pricing, and other teams in FinOp to ensure accuracy of data while managing recurring workflows to sync, reconcile and allocate P&L, expenses and capital. Additionally, you will act as the domain expert and “human in the loop” for automated recurring workflows — running, validating and troubleshooting outputs (including those produced with GenAI) and owning the controls that keep reporting accurate. You will also respond to P&L and capital-related ad-hoc requests from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders. Finally, you will understand changes in the firm’s businesses, like new products and fund launches, and incorporate these changes into the recurring reports independently.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Finance domain knowledge, robust analytical and problem-solving skills, someone who is a quick learner and can excel while working under tight deadlines
* The ability to be self-motivated, exhibit keen attention to detail, and have a high sense of ownership with an attitude to take initiative in driving process enhancements
* 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in P&L / management reporting, fund accounting, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), or a related finance function
* Working knowledge of how hedge funds operate and their revenue model (fees and expenses), along with core financial concepts — instruments, ratios, accounting terms and statements
* Robust data and analytical skills — advanced MS Excel
* Comfort working alongside automation and GenAI tools — able to run, validate and critically evaluate their output as the domain expert, with a solid controls and process-improvement mindset
* Learning agility and adaptability to evolving workflows, tools, and business changes
* Excellent written and oral communication skills along with deft interpersonal skills are essential for managing interactions with senior stakeholders and ability to collaborate with multiple groups

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* A CA / MBA degree from a reputed college with 1 to 3 years of work experience in the Financial Services industry
* A Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) / Financial Risk Manager (FRM) Qualification
* Exposure to SQL, Python, or BI / analytics tools

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/AnaPnLOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

title: Senior Specialist 2, Revenue
description:
MongoDB is growing and gaining adoption rapidly across the globe with the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
We're looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented and hands-on individual to join the Revenue Team as a Revenue Lead. This role will be based out of our Gurugram, India office and will primarily be responsible for analyzing and reviewing complex revenue transactions, providing direction on technical revenue accounting issues and articulating accounting impact to our business partners. In addition, this role will participate in month-end and quarter-end close activities and be responsible for mentoring a small team of revenue accountants based in Gurugram, India.
  
  
This is a great opportunity to join and grow with a strong accounting team at a high growth, enterprise software company!
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Team Description
  
  
The Revenue team is an extremely visible, high-performing team, ultimately responsible for accurate financial reporting of revenue. The team is responsible for managing the monthly close, contract negotiation and documentation, and determining appropriate accounting treatment for our product offerings. Additionally, this team is responsible for designing and maintaining controls over reporting of revenue and assisting in quarterly revenue forecasting activities. This role will report directly to the Manager of Revenue.
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting (CA/CPA preferred) with at least 5+ years of experience in a similar role at a public, high-growth SaaS or technology company
* Prior experience with revenue operations, revenue recognition and reconciliation processes including working with sales data, customer contracts and new product offerings
* Deep expertise in ASC 606
* Experience in hiring, managing and mentoring high performing teams
* Proficiency in MS Excel and working with large volumes of data
* Knowledge of ERP and CRM systems (NetSuite, Salesforce)
* Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills
* Acute attention to detail and well-developed organization
* Excellent time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
* Must be self-motivated, flexible, deadline-oriented, and have the ability to independently drive projects to completion
* Outstanding interpersonal, communication, and business partnering skills with demonstrated ability to work cross functionally at various levels within a company

Position Expectations
  
  

* Provide subject matter expertise on the treatment of revenue accounting transactions (under ASC 606) and related financial reporting requirements
* Lead the execution of quarterly reviews and year-end financial audits by external auditors
* Participate in month-end close activities comprising various revenue analyses, booking JEs, account reconciliations and revenue recognition
* Analyze sales transactions within the Company’s ERP systems to ensure accuracy of data and integrity of revenue schedules, inclusive of revenue allocations
* Review and validate different revenue streams for appropriate revenue treatments
* Review contract write-ups to ensure that revenue is recognized in accordance with ASC 606
* Assist with preparation and review of executive-level analytics for various internal and external presentations
* Work cross-functionally with key internal business partners, such as GL, OTC, FP&A and Business Systems on ongoing NPI initiatives
* Assist with special projects and ad hoc requests as required

Success Measures
  
  

* A successful candidate must have the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, global environment as well as have experience and a strong interest in revenue advisory processes
* In 30 days, a successful candidate will have become familiar with our business, product offerings, and revenue streams
* In 3 to 6 months, you’ll have become familiar with our internal systems, operational workflows and accounting close tasks assigned to you and would be performing them independently
* In 6 to 9 months, you’ll have established relationships with key business partners such as GL, OTC, FP&A and Business Systems and would be working directly with them as and when issues arise
* In 12 months and beyond, this role will be established as a key resource for GTM Ops and responsible for supporting all triage responsibilities

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
Estera Real Estate is a growing real estate organization focused on delivering high-quality residential and commercial property solutions. The company strives to combine strong financial discipline with customer-centric services, ensuring sustainable growth and long-term value for investors and clients. Estera Real Estate emphasizes transparent operations, ethical business practices, and compliance with relevant regulations. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership of their work, and collaborate across functions to support the company’s expansion and operational excellence.

**Role Description**
The Senior Accountant will manage day-to-day accounting operations, including general ledger maintenance, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, and month-end and year-end closing activities. The role includes preparing and reviewing financial statements, supporting budgeting and forecasting, monitoring cash flows, and ensuring accurate recording of real estate transactions such as leases, sales, and project costs. The Senior Accountant will oversee compliance with applicable accounting standards and tax regulations, coordinate with external auditors, and help improve internal controls and accounting processes. This is a full-time, on-site role based in New Delhi, requiring close collaboration with finance, operations, and management teams to support strategic decision-making.

**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of general accounting principles, financial reporting, and month-end/year-end closing processes.
* Experience with budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, and financial analysis in a corporate environment.
* Proficiency in accounting software and ERP systems, along with advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Understanding of taxation, regulatory compliance, and audit procedures relevant to the real estate sector or similar industries.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA, CPA, CMA) are preferred.
* Ability to interpret complex financial data, maintain attention to detail, and produce accurate, timely reports.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Prior experience as an Accountant or Senior Accountant, ideally within real estate, construction, or property management, is an advantage.

We offer critical insight and rigorous analytical techniques to deliver innovative solutions and thought\-provoking analyses for our clients.
   

  

 Working at ICF means applying a passion for meaningful work with intellectual rigour to help solve the leading issues of our day. Smart, compassionate, innovative, committed, ICF employees tackle unprecedented challenges to assist our clients and benefit their constituencies.  Timely client billing and working with Project Managers to monitor aged debts and Making Cash flow estimates.

 Support in Internal and External Audits

 Perform other duties and responsibilities – ad\-hoc as assigned
   

  

 MBA /M.com/ CMA .
   

  

 Excel skills to intermediate level (pivot tables, lookup formulas, financial modeling).
   

  

 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in Project Controllership/ Project administration (finance) work with Service \& Consultancy company
   

  

 MS Excel \& PowerPoint skills at Expert level, Knowledge of PowerBI would be an added advantage.
   

  

 Experienced user of financial systems (preferably Maconomy )
   

  

 Highly numerate

 Strong verbal, interpersonal, and written skills
   

  

 Ability to work in a matrix organization across India and Europe
   

  

 Must have a good work ethic, the ability to work to deadlines, and be interested in learning and development
   

  

 Ability to organize, prioritise, and self\-motivated with a high level of commitment and initiative
   

  

 A team player with a ‘can\-do attitude’
