title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.
* Partner with multiple groups to implement reporting changes and assess post\-implementation execution and performance.
* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities
* Lead loss mitigation strategy changes for required maintenance (e.g., NCI/NPI; MISC1 changes; regulatory updates). This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects and analyses, as needed, Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.
* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior Collection Strategy Development or Credit Strategy Development/ Risk Management experience and/or prior Collections experience in other functions
* 4\+ years demonstrated success developing and delivering advanced analytics solutions
* Data lake experience and strategies
* Master's degree in Business or in a Quantitative Related Field
* Proven analytical and decision\-making skills
* Experience developing scoring models or decision\-tree segmentations
* Ability to independently manage processes, Self\-motivated, and drive continuous process improvement
* Strong communications, problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams
* Demonstrated ability to apply strategic thinking toward tactical execution
* Experience working with cross\-functional project teams


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.


**Work Timings:** 
**2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**

This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. title: Commercial & Transformation Lead
description:
**Mission Brief** 




  





 Transform how Lenskart buys, negotiates and creates value from every rupee it spends.
 



 Lenskart is scaling rapidly across manufacturing, retail, supply chain and multiple geographies. At this scale, commercial decisions are no longer just about procurement. They are a strategic lever for growth, margin and competitive advantage.
 



 The opportunity is to bring greater intelligence, discipline and technology into how we manage external spend, from manufacturing inputs and logistics to retail, technology and corporate categories.
 



 Your mandate is to close the gap between what we spend and what we should spend and create a commercial engine that is data\-led, AI\-enabled and deeply connected to the business.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous business problems and turning those solutions into measurable outcomes.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  





 Commercial Intelligence \& AI
 



 Shape Lenskart’s commercial intelligence layer across:
 


* Spend analytics, should\-cost models and total\-cost\-of\-ownership frameworks
* Supplier intelligence, scorecards and risk assessment
* E\-sourcing and contract intelligence
* AI\-assisted negotiation and price discovery
* Automated, data\-led decision making across categories



  





 The goal is to move from fragmented information and manual decision\-making to a system where
 **the data tells us where the opportunity is and technology helps us act on it.** 




  





 Strategic Sourcing \& P\&L Impact
 



 Own the commercial opportunity across a broad spend universe:
 



**Direct:** 
 Frames, lenses, coatings, accessories, packaging and manufacturing inputs
 



**Indirect:** 
 Store CapEx and OpEx, marketing, technology and corporate spend
 



**Supply Chain:** 
 Logistics, last\-mile, lab\-to\-store, make\-vs\-buy and network optimisation
 



 You will be expected to identify structural opportunities, develop category strategies and deliver measurable YoY P\&L impact through
 **should\-cost, TCO, value engineering and smarter commercial models.** 




  





 Negotiation \& Supplier Strategy
 



 Lead some of Lenskart’s highest\-value commercial negotiations while establishing greater negotiation rigour across the organisation.
 



  





 This includes developing stronger supplier strategies, benchmarking markets, understanding cost structures, defining negotiation playbooks and creating clear walk\-away positions.
 



 The objective is not simply to
 **negotiate harder** 
 , but to fundamentally improve the economics of the relationships we enter into.
 



  





 Business Problem Solving \& Leadership
 



 This role sits at the intersection of multiple parts of the business.
 



 You will work closely with
 **Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Retail, Technology and Marketing** 
 , as well as the founders and senior leadership team, on problems where the answer is not always obvious.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 


* Break down complex business problems into clear commercial decisions.
* Challenge existing ways of working using data and first\-principles thinking.
* Translate business requirements into technology and AI solutions.
* Take ideas from analysis through implementation and measurable impact.
* Influence stakeholders across functions and drive adoption at scale.



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone who
 **thinks like a business leader, not a functional specialist.** 




 You may come from strategy, consulting, business operations, supply chain, sourcing, procurement, corporate development or a high\-growth operating environment.
 



 What matters is that you have demonstrated:
 


* Strong problem\-solving ability across ambiguous, high\-impact business situations.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong commercial and analytical instincts.
* Exposure to supply chain, sourcing, cost structures or commercial strategy.
* The ability to connect
 **strategy, economics, technology and execution.**
* A track record of taking ownership for outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Curiosity and instinct to use AI and technology to fundamentally improve how work gets done.



 Experience with
 **manufacturing, APAC, China or Middle East supply ecosystems** 
 is a strong advantage.
 



  





 Why This Role
 



**This is not a traditional procurement role.** 




 You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most consequential commercial problems at Lenskart, with visibility into the decisions that shape
 **margin, supply chain, capital allocation and growth.** 




  





 You will work closely with the
 **founders and senior leadership** 
 , operate across the full business and have significant ownership over the direction of the commercial function.
 



 The scale is substantial:
 **2,500\+ stores, hundreds of suppliers, multiple geographies and an increasingly complex manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.** 




  





 The opportunity is to combine
 **business problem solving, commercial strategy, supply chain thinking and technology** 
 to create a capability that can materially change Lenskart’s economics.

description:

* Apply your business expertise to a domain that is reshaping the global economy

description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our investments team at Marsh. This role will be based in Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
   

  

**Senior Specialist / Specialist \- Investments (CSO)**
 As a member of the Investments team at Mercer based in India, you will play a crucial role in providing comprehensive analysis and research support throughout the entire investment decision\-making, risk management, and investment monitoring process. Your primary responsibilities will involve assisting with a range of institutional investing activities across different geographies, including collecting and analyzing data, researching investment strategies, portfolio construction and performance analytics reports.
   

  

 In your role, you will be the content specialist/trainer and peer reviewer of crucial tasks including but not limited to quarterly performance evaluation reports including Defined Contribution, Defined Benefit and Not for Profit clients, investment policy statements, and manager commentaries among other tasks. You will be expected to drive/lead ad hoc projects aimed at creating positive business impact/value\-add for the business.
   

  

 This is a challenging and rewarding opportunity for a highly motivated individual with a passion for investments, strong analytical skills, and a desire to work in a dynamic, collaborative team environment.
   

  

**We will count on you for:**
* Developing asset allocation solutions for institutional clients based on the Investment Policy Statement while incorporating the asset class views of the organization’s Strategic Research Group
* Preparing Portfolio evaluation reports (DC, DB, OCIO, Endowment and Foundation) on monthly/quarterly basis detailing the market performance, investment results, style exposures and recommendations for portfolio rebalancing.
* Preparing and reviewing quarterly manager commentary by assessing the performance of fund/investment strategies and linking the performance with market/economic developments and the investment process of the asset managers.
* Lead and support client projects or ad\-hoc projects beyond reporting
* Review asset allocation and portfolio construction as per client goals and risk appetite
* Review and amend investment policy statements
* Fund managers screening and preparation of search report
* Project management, peer review, process training and development of team members
* Lead and contribute on projects for Strategic Research Team and Intellectual Capital publications
* Conduct research and write research papers on macro/micro economic environment and Investment industry
* Lead and participate in knowledge development initiatives
* Providing research support on client requests including ESG, Style Analysis, Asset Class Trends
* Play key role in strategic and operations improvement initiatives
* Support Process Leads in preparation of periodic KPIs and dashboard reporting
* Coach and guide the junior team members and new team members


**What you need to have:**
* 3\+ years’ experience in the wealth management/investment industry overall
* Relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree in finance or economics with demonstrated academic achievement
* Progress towards professional certification such as CFA, CAIA, CIPM
* Proficient understanding in Wealth Management, Investment Management industry and asset classes (equity, fixed income and alternatives)
* Strong logical and analytical skills with attention to details
* Strong working knowledge of MS Office, third party tools – Bloomberg, Morning Star, Lipper, etc
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Exceptional interpersonal, organizational, business communication, and time management skills
* Demonstrated success working with out\-of\-country professionals
* Ability to multitask, manage multiple priorities and work in a rapidly changing and dynamic environment, ensuring standards and deadlines are met and keeping others informed and up\-to\-date
* Stakeholder management; managing escalations and ensuring excellent service delivery


**What makes you stand out?**
* Ability to understand the link between data, client needs and its application to the “bigger picture”
* Excellent client management skills
* Positive attitude \& ability to adapt ever\-changing environment
* Strong multi\-tasking skills
* Domain expertise relevant to wealth management/investment advisory/consulting
* Willing to learn and a strong team player with a collaborative approach
* Effective team management skills
* Good analytical skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills


**Why join our team:**
* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.


 Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office\-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Assistant Vice President - Stress Testing
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Assistant Vice President – Stress Testing.**
**Purpose Of The Role**
 This role is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and well\-governed stress testing results and management information end\-to\-end, including running/consolidating balance sheet and P\&L outputs, coordinating stakeholder submissions and regulatory responses, maintaining data and systems and strengthening the control environment through robust documentation, evidence, issue/risk management, and continuous process automation/improvement.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Support end\-to\-end production of management information and consolidated stress\-testing results. Execute and/or support model runs and results production for balance sheet and P\&L components including loans, deposits, revenue etc. and produce consolidated results.
* Submitting overlays, journals into TM1, CART etc. and ensure the MI is accurate, robust and aligned with the latest management hierarchies. Collaborate with Group to ensure any PRA submissions are completed timely, liaise on Bank of England queries, prepare draft responses relating to unstructured data requests.
* Perform analysis of stress test outputs including movement/variance analysis, sensitivities, trend reviews, and identification of key drivers. Managing stakeholders to ensure timely and complete submissions. Tracking actions, recording key decision points, distributing meeting materials and minutes.
* Support T\-zero data preparation for entity returns, coordinate with Group and ensure data quality throughout the process. Support R\&C and coordination of various stress test exercises and related approvals/governance, including coordination of inputs and evidence packs for exercises such as GIST/GRP/RST and relevant UK/Group regulatory requests (e.g., PRA\-related).
* Partner with model owners and accountable executives in Business, Risk, Finance to analyse, review and challenge stress test submissions. Support the impact assessment and change implementation for various stress\-testing data and systems, including CART, TM1 and maintain key mappings for products, global businesses, MICA etc.
* Implement new models, tools, processes or automated solutions to support any changes in the process or requirements. Build accurate, validated datasets for each stress\-testing cycle, with no critical data\-quality issues, and develop and maintain validation tools to support review activities.
* Improve efficiency, convert manual spreadsheets to automated solutions by leveraging HSBC artificial intelligence tools and other methods of automation. Ensuring processes are run in accordance with the Control framework and agreed procedures.
* Produce and maintain high\-quality stress testing documentation (methodology narratives, process/run books, evidence packs, control checklists, assumptions logs, and decision logs). Providing accurate information status reporting, risk and update on issues.
* Develop and actively manage delivery plans covering key milestones and interdependencies and coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure timely delivery. Support the development and maintenance of process flows, controls, documentation etc., embedding HSBC principles and ensure compliance with risk management framework.
* Support the annual Risk Control Assessment and contribute to ongoing strengthening of the stress testing control environment. Execute and evidence process controls and assurance activities, including maintaining records in relevant tooling (e.g., Helios for controls/assurance, where applicable).


**To Be Successful You Will**
* Qualifications: ACA, ACCA, MBA or similar.
* Experience: Demonstrable experience coordinating internal and external stress test submissions, with a strong understanding of governance and regulatory expectations. Strong analytical skills with business analysis experience or equivalent.
* Data and Systems: Strong understanding of data architecture, finance and accounting systems – ability to work with large, complex datasets.
* Presentation and Communication: Ability to present results effectively to senior stakeholders and distill complex messages into understandable plain English for non\-technical colleagues. Have confidence to review, challenge and improve submissions while maintaining strong relationships.
* Produce high\-quality outputs: Proven ability to produce high\-quality outputs, and to write concise, technically accurate papers, with strong attention to detail and clear audit trail.
* Delivery discipline and control mindset: Strong planning, tracking and reporting capability (run books, RAID, milestones). Understand risk management and control frameworks.
* Problem\-solving: Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritise effectively and keep delivery moving at pace.
* Tools: Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); MI systems (TM1, CART, Saracen), and knowledge of Workviva, Harmony, RRIS.


**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**
**www.hsbc.com/careers**
 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

title: Senior Analyst, AFR
description:
Gurgaon, Haryana, India
   

  

 The role is within the AXA XL Reinsurance Portfolio Analytics team. Portfolio Analytics operates as part of a global reinsurance network, working with underwriters, actuaries and business heads across multiple regions, with a culture of collaboration and participation across a range of high\-profile projects. The team seeks to make full use of available data sources to better manage reinsurance portfolios and enhance the reinsurance operation’s profitability. The team conceptualizes, designs and develops innovative management information for underwriters, actuaries and senior management. The team’s other objectives include creating high\-end analytical solutions and automating manual processes using the latest technologies.
   

  

**What You’ll Be DOING**
 What will your essential responsibilities include?
   

  

* Create and run standard reports whilst looking to automate their generation and distribution. Review management information created by other people across the Reinsurance segment.
* Create new innovative management information using Excel, Qlik Sense, VBA and / or PowerBI.
* Support product management within the reinsurance operations. Work with people from across the reinsurance segment to determine how to best measure risk and profitability for various lines of business and how to construct and manage portfolios accordingly.
* Responsibility for checking that the reinsurance data is correct. Setting up a process for regular data checks, investigating any potential issues and taking any appropriate actions.
* Take ownership of mappings, making sure any new mapping required is added in a timely manner.
* Understand/explain data and assist the reinsurance community with any questions including how to access required data, definitions and the source of data.
* To assist with complex data needs, sourcing the appropriate data from multiple reinsurance systems.
* Test any new developments to the Reinsurance Analytics project before they are released.
* To be involved in deciding the direction of any specifying new development to the Reinsurance Analytics project.
* Provide training and support on the Reinsurance Analytics tools for a broad user base across multiple regions and functions – including underwriting, actuarial and senior management.


 You will report to the Senior Lead, Pricing Data \& Reporting.
   

  

**What You Will BRING**
 We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
   

  

**Required Skills And Abilities**
* University Graduate with qualification B.E/B.Tech(CS/IT).
* Excellent analytical, research and problem\-solving skills.
* Good working knowledge of SQL.
* Desirable skill but not mandatory Knowledge of Python programming language.


**Desired Skills And Abilities**
* Outstanding computer application skills, specifically Excel and experience using any of the following BI applications is desirable e.g. Qlik Sense, Qlik View, PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc.
* Ability to multi\-task and work effectively in a fast\-paced team environment.
* Exposure to Data Analytics / Machine Learning preferred.
* Keen attention to detail.
* Effective oral and written communication skills.


**Who WE Are**
 AXA XL, the P\&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid\-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
   

  

 How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data\-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
   

  

 With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
   

  

 Learn more at axaxl.com
   

  

**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
 AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
 *It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*
* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ\+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family\-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter


 Learn more at axaxl.com/about\-us/inclusion\-and\-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
   

  

**Total Rewards**
 AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
   

  

 We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
   

  

**Sustainability**
 At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever\-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023\-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems \- the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.

Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal\-led solutions.

Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.

These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.


 For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

 The Vege Oil Trader will be responsible for Merchandising Imported Edible Oil such as CPO, RBD Oln and SFO into the local Indian market from various port location but mainly pertaining to the East coast of India (KP/Kaki/Chennai/Haldia). In this role, you will monitor a supplier base and fulfill transactions, delivering commodities that meet production requirements and specifications in terms of timing, volume, quantity and cost.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

**Trading \& Commercial Strategy**
* Develop and execute profitable trading strategies for imported edible oils across Indian markets.
* Manage physical trading positions, inventory exposure, and pricing risk to optimize portfolio profitability.
* Identify and capture arbitrage opportunities between origins, ports, customer segments, and competing oils.
* Monitor global vegetable oil markets, including Palm Oil, Soybean Oil, Sunflower Oil, and related feedstocks, and translate market intelligence into actionable trading decisions.
* Build and maintain trading books to achieve volume, margin, and P\&L targets.


**Market Analysis \& Price Risk Management**
* Analyze domestic and international market fundamentals including supply\-demand balances, crop outlooks, import parity, crush economics, stock levels, and government policies.
* Monitor futures markets, basis relationships, currency movements, freight rates, and competitor activity to support trading decisions.
* Recommend pricing, hedging, and risk\-management strategies to manage market volatility and protect margins.
* Work closely with Risk Management and Trade Analytics teams to manage position exposure and portfolio performance.


**Customer \& Supplier Development**
* Build strategic relationships with refiners, food manufacturers, distributors, and trade houses across India.
* Identify new customer opportunities and develop trading solutions tailored to customer requirements.
* Negotiate commercial contracts involving pricing, volume, delivery terms, and payment structures.
* Collaborate with international trading desks and suppliers to optimize sourcing and trade flows.


**Portfolio Optimization \& Execution**
* Manage inventory and sales liquidation across bonded, high\-seas, and ex\-tank positions to maximize returns.
* Optimize freight, storage, and logistics economics to enhance trade margins.
* Ensure effective coordination with logistics, execution, finance, quality, credit, and operations teams to support seamless trade execution.
* Evaluate inventory holding strategies and working capital impacts to maximize risk\-adjusted returns.


**Market Intelligence \& Collaboration**
* Partner closely with TDA and Market Intelligence teams to assess:
+ Domestic crushing margins and crush economics.
+ Import parity and export competitiveness.
+ Port stock positions and inventory trends.
+ Regional demand patterns and substitution dynamics between edible oils.

* Provide market insights and trade recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Contribute to regional and global market outlook discussions and commercial strategy development.


**Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of vegetable oil fundamentals, futures markets, risk management, and physical commodity trading.
* Proven ability to interpret market data and convert insights into profitable trading decisions.
* Experience managing physical positions, customer portfolios, and price\-risk exposure.
* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and relationship management capabilities.
* Ability to make decisions in fast\-moving and volatile commodity markets.
* P\&L\-driven mindset with a strong focus on value creation and margin optimization.

* Strong communication, interpersonal and client management skills

**Qualitative Demeanour**
* Open to stretching on working hours in periods of peak capital markets and merger \& acquisition activity.

**Key Skills To Accelerate Career**

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 
 Panasonic is a diversified technology company offering integrated solutions for consumers, businesses, and communities. In India, the company provides a wide range of consumer electronics and appliances, including televisions, cameras, home appliances, and beauty products, along with B2B solutions in energy storage, smart factory systems, security and surveillance, automotive, and industrial devices. Panasonic also delivers advanced system solutions such as high\-definition video conferencing, professional audio\-video products, Toughbooks, projectors, and display technologies. With over 100 years of global legacy, Panasonic is committed to contributing to societal progress and enhancing quality of life. Panasonic India operates as Panasonic Life Solutions India as of August 1, 2022\.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Financial Planning Analyst role based in Gurugram. The Financial Planning Analyst will be responsible for preparing budgets, forecasts, and long\-term financial plans, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Daily activities include analyzing financial data, monitoring key performance indicators, preparing management reports, and supporting variance and trend analysis for different business units. The role involves building and maintaining financial models, supporting decision\-making for investments and initiatives, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams such as operations, sales, and corporate finance. The analyst will also assist in improving financial processes, strengthening internal controls, and providing data\-driven insights to support strategic planning.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Financial Planning and Finance skills, with the ability to support strategic and operational decision\-making.
* Candidates should possess advanced Analytical Skills, including proficiency in interpreting complex data sets and preparing insightful reports.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in Budgeting \& Forecasting, ensuring accurate, timely, and realistic financial projections.
* Candidates should possess experience in Financial Modeling, including building and maintaining models for scenario analysis and business planning.
* **Relevant qualification such as CA is mandatory.**
* Proficiency in MS Excel and financial planning tools, familiarity with ERP systems, and strong attention to detail.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross\-functional teams and present financial insights to stakeholders.
* Prior experience in financial analysis or planning, preferably within technology, manufacturing, or diversified business environments, is beneficial.

title: Cost Manager
description:
Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.
   

  





 Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy, and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.
   

  





 Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.
   

  





 We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.
   

  

  

  

 Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Role Overview
   

  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Cost Manager** 
 to lead cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control activities across projects and business operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in project cost management, commercial controls, financial analysis, and stakeholder management, with proven experience in delivering projects within budget while maximizing value and minimizing risks.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Cost Planning \& Budget Management
   

  




* Develop and manage project budgets, cost estimates, and financial forecasts.
* Establish cost control procedures, standards, and reporting frameworks.
* Monitor project expenditures and ensure alignment with approved budgets.
* Conduct cost\-benefit analyses and recommend cost optimization strategies.



 Cost Control \& Reporting
   

  




* Track actual costs against budget and forecast variances.
* Prepare periodic cost reports, dashboards, and performance metrics for senior management.
* Analyze trends, risks, and opportunities impacting project costs.
* Ensure timely identification and escalation of cost overruns and mitigation measures.



 Contract \& Commercial Management
   

  




* Review contracts, change orders, claims, and commercial implications.
* Evaluate contractor invoices, variations, and payment applications.
* Support procurement and vendor negotiations from a cost management perspective.
* Ensure compliance with contractual and financial obligations.



 Forecasting \& Risk Management
   

  




* Lead monthly forecasting and cash flow projections.
* Identify financial risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Support project teams in scenario analysis and decision\-making processes.
* Maintain contingency planning and risk adjustment mechanisms.



 Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Partner with project managers, finance teams, procurement teams, and external stakeholders.
* Present cost performance updates to leadership and clients.
* Provide commercial guidance throughout project lifecycle phases.



 Process Improvement
   

  




* Drive continuous improvements in cost management methodologies and systems.
* Implement best practices, automation tools, and reporting efficiencies.
* Mentor and guide junior cost engineers/analysts.


**Qualifications**

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
* 10–15 years of experience in Cost Management, Project Controls, Commercial Management, or related functions.
* Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and financial reporting.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale projects and complex budgets.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and project management tools.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.


**Additional Information**

 Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
   

  





 We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work\-life balance.
   

  





 Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.
   

  





 Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/
   

  





  

  





 Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner \& Townsend and our exciting future projects:
   

  





 Twitter
   

  





 Instagram

title: Senior Associate – Energy
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate – Energy** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
*4\-8 years of relevant* 
***post MBA***
*experience* 




  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm known for solving complex business challenges and delivering measurable results. Our teams work with organizations facing transformation, performance, restructuring, and growth priorities where practical execution matters as much as strategic direction. The firm brings together industry expertise, analytical rigor, and hands\-on leadership to help clients improve performance and build lasting value. In India, our professionals collaborate across sectors and capabilities to address high\-impact business problems for leading organizations. The Energy practice advises clients across the energy value chain, including oil and gas, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities. We value professionals who combine structured problem\-solving with commercial judgment, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and take ownership for outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to work on challenging engagements, contribute to business development, and help shape solutions that influence critical decisions across the Energy sector.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Senior Associate will own high\-impact workstreams for Energy\-sector clients, combining deep sub\-sector expertise with adaptable advisory skills across adjacent markets. The role will diagnose performance, strategy, restructuring, and operational challenges; convert analysis into clear recommendations; and support implementation that improves value, resilience, and execution. You will work across O\&G upstream and downstream, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities, with the expectation of developing a differentiated point of view in at least one sub\-sector. Success requires strong ownership of analyses, client\-ready communication, team leadership, and the judgment to connect operational levers with financial and strategic impact. Based in Gurgaon and working onsite, you will collaborate closely with senior professionals and client teams on complex, time\-sensitive engagements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end workstreams across Energy consulting engagements, structuring ambiguous problems, defining analyses, and converting findings into decisions that improve client performance and enterprise value.
* Lead market, operational, financial, and strategic analyses using structured problem\-solving, data, and business judgment to identify root causes and prioritize value\-creation opportunities.
* Develop actionable recommendations for strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, and operational transformation, linking each initiative to measurable commercial or operating outcomes.
* Manage client interactions and senior stakeholder communication, presenting concise insights, challenging assumptions constructively, and building alignment around implementation priorities and ownership.
* Guide analysts and associates through problem definition, quality assurance, synthesis, and delivery, raising team capability while maintaining high standards for accuracy, pace, and clarity.
* Contribute to proposals, business development, and knowledge building by applying Energy\-sector expertise to shape differentiated perspectives, compelling solutions, and repeatable intellectual capital.
* Adapt across adjacent Energy sub\-sectors while maintaining deep expertise in at least one area, ensuring recommendations reflect sector economics, operating realities, and relevant value drivers.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Deep expertise in at least one Energy sub\-sector, such as O\&G upstream or downstream, chemicals, mining, power, or utilities, with the ability to transfer insights across adjacent markets.
* Strong experience in consulting, advisory, or relevant industry roles spanning strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting, with ownership of complex workstreams.
* Advanced problem\-solving, financial and operational analysis, executive communication, and stakeholder\-management skills, supported by strong proficiency in standard analytical and presentation tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience delivering implementation programs or transformation initiatives where recommendations were translated into operating changes, performance gains, or measurable financial improvement.
* Exposure to multiple Energy sub\-sectors, market situations, or geographies, enabling faster pattern recognition and more relevant recommendations for complex client contexts.
* Demonstrated contribution to proposals, client development, thought leadership, or internal capability building that strengthens the practice and creates new commercial opportunities.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 4–8 years of total professional experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience, gained in consulting, advisory, or relevant Energy industry roles.
* A strong academic foundation, including an MBA or related postgraduate qualification, with the commercial maturity to engage senior client stakeholders and influence important decisions.
* Demonstrated depth in at least one Energy sub\-sector and the adaptability to work credibly across O\&G, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities as client priorities require.
* A record of owning analytical and problem\-solving workstreams across strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting engagements.
* The ability to move from data and diagnosis to practical recommendations, implementation priorities, and measurable business impact without losing attention to detail.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including the confidence to synthesize complex issues for executives and facilitate productive discussions with diverse stakeholders.
* A collaborative leadership style that develops junior team members, improves quality, and maintains momentum in fast\-paced, high\-expectation environments.
* Willingness to work onsite in Gurgaon and contribute actively to a team culture built around accountability, intellectual rigor, and hands\-on delivery.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work on consequential Energy\-sector challenges where your analyses directly influence strategy, performance, restructuring, and investment decisions. You will see recommendations move from diagnosis into implementation and measurable client outcomes.
* Build differentiated expertise across a broad Energy landscape while developing depth in a chosen sub\-sector. The role offers exposure to senior stakeholders, complex situations, and adjacent industries that accelerate commercial judgment.
* Join a performance\-oriented team that values practical problem solving, clear communication, and ownership. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who expect high standards and support meaningful professional growth.
* Contribute beyond individual engagements through proposals, knowledge building, and practice development. Your perspectives can shape how the firm addresses evolving Energy\-sector priorities and creates value for future clients.



  





**What We Offer** 



* The opportunity to work on high\-impact Energy engagements spanning strategy, performance improvement, restructuring, analytics, and operational transformation across leading industry segments.
* A platform for accelerated learning through direct client exposure, cross\-sector problem solving, senior mentorship, and responsibility for workstreams with visible business impact.
* A collaborative, onsite Gurgaon environment with strong expectations for ownership, analytical rigor, practical execution, and contribution to the growth of the Energy advisory practice.

title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





**Location** 
 : Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience** 
 : 4–8
 *years of* 
***post MBA***
*relevant experience.* 




  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

title: Sr Manager - Decision Intelligence
description:
**Job Description**
**About Busuu**
 Busuu is one of the world's leading language\-learning platforms, part of Chegg. We help over 100 million learners build language skills that change their lives — through apps, web, and now an AI\-first product experience. We operate across consumer (B2C) and business (B2B/enterprise) markets in over 100 countries
   

  

**About Decision Intelligence**
 Decision Intelligence (DI) is the central capability that makes the business measurable, governed, and trusted. It spans data insights and analytics across the organization, operating through three layers: analytics partners embedded in business teams, a central hub that owns standards, metrics architecture, experimentation, and governance, and a platform layer (Data Engineering) that builds the infrastructure.
   

  

 DI does not govern business decisions — it governs the standards that make those decisions trustworthy and evidence\-based. We don't build dashboards on request; we build the foundations teams build on. We work hybrid with team members across India, the UK, and the EU.
   

  

**The Role**
 You are the operational backbone of Busuu's Decision Intelligence function. As Head of Decision Intelligence, you anchor business\-wide strategic intelligence, run the hub day\-to\-day, manage and develop analytics leaders as a player\-coach, and own the methodology behind Busuu's weekly business performance reporting and monthly leadership reviews.
   

  

 You operate as a player\-coach: you lead capability work in the hub, grow direct reports across the organization, and continue to contribute hands\-on to strategic analytics work. You partner with senior analytics stakeholders on metrics architecture and strategy, with the Director on hub direction, and with business leaders on analytics\-driven narratives.
   

  

 The role is the connective tissue of the function — turning measurement into operating decisions across the business. It is also a role with a clear trajectory: the right person grows into broader strategic leadership scope over time as the function scales.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business\-wide strategic owner — anchor cross\-functional business narrative, deep\-dives, and performance readouts. Be the credible analytics voice in leadership forums and key business meetings.
* Player\-coach for direct reports — Develop 3\-4 analytics leaders on craft, level progression, and strategic partnership capability. Balance coaching and mentorship with your own hands\-on strategic analytics contributions.
* Weekly business performance reporting — design, narrative arc, and analytical integrity of weekly business performance summaries.
* Monthly leadership review architecture — partner with senior analytics stakeholders on monthly business review structure; you own the weekly\-to\-monthly narrative connection.
* Experimentation standards — co\-build testing rigor and best practices across the organization.
* Hub operations — day\-to\-day leadership of the analytics hub as the synthesis layer that makes cross\-functional signals usable for executive decisions.
* Metrics architecture co\-ownership — co\-own metrics definition and architecture with senior analytics partners.
* Business performance deep\-dives — cross\-functional lens, working with your team on methodology and insights.
* Strategic planning and forecasting — the senior analytics voice on business strategy, OKR setting, and opportunity sizing.


**Required**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years experience in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, or consulting at meaningful scale — ideally with hands\-on analytical depth and people leadership combined.
* Demonstrated player\-coach experience — managing 3\+ analysts or data scientists while continuing to contribute as a senior individual contributor to strategic work. Comfortable in both leadership and hands\-on analytical work.
* Strong commercial instinct — you understand how analytics maps to business outcomes (revenue, retention, lifetime value, unit economics, conversion).
* Strategic narrative skill — you translate quantitative measurement into executive\-grade communication that drives decisions, not just describes them.
* Senior stakeholder influence — comfortable operating with Directors, VPs, and General Managers. Diplomatic but direct.
* Excellent SQL and fluency with BI tooling (Tableau, Looker, Metabase, or equivalent). Working knowledge of semantic\-layer thinking (dbt, Cube, LookML, or equivalent).
* Experience designing or owning a weekly business performance reporting cadence and a monthly business review architecture.
* Comfort working in a hybrid team across time zones — explicit overlap with London and EU as a known feature of the role.


**Preferred**
* B2C subscription \+ B2B SaaS exposure — comfortable thinking about both segments and weaving them together.
* EdTech context.
* AI and transformation measurement experience.
* Prior team\-building or hiring track record — bringing in talent, growing analysts, and building team\-level capability.
* Demonstrated growth trajectory — you've taken on expanded scope as you've delivered. The function is scaling; the right person will too.
* Familiarity with analytics operating models, data\-driven decision practices, or building analytics functions in fast\-moving environments.


**Competencies Expected at this Level**
* Strategic Thinking — plans strategy for team and projects (3\-9 month horizon); anticipates issues; plans for scalability; contributes to function\-level direction.
* Communication \& Leadership — tactical day\-to\-day team communication; conflict resolution; makes sound talent decisions (hires, performance, promotions); coaches and develops with compassion; fosters collaboration; influences senior stakeholders.
* Critical Thinking — prioritizes given impact and effort; identifies and asks tough questions; coaches reports on data\-driven decision\-making.
* Accountability — drives repeatable results at team and project level; provides clear ownership; knows when to escalate; fully committed to objectives.
* Analytics Architecture and Design — coaches team on measurement design; sets architectural standards; owns system\-level measurement conversations with key stakeholders.
* Cross\-functional Pattern Recognition — drives conversation across teams on shared patterns; coaches team members to identify and surface patterns; weaves signals into coherent narrative.


**How We Work**
 Decision Intelligence is deliberately small and high\-leverage. We are pragmatic about trade\-offs, opinionated about standards, and committed to evidence over opinion. The hub is the connective layer between business teams and Executive Leadership — and as Head of Decision Intelligence, you are the connective tissue of that layer.
   

  

 The function is scaling as part of broader business evolution at Busuu. The right person in this role will grow with it — expanding scope over time as the function matures.
   

  

 We work hybrid across India, the UK, and the EU. The role is India\-based with explicit time\-zone bridging with EU/UK.

**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.

* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.


**Eligibility Criteria**

This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose.
