title: Senior Manager, Finance
description:
**Role Summary**
 IORA Ecological Solutions is seeking a qualified Chartered Accountant with a minimum of 7–8 years of relevant post\-qualification experience to lead and strengthen the organisation’s finance and accounting function. The Senior Manager, Finance will provide leadership across financial management, accounting, statutory compliance, taxation, budgeting, financial reporting, project finance, internal controls, systems and financial planning. The role will work closely with the CEO and senior leadership and will be an important finance partner in supporting IORA’s organisational growth and project portfolio.
   

  

 The position combines strong technical finance and accounting responsibilities with systems strengthening, process improvement and an important external\-facing role. The Senior Manager, Finance will serve as the primary finance interface with international donors, funding agencies, development partners and other external stakeholders, and will be expected to represent IORA with credibility and professionalism.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Financial Management \& Accounting
* Lead end\-to\-end accounting operations and ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closure.
* Review financial statements, ledgers, bank reconciliations and statutory records to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking transactions, advances and other routine financial operations.
* Ensure effective cash management and timely availability of funds for organisational and project requirements.
* Provide financial oversight across IORA’s projects and programmes.
* Statutory Compliance, Taxation \& Audit
* Oversee TDS, GST, Income Tax and other applicable statutory compliances, filings and reconciliations.
* Coordinate statutory, internal, tax, donor and other audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Monitor changes in applicable financial and tax regulations and advise management on their implications.
* Ensure robust financial documentation, audit trails and compliance with applicable requirements.
* Financial Planning, Budgeting \& MIS
* Lead annual budgeting, financial forecasting and cash\-flow planning.
* Prepare and review monthly MIS, budget\-versus\-actual analysis, variance analysis and management reports.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support management decision\-making.
* Work with programme and project teams to prepare project budgets, monitor expenditure and manage financial performance.
* Support financial modelling and analysis for new projects, partnerships and funding opportunities.
* Internal Controls, Systems \& Process Improvement
* Strengthen IORA’s internal financial controls, SOPs, approval workflows and financial governance systems.
* Oversee accounting records in Tally/ERP and play a key role in the development and implementation of IORA’s new ERP and finance systems.
* Drive process improvements, automation and standardisation across finance operations.
* Ensure proper financial documentation and controls for procurement, payments, expenses, advances and project accounting.
* Identify financial risks and strengthen systems for risk mitigation and compliance.
* Project, Donor \& Grant Finance
* Provide financial oversight for externally funded projects, grants and partnerships, including budgeting, fund utilisation, financial reporting and compliance.
* Ensure compliance with donor\-specific financial requirements, contractual obligations and reporting timelines.
* Work closely with project teams and external partners to resolve financial issues and ensure effective financial management.
* Support preparation of financial components of project proposals, budgets, funding applications and partnership agreements.
* External Donor \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Serve as the primary point of contact for all finance\-related matters with international donors, funding agencies, development partners and other external stakeholders.
* Lead financial discussions with donors and partners on budgets, fund utilisation, financial reporting, audits, forecasts, amendments and financial queries.
* Prepare and deliver clear, compelling and decision\-oriented financial presentations and reports for donors, funders, partners and senior management.
* Represent IORA in finance\-related discussions with donors, funders, auditors, financial institutions and partners.
* Support senior management in engagement with prospective funders and partners, including financial due diligence, financial modelling, proposals and negotiations.
* Serve as a strong external face of IORA on financial matters, building confidence in IORA’s financial systems, controls and stewardship of funds.
* Team Leadership \& Organisational Support
* Lead, mentor and develop the finance team and promote a culture of accountability, accuracy and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a trusted finance partner to the CEO, senior management and project leads.
* Build financial management capacity across non\-finance teams.
* Work closely with internal teams and external consultants on finance\-related matters.


**Essential Qualifications \& Experience**
* Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) is essential.
* Minimum 7–8 years of relevant post\-qualification experience in finance and accounts, with experience in a role involving ownership of core finance functions.
* Strong experience in financial management, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, budgeting, financial reporting, audit management and internal controls.
* Demonstrated experience in managing or mentoring finance teams and working directly with senior management.
* Experience in managing donor\-funded projects, grants or partnerships, particularly with international donors or development agencies, is highly desirable.
* Experience in a consulting firm, professional services organisation, research organisation, NGO/development organisation or sustainability\-focused organisation is preferred.


**Technical \& Professional Skills**
* Strong working knowledge of accounting, TDS, GST, Income Tax, statutory compliance and audit requirements.
* Demonstrated experience in budgeting, financial forecasting, cash\-flow management, MIS, variance analysis and management reporting.
* Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, with the ability to translate financial information into actionable management insights.
* Strong presentation and communication skills, including the ability to develop clear, compelling financial presentations for donors, funders, partners and senior management.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP and advanced formulas; Power Query is a plus.
* Proficiency in Tally, ERP systems or other accounting software, with an interest in process automation and digital finance systems.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.


**What The Role Offers**
* A leadership role with direct exposure to the CEO and senior management and the opportunity to shape IORA’s finance function as the organisation grows.
* An opportunity to contribute beyond accounting and compliance, including financial planning, project and donor finance, financial analysis, systems strengthening and organisational decision\-making.
* Significant external exposure to international donors, funding agencies, development partners, auditors and other stakeholders.
* Exposure to diverse projects and partnerships spanning climate action, nature conservation, sustainable livelihoods, carbon markets and innovative finance.
* An opportunity to build robust, scalable finance systems and processes in a dynamic, mission\-driven organisation.


**Application Process**
 To apply, please submit your resume and a one\-page letter to careers@ioraecological.com stating your understanding of IORA, why you are interested in joining IORA, and where you see yourself after five years in collaboration with IORA.
   

  

 Subject Line: Application for Senior Manager, Finance
   

  

 To know more about IORA, please visit: https://ioraecological.com

* Have strong reconciliation and accounting\-control skills.

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx

* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.

title: Senior Analyst/Lead Analyst/Principal Analyst – Private Credit (Asset Management)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates to join the Asset Management function within our Private Credit team in the Financial Research group, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Gurugram. The Private Credit team underwrites investment opportunities across public and private corporate credit, commercial real estate, loan portfolios, and special situations in Europe and North America. The Asset Management function sits within this team, monitoring investment performance and dealing cash flows, and managing key commercial aspects of the portfolio including exit strategies, servicer effectiveness, and pricing.
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:
   

  

 On a day\-to\-day basis, you will oversee deal onboarding into proprietary platforms and develop comprehensive end\-to\-end reporting frameworks. You will review borrower business models, cash flow forecasts, debt capacity, and collateral, and perform detailed financial modeling, including ROI, IRR, and discounted cash flow analysis to support portfolio oversight and investment decisions. The role involves regular engagement with borrowers, lenders, and other stakeholders across calls and meetings. You will develop cash management strategies for future funding needs, oversee capital allocation and funding processes, and monitor company developments, competitor actions, and industry trends to inform strategic decisions. You will track covenant compliance, monitor portfolio investments, and contribute to the development of asset exit strategies. A critical function of this role is to identify and escalate early signs of asset distress or underperformance and lead restructuring, amendment, or workout processes for distressed assets. You will also support valuations, portfolio reviews, and business plan deviation analysis on monthly, quarterly, and annual cycles.
   

  

 WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* An MBA or equivalent in Finance, with 2 to 13 years of experience in corporate credit analysis and asset management, with a robust grounding in financial concepts and advanced quantitative modeling capabilities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with trading desks and stakeholders
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with keen attention to detail
* Proven experience leading complex projects


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* Experience with structured finance asset classes


 Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/SLAnlPCAMFinresMay2026
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
   

  

 The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

* Support the development of Global Value Dossiers (GVDs), Reimbursement Dossiers, and Manuscripts, ensuring high\-quality content that aligns with payer and publication standards
* Support in the development of impactful slide decks to effectively translate complex health economic evidence into clear, visually compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders
* Manage your own workload to ensure delivery according to agreed milestones and timelines
* Support project leads in day\-to\-day project activities, ensuring assigned tasks are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Collaborate closely with project team members, contributing to discussions and sharing ideas.
* Provide guidance and quality oversight to Analysts and Junior Associates.
* Contribute to internal knowledge\-building initiatives, training, and process improvement activities.


**Essential Requirements:**
* Postgraduate degree (M.pharm or equivalent) or PhD with 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in scientific discipline including HEOR, epidemiology, or market access
* Good oral/written communication skills along with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Working knowledge of office applications, e.g. MS Word/ PowerPoint/ Excel/EndNote


**Desired Requirements:**
* Hands\-on experience in Literature Review Reports, Value Dossiers and Manuscript writing

description:
**About OnDemand International** 




 OnDemand International is a global corporate services and business mobility firm supporting businesses, entrepreneurs, and enterprises with international company formation, compliance coordination, accounting support, and business expansion services.
 



 Our finance function manages multi\-entity and multi\-currency operations across India, the UK, Europe, Australia, Singapore, and other international markets. We are looking for a strong finance professional who can bring structure, accuracy, reporting discipline, financial control, and operational visibility to a growing global business.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are hiring a 
 **Senior Finance Manager – International Finance Operations \& Management** 




**Reporting** 
  to manage and strengthen our finance function across multiple countries. This role is best suited for candidates with a strong academic background in commerce, accounting, and finance, preferably with a 
 **B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance** 
  qualification, along with hands\-on experience in accounting operations, management reporting, financial controls, reconciliations, compliance coordination, and team management. The position requires a practical finance professional who can run day\-to\-day finance operations, review books, manage reporting timelines, coordinate with country\-level accountants and advisors, and present clear financial visibility to senior management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Financial Control \& Management Reporting
 



 • Own financial control across all OnDemand International entities, ensuring accuracy,
 



 completeness, and integrity of books across multiple jurisdictions.
 



 • Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports to the Managing Partner and
 



 leadership team.
 



 • Lead month\-end and year\-end closing activities across multiple entities.
 



 • Monitor cash flow, working capital, receivables, payables, expenses, and financial performance
 



 across the group.
 



 • Build and maintain reporting dashboards, MIS reports, and management accounts for leadership
 



 review.
 



 • Ensure internal approval workflows, payment controls, documentation, and reporting systems are
 



 properly followed.
 



 • Support the development and implementation of internal finance controls, reporting formats, and
 



 review mechanisms.
 



  





**Multi\-Country Finance Operations** 




 • Oversee finance operations across India, the UK, Europe, Australia, Singapore, and other relevant
 



 jurisdictions.
 



 • Coordinate with local accountants, bookkeepers, auditors, tax advisors, and statutory agents in
 



 each country.
 



 • Ensure books are maintained in line with applicable country\-level accounting and reporting
 



 requirements.
 



 • Manage multi\-currency accounting, inter\-company transactions, reconciliations, and consolidated
 



 group\-level reporting.
 



 • Maintain financial records, entity\-wise reports, and country\-wise compliance trackers.
 



 • Ensure timely coordination for accounting updates, reporting deadlines, statutory filings, and
 



 management review requirements.
 



  





**Accounting \& Bookkeeping Oversight** 




 • Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, payroll accounting,
 



 expense booking, invoicing, and general ledger maintenance.
 



 • Review journal entries, vendor payments, client invoices, expense claims, and reconciliations
 



 prepared by the accounting team.
 



 • Ensure proper chart of accounts, accounting structure, documentation, and reporting discipline
 



 across entities.• Identify gaps in existing accounting processes and implement practical systems to improve accuracy, efficiency, and control.• Identify gaps in existing accounting processes and implement practical systems to improve accuracy, efficiency, and control.
 



 • Ensure finance records are properly maintained and available for management review, external
 



 advisors, and audit coordination.
 



  





**Tax \& Compliance Coordination** 




 • Track direct and indirect tax\-related obligations across operating entities, including GST/VAT,
 



 corporation tax, withholding tax, payroll\-related statutory requirements, and other recurring
 



 filings.
 



 • Coordinate with external tax advisors and country\-specific consultants for filings, clarifications,
 



 documentation, and compliance updates.
 



 • Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure internal follow\-up so that deadlines are not missed.
 



 • Review tax and compliance information from an operational finance perspective before
 



 submission to external advisors.
 



 • Support management with visibility on upcoming compliance requirements, filing status, and
 



 pending action items.
 



  





**Team Management** 




 • Lead and manage a team of accountants, bookkeepers, and finance executives working across
 



 multiple entities.
 



 • Allocate responsibilities, review work quality, set reporting timelines, and ensure accountability
 



 within the finance team.
 



 • Act as the senior finance escalation point for internal teams and management.
 



 • Build systems, process notes, checklists, and documentation to reduce dependency on individuals
 



 and make the finance function scalable.
 



 • Train and guide team members to improve accuracy, reporting quality, and process discipline.
 



  





**Required Candidate Profile** 




**We are looking for candidates who have:** 




 • 8–10\+ years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, MIS, management reporting, and
 



 finance operations.
 



 • Strong academic foundation in commerce, accounting, and finance.
 



 • B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance background preferred.
 



 • Hands\-on experience managing books, reports, reconciliations, cash flow, payables, receivables,
 



 and management accounts.
 



 • Experience working with multi\-entity or multi\-country finance operations.
 



 • Ability to review the work of accountants and bookkeepers across different entities.
 



 • Strong understanding of financial reporting, consolidation, inter\-company transactions, and multi\-
 



 currency accounting.
 



 • Practical working knowledge of GST/VAT, tax coordination, statutory filing timelines, and
 



 compliance tracking.
 



 • Experience using accounting platforms such as Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, SAP, or
 



 similar systems.
 



 • Strong Excel, MIS, reporting, and financial analysis skills.
 



 • Ability to work directly with founders, senior management, and internal business teams.
 



 • Demonstrated continuity, ownership, and depth of experience in previous finance roles.
 



  





**Educational Preference** 




**Strong preference will be given to candidates with:** 




 • B.Com / M.Com / accounting\-based graduation.
 



 • MBA in Finance from a recognised institution.
 



 • Hands\-on finance operations and reporting experience in a company, group, consulting firm, or
 



 multi\-entity business environment.
 



  





 This role is best aligned with candidates who have practical experience in corporate finance operations, accounting management, MIS reporting, reconciliations, multi\-entity finance coordination, and management\-level financial reporting. Candidates from audit, taxation, advisory, or statutory compliance backgrounds are welcome to apply, provided they have practical experience managing in\-house finance operations, accounting teams, reporting cycles, reconciliations, and management reporting.
 



**Preferred Background** 




 • Prior experience in a corporate services firm, consulting company, international business group, or
 



 multi\-entity organisation.
 



 • Experience reporting directly to founders, directors, managing partners, or senior leadership.
 



 • Exposure to international accounting coordination across countries such as the UK, Europe,
 



 Australia, Singapore, or India.
 



 • Experience managing finance teams and creating scalable reporting processes.
 



 • Understanding of cross\-border inter\-company structures and transfer pricing coordination will be
 



 an advantage.
 



  





**Candidate Requirements** 




 • Must be based in Delhi NCR or willing to commute daily to the Delhi office.
 



 • This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office role. There is no remote or hybrid option.
 



 • Immediate or early joiners will be preferred.
 



 • Candidates with demonstrated ownership and meaningful tenure in previous finance roles will be
 



 prioritised.
 



 • Must be comfortable working in a fast\-paced, founder\-led, multi\-entity business environment.
 



  





**Why Join OnDemand International** 




 This is a senior, high\-ownership finance role with direct access to the Managing Partner and exposure to international business operations across multiple countries. You will not be limited to maintaining one company’s books. You will be responsible for building, managing, and improving a finance function that supports a growing global business. The role offers strong exposure to international finance operations, management reporting, multi\-entity accounting, team leadership, compliance coordination, and financial process building.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates may send their CV at
 **:** 
  
 **hr@ondemandint.com** 




  





**Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Interviews will be conducted in person at our Delhi** 




**office.**

title: Business Finance Manager
description:
**About Virohan:** 




 Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal, Virohan is an
 **education–to\-industry partner** 
 building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry\- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real\-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms.
 **Our model combines academic learning with hands\-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles.** 
 Today, Virohan has trained 13,000\+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
 



 Backed by
 **global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),** 
 we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest\-growing sectors.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We train India's next Allied Healthcare Professionals and we need someone who is a highly analytical and business\-oriented
 **Business Finance professional (Leadership Role) who treats each campus like their own company, not just a row in a spreadsheet and can drive financial performance through data\-driven insights and strategic decision\-making** 
 . This is not a traditional accounting or controllership role. This is for someone who wants to be in the room where growth, admissions, and campus operations decisions are made; bringing the financial lens that turns good intentions into profitable outcomes.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




 Most finance people explain the P\&L after the quarter ends. We want someone who changes it before it does. If you've ever sat in a business meeting thinking "I could've told you that three weeks ago", this is your seat.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 ● Run the numbers behind real campuses, enrollments, faculty costs, placements, profitability. Know them cold.
 



 ● Be in the room, not the report; sit with Business Heads and speak up before decisions are made, not just summarize them after.
 



 ● Chase the "why" behind the money; why did this channel's cost\-per\-enrollment spike? Why is one campus profitable and a near\-identical one isn't?
 



 ● Follow the cash all the way home from student loan approval to actual money in the bank.
 



 ● Build the model before anyone asks for it; forecasts, business cases, what\-ifs are rooted in real batch sizes and seat fill rates, not last year's numbers with 15% added on.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 ● 3 to 6 years in FP\&A or business finance; bonus if it's EdTech, healthtech, FinTech, or another fast\-moving, multi\-location business
 



 ● You've worked with business teams, not just for them
 



 ● Excel/Sheets fluent; SQL or BI tools a bonus
 



 ● You can explain a complex model in one sentence a non\-finance person gets instantly
 



 ● Curious by default; you ask "why" before you build the spreadsheet
 



 ● Confident enough to challenge a decision with data, even without authority over the room
 



  





**Bonus Points.** 




 ● CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA. Startup scars preferred over big\-company polish.
 



  





**Winning Looks Like** 




 ● Six months in, a Business Head calls you before making a big call, not after. And you can point to one real number you moved.
 



  





**If you believe in making an impact on society and are keen to be a part of the fast growing healthcare education sector, we would be delighted to hear from you!**

This role sits at the intersection of freight operations and accounting — you will be responsible for POD (Proof of Delivery) management, carrier invoice processing and reconciliation, accessorial claims, and customer invoicing for US truckload/freight shipments. **POD (Proof of Delivery) Management:** 



* Collect POD documents from carriers/drivers via email, portals, or carrier calls, and upload them accurately into the TMS (Transportation Management System) within defined turnaround times.
* Track and maintain the POD Reduction Report — identifying loads with missing, delayed, or incomplete PODs.
* Apply rate deductions/reductions for late POD submission as per company SOP, and present findings and trends in weekly team meetings.
* Ensure PODs are matched correctly against the Bill of Lading (BOL) and shipment/load number before filing.



  





**Carrier Invoice Processing \& Reconciliation:** 



* Upload carrier invoices into the TMS/accounting system and match them against agreed rates, rate confirmations, and load details (a form of three\-way match: BOL, POD, invoice).
* Identify billing discrepancies (rate mismatches, duplicate billing, unsupported accessorials, weight/quantity mismatches) and proactively communicate them to the sender (carrier/dispatcher) for correction.
* Maintain clear audit trails and documentation for every discrepancy raised and resolved.



  





**Accessorial Charges:** 



* Review, verify, and apply for all applicable accessorial charges, including detention, layover (LO), lumper fees, and other shipment\-related charges, with correct supporting documentation (timestamps, signed tickets, receipts, etc.).
* Validate that accessorial claims are within contractual/company guidelines before submission or approval.



  





**Open Loads \& Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 



* Monitor and manage the open/unresolved loads queue; work daily with Operations, Carrier Sales, and Customer Service to close out pending load files.
* Chase down missing information (PODs, signed rate confirmations, accessorial backup, etc.) required to finalize billing, escalating aged items as needed.



  





**Documentation Compliance:** 



* Ensure that all documentation pertaining to a shipment — BOL, POD, rate confirmation, accessorial backup, and any exception/claim paperwork \- is complete, accurate, and properly filed in the TMS before a load is closed or billed.



  





**Customer Invoicing** 



* Generate and submit accurate, timely customer invoices via billing/invoicing portals such as Ascend (and other client\-specific portals as required).
* Ensure invoiced amounts reconcile with agreed customer rates, accessorials, and supporting shipment documentation before submission.
* Follow up on portal rejections or invoice queries raised by customers.



  





**Reporting** 



* Prepare and present recurring reports (POD reduction, open loads aging, invoicing status) in internal review/weekly meetings. Flag recurring issues or process gaps to management for resolution.



  





**Key Competencies Attention to Detail** 



* catches discrepancies and errors others might miss Ownership \& Follow\-Through
* chases open items (loads, discrepancies, missing docs) to closure Organization \& Time Management
* handles high transaction volumes without backlog Cross\-Team Collaboration
* coordinates effectively with Ops, Carrier Sales, and Customer Service Process Discipline
* adheres consistently to documentation, billing, and compliance procedures Communication
* clear, professional communication with US\-based carriers and internal stakeholders



  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 



* POD collection and TMS uploads consistently within SLA turnaround
* Minimal aged/open loads due to proactive daily follow\-up
* Carrier invoice discrepancies flagged and resolved quickly and accurately
* Accessorial claims (detention/LO/lumper) submitted correctly with full backup, first time
* Shipment files complete with no missing documentation at closeout
* Customer invoices submitted accurately and on time via Ascend/other portals
* Clear, data\-backed weekly reporting on POD reduction and open load trends



  





**Note:** 
 The above is representative of the core duties of this role and is not exhaustive. The Company reserves the right to add, modify, or remove duties and responsibilities at its discretion, based on business requirements.

title: Senior Manager, Strategy - Franchise Strategy & Special Projects
description:
**Role Purpose**
 This role acts as a central Strategy bridge between the OU and the Integrated Operations function, helping translate Company and OU priorities into clear system implications, execution imperatives, and market\-level priorities.
   

  

 Working closely with Integrated Operations, the role brings strategic clarity, fact\-based challenge, and a consistent cross\-system lens to ensure OU priorities and growth opportunities are reflected in Bottling Partner planning and execution discussions. It also helps identify gaps, opportunities, and interventions across plans and performance to strengthen alignment and improve system execution.
   

  

**What You’ll Do For Us**
**Insights\-Led Strategy and Initiatives**
* Connect data, analytics, research, and consumer, customer, category, channel, competitive, and market insights to identify granular growth opportunities across channels, customers, and geographies.
* Translate insights into clear system implications, growth choices, and execution priorities for Integrated Operations and Bottling Partners.
* Use a fact\-based, hypothesis\-driven approach to challenge assumptions and sharpen local strategies.
* Identify, frame, and conduct preliminary evaluation of strategic initiatives that support OU priorities and system growth objectives.


**Strategic Projects**
* Actively contribute to select strategic projects linked to OU priorities, partnering with Integrated Operations teams and OU functions to bring structure, strategic clarity, and execution discipline to priority initiatives.
* Ensure disciplined project governance—clear objectives, success metrics, timelines, and accountability.


**Strategic Integration \& Execution**
* Act as a central Strategy partner connecting OU priorities, Integrated Operations plans, and Bottling Partner execution agendas.
* Translate Company and OU priorities into clear commercial and execution imperatives for Bottling Partners, ensuring consistency across markets while allowing for local context.
* Help translate global and Company “where to play” priorities into OU\-relevant implications, market\-level choices, and Bottling Partner execution priorities.
* Support Integrated Operations teams by bringing strategic clarity, fact\-based challenge, and an enterprise\-wide perspective into Bottling Partner planning discussions.
* Partner with Integrated Operations teams to calibrate and refine commercial execution strategies based on market realities, OU priorities, and Bottling Partner capabilities.
* Act as a thought partner to Integrated Operations Leads, bringing rigor, clarity, and pace to strategy development and priority initiatives.


**Performance Measurement \& Learning**
* Assess Bottling Partner performance against OU priorities, agreed business plans, and key strategic initiatives.
* Identify common performance patterns, execution gaps, risks, and scalable opportunities across Bottling Partners and markets.
* Objectively assess the impact of strategic initiatives, codifying what worked, what did not, and translating learnings into future strategies, planning processes, and execution priorities.
* Build mechanisms to network best practices, importing and exporting scalable ideas across markets and Bottling Partners.


**Enterprise Contribution**
* Contribute to business\-critical OU initiatives and leadership discussions through structured analysis, clear recommendations, a system lens, and execution rigor.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of progressive experience across Strategy, Growth, Insights, Planning, Commercial Strategy, Sales, or related business roles.
* Preferred experience in strategy consulting or equivalent strategy roles, with exposure to structured problem\-solving, hypothesis\-led analysis, stakeholder engagement, and translating insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong understanding of FMCG industry, with the ability to translate consumer, customer, channel, and market dynamics into actionable commercial strategies and execution priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, work effectively in cross\-functional teams, and contribute clear, fact\-based recommendations to senior business discussions.
* Experience working in complex, matrixed, and culturally diverse environments.
* Strong analytical orientation combined with practical, execution\-focused thinking.
* Experience using digital tools, analytics platforms, and AI\-enabled solutions to improve analysis, generate insights, and enhance the quality and speed of strategic decision\-making.


**Success enablers**
* Strong ability to develop compelling, actionable consumer and commercial insights at market level.
* Ability to translate strategy into clear execution roadmaps, governance rhythms, and measurable commercial outcomes
* Ability to operate with a system and portfolio lens, connecting OU priorities, market realities, and Bottling Partner performance and commercial opportunities into clear strategic choices
* Ability to manage ambiguity and complexity while working with multiple cross\-functional stakeholders across the system.
* Ability to influence without authority in cross\-functional, matrixed, and Bottling Partner\-facing environments.
* Collaborative, inclusive, enterprise\-first mindset consistent with “Leadership in the Network.”


**Core Competencies And Skills**
* Data\-Driven Decision Making: Ability to analyze large datasets and translate insights into actionable commercial strategies.
* Strategic Problem Solving: Structured approach to solving complex business challenges, informed by data and an intuitive understanding of “Future Back” and “Present Forward” perspectives.
* Foresight \& Innovation: Strong ability to anticipate short\- and long\-term business challenges, identify opportunities, and shape strategies for growth in competitive markets.
* Communication Excellence: Proficiency in storytelling through data\-driven presentations, conveying complex ideas with clarity, and customizing messaging for diverse audiences.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to effectively collaborate across functions such as Marketing, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on initiatives
* Digital \& AI Fluency: Ability to use digital tools, analytics platforms, and AI\-enabled applications to strengthen problem\-solving, insight generation, storytelling, and decision support.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Listing: Supervising Associate \-**
**Job Listing Detail**
 At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help build a better working world.
   

  

**Domain Analyst**
**The opportunity**
 As a Domain Analyst at Supervising Associate rank at EY this role goes well beyond research delivery. You will specialize in key domain topics, contributing to EY's distinctive perspective on client issues to support commercial impact and business development. You will support specific programs within your area of expertise to drive the global or regional domain and specific accounts' growth ambitions. Working alongside the Domain Lead Analyst and/or Coordinating Analyst, you will deliver impactful analysis and insights for your domain and its activation with clients. Your role will involve providing analytical support and strategic advice on domain developments to EY leadership and sometimes clients, in your areas of specialism.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Develop an internal brand to become recognized within EY as a subject matter expert in specific topic areas.
* Engage with senior domain stakeholders to provide commercial perspectives on the issues, challenges, and opportunities facing the domain and prepare insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients.
* Regularly interact and present to internal EY stakeholders, participate in account meetings, and support domain leaders, solution leaders, and senior stakeholders in preparing for client meetings and events.
* Create commercial impact for EY by activating content with client servers across the EY network and proactively identifying opportunities for EY.
* Collaborate with domain stakeholders and EY colleagues across Insights and Clients and Industries to bring insights that support business development activities and service delivery to clients.
* Co\-create insights/PoV with EY SMEs with an audience\-first mindset and present them in a clear, compelling way.
* Proactively contribute your own ideas for insights for the domain, based on business priorities and an understanding of the domain's dynamics.
* Lead the creation of specific insights within areas of specialism by leveraging EY's proprietary knowledge and using data modelling and technology tools including AI while collaborating with Clients and Industries colleagues.
* Support the activation of specific external thought leadership across the EY network.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-domain collaboration and share insights with other Insights and Clients and Industries teams.
* Synthesize diverse perspectives and sources to develop compelling insights that drive results.
* Identify trends and translate them into key market\-facing initiatives for EY.
* Familiarize yourself with high\-quality sources of data in your domain and use both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis methodologies to generate insights.
* Understand the firm's go\-to\-market strategy and how Insights support exceptional client service.
* Continually build skills in research, analysis, data analytics, and visualization.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong presentation skills, with experience influencing internal decision\-makers.
* Demonstrate high usage of advanced technological tools available for research.
* Demonstrated experience in a fast\-paced, client\-driven environment.
* A self\-starter, able to bring new ideas for new insights to leadership.
* Collaborative and able to work effectively in a global, multi\-cultural environment.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, capable of explaining complex concepts clearly and concisely.
* Ability to proactively build a network of internal and external contacts to shape insights.
* Proficient in managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Adheres to key quality standards.


**What We Look For**
 University/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. Master's degree or postgraduate qualification preferred.
   

  

* 5\-7 years' experience in strategy, business analysis, industry research, management consulting, or business performance, advising organizations in the relevant domain.
* May require occasional travel, both domestic and international.
* Proficient in English, both written and verbal.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we'll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Cost Manager  - Procurement
description:
**Who is Turner \& Townsend?**




 All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.
   

  





**Our purpose:**




**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**




 The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.
   

  





**Our values:**




**Love a challenge:** 
 We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.
   

  





**Stronger together:** 
 We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.
   

  





**Bring out the best in everyone:** 
 We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Role Overview
   

  





 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced
 **Cost Manager – Procurement** 
 with
 **8–10 years of experience** 
 in procurement, sourcing, cost management, contract administration, and supplier management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving procurement strategy, optimizing project and operational costs, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring timely procurement of materials and services while achieving commercial objectives.
   

  





 The role requires strong commercial acumen, negotiation expertise, and experience in managing procurement activities for construction, real estate, infrastructure, manufacturing, industrial, or engineering projects.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Procurement Strategy \& Planning
   

  




* Develop and execute procurement strategies aligned with organizational and project goals.
* Prepare procurement schedules and sourcing plans for various projects and operational requirements.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction and procurement process improvements.
* Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and procurement planning activities.



 Cost Management \& Control
   

  




* Develop detailed cost estimates and procurement budgets.
* Monitor procurement spend against approved budgets and identify cost\-saving opportunities.
* Analyze market trends, pricing fluctuations, and supplier performance to optimize procurement costs.
* Implement value engineering and strategic sourcing initiatives to maximize savings.



 Sourcing \& Supplier Management
   

  




* Lead sourcing activities for materials, equipment, subcontractors, and services.
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard qualified vendors and suppliers.
* Conduct supplier assessments, audits, and performance evaluations.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with key suppliers and stakeholders.



 Tendering \& Contract Management
   

  




* Manage the end\-to\-end tendering process, including RFQs, RFPs, bid evaluations, and supplier negotiations.
* Review technical and commercial proposals to ensure alignment with project requirements.
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, and contracts with suppliers and subcontractors.
* Administer contracts and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.



 Commercial \& Risk Management
   

  




* Assess procurement\-related risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and governance standards.
* Manage supplier claims, disputes, and contract variations.
* Evaluate procurement risks associated with supply chain disruptions and market volatility.



 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  




* Collaborate with project teams, engineering, finance, operations, and project controls departments.
* Support project managers in achieving cost and schedule objectives.
* Present procurement performance reports and cost analyses to management.
* Act as a key liaison between internal stakeholders and suppliers.



 Reporting \& Process Improvement
   

  




* Prepare procurement dashboards, spend analysis reports, and savings reports.
* Monitor procurement KPIs and identify opportunities for operational efficiency.
* Support digital procurement initiatives and ERP optimization projects.
* Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes and controls.


**Qualifications**

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum
 **8–10 years of experience** 
 in procurement, sourcing, commercial management, or cost management.
* Experience in handling large\-value procurement packages and supplier negotiations.
* Proven track record of delivering cost savings and procurement efficiencies.


**Additional Information**

 Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
   

  





 We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work\-life balance.
   

  





 Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.
   

  





 Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

title: Senior Team Manager – Energy & Industrials, Expert Content
description:
Position summary
   

  

 The Senior Team Manager leads the Energy \& Industrials Expert Content team and is accountable for its portfolio direction, research quality, talent development and delivery. The role converts market and client demand into coverage priorities, assigns topic ownership across sub\-sector and asset\-class subject matter experts, manages capacity, and develops the team’s sector expertise, ideation, research judgment and interviewing capabilities.
   

  

 The role requires deep knowledge of Energy \& Industrials, working knowledge of adjacent sectors, a broad understanding of relevant asset classes and strong investor\-oriented judgment. The Senior Team Manager interprets earnings calls, management commentary, analyst questions and market developments; connects insights across the team’s work; and uses that perspective to originate differentiated research concepts, synthesis products and selected expert conversations.
   

  

 Location: Gurugram, India
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Coverage strategy and prioritization
   

  

* Set and maintain the coverage roadmap for the Energy \& Industrials team, including priority coverage areas, companies, themes, recurring programs and known gaps.
* Translate global Expert Content strategy and priorities, content viewership and usage trends, client and Sales feedback, regional demand and market developments into coverage priorities, format choices, capacity decisions and an appropriate geographic balance across APAC, the United States and other priority markets.
* Identify cross\-company themes, divergent views, emerging risks and content gaps, connecting macro and sector developments to company\-level and investment implications.
* Challenge the team to pursue original angles beyond familiar companies, topics and approaches, and determine primary and supporting ownership when sub\-sector, asset\-class, geographic or thematic expertise overlaps.


 Team leadership and capability building
   

  

* Lead, coach and performance\-manage the team’s sub\-sector and asset\-class subject matter experts, and provide research direction and quality calibration for Associates supporting the team.
* Assign ownership of individual topics and manage work queues, capacity, delivery cadence and escalations across the team.
* Lead regular sector discussions that surface new signals, test interpretations, generate content ideas and build the team’s collective expertise.
* Review research plans, expert profiles, interview questions and completed transcripts; observe selected interviews; and coach research approach, sector judgment and interviewing technique.
* Build a shared understanding of quality, insight and investor value through transcript calibration, direct feedback and structured coaching that strengthen execution and judgment across the team’s subject matter experts (SMEs).


 Research innovation, synthesis and quality
   

  

* Originate differentiated research concepts, conversation structures, recurring series and synthesis formats; work with relevant internal partners to turn viable ideas into clear research objectives, required expert perspectives and execution plans.
* Produce and review sector\-level and thematic research that connects insights across multiple expert interviews, companies and perspectives, presenting a more comprehensive view of what the collective evidence may indicate without making investment recommendations.
* Use AI tools and effective prompts to accelerate synthesis and drafting while independently validating the underlying evidence, adding context and strengthening the final analysis.
* Personally conduct or moderate selected high\-value expert conversations where senior sector experience can materially improve the depth, originality or integration of the insights generated.
* Set standards for expert fit, question design, interview execution and research quality; coach interviewers to listen actively, adapt beyond prepared questions and pursue valuable unanticipated lines of inquiry.
* Use performance data and recurring quality or workflow issues to identify coverage gaps, guide coaching and improve research practices, templates and processes; ensure recurring insights and effective research approaches are documented and applied across future coverage, and that all work meets established quality, confidentiality and compliance requirements.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10–13 years of relevant experience in buy\-side investment research, equity or credit research, strategy consulting, corporate strategy, transaction advisory or a comparable research leadership role.
* Demonstrated depth within Energy \& Industrials, including its major industries and value chains, combined with working knowledge of adjacent sectors, relevant asset classes and broader market dynamics.
* Experience serving institutional investors or another sophisticated financial audience, with a strong understanding of how investors frame decisions and uncertainty.
* Ability to synthesize earnings calls, market developments and primary research into themes, risks, differentiated research concepts and decision\-useful outputs.
* Demonstrated ability to originate differentiated research concepts; translate them into clear objectives, expert profiles and interview structures; and frame incisive, investor\-relevant questions.
* People leadership and coaching experience, including facilitating thoughtful team discussion and strengthening SMEs’ research judgment, capabilities and performance.
* Credible live\-interviewing capability and the ability to coach others in active listening, probing, real\-time adaptation and moderation technique.
* Strong written and verbal English, research judgment and operating discipline to convert strategy into priorities, quality controls and measurable delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of financial statements, operating drivers and valuation context sufficient to evaluate investor\-relevant research across Energy \& Industrials.
* Strong interest in financial markets, company and industry analysis, and business dynamics, with the curiosity and discipline to maintain deep sector expertise and relevant cross\-sector and asset\-class awareness.
* Comfort using AI\-enabled research tools and developing effective prompts to accelerate synthesis, drafting and workflow without substituting for human judgment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* A track record of establishing or scaling research teams, coverage models, quality standards, training programs or knowledge repositories.
* Experience integrating equity, credit, private\-market or other relevant investor perspectives into sector research.
* Experience in expert networks or scaled primary research; MBA, CFA, CA or a relevant advanced qualification.


**About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group**
 GLG is the world’s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision\-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.

title: Tax Senior - Business Tax Services - US Corporate Tax, Operating Partnerships, Private Equity, Investment Management, Real Estate, Fund of Funds, Insurance, RIC, GIR
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 U.S. Business Tax Services \- Tax Senior
   

  

 Tax Senior \- US Corporate Tax, Operating Partnerships, Private Equity, Investment Management, Real Estate, Fund of Funds, Insurance, Regulated Investment Company
   

  

 Do you have a passion to work for U.S. based clients of Deloitte Tax and help transform their current tax practice to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to take the next step in your career, and find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations? Are you ready to fulfil your potential, and have a significant impact on global initiatives? If the answer to all the above is "Yes," come join the Business Tax Services group in Deloitte India (Offices of the U.S.), a service line of Deloitte Tax LLP!
   

  

 Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited ("USI Tax") commenced operations in June 2004\. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines have obtained support through the USI Tax teams.
   

  

 Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and tax technical resources to comply with the reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
   

  

 Work You’ll Do:
   

  

* Provide tax compliance services to US\-based clients of Deloitte Tax, including income and other types of tax return preparation and computations.
* Focus on business tax return compliance, including projections and tax accounting for U.S. federal, state, and international tax matters, and related advisory services.
* Perform detail\-level reviews of tax research, regulated investment company (RIC) tax work papers, financial statement provisions, related tax disclosures, federal and relevant state returns, excise calculations, and RIC compliance tests.
* Perform tax planning and supervise tax consultants.
* Attend required Deloitte Tax LLP and sector\-specific training.
* Review partnership work papers, allocations, and tax returns for Hedge Fund Tax practice, and prepare materials and research for consulting projects related to tax planning opportunities.
* Coordinate and communicate with client contacts to gather information to complete tax returns.
* Train, mentor, and supervise new and experienced\-level staff.


 The Team
   

  

 Accelerating globalization, growing regulatory and business complexity, and the evolution of tax technology are creating ever\-increasing expectations for tax executives. At Deloitte, we are leading clients through change, uncovering insights, and providing strategic value to organizations. Our approach combines insight and innovation from multiple disciplines with business and industry knowledge to help serve our clients with distinction. You will be based in India and are part of the US team serving our U.S. based clients.
   

  

 Work Location: Hyderabad/Gurugram/Pune/Bengaluru/Chennai/Kolkata/Mumbai
   

  

 Shift Timings: 7 AM to 4 PM \| 11 AM to 8 PM \| 2 PM to 11 PM
   

  

 Required Qualification
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in US Federal Tax \- Corporate, Partnership, Private Wealth, Trust, Investment Management \- Hedge Funds, Private Equity, Mutual Funds, Regulated Investment Companies \- Forms 1120, 1065
* Enrolled Agent or other appropriate certification (or in the process of pursuing)
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or another business\-related field
* Prior Big 4 experience or equivalent experience
* Knowledge of fund accounting and general ledger accounting a plus
* Experience with managing projects including scheduling, budgeting, client correspondence and billing, excellent technology (i.e., Microsoft Excel and compliance software), research and writing skills.


 \#CA\-AG
   

  

 \#CA\-HPN
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Senior Cash Transfer Analyst
description:
**Job Description:** 




 IPE Global Limited invites applications from eligible candidates for the position of
 **Senior Cash Transfer Analyst** 
 to support the strengthening and implementation of the Cash Transfer Scheme.
 



 The position will provide programmatic, analytical, and coordination support to improve the implementation, monitoring, and governance of the schemes. The Analyst will work closely with the national team, technical partners, project state teams, and other key stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**1\. Programme Monitoring \& Implementation Support** 



* Support the national team in monitoring the implementation of the Scheme across various states. Track programme performance, enrolment, approvals, benefit disbursement, pendency and key implementation indicators.
* Support development and revision of implementation strategies, SOPs, advisories, operational tools and review formats. Support development and revision of implementation strategies, SOPs, advisories, operational tools and review formats.
* Identify implementation bottlenecks and support coordination with the national and the state teams.



**2\. Data Management \& Analysis** 



* Compile, clean and analyse programme data and other relevant datasets to generate actionable insights.
* Conduct trend analysis to identify coverage gaps, operational issues and high\-priority geographies.
* Prepare dashboards, presentations and analytical summaries for reviews and decision\-making.
* Support periodic data validation and quality improvement exercises.



  





**3\. Government Engagement \& Programme Strengthening** 



* Coordinate with various Government stakeholders and other partners on programme implementation issues.
* Support national review meetings, consultations, workshops and capacity\-building initiatives.
* Follow up on action points emerging from reviews and ensure timely reporting by teams.



  





**4\. Documentation \& Knowledge Management** 



* Prepare monthly, quarterly and ad\-hoc reports, briefing notes and presentations.
* Document implementation challenges, best practices, innovations and success stories from the project states.
* Support preparation of policy notes, concept notes and technical documents.



  





**5\. Capacity Building \& Technical Assistance** 



* Support development of training materials, user guides and communication resources related to various Cash Transfer Schemes.
* Provide technical support to project states on scheme processes , MIS functionality and reporting requirements.
* Coordinate with technical team to address system\-related issues and improve user adoption.



  





 As job descriptions cannot be exhaustive, the Cash Transfer Analyst may be required to undertake other duties as determined by the Cash Transfer Expert that are broadly in line with the above key responsibilities.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience:** 




**Essential**



* Postgraduate degree in Public Policy, Economics, Public Administration, Social Sciences, Management, Statistics or a related field.
* 5\-8 years of experience supporting Government of India programmes, preferably in DBT, social protection, health or nutrition.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in Excel and presentation development; familiarity with MIS data analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



  





**Desirable**



* Experience working on national cash transfer schemes or social protection programmes.
* Knowledge of DBT, PFMS and government programme implementation processes.

title: Strategic Operations Partner
description:
**Seeking  Operations Co\-Pilot \& Right\-Hand (Industry \- Petroleum Logistics)** 




  





**Location:** 
 100% Remote / Work from Home
 



**Reports To:** 
 Company Owner (Direct partnership)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Work Schedule:** 
 Monday–Friday \| Shift starts \~11:00 AM U.S. Central Time (Nighttime / Overnight shift in India)
 



**Hours:** 
 Minimum 45 hours/week (Ranges from 45 to 55\+ hours based on fluctuating live volume)
 



**Compensation:** 
 Fixed (₹12 Lakhs per annum)\+ Direct Performance\-Based Bonuses 
 



**Position Summary** 




 This is
 **not a corporate management job** 
 . We are a fast\-moving organization. Because our team is tiny,
 **everyone does everything** 
 . The workload fluctuates rapidly—some days are quiet and require deep\-focus administrative work; other days are high\-stress, chaotic, and require rapid\-fire multitasking to handle live U.S. fuel distribution.
 



 We are looking for an adaptable, multi\-skilled
 **Operations Co\-Pilot** 
 to act as the Owner’s right hand. You must be equally comfortable executing basic data entry (Accounts Payable/Receivable) and building high\-level operational systems (SOPs, Excel dashboards, KPIs). If you are looking for a rigid, single\-task job description, this is not the role for you. If you want to help build a business from the ground up and share in its financial success, read on.
 



**Mandatory Remote Work Infrastructure** 




 Because you will be the absolute lifeline of live U.S. operations during overnight hours, you
 **must** 
 have this infrastructure 100% ready before day one:
 



 · High\-speed, enterprise\-grade reliable internet.
 



 · A completely independent backup internet connection (dual\-line setup).
 



 · Heavy\-duty UPS or generator capable of keeping your PC and router alive during outages.
 



 · A completely quiet, private home office for professional U.S. business communications.

**1\. Live Logistics \& Emergency Multitasking (High\-Volume Days)**

 **QuickBooks/Xero** 
 .

 .

**Requirements:** 




**· 7\+ Years of Swiss\-Army\-Knife Experience:** 
 A proven track record in operations where you were required to wear multiple hats (Logistics, Finance, and Administration).
 



**· Industry Match:** 
 Deep exposure to fuel distribution, petroleum, freight tracking, or heavy logistics is highly preferred.
 



**· The Accountant\-Analyst Hybrid:** 
 High comfort level managing financial numbers combined with
 **expert\-level Microsoft Excel skills** 
 .
 



**· Impeccable English:** 
 Flawless spoken and written English to confidently handle U.S. suppliers, vendors, and clients.
 



**· The "No Excuses" Mindset:** 
 A strong, self\-reliant personality who thrives working directly with a business owner without a layer of middle management.
 



**Must Have Skills:** 




 · 
 



**· High\-Speed Multitasking:** 
 Switches instantly between live phone calls, driver tracking, and urgent emails during chaotic logistics emergencies.
 



**· Rapid Problem Solving:** 
 Thinks fast under pressure to resolve supply stockouts, missed deliveries, and route delays instantly.
 



**· Dynamic Range:** 
 Alternates seamlessly between high\-level operational design and tedious data\-entry grunt work.
 



**· Extreme Autonomy:** 
 Makes confident, executive operational decisions on the fly without needing hand\-holding or owner approval.
 



**· Data Reconciler:**
