title: Category Manager
description:
**MERCHANDISING MANAGER \- HOME** 




 Function: Merchandising \| Location: New Delhi (Tulsi Farms) \| Reporting to: Chief Merchandising Officer
 



 Experience: 6\-9 years in Merchandising (minimum 3 years handling the Home category)
 



**Step Into the World of Nicobar** 




 Founded in 2016 by Simran Lal and Raul Rai,
 **Nicobar** 
 is a modern, mindful, design\-led lifestyle brand from India.
 



*“We wanted to create a new Indian sensibility that wasn’t necessarily Westernised.”* 




 We’re reimagining a contemporary Indian way of living, dressing, and looking at the world—rooted in culture, shaped by design, and guided by intention. At Nicobar, we believe in culture as much as commerce, and that how we build is just as important as what we build.
 



 Our studio is tucked away in Tulsi Farms, Chhatarpur, Delhi. Nestled among trees, seasonal gardens, a citrus grove, and our beloved dogs Nico \& Dot, we call it
 *“
 
 the Treehouse.
 
 ”* 
 It earned its name when our architect reworked the blueprint to protect every single tree on the land. It’s a space where creativity brims and energy flows.
 



 If you’re drawn to thoughtful design, a youthful and nourishing team culture, and the chance to grow a brand with heart—we’d love to hear from you.
 



**Follow our journey:** 

 Instagram
 
 \|
 
 LinkedIn
 
 \|
 
 Nicobar.com
 
 \|
 **Watch our Co\-founders, Raul \& Simran talking about Nicobar**




**Reach out to us through the below link \-** 
 📩
 **https://lnkd.in/gghFi5Yz**




**Your Role in the Story** 




 You are the commercial engine behind Nicobar’s Home category – owning the numbers, the range, and the results across tableware, drinkware, textiles, décor, and furniture. Reporting to the CMO, you sit at the intersection of data and intuition, analysing what is selling, anticipating what should, and working across planning, design, sourcing, and retail to keep the category commercially sharp season after season.
 



**Where You’ll Make Impact** 



* Own the commercial performance of Home – sell\-throughs, best and worst sellers, markdowns, and replenishment against seasonal targets.
* Drive the Home range plan with design and sourcing – balanced, seasonally relevant, and aligned to pricing architecture and occasion (everyday, entertaining, gifting, festive).
* Manage width, depth, and open\-to\-buy – balancing core replenishable lines against seasonal drops, and keeping inventory and stock cover healthy.
* Build the seasonal buy and forecast – size and phase orders by channel, set OTB by sub\-category, and manage in\-season re\-orders to protect margin.
* Own markdown, ageing, and terminal\-stock strategy – act early on slow sellers, plan exit routes, and keep provision and liquidation under control.
* Ensure on\-time launches across channels, flagging critical\-path risks early enough to course\-correct.
* Set pricing and margin architecture for the category – benchmark against competitors, protect intake and realised margins, and guide sourcing on cost targets.
* Partner with the design team on newness and hero products – translate commercial signals into clear briefs for gifting, festive, and collection drops.
* Shop the market and competitors – identify white spaces and bring sharp, well\-evidenced range recommendations.
* Drive category expansion – spot adjacent sub\-categories and gaps in tableware, textiles, décor, and gifting, and build the case to enter them.
* Partner with VM and retail so the Home story is told well in\-store and online, and build reports and dashboards that turn numbers into decisions.



**What You Bring Along** 



* 5–8 years in fashion, home, or lifestyle merchandising, with a minimum of 3 years handling the Home category.
* Very strong analytical ability, including proficient, hands\-on command of Excel / Google Sheets.
* Fluent with AI and digital tools, and quick to apply them – turning technology into sharper planning, cleaner communication, and building efficient dashboards and workflows.
* You understand what makes Home aesthetically and commercially different – sub\-categories with distinct end uses, buying rhythms and margin logic.
* Strong cross\-functional skills with design, sourcing, planning, VM, and retail, and disciplined follow\-through across multiple drops.



**The Nicobar Spark** 



* A natural problem\-solver – you break messy, ambiguous situations into clear parts, and you'd rather bring a solution than escalate a problem.
* Strong stakeholder management – you build trust quickly across design, sourcing, planning, and retail, and you know how to influence without authority.
* A clear communicator – you turn numbers into a story people can act on, whether you're in a leadership review or a design huddle.
* Calm under pressure – drops, deadlines, and last\-minute changes don't rattle you; you re\-prioritise and keep the critical path moving.
* Detail\-obsessed without losing the big picture – you sweat the SKU\-level numbers but never lose sight of the season and the brand.
* A builder, not just a doer – you leave behind better templates, cleaner reports, and sharper ways of working than you found.
* Genuinely collaborative – you share credit, ask good questions, and make the people around you better.
* Commercially curious – you keep asking "why" behind the numbers and "what next" for the category.

title: Junior Founder Executive-D2C -Fmcg
description:
**About the Role** 


 Éprise is looking for a sharp, tech\-savvy Executive Assistant to run the founder's office. This isn't a traditional scheduling\-and\-travel EA role — you'll be the operational nerve center for the founder, owning MIS reporting, building and maintaining company dashboards, and coordinating cross\-functional execution so the founder can focus on strategic priorities.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

**1\. Founder's Office \& Coordination** 



* Manage the founder's calendar, priorities, and follow\-ups across all functions.
* Act as the single point of coordination between the founder and department heads (sales, ops, finance, etc.).
* Track action items from meetings and ensure timely closure across teams.
* Prepare briefing notes, agendas, and summaries ahead of key meetings.



**2\. MIS \& Reporting** 



* Build and maintain a company\-wide MIS covering sales, operations, and financial metrics.
* Consolidate data from multiple teams/sources into clean, accurate, decision\-ready reports.
* Design daily/weekly/monthly dashboards tracking key business KPIs.
* Flag anomalies, trends, and risks proactively to the founder.



**3\. Dashboards \& Tools** 



* Own the company dashboard end\-to\-end — structure, data pipelines, and visual presentation.
* Work with Excel/Google Sheets, and ideally BI tools (Power BI, Looker Studio, or similar) to automate reporting.
* Continuously improve reporting systems to reduce manual work and improve accuracy.

* Support the founder on ad hoc analysis — market research, competitor tracking, business case prep.
* Drive special projects assigned by the founder from planning through execution.

**5\. Confidentiality \& Judgment** 



* Handle sensitive business and financial information with discretion.

* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); familiarity with BI tools is a strong plus.

* High ownership mindset — comfortable working directly with a founder in a fast\-moving environment.

* Ability to handle ambiguity and multitask across functions.

title: Sr. Analyst II FP&A
description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+
   

  

 employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999,
   

  

 Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event
   

  

 professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help
   

  

 them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people
   

  

 together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry
   

  

 through innovative technology that powers human connection.
   

  

 Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone
   

  

 and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.
   

  

 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like
   

  

 entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and
   

  

 celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
   

  

 Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human
   

  

 connection.
   

  

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At
   

  

 Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our
   

  

 DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to
   

  

 experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll
   

  

 thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering
   

  

 exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
   

  

 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn,
   

  

 iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AIpowered
   

  

 collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a strategic, analytically strong FP\&A professional to join our team as an Senior Analyst
   

  

 II \- FP\&A, supporting Marketing mini\-CFO, in partnering with Cvent's Global Marketing organization —
   

  

 spanning Brand, Demand Generation, Events, Digital, Product Marketing, and Regional Field
   

  

 Marketing.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Marketing and FP\&A. You will be supporting Marketing mini\-CFO to
   

  

 drive marketing efficiency and ROI analysis, but you must also deeply understand the \*bookings and
   

  

 pipeline world\* — how marketing activity converts into leads, MQLs, SQL, pipeline, and ultimately
   

  

 bookings. You will help Marketing and Finance leaders answer the core questions: “what is working,
   

  

 what is not working, and where should the next marketing dollar go.”
   

  

 In addition to this, the individual would also be required to drive core planning processes such as annual
   

  

 budgeting, monthly reforecasting, and cost tracking, while building and interpreting the full marketingto\-
   

  

 bookings funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, cost per lead, lead
   

  

 conversion by tactic, and marketing ROI by LoB. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen
   

  

 with genuine fluency in what a B2B marketing function should deliver, and the drive to translate data
   

  

 into clear recommendations for the Marketing organization and senior leaders.
   

  

 This role involves frequent interaction with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, and Corporate
   

  

 Finance teams based in the U.S. and India.
   

  

 ▪ Marketing Finance Partnership \& RI (primary focus)
   

  

* Act as support to Marketing mini\-CFO to support to the Global Marketing organization,


 partnering with marketing leadership to translate growth strategies, campaign plans, and
   

  

 pipeline targets into annual budgets and rolling forecasts.
   

  

* Build, own, and continuously improve the Marketing ROI financial model by LoB —


 connecting spend, activity and outcomes end to end.
   

  

* Develop and track key Marketing efficiency metrics, including:


 ▪ CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
   

  

 ▪ CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)
   

  

 ▪ Cost per Lead/MQL (by LoB, by tactic)
   

  

 ▪ Lead Conversion Rates (by tactic / channel), CTR
   

  

 ▪ Marketing ROI
   

  

* Analyze the full funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, and cost


 per lead — and tie each stage to financial and pipeline outcomes.
   

  

* Drive deep\-dive analytics on event ROI, digital campaigns, tradeshows, and content


 marketing performance.
   

  

* Deliver a clear point of view on what's working and what's not working across marketing


 tactics and channels, with concrete, prioritized recommendations for the marketing
   

  

 organization.
   

  

* Build and evaluate business cases for marketing initiatives — campaigns, media


 investments, Martech, and events — using ROI, CAC, payback to guide spend prioritization.
   

  

* Support and advise on resource\-allocation decisions across marketing channels and


 geographies.
   

  

 ▪ Bookings \& Pipeline Fluency
   

  

* Understand and work fluently with the sales forecasting and bookings process, connecting


 marketing funnel metrics (MQLs, pipeline, bookings influence) to bookings outcomes by LoB.
   

  

* Partner on pipeline\-trend and funnel analysis — conversion rates, sales cycle length, and


 pipeline velocity — to assess how marketing feeds the bookings engine.
   

  

* Align marketing investment views with bookings and pipeline targets so finance tells one


 consistent growth story.
   

  

 ▪ Stakeholder \& Cross\-functional Work
   

  

* Partner with Sales, Marketing Ops, and Data/Analytics teams to ensure consistent, trusted


 measurement frameworks.
   

  

* Create executive\-level dashboards, presentations, and financial insights to support strategic


 initiatives, and present them confidently to non\-financial and senior audiences.
   

  

* Lead or support ad\-hoc strategic projects, including M\&A / acquisition integration and costoptimization


 initiatives.
   

  

* Extract and analyze data using tools like Salesforce, Adaptive Insights, Excel, and other


 analytics platforms.
   

  

 ▪ 7\-10 years of experience in FP\&A, business finance, or a related field.
   

  

 ▪ Preferred background (either path works): experience in a B2B organization either (a) in
   

  

 Marketing Data \& ROI Analytics, or (b) in Finance partnering with Marketing — with real
   

  

 exposure to marketing funnel dynamics and bookings/pipeline.
   

  

 ▪ Deep understanding of B2B marketing funnel metrics, digital campaign dynamics,
   

  

 channel/tactic\-level ROI, and a clear view of what a B2B marketing function should bring to the
   

  

 business.
   

  

 ▪ Solid understanding of the bookings and pipeline world — sales forecasting, funnel/conversion
   

  

 analysis, and how marketing influences bookings
   

  

 ▪ Strong data\-driven mindset and the ability to structure and interpret large, imperfect datasets to
   

  

 generate insights.
   

  

 ▪ Expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and metric development — including the ability to
   

  

 think through a marketing ROI model from first principles.
   

  

 ▪ Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CRM, Adaptive Insights or similar tools preferred.
   

  

 ▪ Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to non\-financial and senior
   

  

 stakeholders; proven ability to work closely with senior leaders is strongly preferred.
   

  

 ▪ Strong drive, curiosity, and willingness to learn.
   

  

 ▪ MBA or CFA preferred
   

  

**Disclaimer**
 Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting
   

  

 communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email address. Cvent will
   

  

 never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social
   

  

 media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications,
   

  

 payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.
   

  

 If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and
   

  

 report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.
   

  

 For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/noticerecruitment\-
   

  

 fraud.

title: Investment Analyst – Investments
description:
**Investment Analyst – Investments** 




  





**We’re looking for someone who is, at their core, curious about businesses and how they are built someone who enjoys going beyond numbers to understand founders, markets, products, customers and what makes a business scale.** 




  





 This role is an opportunity to work closely with the investment team across the full investment lifecycle, from evaluating new opportunities to supporting portfolio companies post\-investment.
 



  





**📍 Location: Gurgaon** 




  





**What we’re looking for** 




 \* 2–3 years of experience, ideally across high\-quality startups, investment banking, consulting, venture capital, private equity or other analytical/strategy\-oriented roles
 



 \* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex business problems
 



 \* Genuine interest in startups, technology, businesses and investing
 



 \* Strong understanding of business fundamentals — revenue, growth, margins, unit economics, P\&L and key business metrics
 



 \* Ability to conduct market, industry and company\-level research and form an independent point of view
 



 \* Strong financial modelling and data analysis skills
 



 \* Exposure to transaction processes, due diligence or working closely with businesses would be an advantage
 



 \* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate insights and recommendations
 



 \* High ownership, attention to detail and ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment
 



 \* Intellectual curiosity, humility and a willingness to learn
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




**This is a full\-stack investing role, with exposure across:** 




 \* Identifying and evaluating potential investment opportunities
 



 \* Conducting market, sector and company research
 



 \* Analysing business models, financials, unit economics and growth drivers
 



 \* Building financial models and investment analyses
 



 \* Supporting due diligence and preparing investment memos
 



 \* Working closely with founders and management teams to understand businesses, challenges and opportunities
 



 \* Tracking and analysing portfolio company performance and MIS
 



 \* Supporting deal execution and transaction\-related activities
 



 \* Preparing materials for internal investment discussions and reviews
 



 \* Developing perspectives on emerging sectors, business models and market trends
 



 \* Supporting the team across portfolio engagement, investor reporting and other fund initiatives
 



  





**What success looks like** 




 \* Developing a strong understanding of businesses and the ability to independently assess investment opportunities
 



 \* Bringing sharp, data\-backed and differentiated perspectives to investment discussions
 



 \* Building strong relationships with founders and becoming a trusted partner to the investment team
 



 \* Taking ownership of investment analysis and key workstreams end\-to\-end
 



 \* Demonstrating the ability to move beyond analysis to understand what drives business outcomes
 



 \* Growing into an investor who can independently evaluate opportunities and contribute meaningfully to investment decisions
 



  





 If you are someone who enjoys understanding businesses, questioning assumptions, working with founders and solving problems, and want to build a career at the intersection of capital, technology and company building, this could be a strong fit.

Responsible for incorporating accurate data uploads into the Hyperion budgeting and forecasting tool, as well as compiling, completing and submitting the Preliminary Budget Review Template and CEO Review Template to Global Markets on time.

title: Risk Management System
description:
**About Us** 




 PlusWealth Capital Management LLP is a proprietary high\-frequency trading firm, active in multiple markets including equities, options, and futures. We thrive on building cutting edge, data\-driven, and tech\-based trading algorithms. As a dynamic, machine\-learning oriented trading platform, we embody the ethos of THINK. TECH. TRADE. If you share our vision, we’d love to have you onboard.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Risk Management System (RMS) team is responsible for monitoring and managing trading risks across strategies, portfolios, products, and trading infrastructure. The role involves real\-time risk monitoring, analysis of trading activity, identification of abnormal exposures, investigation of risk breaches, and continuous improvement of risk controls and monitoring systems.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Monitor trading activity, positions, exposures, limits, and risk metrics across equities, futures, and options.
* Monitor real\-time and end\-of\-day risk parameters and identify unusual trading patterns, concentration, or excessive exposures.
* Track and investigate limit breaches, risk alerts, unusual positions, and trading anomalies.
* Work closely with Trading, Quantitative Research, Technology, and Operations teams to resolve risk\-related issues.
* Perform analysis of trading positions, P\&L, exposure, margin, liquidity, and other relevant risk measures.
* Support the implementation, monitoring, and enhancement of pre\-trade and post\-trade risk controls.
* Analyze market and trading data to identify emerging risks and potential weaknesses in existing risk controls.
* Assist in developing and maintaining risk dashboards, reports, alerts, and monitoring tools.
* Automate repetitive risk\-monitoring and reporting activities using Python, SQL, Excel, or other relevant technologies.
* Support periodic reviews of risk limits, thresholds, controls, and monitoring frameworks.
* Collaborate with technology teams to improve the reliability, scalability, and effectiveness of RMS systems.
* Contribute to the development of analytical tools for monitoring trading risks and improving risk visibility.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of risk incidents, investigations, controls, and remediation actions.
* Support regulatory, audit, and internal risk\-management requirements as applicable.
* Participate in projects aimed at strengthening risk controls, automation, data quality, and risk infrastructure.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 3\+ years of experience in Risk Reporting, Risk Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Operational Risk, Compliance, or a related analytical function within Financial Services.
* Hands\-on experience with Excel, Power BI, Python, SQL, and Gen\-AI tools (Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT)
* Strong communication and storytelling skills
* Experience in the MCX market is an added advantage.
* Demonstrated experience developing executive reporting, dashboards, and analytical presentations for senior leadership.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with experience performing trend analysis, root cause investigations, and insight generation from large and complex datasets.
* Knowledge of operational and enterprise risk management frameworks and key risk indicators (OREs, Issues, PRSA/RCSAs)
* Master’s in business administration, Risk Management, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting enterprise risk governance, executive reporting, or regulatory reporting initiatives.
* Experience driving reporting automation, process optimization, or analytics transformation initiatives.



  





**Benefits \& Perks:** 



* Competitive compensation and performance\-based bonuses.
* Flat organizational structure with high ownership and visibility.
* Medical insurance – we've got you and your dependents covered.
* Catered meals/snacks for 5 working days in the office.
* Generous paid time off policies.



  





**Pluswealth Capital Management is an equal opportunity employer**

 To extract meaningful insights from complex data sets, developing robust decision models, and presenting actionable recommendations to stakeholders across the departments.

title: Vice President - Product Control
description:
**Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Vice President, Product Control**
**Location\- Bangalore and Gurugram**
**Overview**
 The Product Control (PC) function within Finance Controllership provides independent control and assurance, product expertise, and commercial insight and guidance to all HSBC businesses engaged in trading activities.
   

  

 PC is responsible for delivering accurate Profit \& Loss (P\&L) and Balance Sheet (BS) reporting to the Front Office (FO), and for ensuring that assets and liabilities are recognised and measured in line with the appropriate accounting treatment. This includes analysing the drivers of P\&L to provide insight into underlying performance and to assess outcomes against expectations, based on an understanding of the trading portfolio, trading activity, market movements, and other relevant factors.
   

  

 The team also ensures the Markets Balance Sheet is fully controlled and substantiated. In addition, PC oversees all aspects of Fair Value determination for traded instruments across Markets and Securities Services (MSS), Markets Treasury (MKTY), and, where applicable, more broadly across HSBC
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Own end\-to\-end Product Control for Markets/Markets Treasury, accountable for P\&L and Balance Sheet control within the HSBC Risk Management Framework.
* Proactively manage controls, SOX activities, risks/issues, and align FO, Product Control and Controllership to emerging risk themes.
* Deliver timely, accurate daily/monthly P\&L with clear commentary and attribution (trades, market moves, reserves/adjustments, valuation impacts).
* Provide constructive challenge and commercial insight to support Front Office decisions and reduce reporting uncertainty.
* Lead Balance Sheet substantiation for PC\-owned accounts, including monthly analytical review and BSRS with robust governance/audit trail.
* Identify, investigate, escalate and close breaks to root cause within agreed timelines.
* Partner with Controllership/Valuations/Financial Control/Policy/AC\&R to ensure consistent accounting, valuation principles and reporting integrity.
* Drive consistent control standards across sites/teams, remediate gaps, and strengthen operational risk outcomes.
* Shape strategic change (process re\-engineering, systems uplift, automation) to improve P\&L explain, shorten close, and enhance transparency.
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team; manage senior stakeholders/governance and maintain audit and regulatory readiness.


**To Be Successful You Will**
* 10\-15 yrs with 5 years of relevant experience in a Product Control function, or similar, with a strong control focus and understanding of the Product Control workflow. Professional qualifications such as CFA, ACA, CPA, FRM etc will be an advantage
* Knowledge and experience of financial market products and their associated risks, data flows, trade lifecycle, accounting principles and valuation techniques/models.
* Knowledge of primary financial statements (Balance Sheet \& Income Statement) and notes to ARAs (Fair Value Disclosure, Derivative Assets/Liabilities, Trading Assets/Liabilities)
* Track record of driving change and automation using available tools such as Alteryx, Python, AI / ML etc
* Excellent written and oral communication skills to be able to communicate at all levels of the organisation and different stakeholders in Finance and Front Office
* Ability to influence and work though others to achieve results and maintain strong collaborative partnerships
* Excellent interpersonal skills and able to work with people across different locations and backgrounds. Experience managing nearshore and offshore teams
* Work independently with minimum guidance and able to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines. Excellent analytical skills and a proactive approach to problem solving, driven and enthusiastic


**You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

title: Financial Controller
description:
**Role Responsibility:** 
 Lead the end\-to\-end finance controllership function across the Company and its group entities, ensuring accurate financial reporting, strong governance and controls, efficient finance operations, cash and working\-capital discipline and a scalable finance organisation. The role will be a key partner to the CFO and senior management and will support strategic transactions and future capital\-market readiness.
 



**Financial Controllership \& Reporting:** 



* Own monthly, quarterly and annual book closure and preparation/review of standalone and consolidated financial statements in accordance with Ind AS and applicable requirements.
* Maintain balance\-sheet hygiene through robust GL reviews, reconciliations, provisions, accruals, inter\-company balances and accounting policies; resolve complex technical accounting matters.
* Own monthly/quarterly management reporting and provide analytical insights on financial performance, cash flow, working capital, margins and key KPIs; support Board and investor reporting.



**Audit, Controls \& Compliance:** 



* Lead statutory, internal, tax and special\-purpose audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Establish and strengthen Internal Financial Controls/ICFR, finance SOPs, approval controls and year\-round audit readiness.
* Provide finance oversight for direct/indirect tax and regulatory reporting, in coordination with internal teams and external advisors.



**Finance Operations, Inventory \& Working Capital:** 



* Oversee core finance processes including AP, AR, revenue accounting, fixed assets, payroll accounting and record\-to\-report, with focus on accuracy, controls and turnaround time.
* Ensure robust inventory accounting, valuation and controls across manufacturing locations, warehouses and stores, including costing, provisions, obsolescence and ERP\-to\-books reconciliation.
* Drive cash\-flow visibility and working\-capital optimisation across receivables, payables and inventory; oversee banking and treasury governance.



**Group, Strategic \& Transformation:** 



* Ensure consistent accounting, consolidation, inter\-company reconciliation and reporting across domestic and overseas subsidiaries.
* Support M\&A, investments and strategic transactions, including financial/tax due diligence, valuations, acquisition accounting and finance integration.
* Support IPO/capital\-market readiness, including restated financial information, finance diligence and coordination with auditors, bankers and advisors, as required.
* Drive ERP/SAP enhancements, automation, dashboards, data integrity and process standardisation to build a scalable finance function.



  





**Business Partnership \& Team Leadership:** 



* Partner with FP\&A, business and functional teams on budgets/forecasts, profitability, commercial decisions, capex, cost optimisation and financial risk assessment.
* Lead, mentor and develop the controllership/finance operations team, with clear accountability, strong review mechanisms and succession capability.

title: Demand Planner
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
   

  

 Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
   

  

 While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia\-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Demand Planner executes the demand forecasting strategy for a low\-volume and low complexity portfolio, accountable for \<$500\+ million of annual sales revenue. This role requires analytical mastery and proven experience with statistical modeling. The Demand Planner also requires strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex algorithms to cross\-functional business partners. The position helps support the monthly Pre\-Commercial Review/Consensus process within the IBP framework by owning the baseline statistical forecast. This role also supports Product Life Cycle management through supply chain forecasting, error detection and resolution. By providing accurate baseline forecasts and reducing forecast bias, this position enables McCormick to deliver predictable financial results and ensure cost, service and working capital goals are met.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Maintains historical baseline data and trends, determines best\-fit statistical models for each SKU, and cleanses historical data to remove anomalies where applicable.
* Tracks and maintains demand KPIs (Forecast Accuracy and Forecast Bias) to determine appropriate root cause corrective action next steps.
* Communication of downstream impacts of material plan changes (short\-term).
* Forecast Value\-Add (FVA) analysis and implementation
* Trouble shoots large, complex system problems with IT and GBS; develops forecast scenarios with assumptions.
* Support role in IBP and S\&OE processes (Pre\-PCR, PCR and PSRs)


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field of study.
* 4 years \+ of planning experience with a strong understanding of demand planning processes.
* Experience in (statistical) forecasting and knowledge of Demand Planning systems and complex algorithms.
* SAP, MS\-Office tools, ERP packages and other relevant IT systems knowledge with focus on planning and forecasting.
* CPG Experience preferred.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Excellent time management and prioritization skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Curiosity (experience diagnosing RCCA).
* Excellent analytical skills.
* Ability to analyze complex and disparate data sources down to incorporate key insights.
* Proven problem\-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Proficiency with MS Excel, Power Point, Word, ERP (ex: SAP), ECC, APO, IBP and forecasting tools required.


 At McCormick, we have over a 100\-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Manager / Assistant Vice President (AVP)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Investment Banking professional to join our Sell\-Side Investment Banking team, focused on helping companies raise capital and prepare for their next stage of growth.
   

  

 The role will primarily involve working with IPO\-bound, pre\-IPO and high\-growth companies on fundraising, capital structuring, investor positioning and transaction execution.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in investment banking, equity fundraising, IPO/pre\-IPO transactions, corporate finance, valuation and client acquisition, along with the ability to independently manage relationships with promoters, founders, investors and other transaction stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Origination \& Client Acquisition
* Identify and develop relationships with companies that are potential pre\-IPO or IPO candidates.
* Source new mandates through promoter/founder relationships, professional networks, intermediaries and industry relationships.
* Develop a strong pipeline of potential fundraising and IPO mandates.
* Understand the company’s business, capital requirements, growth plans and fundraising objectives.
* Pitch and present investment banking solutions to promoters, founders and senior management.
* Fundraising \& Transaction Execution
* Lead and support equity fundraising transactions, including pre\-IPO/private placements and other structured equity transactions.
* Work with companies to determine appropriate fundraising size, valuation, transaction structure and investor positioning.
* Coordinate the complete transaction process from mandate acquisition through successful closure.
* Prepare transaction timelines, investor lists, deal structures and execution plans.
* Coordinate with legal, secretarial, accounting, merchant banking, due\-diligence and other professional advisors.
* IPO \& Pre\-IPO Advisory
* Evaluate companies for IPO readiness and identify gaps that need to be addressed before listing.
* Assist companies in developing an appropriate roadmap from private/pre\-IPO stage to IPO.
* Work closely with management on business positioning, equity story and investor communication.
* Support preparation of investor presentations, information memoranda, financial analysis and other transaction\-related materials.
* Assist in valuation analysis and benchmarking against listed and comparable companies.
* Investor \& Institutional Relationships
* Develop and maintain relationships with HNI, family office, institutional and strategic investors.
* Build and maintain an investor database across sectors.
* Match suitable companies and transactions with relevant investors.
* Coordinate investor meetings, management presentations, conference calls and due\-diligence discussions.
* Understand investor requirements and communicate transaction opportunities effectively.
* Financial Analysis \& Valuation
* Build and review financial models, projections and valuation analyses.
* Conduct comparable\-company, precedent\-transaction and other relevant valuation analyses.
* Analyse financial statements, business performance, growth prospects and key operating metrics.
* Assist management in understanding valuation expectations and capital\-market positioning.
* Deal Management
* Take ownership of assigned mandates and ensure timely execution.
* Manage multiple transactions simultaneously and maintain transaction trackers.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external advisors throughout the transaction lifecycle.
* Identify transaction risks, bottlenecks and execution issues and proactively resolve them.
* Maintain high standards of confidentiality and transaction discipline.


 Business Development Expectations
   

  

 For the Manager/AVP level, this is not intended to be a purely execution\-oriented role.
   

  

**The Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Build a meaningful company/promoter pipeline.
* Develop independent relationships with founders, promoters and senior management.
* Generate new investment\-banking mandates.
* Convert opportunities into signed mandates and successfully executed transactions.
* Build long\-term relationships with companies beyond a single fundraising transaction.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong understanding of Investment Banking and Sell\-Side transactions.
* Experience in equity fundraising, pre\-IPO, IPO or corporate finance.
* Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.
* Excellent understanding of financial statements and capital structures.
* Strong business\-development and relationship\-management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to interact confidently with promoters, CXOs, investors and senior stakeholders.
* Strong transaction\-management and execution capabilities.
* Ability to work independently in a high\-growth, entrepreneurial environment.


**Preferred Background**
 Candidates from the following backgrounds would be relevant:
   

  

* Investment Banking
* CFA (Mandatory)
* Equity Capital Markets
* Merchant Banking
* Corporate Finance
* M\&A / Transaction Advisory
* Private Equity / Venture Capital with strong transaction exposure
* Big 4 Transaction Advisory / Deals
* Securities / Capital Markets


 Experience specifically involving IPO, pre\-IPO or equity fundraising transactions will be an advantage.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to build and manage a strong pipeline of IPO\-bound and pre\-IPO companies, originate high\-quality mandates, execute fundraising transactions efficiently and develop long\-term relationships with promoters and investors.
   

  

 In short: Originate → Advise → Structure → Raise Capital → Execute → Build Long\-Term Client Relationships.
   

  

 Skills: management,investment banking,capital,ipo,pre\-ipo,investors

**Job Description:**
**ROLE PURPOSE:**
 As Market Access Manager, you will be responsible for enabling access across the company’s portfolio by developing and implementing market access strategies that address pricing, reimbursement, funding pathways, policy shaping, and stakeholder engagement. The role will support portfolio\-wide access objectives across relevant therapeutic areas, with a specific focus on public accounts, national and sub\-national health authorities, public procurement bodies, and public health programs. Your work will help ensure timely, sustainable, and equitable access to medicines and vaccines by aligning evidence, value communication, and partnership strategies with public\-sector priorities and patient needs.
   

  

**ACCOUNTABILITIES:**
**Portfolio Market Access Strategy:** 
 Develop and execute integrated market access strategies across the portfolio, ensuring each product has a clear access pathway that reflects its value proposition, patient need, public health relevance, affordability considerations, and local healthcare system dynamics.
 **Evidence Generation and Value Demonstration:** 
 Collaborate with medical, HEOR, policy, and cross\-functional teams to generate and translate evidence that demonstrates clinical, economic, budgetary, and public health value across the portfolio, supporting access discussions with public stakeholders and payers.
 **Pricing, Reimbursement, and Funding Pathways:** 
 Support pricing and reimbursement strategies by analyzing market dynamics, public funding mechanisms, procurement models, affordability barriers, and competitor benchmarks, while ensuring alignment with portfolio value, patient access objectives, and compliance requirements.
 **Public Account Engagement:** 
 Build and maintain strategic relationships with public accounts, including government health authorities, public payers, national and sub\-national institutions, procurement agencies, public hospitals, and public health program stakeholders, to understand priorities and shape sustainable access solutions.
 **Value Communication:** 
 Communicate product and portfolio value propositions to policymakers, public payers, procurement stakeholders, healthcare providers, and internal teams, clearly articulating clinical value, public health impact, economic considerations, and relevance to public\-sector priorities.
 **Public Market Intelligence:** 
 Monitor healthcare policy, public funding priorities, reimbursement trends, procurement processes, tender opportunities, competitor activity, and stakeholder dynamics to identify access opportunities, risks, and implications for the portfolio.
 **Access Planning and Execution:** 
 Partner with cross\-functional teams to integrate market access considerations into brand planning, launch planning, lifecycle management, reimbursement planning, public account plans, and private\-channel access initiatives, ensuring timely execution of activities that support access across the portfolio.
 **Compliance:** 
**and Governance:** 
**:** 
 Ensure all market access and public account activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, and ethical standards, maintaining transparency and integrity in all interactions with external stakeholders.
   

  

**Critical leadership capabilities:**
 As a Market Access Manager responsible for portfolio\-wide access with a focus on public accounts, strong leadership capabilities are essential to navigate complex healthcare systems, align internal and external stakeholders, and deliver sustainable access outcomes. The following capabilities are critical for success in this role
   

  

**Strategic Vision:** 
 A Market Access Manager should have a clear and compelling strategic vision for market access initiatives. They must be able to align with the organization's overall goals and craft a well\-defined roadmap to achieve market access objectives.

 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Market access initiatives require close collaboration with commercial, medical, regulatory, policy, legal, compliance, supply, and finance teams. The Market Access Manager should foster alignment across functions to support portfolio planning, public account execution, and sustainable access outcomes.
   

  

**Adaptability:** 
 The healthcare landscape and regulatory environment can be dynamic and unpredictable. Effective leaders in market access must be adaptable to changes, able to navigate challenges, and pivot strategies as needed to achieve objectives.

 A successful Market Access Manager relies on data\-driven insights to support their decisions. This includes analyzing health economic data, market trends, competitor analysis, and real\-world evidence to shape pricing and access strategies.

 Market access involves engaging with public health stakeholders, and ethical conduct is critical. A Market Access Manager should uphold high ethical standards and ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations throughout all interactions.
   

  

**Resilience:** 
 Achieving market access for a new vaccine can be a complex and demanding process, often requiring persistence and resilience. A strong leader in this role remains focused, positive, and determined in overcoming obstacles and achieving objectives.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.



  





**4\. Competitor Research \& Pricing Strategy** 



* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.



  





**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.



  





**6\. New Digital Sales Channels** 



* Identify and onboard relevant e\-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro\-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

title: Asia Pacific Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 This position is an integral part of the Asia\-Pacific (AP) Regional Finance Team and works very closely with our regional Specialty Business Units (SBUs), particularly TDA and Platinion business and leadership. The role primarily provides business partnering support to Platinion in the areas of commercial, analysis, decision support, planning, closing review and reporting. It could evolve into further SBU financial support over time.
   

  

 This position is built around teamwork and meeting customer needs which provides the opportunity to work with senior stakeholders in the AP region. The role teams with the local Finance teams, other regional and cross\-functional teams, and the global Finance community. The individual must be a team player and capable of working flexibly, virtually and across different cultures.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Platinion business finance support
* Developing and presenting insightful financial analysis for Platinion and regional leadership to support business decisions; both recurring weekly / monthly reporting as well as ad\-hoc analysis and reporting as required
* Providing in\-depth commercial support to Platinion involved cases, such as, but not limited to evaluating pricing of projects, and its implications on Platinion financials, along with project end\-to\-end management and keeping track of estimated project position to avoid surprises on any overruns/premium adjustment etc
* Supporting the plan and estimate processes for the Platinion business covering financial modelling, capacity planning, revenue projections, reporting and functional cost estimates as well as the preparation of related presentations
* Monitoring and analysing performance against plan and pro\-actively highlighting issues and opportunities for improvements (including but not restricted to revenue, capacity, billability, staffing\- and pricing trends)
* Responsible for the monthly and annual closing of Platinion AP books in coordination with Global Accounting \& Control and local offices.


**Functional Practice Finance Support**
* Supporting the Planning, analysis and reporting on broader functional areas for the TDA Practice Area in AP
* Supporting the coordination and alignment of Platinion reporting units across BCG with other regions, the global team and TDA Practice Area


**AP Regional Finance support**
* Acting as back\-up to the other AP Regional Finance team members as required
* Supporting the broader global finance function in its transformation efforts including roll\-out of new systems, policies, processes, and initiatives.
* Providing support to \& sharing best practices with local Finance teams as required
* Building networks with other regional finance teams, liaising with Global services, Global finance and other Regional Functions as required


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance
* Work experience:
* Internal: Significant experience in BCG Finance preferred, with deep knowledge of BCG accounting, planning, commercial and systems
* External: of around 5\-10 years in handling the Finance planning \& analysis, commercial \& stakeholder management. Experience in service industry and more specifically consulting firms preferred
* Advanced computer literacy:
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Financial Systems, HFM, FIM and BCG’s BIR tool preferred. SAP experience helpful
* At minimum, strong Excel skills required. Affinity with more advanced analytics tools like Tableau \& Power BI is a preference
* Strong knowledge of PowerPoint slide writing with familiarity with Thinkcell preferred
* Strong business sense, working knowledge of BCG commercial process \& working knowledge of US GAAP accounting standards
* Good analytical skills with an attention to detail and an ability to look at data in different ways while also being able to see the bigger picture
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and ability to operate effectively in a virtual team and a global environment through establishing positive and productive working relationships (self\-motivated, responsive, service oriented)
* Proven ability to plan work effectively and prioritize work, even in stressful situations


 Additional info
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Financial Due Diligence | TS | Manager
description:
**About Interpath**
 Interpath Advisory, a leading financial advisory business,
   

  

 Interpath is an international and fast\-growing advisory business with deep expertise in a broad range of specialisms spanning deals, advisory and restructuring.
   

  

 We deliver tangible results for global businesses, their investors, and stakeholders when complex problems arise, and critical decisions need to be made. Interpath is agile, independent, and conflict\-free, and our passion for doing what's right, every time, sets us apart.
   

  

 Our diverse teams provide specialist technical knowledge combined with deep sector experience across our service line specialisms. Since our foundation in 2021, Interpath has grown rapidly, and we now have a presence across the UK, Ireland, France, Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Spain, Switzerland, BVI, Cayman Islands, Bermuda, Barbados, and Hong Kong. By 2030 we aim to be one of the world's leading advisory firms with a truly global footprint.
   

  

 In an agile, independent and conflict\-free setting, our market\-leading teams focus on supporting businesses, their investors and stakeholders to help them navigate complex financial challenges and achieve their strategic objectives.
   

  

**The team**
 This role sits in Interpath's Transaction Services practice. You will work on financial due diligence for buy\-side and sell\-side transactions alongside Interpath Global deal teams, on engagements.
   

  

**The role**
 You will run financial due diligence workstreams day to day, own the supporting analysis and the first draft of the report, hold the quality of everything produced below you, and develop the people producing it.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What you will be doing**
* Run financial due diligence workstreams on a day\-to\-day basis, from the initial information request through to drafted findings
* Build and own the core analysis of the target's trading performance, earnings, working capital and net debt position
* Take responsibility for the supporting analysis pack, ensuring that every figure can be traced back to source records
* Prepare the first draft of the report sections covering your workstreams, to a standard that can be reviewed rather than rewritten
* Manage the information request and question\-and\-answer process, following up on outstanding items and escalating where information is not forthcoming
* Supervise and review the work of Assistant Managers and Senior Associates before it is submitted
* Line manage a small group of colleagues, covering objectives, regular feedback, appraisals and development planning
* Coach colleagues on live engagements and deliver technical training to the team in your areas of strength
* Present findings to the wider deal team and take part in management meetings
* Keep engagements to time and to budget, and flag any change in scope at the point at which it arises


**What We Are Looking For**
* Qualified accountant — CA (ICAI), CA (SA), ACA, ACCA or equivalent OR MBA in Finance or equivalent
* Minimum 7 to 10 years post\-qualification, of which at least 5 in transaction services or financial due diligence
* Has run FDD workstreams independently and reviewed the work of others
* Experience of supervising and developing junior colleagues, including delivering difficult feedback
* Strong grasp of quality of earnings, net debt and working capital, and of why each matters to the buyer
* Advanced Excel skills and confidence in handling large and poorly structured datasets
* Clear written English to report standard
* Works effectively to transaction deadlines and is comfortable operating with incomplete information


**What Would Also Help**
* Experience running or contributing to a technical training programme
* Sector depth in one or more of industrials, business services, consumer, healthcare or technology
* Sell\-side as well as buy\-side experience
* Alteryx, Power Query or Power BI
* Exposure to UK or European deal processes


**How We Will Assess You**
 A screening call, a technical interview, a case study, and a conversation with the Transaction Services lead you will be working with. We will tell you where you stand after each stage.
   

  

**Our Values:**
**Embrace different: \-** 
 From cultures to mindsets, we welcome them all. Our global presence means we're inclusive by nature and we believe that people are equal, but not the same.
   

  

**Do the right thing:** 
 \- Our comfort zone is uncomfortable; we always make the right decision not what is simply easy or popular. Always consider how to implement these decisions, people will always remember how you made them feel.
   

  

**All hands on deck:** 
 \- We stand shoulder to shoulder with colleagues and clients, be that physically or from afar. Our individual expertise may find them answers, but it is through teamwork that it is implemented.
   

  

**Passion drives success:** 
 \- The impossible is always possible, we push the boundaries of what is expected because we're never satisfied with the status quo. Our clients expect a positive result when they engage with us, and it's only by delivering this that we win.
   

  

**Benefits**
****Benefits****
* Opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced global organisation and build deep expertise in M\&A integration
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and executive management
* Competitive salary package, aligned with experience and market standards
* International exposure, working with multicultural teams across multiple regions

**Job Description:**
 Lead/Assistant Manager – ICFR (Business Controls)
   

  

 Location: Sector\- 62, Gurugram
   

  

 Shift timings: 3:30 pm\- 12 am
   

  

 Mode: Hybrid
   

  

 Department: ICFR
   

  

 Reports To: Associate Director
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Financial Control Analyst – ICFR (2nd Line of Defense) plays a vital role in validating the integrity of Sun Life’s financial and actuarial processes, and external reporting. Reporting to the Director, ICFR in the Financial Controls department, this role supports management and assurance activities by evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of key financial and actuarial controls, which underpin CEO/CFO certifications and regulatory compliance requirements.
   

  

 The analyst partners with Finance, Actuarial, and underlying Operational process owners and external auditors to plan and execute control walkthroughs, testing, and deficiency evaluation. The position offers broad exposure to ICFR across the end\-to\-end financial close and actuarial reporting lifecycle and provides meaningful opportunities to deepen expertise in financial and actuarial control frameworks within a digitally transforming organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Execute ICFR Control Evaluation Program
   

  

* Coordinate and lead internal control walkthroughs with Finance, Actuarial, and Operational process owners (and external auditors as applicable) to confirm process understanding, key risks, and control points across the end\-to\-end lifecycle.
* Perform testing of operational, financial close, and actuarial reporting controls (e.g., policy set\-up, data activity reviews, reconciliations, journal entry controls, management review controls, reserve review controls, and assumption governance) in accordance with professional audit standards and established deadlines.
* Evaluate control deficiencies, support root cause analysis, and perform remediation validation testing to confirm corrective actions are effectively implemented.


 Support Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Assess control effectiveness across operational processes, the financial close, and actuarial reporting; identify gaps and opportunities to strengthen the control environment.
* Partner with process and control owners to enhance the sustainability of controls through clearer procedures, evidence standards, and consistent execution across the close and actuarial reporting cycle.
* Remain informed about emerging risks, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices relevant to ICFR, financial reporting, and actuarial governance.


 Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement
   

  

* Liaise with external auditors to coordinate walkthroughs, testing, and evidence requests related to operational, financial close, and actuarial reporting controls.
* Build strong working relationships with cross\-functional stakeholders across Operations, Finance, and Actuarial to drive timely walkthroughs, testing, and issue resolution.
* Communicate testing results, deficiencies, and observations clearly and professionally to team management, including recommended remediation actions.


 Quality and Professional Development
   

  

* Maintain high standards for walkthrough and testing documentation, including clear testing narratives, risk/control mappings, and sufficient audit evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and standardization of walkthrough and testing approaches for operational, financial close, and actuarial reporting controls.
* Proactively develop technical and professional skills in financial and actuarial control evaluation, including ICFR requirements, deficiency evaluation, and effective remediation practices.


**What You Bring**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CA, CPA, CISA, or progress toward a relevant professional certification.
* Typically, 2\.5\- 8 years of experience in audit, controls, or risk management, with exposure to ICFR/SOX environments.
* Public accounting experience is strongly preferred.


 Technical Knowledge
   

  

* Working knowledge of ICFR/SOX and COSO frameworks.
* Familiarity with control walkthroughs, testing techniques, and audit documentation standards.


 Core Skills
   

  

* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze control designs, identify risks, and assess operating effectiveness.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain control concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Execution Focus: Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple testing activities, and meet deadlines in a structured environment.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working as part of a team and engaging constructively with stakeholders at various levels.


 Valued Assets
   

  

* Experience in insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries.
* Experience with actuarial concepts and evaluating actuarial internal controls.
* Prior experience supporting external audit engagements.


**About Sun Life**
 Sun Life is a leading international financial services organization providing insurance, wealth, and asset management solutions to individual and corporate Clients. Sun Life has operations in a number of markets worldwide, Head Quartered in Canada. Other Location include the United States, Ireland, Business in Asia \- Hong Kong, Philippines, Indonesia, Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Bermuda. SLF also operates its JV in India \& China,
   

  

**Sun Life Global Solutions (SLGS)**
 SLGS is a global in\-house shared services center for Sun Life businesses across the globe. The term ‘SLGS’ is collectively used for its two centers in India \& Philippines. SLGS has achieved scale and operational maturity, is now a strong 4,500\+ employee organization. Our service portfolio includes:
   

  

* Operations: which covers Business Processing and Client Care Centre (CCC i.e. voice services) support;
* Technology: which covers Application Development and Management, DevOps, Support, Testing, Digital and Data Analytics, Robotics, and Infrastructure Services;
* Knowledge Services: which includes Corporate Investments team in Public Fixed Income, Private Fixed Income, Mortgages and Compliance;
* Business Excellence: which includes operational, and technology process quality assurance, process training, business reporting, methodologies (Agile, Lean, Process Improvement);
* Global innovation hub \- use technology innovation available through start\-ups and combine its own understanding of SLF business and clients to solve business problems.

title: Finance Manager, Trilogy (Remote) - $100,000/year USD
description:
Most finance managers gradually stop doing finance. Their calendars fill with status meetings, task chasing, and people administration while their technical skills go stale. This role takes the opposite path.
   

  

 You will run global finance operations through a team of Senior Accountants while staying close enough to the work to know whether it is actually right. You'll inspect invoices, payments, reconciliations, allocations, and other finance outputs; diagnose the accounting or process failures behind errors; and turn those findings into written coaching that prevents the same mistakes from happening again. When a critical deadline or difficult finance problem demands it, you will still be capable of getting hands\-on yourself.
   

  

 Trilogy's Central Finance team operates differently from a traditional accounting organization. We automate routine coordination and continuously look for ways AI and automation can eliminate manual work, leaving finance professionals focused on judgment, quality, and improvement. You'll get exposure to complex global finance operations while retaining the technical edge that many managers lose as they advance. If you want management responsibility without becoming a professional meeting\-attendee, this is where your accounting expertise becomes leverage.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Keep finance operations moving through Senior Accountants, continuously prioritizing work based on deadlines, business impact, dependencies, and financial risk.
* Inspect finance dashboards and completed work to ensure bills, invoices, payments, bank transactions, reconciliations, control accounts, revenue, and spend allocations are accurate and current.
* Diagnose quality failures using your own accounting expertise, identifying whether the root cause is incorrect data, system configuration, accounting treatment, or process execution.
* Write evidence\-based coaching that explains what went wrong, how to correct it, and how to prevent it from happening again.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, LLMs, and automation to eliminate manual work and improve the speed and accuracy of finance operations.


**What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Spending your week chasing status updates, assigning routine tasks, or sitting in project\-management meetings.
* Personally processing every transaction because delegating is easier than developing a strong accounting team.
* Giving generic performance feedback disconnected from actual invoices, payments, reconciliations, reports, or other finance outputs.
* Accepting recurring errors and inefficient manual processes as “just how finance works.”


**Finance Manager Key Responsibilities**
 Build a high\-performing finance operations team that consistently produces accurate, timely finance deliverables while continuously improving quality and reducing unnecessary manual work.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**
* A degree in Accounting or Finance.
* A recognized professional accounting qualification such as CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent.
* Experience on at least five audits involving a Big 4 accounting firm, either as the auditor or the client.
* Accounting or finance experience within an organization with at least $100M USD in revenue.
* People\-management experience with direct responsibility for finance or accounting professionals.
* Hands\-on experience across AP, AR/customer invoicing, bank and control\-account reconciliations, and revenue and spend allocation.
* Experience prioritizing and allocating operational finance work across a team while managing deadlines and resolving blockers.
* Experience embedding AI or LLM tools into a recurring, high\-volume finance transaction\-processing workflow, beyond ad hoc prompting or reporting\-only analysis, with a clear impact on efficiency or accuracy.
* Ability to work US business hours.


**Nice\-to\-have Requirements**
* Experience designing or building finance workflow automations using tools such as n8n, Lovable, Claude Code, or similar platforms.
* Experience managing finance operations across multiple business lines or international entities.


**About Trilogy**
 Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses.
   

  

 Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer\-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon\-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud\-based stack.
   

  

 Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career in leaps and bounds.
   

  

 There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**Working with us**
 This is a full\-time (40 hours per week), long\-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $50 USD/hour, which equates to $100,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult www.crossover.com/help\-and\-faqs for more details on this topic.

title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting**
